Result: 在室内和室外语义分割任务上均超越先前最佳方法。在未见球面变换下，相对mIoU较次优方法在Stanford2D3D上提升13.38%，在WildPASS上提升18.77%。轻量级变体AdapToPASS-Swift参数少于200万，超越紧凑型基线且保持球面变换鲁棒性。

Conclusion: AdapToPASS通过模仿生物视觉的歧义感知机制，有效解决了球面Transformer在复杂变换下的鲁棒性问题，同时兼顾了性能与效率，为全景语义分割领域提供了新的生物启发设计方向。

Abstract: Spherical Transformers have emerged as a promising framework for panoramic semantic segmentation (PASS) by operating directly on spherical geometry and alleviating projection-induced distortions. However, existing architectures often assume canonical spherical structure and stable viewpoints, which are frequently violated in real-world imagery due to unconstrained camera motion, introducing contextual and geometric ambiguity. Consequently, they lack adaptive mechanisms to handle such ambiguity, limiting robustness to unseen spherical transformations. In contrast, biological perception is inherently ambiguity-aware, adapting to fluctuations in cue reliability caused by geometric and contextual variations to maintain stable interpretation under complex transformations. Motivated by this, we first systematically analyze existing PASS architectures under various unseen spherical transformations. We then introduce AdapToPASS, a novel bio-inspired Spherical Transformer that adaptively models contextual and geometric ambiguities for robust PASS. At its core, Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA) blocks dynamically modulate attention according to local contextual ambiguity, mimicking adaptive, context-driven biological perception. To address geometric ambiguity, AdapToPASS employs Bifocal Spherical Representation to balance field of view and spatial resolution, together with boundary supervision inspired by the boundary-sensitive nature of biological vision. Across indoor and outdoor semantic segmentation, AdapToPASS consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods. Under unseen spherical transformations, it surpasses the next-best method by +13.38% relative mIoU on Stanford2D3D and +18.77% on WildPASS. We further introduce AdapToPASS-Swift, a lightweight variant with fewer than 2M parameters, which surpasses compact baselines while retaining robustness to spherical transformations.

</details>


### [60] [Elastic Triangle Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29106)
*Tian Shi,Shenhan Qian,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统分析三角形拼接（triangle splatting）中核函数的设计对优化行为的影响，并提出一种弹性核函数（elastic kernel），具备双向梯度支持和自适应边界值，在形状重建和新视角合成任务中均优于现有核函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯拼接等神经渲染方法视觉保真度高，但传统多边形网格仍是图形管线的核心。三角形拼接通过将三角形基元作为可微拼接来桥接二者，其核心是软化三角形边界的核函数。然而现有方法对核函数的选择不一致，且分析局限于无序三角形汤的新视角合成任务，缺乏对核函数优化行为的系统对比。

Method: 将三角形拼接作为通用光度优化工具，通过两个互补任务（网格形状重建优化与三角形汤新视角合成优化）对比核函数性质；提出弹性核函数，包含跨边界的双向梯度支持与自适应边界值两个关键特性，并进行隔离对比实验。

Result: 弹性核函数在形状重建任务上全面优于现有核函数，并在大多数新视角合成基准上取得更优表现，验证了核函数设计对三角形拼接有效性和通用性的关键作用。

Conclusion: 核函数设计是三角形拼接优化鲁棒性与泛化能力的重要决定因素，双向梯度支持和自适应边界值是实现稳健优化的关键，弹性核函数为三角形拼接在多任务场景下的广泛应用提供了有力工具。

Abstract: While neural rendering methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting achieve remarkable visual fidelity, traditional polygonal meshes remain the backbone of established graphics pipelines. Triangle splatting bridges this gap by optimizing triangle primitives as differentiable splats, producing representations that are closer to mesh-based workflows. Central to these methods is the kernel function that softens triangle boundaries to propagate gradients to vertex positions. Existing triangle splatting methods make inconsistent choices of kernel functions, and analysis of these kernels' optimization behavior has been limited to unstructured triangle soups for novel-view synthesis. In this work, we consider triangle splatting as a generic tool for photometric optimization, comparing kernel properties through two complementary tasks: mesh optimization for shape reconstruction and triangle soup optimization for novel-view synthesis. Along with the analysis, we introduce an elastic kernel function that features bilateral gradient support across the boundary and an adaptive boundary value, which are shown to be essential for robust optimization. Under isolated comparison, our elastic kernel outperforms existing kernels on shape reconstruction and in the majority of novel-view synthesis benchmarks, demonstrating the importance of kernel design in the effectiveness and versatility of triangle splatting.

</details>


### [61] [NFAD: Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29112)
*Dat Cao,Son Nghiem,Phan Nguyen,Jun Rekimoto,Jhih-Ciang Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection (NFAD)框架，通过显式建模成像条件变化引起的干扰（如光照、背景、视角等）来应对分布偏移下的异常检测问题。NFAD从内容保持扰动引发的特征位移中估计干扰子空间，并在推理时抑制其对异常残差的贡献，同时通过全投影和选择性抑制两个互补分支分别处理图像级检测和像素级定位。在AeBAD-S基准上达到91.0%图像级AUROC，刷新SOTA，同时在VisA、Real-IAD、MVTec AD等标准基准上保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异常检测基准在受控采集条件下已趋于饱和，但真实部署中存在光照、背景、视角等环境因素变化，这些分布偏移会使正常样本偏离学习到的正常分布，产生虚假异常响应。作者旨在解决无异常标签、无目标域数据条件下的分布偏移异常检测问题。

Method: NFAD框架在特征空间中显式建模干扰变化。核心思路：(1) 通过内容保持扰动诱导的匹配特征位移来估计干扰子空间；(2) 在推理时抑制该子空间对异常残差的贡献；(3) 采用两个互补分支——全投影用于图像级检测，选择性抑制用于像素级定位，以保留局部缺陷证据。

Result: 在AeBAD-S基准上达到91.0%图像级AUROC，创下新SOTA；在VisA、Real-IAD和MVTec AD等标准基准上保持竞争力，表明鲁棒性提升未牺牲常规异常检测性能。

Conclusion: 显式抑制干扰变化能有效提升分布偏移下的异常检测鲁棒性，同时保持标准场景下的强性能，验证了该方法的有效性和通用性。

Abstract: Recent advances in anomaly detection (AD) for industrial inspection have pushed performance on standard benchmarks toward saturation. However, strong benchmark performance does not necessarily translate to real-world deployment, as these benchmarks are primarily collected under controlled acquisition conditions. Changes in illumination, background, viewpoint, and other environmental factors can shift normal samples away from the learned normal distribution and cause false anomaly responses. We address AD under such distribution shifts by explicitly modeling nuisance variation from changing imaging conditions in feature space. Without anomaly labels or target-domain data, our Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection (NFAD) framework estimates a nuisance subspace from matched feature displacements induced by content-preserving perturbations and suppresses its contribution to anomaly residuals at inference. The same subspace supports two complementary branches: full projection for image-level detection and selective suppression for pixel-level localization, preserving evidence of localized defects. On AeBAD-S, a benchmark specifically designed for AD under acquisition shifts, NFAD achieves 91.0\% image-level AUROC, establishing a new state of the art. Notably, this robustness does not come at the expense of conventional AD performance: NFAD remains competitive on standard benchmarks that do not explicitly evaluate distribution shift, including VisA, Real-IAD, and MVTec AD. These results show that explicitly suppressing such nuisance variation improves AD under distribution shift while preserving strong performance in standard settings.

</details>


### [62] [GramLoop: Training-Free Gram-Gated Replay for Robust Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29113)
*Yang Chen,Canyu Shen,Xinzhe Rao,Yuanyi Yan,Yunlu Chen,Meng Tang,Teng Long,Vincent Tao Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GramLoop是一种无需训练的推理时框架，通过在冻结的DINOv3视觉骨干内重放短transformer窗口，并用最终层余弦-Gram一致性控制每次重放，来提升分布偏移下的密集预测性能，无需改变模型权重、任务适配器或预测头。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结的DINOv3密集预测模型在分布偏移下性能下降，而现有方法或需要微调、或需要修改任务适配器。核心挑战在于：在骨干内重复transformer块计算时，需保持DINOv3用于空间结构保持的成对patch关系不被破坏。

Method: GramLoop是一个训练自由的框架：(1) 重放一个短的transformer窗口；(2) 通过最终层的余弦-Gram一致性控制每次重放；(3) 每个提议候选被传播通过冻结的后续层；(4) 与标准DINOv3轨迹进行比较；(5) 在重放窗口端点通过patch级门控接受或拒绝提议。

Result: 在对象检测和语义分割的多种分布偏移（损坏、扰动、自然偏移）下，GramLoop在所有五个偏移基准上均优于配对DINOv3基线。在COCO-O上，mAP提升+0.252，有效鲁棒性提升+0.250，同时保持了干净的ADE20K性能。

Conclusion: GramLoop通过训练自由的推理时计算增强，在保持干净场景性能的同时显著提升了DINOv3在分布偏移下的密集预测能力，展示了在视觉骨干内部加推理计算而不改变权重的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: We aim to improve frozen DINOv3 dense-prediction models under distribution shift by adding inference computation inside the visual backbone, without changing model weights, task adapters, or prediction heads. The challenge is that repeated transformer-block computation must refine dense features without disrupting the pairwise patch relations that DINOv3 uses to preserve spatial structure. We introduce GramLoop, a training-free framework that replays a short transformer window and controls each replay through final-layer cosine-Gram consistency. Each proposal is propagated through the frozen suffix, measured against the standard DINOv3 trajectory, and accepted through a patchwise gate at the replay-window endpoint. Across object detection and semantic segmentation under corruptions, perturbations, and natural shifts, GramLoop improves all five shifted benchmarks over the paired DINOv3 baseline. On COCO-O, it improves mAP by +0.252 and Effective Robustness by +0.250, while preserving clean ADE20K performance. Code will be released.

</details>


### [63] [Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29121)
*Tianrui Hui,Shaofei Huang,Qisong Han,Yaxiong Wang,Lechao Cheng,Zhedong Zheng,Zhun Zhong,Richang Hong,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AGCL框架解决开放词汇音频-视觉语义分割问题，通过音频调制成本生成和音频引导时间聚合实现类别特定的发声目标分割，并引入协同干扰挖掘策略提升判别能力，在AVSBench-OV数据集上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 之前的方法依赖类别无关的前景定义，将语义多样的目标归入异质正样本集合，导致模型学习到不稳定的发声模式并产生不可靠的提议。因此需要将目标重新定义为类别特定的发声目标分割。

Method: 提出声学接地成本学习(AGCL)框架，将静态的、与音频无关的视觉-文本先验转化为动态的、音频接地的成本表示。包含三个核心模块：(1)音频调制成本生成(AMCG)和音频引导时间聚合(AGTA)模块，通过低侵入式音频注入实现帧级发声区域高亮和视频级时间细化；(2)协同干扰挖掘(SDM)策略，选择性惩罚声学和语义上混淆的负类别，学习更具判别性的决策边界。

Result: 在AVSBench-OV数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法，特别是在未见类别上表现突出。

Conclusion: 通过将目标从类别无关转变为类别特定的发声物体分割，并结合低侵入式音频注入和干扰挖掘策略，有效解决了开放词汇音频-视觉语义分割中发声模式不稳定和提议不可靠的问题。

Abstract: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (OV-AVSS) aims to perform pixel-level segmentation of sound-emitting objects from an open set of categories. The previous method relies on a class-agnostic foreground definition, which groups semantically diverse objects into a heterogeneous positive set, causing the model to learn unstable sounding patterns and produce unreliable proposals. To address this, we reformulate the objective to be category-specific and propose a novel Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning (AGCL) framework to transform the static, audio-agnostic visual-text priors into dynamic, audio-grounded cost representations. For intra-category soundingness discovery, we devise Audio-Modulated Cost Generation (AMCG) and Audio-Guided Temporal Aggregation (AGTA) modules to enable both frame-level sounding region highlighting and video-level temporal refinement with a low-intrusive audio injection mechanism. For inter-category distractor discrimination, we introduce a Synergistic Distractor Mining (SDM) strategy, which selectively penalizes acoustically and semantically confusing negative categories to learn more discriminative decision boundaries. Extensive experiments on the AVSBench-OV dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches, particularly on unseen categories. Code is available at https://github.com/spyflying/AGCL.

</details>


### [64] [Dancing Stick Figures: An Introductory Dataset for Training Video Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29123)
*Jin Hyuk Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了"Dancing Stick Figures"，一个为视频生成模型训练设计的合成视频数据集，针对三大痛点：训练反馈循环长、数据难以获取、评估指标模糊。数据集包含64x64、64帧的参考任务，0.79GB的训练规模（4,020个视频片段），并提供相机、深度、法线、部件标签等完整标注，支持细粒度的数据集专属评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型从零训练面临三个结构性障碍：(1)反馈循环长——只有在训练运行结束后才能发现失败，导致每次修复都需要重新训练；(2)数据难以获取——强模型的语料库和配方规模大、异构且常未公开；(3)评分粗糙——开放生成没有唯一正确答案，聚合分数无法定位具体失败样本或失败属性。这些障碍在模型设计之前就已存在。

Method: 构建"跳舞火柴人"合成视频数据集：(1)迭代速度——设计64x64、64帧的参考任务，可在单工作站GPU上实际重复训练；(2)可访问性——发布0.79GB训练数据，含4,020个视频片段（1,340个六秒源运动，每段由确定性数据生成工具从三个相机视角渲染），并提供检查点及可在16GB Tesla T4上以缩减预算复跑参考训练流程的Colab工作流；(3)评分——每帧保留生成状态（ARDY cskel27关节位置、相机、身体参数、源运动）、逐像素深度、表面法线和部件标签，支持可见拓扑和部件级运动的数据集专属指标，并通过破坏实验暴露指标敏感性和盲点。

Result: 生成了一个带有完整标注的合成视频数据集，支持细粒度的评估：通过保留每帧生成状态和逐像素标注（深度、法线、部件标签），实现了可见拓扑和部件级运动的自定义评估指标；同时通过corruptions实验揭示了这些指标对特定扰动（如时间异常、空间变形）的敏感性和检测盲区。

Conclusion: Dancing Stick Figures通过精心设计的合成数据策略，针对性地缓解了视频生成研究的三大障碍：以小型化任务提升迭代速度，以轻量开源降低数据门槛，以丰富标注支撑细粒度评估。该数据集有望成为视频生成模型诊断和快速验证的标准测试平台。

Abstract: Training a video-generation model from scratch is hard for reasons that precede model design. The feedback loop is long: a failure that appears only after a training run can make each attempted fix another run. The data are hard to reach: the corpora and recipes behind strong models are large, heterogeneous, and often unreleased. And scoring is blunt: open-ended generation has no single correct output, and an aggregate score does not by itself establish whether a sample succeeds or which property failed. Dancing Stick Figures is a synthetic video dataset built against these three obstacles. For iteration speed, its 64x64, 64-frame reference task is sized for practical repeated training on a single workstation GPU. For accessibility, the release is a 0.79-GB training tier of 4,020 video clips--1,340 six-second source motions, each rendered from three cameras by a deterministic dataset-generation harness--with checkpoints and a Colab workflow that reruns the reference training pipeline at reduced budget on a 16 GB Tesla T4. For scoring, every frame retains its generating state (ARDY cskel27 joint positions, camera, body parameters, and source motion) and per-pixel depth, surface normals, and part labels. These annotations support dataset-specific metrics for visible topology and part-wise motion; corruptions expose their sensitivities and blind spots.

</details>


### [65] [Efficient Language-to-Vision Feature Injection for Referring Single-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29126)
*Han Wang,Yuxuan Liu,Yuhan Sun,Jian Yang,Xiaotong Xu,Yixuan Lv,Zhuang Zhou,Shengyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LVTrack是一种纯transformer框架，通过模式条件门控特征注入器自适应调节文本引导以缓解语义漂移，直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型降低训练成本，并结合混合位置编码、轻量级记忆机制和高斯平滑KL损失提升时间定位能力，在标准基准上取得强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指代单目标跟踪的核心难点在于语言在不同阶段的使用方式不同：语言对目标接地必不可少，但在跟踪阶段过度强调会导致语义漂移。此外，现有方法通常需要昂贵的视觉-语言对齐训练。

Method: 提出LVTrack纯transformer框架，包含：(1)模式条件门控特征注入器自适应调节文本引导；(2)直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型；(3)混合相对-绝对位置编码与轻量级记忆机制；(4)基于高斯平滑KL损失的自回归框预测优化。

Result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明LVTrack取得了强性能。

Conclusion: LVTrack通过自适应门控机制有效缓解了语义漂移问题，同时利用冻结的预训练模型大幅降低了训练成本，验证了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Referring single-object tracking enables language-grounded target initialization and subsequent tracking by jointly leveraging semantic cues and visual templates. The core difficulty is to use language differently across stages: it is indispensable for grounding but can induce semantic drift during tracking when overemphasized. Meanwhile, current methods often require costly vision-language alignment training. We present LVTrack, a pure transformer framework that introduces a mode-conditioned Gated Feature Injector to adaptively regulate textual guidance and alleviate semantic drift. Together with targeted adaptations, it directly harnesses a frozen vision-language pretrained model, greatly reducing training cost and preserving strong language understanding. To further improve temporal localization, LVTrack integrates hybrid relative-absolute positional encodings with a lightweight memory mechanism and optimizes autoregressive box prediction using a Gaussian-smoothed KL loss. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that LVTrack achieves strong performance.

</details>


### [66] [Chat-Edit-3D++: Interactive 3D and 4D Scene Editing via Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29137)
*Shuangkang Fang,Yufeng Wang,Yi-Hsuan Tsai,Wenrui Ding,Yi Yang,Shuchang Zhou,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CE3D++，一种基于对话的3D场景编辑方法。通过引入Hash-Atlas网络将3D场景编辑重构为2D Atlas图像上的操作，解耦2D编辑与3D重建流程，并以大型语言模型（LLM）为核心，允许用户任意文本输入，自主调用相应视觉模型完成编辑。此外，该方法扩展至单目4D场景，并通过轨迹数据集微调LLM，使其能调度多达30种视觉工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D场景编辑方案存在以下不足：1）输入模式固定，文本输入灵活性受限；2）编辑能力受限于单一或少数2D视觉模型；3）需要复杂的pipeline设计来集成模型到3D重建流程中，阻碍其发展为交互式设计工具。

Method: 1）提出Hash-Atlas网络，将3D场景编辑转化为2D Atlas图像操作，实现2D编辑与3D重建的解耦；2）设计CE3D++对话式3D编辑框架，以LLM为核心理解用户意图并自主调用视觉模型；3）扩展至单目4D场景，对运动物体施加运动约束；4）构建轨迹数据集微调较小LLM，使其能准确调度多达30种视觉工具。

Result: 实验结果表明，CE3D++能有效集成多种视觉模型实现多样化的视觉编辑效果，具备强大的场景理解能力和多轮对话能力。

Conclusion: CE3D++通过解耦2D编辑与3D重建流程并以LLM为核心驱动，显著提升了3D场景编辑的灵活性与扩展性，为交互式3D设计工具的发展提供了新思路。代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Recent work on image content manipulation based on vision-language pre-training models has been effectively extended to text-driven 3D scene editing. However, existing schemes for 3D scene editing still have certain shortcomings, hindering their further development as interactive design tools. Such schemes typically adhere to fixed input patterns, limiting flexibility in text input. Furthermore, their editing capabilities are constrained by a single or a few 2D visual models and require intricate pipeline design to integrate these models into 3D reconstruction processes. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose the Hash-Atlas network, which reformulates 3D scene editing as operations on 2D atlas images, thereby achieving a workflow decoupling of the 2D editing and 3D reconstruction processes. Building on this foundation, we introduce a dialogue-based 3D scene editing approach, termed CE3D++, which is centered on a large language model (LLM) that allows arbitrary textual input from users and interprets their intentions, subsequently facilitating the autonomous invocation of the corresponding visual models. Additionally, we extend CE3D++ to monocular 4D scenes by imposing motion constraints on moving objects and further fine-tuning the LLM by creating a trajectory dataset related to editing tasks, which enables the smaller LLM to schedule up to 30 different visual tools accurately. Experimental results demonstrate that CE3D++ effectively integrates multiple visual models to achieve diverse visual editing effects, possessing strong scene comprehension and multi-round dialog capabilities. The source codes and trained models are available at https://github.com/Fangkang515/CE3D.

</details>


### [67] [STARLINC: Satellite Trail Artifact Removal using Inter-Frame Correlation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29145)
*Shingeon Kim,Hyeyoon Lee,Dain Kwon,Kanghyun Choi,Sunjong Park,Mi-Ryang Kim,Jeong-Eun Lee,Jinho Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STARLINC是首个无需像素级标注的ML框架，用于从天文图像中去除卫星轨迹。它结合合成轨迹生成训练、时间相邻曝光的帧间差分图突出瞬态轨迹，以及热图提供像素级分割的定位线索，在真实数据上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低轨卫星（如Starlink）的快速增长正污染天文巡天观测数据。人工筛查不可行，现有通用线条检测方法因域不匹配无法泛化到天文图像（灰度、稀疏亮星、低信噪比），且缺乏大规模标注数据集，难以从头训练新模型。

Method: STARLINC采用三管齐下的方法：(1) 合成卫星轨迹生成用于训练数据；(2) 利用时间相邻曝光的帧间差分图突出瞬态轨迹；(3) 使用热图提供额外的定位线索以辅助像素级分割。

Result: 在真实世界数据上的大量实验表明，STARLINC显著优于现有基线方法，证明了其作为下一代天文巡天可扩展解决方案的有效性。

Conclusion: STARLINC解决了天文图像卫星轨迹去除中缺乏标注数据和域不匹配的核心挑战，为下一代天文巡天提供了一个可扩展、无需繁琐像素级标注的解决方案。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of low Earth orbit satellites such as Starlink is increasingly contaminating astronomical surveys. In practice, contaminated images are often identified through inspection. However, modern surveys generate terabytes of data each night, making manual screening infeasible and necessitating reliable automated methods for satellite trail removal. Unfortunately, existing general-domain line detection methods fail to generalize to astronomical images due to domain mismatch, which are mostly grayscale with sparse bright stars and have a low signal-to-noise ratio. Moreover, training new models from scratch is impractical due to the lack of large-scale annotated astronomical datasets. To address these challenges, we introduce STARLINC, the first ML-based framework for satellite trail removal without requiring tedious pixel-level annotation of astronomical images. STARLINC combines synthetic satellite trail generation for training, inter-frame differential maps from temporally adjacent exposures to highlight transient trails, and heatmaps to provide additional localization cues for pixel-level segmentation. Extensive experiments on real-world data demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines, establishing STARLINC as a scalable solution for next-generation astronomical surveys. Code is available at https://github.com/starioKim/STARLINC.

</details>


### [68] [SGRNet: Spatially Guided Radiology Network for Structured Radiological Reporting of Head and Neck Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29153)
*Ayush Gupta,Vinkle Srivastav,Prateek Upadhya,Amit Gupta,Krithika Rangarajan,Nicolas Padoy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SGRNet（空间引导放射学网络），将头颈癌（HNC）放射学报告生成重构为基于解剖的多标签结构化报告任务，通过自动化器官分割和弱监督肿瘤定位图（3D高斯热图）两个低成本空间先验，动态特征调制引导网络，在184例多中心CECT数据上mAP达0.60，较强3D基线提升8.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自由文本报告生成模型存在密集区域的幻觉风险，且在数据稀缺场景下表现不佳；头颈癌CECT成像缺乏代谢影像（如PET）信息的视觉补充，导致肿瘤定位困难。

Method: 将报告生成重构为解剖学基础的多标签结构化报告任务，预测分层临床模式下的局部肿瘤累及；提出SGRNet，引入两个低成本空间先验（自动化器官分割和通过3D高斯热图建模的弱监督肿瘤定位图），并通过空间特征调制动态集成这些先验，引导网络关注细微的肿瘤诱导结构改变。

Result: 在多中心184例HNC CECT数据集上，五个临床密集解剖亚区上SGRNet达到mAP 0.60，较强体积3D基线绝对提升8.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过结构化的解剖学报告范式结合空间先验，可有效缓解自由文本生成中的幻觉风险和数据稀缺问题，同时弥补缺失代谢成像的视觉信息，提升头颈癌报告的临床安全性和准确性。

Abstract: Automated radiological report generation can alleviate clinical workloads and eliminate observer variability. However, standard free-text generation models pose hallucination risks in dense regions and fail under data scarcity. We address these challenges in Head and Neck Cancer (HNC) from contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) imaging. To enforce factual safety, we reformulate report generation as an anatomically grounded, multi-label, structured reporting task, predicting localized tumor involvement across a hierarchical clinical schema. To bridge the visual gap from missing metabolic imaging (e.g., PET), we introduce SGRNet (Spatially Guided Radiology Network), incorporating two low-cost spatial priors: automated organ segmentations and weakly supervised tumor localization maps modeled via 3D Gaussian heatmaps. These priors are dynamically integrated via spatial feature modulation to guide the network toward subtle tumor-induced structural alterations. Evaluated on a multi-centric dataset of 184 paired HNC CECT volumes and reports, on five clinically salient, densely packed anatomical subsites, SGRNet achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.60, an 8.8 percentage-point absolute improvement over strong volume-only 3D baselines.

</details>


### [69] [Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29160)
*Yuanyi Yan,Xinzhe Rao,Canyu Shen,Yang Chen,Yunlu Chen,Meng Tang,Teng Long,Vincent Tao Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需训练的循环（looping）框架，通过在冻结的flow-matching图像生成器（denoiser）内部重复应用选定Transformer层来增加推理计算量，从而提升生成质量，而不改变模型权重或外部采样器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成器通常通过增加采样步数来消耗额外测试时间计算，但这会反复评估整个denoiser，将质量提升与采样器成本耦合。作者希望在不改变模型结构和采样流程的前提下，将额外计算投放到冻结Transformer denoiser内部，提升生成质量。

Method: 提出训练自由的循环框架：在每次denoising调用中重复应用选定的Transformer层。包含多种变体：Dense/Sparse Token Loop控制token范围；Sampling-Progress Gating和loop layer range决定循环激活的时机与位置；loop count和strength控制重复更新的强度；Loop Guidance结合普通与循环向量场预测。

Result: 在两种Scale-RAE模型规模上，循环变体提升了主要和辅助质量指标，并具备有竞争力的质量-效率权衡。Loop Guidance在全部三个测试模型上均提升了两个主要指标；在Scale-RAE DiT2.4B上，GenEval从0.4471提升至0.5691，DPG-Bench从0.7656提升至0.8053。

Conclusion: 通过推理时在denoiser内部循环应用Transformer层，可以在不改变模型权重和外部采样器的情况下有效提升flow-matching图像生成质量，Loop Guidance是最有效的变体。

Abstract: We aim to improve frozen flow-matching image generators by adding inference computation inside the denoiser, without changing model weights or the outer sampler. Existing generators usually spend extra test-time computation by increasing the number of sampling steps, which repeatedly evaluates the entire denoiser and couples quality gains to sampler cost. A key challenge is how to use extra computation inside a frozen transformer denoiser: the method must decide which tokens, layers, and sampling times receive repeated updates while preserving the original generation pipeline. We introduce a training-free looping framework that repeatedly applies selected transformer layers inside each denoising call. Dense and Sparse Token Loop vary the token scope; Sampling-Progress Gating and the loop layer range specify when and where looping is active; loop count and strength control the repeated updates; and Loop Guidance combines ordinary and looped vector-field predictions. Across two Scale-RAE model scales, loop variants improve primary and auxiliary quality metrics with competitive quality--efficiency trade-offs. Loop Guidance further improves both primary metrics across all three tested models; on Scale-RAE DiT2.4B, it raises GenEval from 0.4471 to 0.5691 and DPG-Bench from 0.7656 to 0.8053. Code will be released.

</details>


### [70] [Subtraction-Based Tumor Segmentation and Lesion-Centered pCR Prediction for the MAMA-MIA Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29162)
*Kai Geissler,Raphael Schäfer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FME团队在MAMA-MIA挑战赛中的方案：使用五折残差编码器nnU-Net集成进行肿瘤分割（仅用首期增强减影图像），集成25个预训练3D视频分类器进行pCR预测。两项任务均获第二名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证分割与pCR预测方法在外部多国队列上的泛化能力，应对跨站点域偏移挑战，探索基线性DCE-MRI对pCR预测的局限性。

Method: 分割：五折残差编码器nnU-Net集成，输入为第一增强期减影图像，结合镜像测试增强和最大连通域滤波；pCR预测：集成25个预训练3D视频分类器，输入为病灶中心裁剪的3个体积（预造影及两个增强期）。

Result: 两项均排名第二。分割：综合性能-公平性得分0.882，Dice 0.713，归一化Hausdorff距离0.099；pCR预测：综合得分0.664，平衡准确率0.541，等几率差异0.212。

Conclusion: 减影输入和集成学习能支持跨站点域偏移下的稳健肿瘤分割；但仅凭基线DCE-MRI进行pCR预测的能力仍然有限。

Abstract: We describe the submission of team FME to the MAMA-MIA Challenge, which evaluated primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) from pretreatment dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI on an external multi-country cohort. For segmentation, we trained a five-fold residual-encoder nnU-Net ensemble using only the first post-contrast minus pre-contrast image, combined with mirroring test-time augmentation and largest-connected-component filtering. For pCR prediction, we ensembled 25 pretrained 3D video classifiers trained on lesion-centred crops from the pre-contrast and first two post-contrast volumes. FME ranked second in both tasks. The segmentation method achieved a combined performance-fairness score of 0.882, with Dice 0.713 and normalized Hausdorff distance 0.099. The pCR method achieved a combined score of 0.664, balanced accuracy of 0.541, and equalized-odds disparity of 0.212. The results indicate that subtraction-based input and ensembling support robust tumor segmentation under cross-site domain shift, whereas pCR prediction from baseline DCE-MRI alone remains limited.
  For the submission repository, see https://github.com/FraunhoferMEVIS/MAMA-MIA-Challenge-FME

</details>


### [71] [Mapping-Based Image Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29164)
*Freddie Åström,Michael Felsberg,George Baravdish*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于张量的新型泛函，用于目标图像增强和去噪。该泛函通过显式正则化整合了应用依赖和上下文信息，并证明了极小值的存在性、张量对称性约束、凸性及几何解释。在非线性应用（如伽马校正和目标值域滤波）中表现优异，同时在一般去噪任务中与基于PDE的最先进方法性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献中很少有变分模型能同时描述应用依赖信息和去噪问题的上下文知识。作者希望填补这一空白，构建一个统一的框架，使图像增强和去噪能够结合特定的应用场景（如伽马校正）而不仅仅是通用的去噪处理。

Method: 提出一种基于张量的变分泛函，通过显式正则化项将应用依赖信息和上下文信息（基于第一性原理）整合到模型中。作者从理论上证明了极小值的存在性，并分析了张量对称性约束、凸性以及泛函的几何解释。

Result: 该框架在存在非线性函数的应用中表现优异，例如伽马校正和针对性的值域范围过滤。在一般去噪性能方面，作者展示了与专用于PDE的先进方法相当的结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的张量变分框架为同时处理应用依赖信息与上下文知识的图像增强和去噪提供了一种新颖有效的方法，兼具理论严谨性与实际应用的灵活性。

Abstract: In this work, we introduce a novel tensor-based functional for targeted image enhancement and denoising. Via explicit regularization, our formulation incorporates application dependent and contextual information using first principles. Few works in literature treat variational models that describe both application dependent information and contextual knowledge of the denoising problem. We prove the existence of a minimizer and present results on tensor symmetry constraints, convexity, and geometric interpretation of the proposed functional. We show that our framework excels in applications where nonlinear functions are present such as in gamma correction and targeted value range filtering. We also study general denoising performance where we show comparable results to dedicated PDE-based state of the art methods.

</details>


### [72] [Feature-Spectral Fragility in Segmentation: Dataset Dependence, Architecture-Specific Localization, and Spectral Correlates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29167)
*Subhash Kashyap*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了三种分割架构（CNN、SSM、Transformer）在内部特征表示上的频率依赖性，通过在特征域进行低通滤波干预发现：特征谱鲁棒性强烈依赖数据集（CVC上退化严重，ISIC上轻微）、具有架构特异性（CNN峰值在中晚期编码器，SSM在早期编码器），且与输入域谱鲁棒性完全不同——Fourier数据增强无法改善特征域退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分割模型的鲁棒性通常通过输入域扰动来评估，但对特征表示中频率内容依赖性的理解仍然不足。作者希望系统性地探测特征域频率内容对分割模型性能的影响，以填补这一研究空白。

Method: 对三种分割架构（ResNet50-UNet CNN、VM-UNet SSM、Swin-UNETR Transformer）在CVC-ClinicDB和ISIC2018两个数据集上实施针对性训练后低通滤波干预（在rho=0.25截止频率），包括全阶段干预和单阶段干预以定位敏感层，同时进行原生特征域频谱测量和Fourier数据增强对比实验。

Result: 在rho=0.25时，CVC上Dice下降CNN为100%、SSM为73.2%、Transformer为30.9%，而ISIC上仅下降9.4%、10.3%、0.6%，跨数据集差异统计显著。敏感度定位显示CNN在中晚期编码器、SSM在早期编码器达到峰值。高频能量与脆弱性在CVC上呈负相关，ISIC上关系部分成立。Fourier增强改善输入域低通滤波鲁棒性但对特征域退化无改善。

Conclusion: 特征谱鲁棒性具有强烈数据集依赖性、架构特异性，且与输入域谱鲁棒性截然不同，是独立的鲁棒性维度，需要单独评估和针对性改进。

Abstract: Robustness of segmentation models is commonly assessed through input-domain perturbations, while dependence on frequency content within learned feature representations remains less understood. We probe this dependence using targeted post-training low-pass interventions on internal representations of three segmentation architectures, ResNet50-UNet (CNN), VM-UNet (SSM), and Swin-UNETR (Transformer), across CVC-ClinicDB and ISIC2018, with headline evaluations performed on untouched held-out test sets. At cutoff rho=0.25, feature-domain low-pass filtering causes severe degradation on CVC: Dice drops by 100%, 73.2%, and 30.9% for CNN, SSM, and Transformer, respectively, compared with 9.4%, 10.3%, and 0.6% on ISIC. The cross-dataset difference is statistically significant for every architecture. Single-stage interventions further show that sensitivity is localized at architecture-specific depths: the CNN peaks at a mid/late encoder block, whereas the SSM peaks in an early encoder stage on both datasets. Native feature-domain spectral measurements show an inverse association between high-frequency energy and fragility on CVC; the relationship is only partial on ISIC and is therefore treated as a candidate correlate rather than a proven mechanism. Finally, Fourier augmentation improves robustness to input-space low-pass filtering but leaves feature-domain degradation essentially unchanged. These results show that feature-spectral robustness is strongly dataset-dependent, architecture-specific, and distinct from input-domain spectral robustness.

</details>


### [73] [A Tensor Variational Formulation of Gradient Energy Total Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29172)
*Freddie Åström,George Baravdish,Michael Felsberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于张量的全变分新变分方法——梯度能量全变分（GETV），将梯度能量张量引入GETV框架，证明了其凸性，并推导出相应的欧拉-拉格朗日方程。实验表明在灰度及彩色图像去噪上优于EAD和TV等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的结构张量在变分框架中难以形式化推导对应的欧拉-拉格朗日方程，限制了张量型全变分方法的发展。作者希望引入梯度能量张量来解决这一问题。

Method: 提出梯度能量全变分（GETV）变分模型，将梯度能量张量引入全变分框架；给出GETV为凸泛函的数学证明；形式化推导出对应的张量型偏微分方程（欧拉-拉格朗日方程）。

Result: 实验结果表明，GETV在灰度图像和彩色图像去噪任务中优于扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和全变分（TV）等当前先进方法。

Conclusion: GETV作为一种新的张量型全变分方法，既具备凸性等良好数学性质，又能形式化推导E-L方程，且在实验中表现出优越的去噪性能。

Abstract: We present a novel variational approach to a tensor-based total variation formulation which is called gradient energy total variation, GETV. We introduce the gradient energy tensor [6] into the GETV and show that the corresponding Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation is a tensor-based partial differential equation of total variation type. Furthermore, we give a proof which shows that GETV is a convex functional. This approach, in contrast to the commonly used structure tensor, enables a formal derivation of the corresponding E-L equation. Experimental results suggest that GETV compares favourably to other state of the art variational denoising methods such as extended anisotropic diffusion (EAD)[1] and total variation (TV) [18] for gray-scale and colour images.

</details>


### [74] [Dynamic-Robust Photometric-Semantic Reconstruction for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29177)
*Boyu Cai,Li Yang,Yan Xu,Wei Liu,Nian Liu,Sikui Zhang,Yan Wang,Chunfeng Yuan,Weiming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPAR是一个联合语义-几何编码架构，通过显式隔离瞬态动态噪声，将新视角合成与开放词汇分割统一到动态场景中，在D-RE10K基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈式3D基础模型将NVS与OVS结合,但依赖静态场景假设,在无约束动态环境中会导致空间特征严重错配。需要弥合这一关键差距。

Method: 提出了SPAR架构，包含：(1)联合语义-几何编码架构，在潜在空间聚合前显式隔离瞬态动态噪声；(2)动态区域感知的端到端训练范式，将运动估计与多视角视觉和语义学习结构耦合，使网络内在地解决运动冲突并从动态输入中提取多视角一致、时间稳定的场景表示。

Result: 在D-RE10K基准上达到SOTA性能。以3和4个输入视图分别获得22.15 dB和23.33 dB的PSNR。自监督训练下运动掩码预测mIoU达88.5%。发现场景重建与语义理解之间存在强任务协同效应。

Conclusion: SPAR通过显式动态噪声隔离和端到端动态感知训练，成功将NVS和OVS扩展到动态环境，并揭示了语义合成学习能持续增强新视角渲染的光度保真度这一有趣的跨任务协同现象。

Abstract: The integration of novel view synthesis (NVS) and open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) has recently yielded powerful feed-forward 3D foundation models. However, their inherent reliance on static-scene assumptions leads to severe misalignment of spatial features in unconstrained dynamic environments. To bridge this critical gap, we propose SPAR, a novel joint semantic-geometric encoding architecture that explicitly isolates transient dynamic noise prior to latent space aggregation. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic-region-aware end-to-end training paradigm that structurally couples motion estimation with multi-view visual and semantic learning. This unified approach enables the network to inherently resolve motion conflicts and distill multi-view consistent, temporally stable scene representations from dynamic inputs. Extensive experiments on the challenging D-RE10K benchmark demonstrate that SPAR achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our end-to-end approach achieves exceptional novel view synthesis quality, yielding a PSNR of 22.15 dB and 23.33 dB given only 3 and 4 input views respectively. Despite being trained in a self-supervised manner, our model achieves an mIoU of 88.5% for motion mask prediction. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a strong inter-task synergy between photometric scene reconstruction and semantic understanding, where semantic synthesis learning consistently enhances photometric fidelity in novel view rendering. Code will be available at https://github.com/dmucby/SPAR.

</details>


### [75] [Foundational feature fusion for conditional flow matching in 6D pose estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29183)
*Amir Hamza,Davide Boscaini,Fabio Poiesi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FunFlow6D 是一种基于流匹配（flow matching）的物体6D姿态估计方法，利用几何和外观基础模型的特征，无需任务特定编码器训练，并通过交叉注意力融合机制动态结合两种特征进行姿态估计。在BOP基准的四个数据集上超越了现有SOTA，同时降低了监督需求和内存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件流匹配方法在6D姿态估计中虽然达到了SOTA性能，但需要训练任务特定的编码器并在物体-场景重叠上进行监督，同时依赖简单的特征融合策略来处理姿态歧义，这些限制增加了训练复杂度和资源消耗。

Method: 1) 利用几何和外观基础模型（foundation models）的特征进行姿态估计，避免任务特定编码器训练；2) 提出基于交叉注意力（cross attention）的融合机制，动态结合几何与外观特征，为流匹配模块提供更丰富的条件信息。

Result: 在BOP基准的四个数据集上，FunFlow6D超越了之前的最先进方法，同时减少了监督需求并降低了内存开销；大量消融实验验证了每个提出组件的贡献。

Conclusion: FunFlow6D证明了利用基础模型特征能有效替代任务特定编码器，且交叉注意力融合能提升流匹配的6D姿态估计性能，为高效、低监督的6D姿态估计提供了新方案。

Abstract: Conditional flow matching has enabled a step forward in object 6D pose estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance by progressively denoising and registering object representations to observed scenes. Existing methods require training task-specific encoders supervised on object-scene overlap and rely on trivial feature fusion strategies to resolve pose ambiguities. We present FunFlow6D, a novel flow matching-based formulation that leverages features from geometric and appearance foundation models for pose estimation, eliminating the need for task-specific encoder training. We also introduce a cross attention-based fusion mechanism that dynamically combines geometric and appearance features to provide richer conditioning for the flow matching module. Experiments on four datasets from the BOP benchmark show that FunFlow6D outperforms the previous state of the art while reducing supervision requirements and memory overhead. Extensive ablations validate the contribution of each proposed component. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/FunFlow6D/.

</details>


### [76] [Multi-Scale Temporal Domain Alignment for Federated Video Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29186)
*Lee En-Yi Hannah,Haozhi Cao,Yuecong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出METAL框架，通过多尺度时间域对齐解决联邦视频域适应(FVDA)中时间信息对齐的挑战，仅通过模型参数传输实现跨域视频动作识别，在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FVDA允许在分布式非独立同分布视频数据集上进行协作学习同时保护隐私，但由于时间信息对齐的挑战而研究不足。现有的联邦域适应方法未能有效利用视频数据中的时间维度信息。

Method: METAL框架包含四个关键组件：(1)在源客户端训练多尺度transformer编码器；(2)在每个时间尺度上进行独立知识投票生成目标服务器上的鲁棒伪标签；(3)通过L2方差惩罚在尺度知识蒸馏中强制跨尺度一致性，防止单一主导尺度；(4)后期融合通过置信度加权聚合各尺度预测，融合头通过知识蒸馏训练。

Result: 在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上取得SOTA性能，相比现有FDA方法最高提升28.47%。消融实验证明多尺度蒸馏和尺度协调对有效时间知识迁移至关重要。

Conclusion: 多尺度时间信息对齐和跨尺度一致性约束是解决FVDA中时间域适应的关键，METAL通过尺度间的协同学习有效利用了互补的时间信息。

Abstract: Federated Video Domain Adaptation (FVDA) enables collaborative learning across distributed and non-IID video datasets while preserving privacy, but is under-explored due to challenges in aligning temporal information. We propose Multi-scalE Temporal domAin aLignment (METAL), a novel framework that leverages temporal information at multiple resolutions to improve cross-domain video action recognition with only model parameter transfers. METAL trains per-scale transformer encoders on source-clients, then performs independent knowledge voting at each temporal scale to generate robust pseudo-labels on the target-server. A novel $L_2$ variance penalty enforces cross-scale consistency during scale-based knowledge distillation, preventing a singular dominant scale. Abstract: Tri-Perspective View (TPV) representations describe 3D scene structure through top, side, and front feature planes, but existing TPV lifting is primarily camera-based, leaving the depth of sampled image evidence ambiguous along projected camera rays. For temporal aggregation, Doppler-guided temporal fusion aligns past features using a motion field anchored by measured radar radial velocity, with gating that limits warping in regions without supported motion. Abstract: Optic disc (OD) segmentation is essential for diagnosing ophthalmic pathologies from retinal fundus images. A quantitative evaluation on the Drishti-GS dataset demonstrates that our method achieves a Dice coefficient of 0.9536, matching state-of-the-art performance. Method: 提出层次化跨视角定位框架：1）利用SfM模型中的几何约束生成粗到细的姿态假设；2）通过跨视角匹配方法进行对齐；3）使用核密度估计（KDE）聚合SfM模型间的噪声预测，恢复一致性对齐并过滤离群值。

Abstract: Ground image localization with respect to satellite imagery is a key enabler for metrically-accurate, geo-localized 3D scene reconstruction from unconstrained image collections. Existing cross-view localization methods have strict requirements such as panoramic imagery or known initial locations, limiting their applicability for in-the-wild reconstruction settings. We propose a robust hierarchical cross-view localization framework that leverages geometric constraints from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) models derived from unconstrained ground image collections. Our method generates coarse-to-fine pose hypotheses through a cross-view matching approach and aggregates noisy predictions across SfM model(s) using Kernel Density Estimation to recover consensus alignments while filtering outliers. Experiments demonstrate reliable localization performance from challenging image collections. Empirically we found satellite-referenced alignment enables accurate metric scale estimation, doppelgänger detection, and merging of disjoint SfM reconstructions, resulting in more complete, geo-localized site models than are possible with SfM alone.

Abstract: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary sensor data into a single representation that preserves intrinsic scene reality while eliminating environmental interferences. Most existing approaches rely on blind feature aggregation, which excels at signal accumulation but fails to distinguish essential content from physical degradations. We propose SGPDFuse, which bridges this gap by mapping inputs into a physics-disentangled structural representation via a Semantic-Physical Parametric Bridge (SPPB) built on pretrained vision foundation models, utilizing the Intrinsic-Variation principle to decouple invariant scene attributes from transient environmental factors. To guide this decomposition, we introduce a Semantic Alignment mechanism: we explicitly anchor the fused representation to salient semantic features in the same foundation model feature space via cosine similarity to preserve critical targets, while enforcing physical texture fidelity through Gram-matrix regularization to strictly eliminate unnatural artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGPDFuse achieves state-of-the-art performance across infrared-visible, multi-focus, and multi-exposure benchmarks using a single architecture.

</details>

Abstract: In this work we propose a novel non-linear diffusion filtering approach for images based on their channel representation. The resulting Euler-Lagrange equation yields a non-linear robust diffusion scheme with additional weighting terms stemming from the channel representation which steer the diffusion process. We apply this novel energy formulation to image reconstruction problems, showing good performance in the presence of mixtures of Gaussian and impulse-like noise, e.g. missing data. In denoising experiments of common scalar-valued images our approach performs competitive compared to other diffusion schemes as well as state-of-the-art denoising methods for the considered noise types.

</details>

Abstract: Snapshot Spectral Imaging (SSI) provides high-dimensional temporal-spatial-spectral observation to uncover intrinsic physical characteristics. However, its complex system and repetitive calibration requirements hinder edge applications. Here, we propose a compact, cost-effective, calibration-free SSI method, Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS), which consists only of a diffractive lens with a binary mask and a Bayer-filtered sensor, requiring no additional physical footprint compared to standard RGB cameras. ADIS disperses and multiplexes wavelengths, mapping energy to distinct sensor locations, enabling full-resolution recovery from superpixel-level encodings. ADIS directly leverages theoretically computed PSFs to enable calibration-free spectral reconstruction, while tolerating lens-dependent variations across different optical configurations and bridging the gap between simulation and reality. To achieve SSI by solving a sparsely-constrained inverse problem, we introduce the Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Framework (ODAUF) with Voxel Shift Transformer (VST) for improved orthogonal diffraction perception. Integrating VST into ODAUF forms the efficient Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Voxel Shift Transformer (ODAUVST), delivering excellent recovery and reduced parameters. By elaborating on theory, systematic and comprehensive comparing, and demonstrating real SSI results, we validate the superiority of ADIS, achieving calibration-free full-resolution SSI within a commercial camera footprint.

</details>


### [84] [Background-Free Objectness Learning for Class-Agnostic Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29232)
*Dania Batool,Liliana Lo Presti,Marco La Cascia,Filippo Vella*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出B-FOR框架，一种不依赖显式背景监督的密集类无关目标检测方法，通过学习多尺度目标中心和尺度场，使目标假设从局部空间结构中涌现，在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上比先前类无关基线提升超过+10 AR点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统目标检测器在封闭集监督下训练，将未标注区域隐式视为背景。在标注不完整的情况下，这种假设引入"objectness bias"——视觉上有效但未标注的目标被当作负样本，使得objectness与标注类目绑定而非通用目标结构，这一问题在类无关和开放世界检测中尤为严重。

Method: B-FOR将检测建模为密集多尺度目标中心和尺度场的预测，目标假设从局部空间结构（局部最大值）中涌现。监督仅通过空间结构化的软目标限制在可靠标注区域内，避免前景-背景判别；此外引入位移感知的尺度场（displacement-aware scale fields），将目标范围建模为学习到的objectness场的空间变化属性，以支持从局部最大值解码目标。

Result: 在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上的实验表明，B-FOR对未见类别和跨数据集目标分布具有强泛化能力，比先前类无关基线提升超过+10 AR点。消融实验证明局部化objectness监督和位移感知尺度场对不完整标注下的类无关定位至关重要。

Conclusion: B-FOR通过消除未标注区域的背景监督，有效缓解了objectness bias问题，实现了不依赖显式背景语义的类无关目标检测，为开放世界和类无关检测任务提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Object detectors are typically trained under closed-set supervision, where unlabeled regions are implicitly treated as background. Under incomplete annotations, this assumption introduces objectness bias: visually valid but unlabeled objects are used as negatives, tying objectness to the annotated taxonomy rather than generic object structure. This limitation is particularly problematic for class-agnostic and open-world detection. This paper proposes Background-Free Objectness Learning (B-FOR), a dense class-agnostic detection framework that learns objectness without explicit background supervision on unlabeled regions. B-FOR formulates detection as the prediction of dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields, from which object hypotheses emerge as local spatial structures. Supervision is confined to reliable annotated regions through spatially structured soft targets, avoiding foreground-background discrimination. To support decoding from emergent local maxima, the paper further introduces displacement-aware scale fields that model object extent as a spatially varying property of the learned objectness field. Experiments on PASCAL VOC, MS-COCO, and Open Images demonstrate strong generalization to unseen categories and cross-dataset object distributions. B-FOR improves recall by more than +10 AR points over prior class-agnostic baselines. Ablation studies show that both localized objectness supervision and displacement-aware scale fields are critical for class-agnostic localization under incomplete annotations. Code available at: https://github.com/Daniaawan/B-FOR.

</details>


### [85] [Generalization over Memorization: Generalization-Aware Diffusion Adaptation for Single-Image Multi-View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29233)
*Jie Li,Xingchen Zou,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GoM框架，在ACM Multimedia 2026单图引导多视角图像合成大挑战中，从293个注册队伍中脱颖而出排名第一。关键洞见是共享训练/验证场景会导致"记忆被误认为可迁移视角控制"的模型选择失效，因此GoM采用场景分离验证、曝光匹配选择和定向扩散适配来解决小数据生成建模中的泛化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战赛仅提供40个训练场景，需要从单张RGB模型生成26个目标视角，且禁止显式几何、外部渲染、链式生成等辅助手段。作者发现传统模型选择方法（共享训练与验证场景）会产生严重的模型选择失败，即模型记忆训练场景反而被误判为具有可迁移的视角控制能力，这误导了模型选择和优化方向。

Method: GoM框架包含三个核心组件：1）场景不相交验证（scene-disjoint validation）确保验证集与训练集场景完全分离；2）曝光匹配选择（exposure-matched selection）确保不同模型在同等训练条件下进行比较；3）定向扩散适配（targeted diffusion adaptation）——基于4B整流流扩散Transformer，采用rank-32 LoRA、优化器重启、晚期检查点平均和VAE解码器微调。

Result: 在293支注册队伍中排名第一，56支队伍在Phase-A公开排行榜获得至少一次有效提交。通过超过300次离线实验和24次在线提交验证，证明在数据量极小的生成建模任务中，验证设计与训练轨迹控制可以与大模型架构规模同等重要。

Conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：在少样本生成建模中，实验设计和模型选择的严谨性（如验证集的构建方式）对最终性能的影响被严重低估。GoM的实践表明，"泛化优于记忆"的验证设计原则和精细的训练轨迹控制，能够在小数据场景下超越仅在模型规模上的投入。

Abstract: We present the winning solution to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge on Single-Image Guided Multi-Angle Image Synthesis. It ranks first among 293 registered teams; 56 teams obtained at least one scored submission on the public Phase-A leaderboard. With only 40 training scenes, the challenge requires 26 target views from one RGB model and one forward pass per view; it prohibits explicit geometry, external rendering, chained generation, candidate selection, and post-processing. We identify a critical model-selection failure: shared training and validation scenes make memorization appear as transferable view control. We therefore introduce GoM. Short for Generalization over Memorization, the framework combines scene-disjoint validation, exposure-matched selection, and targeted diffusion adaptation. Its synthesis model adapts a 4B rectified-flow DiT using rank-32 LoRA, optimizer restarts, late-checkpoint averaging, and VAE decoder tuning. More than 300 offline experiments and 24 online submissions show that validation design and training-trajectory control can matter as much as architecture scale in small-data generative modeling.

</details>


### [86] [Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Anti-UAV Detection via Evidential Fusion and Conflict-Discounted Belief Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29235)
*Sharanda Suttorp,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansour Alsahag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对反无人机感知系统，提出将证据深度学习（EDL）从单模态热成像扩展到RGB-热成像多模态融合，采用折扣信念融合（DBF）将模态间冲突转化为不确定性质量。在Anti-UAV基准上，多模态融合以实时速度（≥38 FPS）优于任一单流（测试准确率0.670 vs 0.604 IR/0.598 RGB），不确定性校准良好（ECE 0.057）。然而，DBF与无折扣平均在经验上不可区分，因为该基准以目标存在为主导，模态间冲突近乎为零，导致折扣步骤失效。作者诊断出这一零结果是结构性的：基准中近乎普遍的存在标注和空洞的漏检编码共同抑制了模态间冲突，从而界定了冲突感知融合能带来可衡量收益的适用范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态反无人机系统以确定性方式融合RGB和热成像流，无法建模预测不确定性，当流在不同模态下退化（遮挡、快速运动或特定模态故障）时无法表达怀疑。虽然EDTC已利用证据深度学习进行纯热成像感知，但跨模态证据融合仍是空白。

Method: 将EDTC扩展至RGB-热成像多模态感知，引入折扣信念融合（DBF）：将模态间冲突转换为不确定性质量后再聚合各流观点；边界框通过选择不确定性较低的模态来解析。

Result: 在Anti-UAV基准上，多模态融合一致优于任一单流（测试准确率0.670 vs 0.604 IR、0.598 RGB），实时速度≥38 FPS；融合不确定性校准良好（ECE 0.057）。但DBF与无折扣平均在经验上不可区分，模态间冲突接近零使折扣步骤失效；作为定位失败检测器，其性能弱于空间方差（AUROC 0.626 vs 0.739）。

Conclusion: 该零结果是结构性的：基准数据的近普遍存在标注和空洞的漏检编码共同抑制了模态间冲突。这一诊断界定了冲突感知融合能带来可测量收益的适用条件，为未来在更高冲突场景中验证DBF提供了方向。

Abstract: Anti-UAV perception systems must remain reliable when sensor streams degrade under occlusion, fast motion, or modality-specific failure. Existing multimodal anti-UAV systems fuse RGB and thermal streams deterministically, without modeling predictive uncertainty, and cannot express doubt when streams disagree. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) produces calibrated per-class uncertainty in a single forward pass. EDTC already exploits this for thermal-only perception, yet cross-modal evidential fusion remains unaddressed.
  This paper extends EDTC to multimodal RGB-Thermal perception via Discounted Belief Fusion (DBF), which converts inter-modal conflict into uncertainty mass before aggregating stream opinions. Bounding boxes are resolved by selecting the lower-uncertainty modality. On the Anti-UAV benchmark, multimodal fusion consistently outperforms either single stream (test Acc 0.670 vs. 0.604 IR, 0.598 RGB) at real-time speed (at least 38 FPS). However, DBF is empirically indistinguishable from undiscounted averaging: near-zero inter-modal conflict on this presence-dominated benchmark leaves the discounting step inert. The fused uncertainty is well-calibrated (ECE 0.057) yet expectedly a weaker localization failure detector than spatial variance (AUROC 0.626 vs. 0.739). The null result is structural: the benchmark's near-universal presence and vacuous miss-encoding jointly suppress inter-modal conflict, a diagnosis that delimits where conflict-aware fusion provides measurable benefit.

</details>


### [87] [AGRICAM: A Track-Mounted Crop Pollination Monitoring Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29237)
*Malika Nisal Ratnayake,Adel N. Toosi,James Cook,Romina Rader,Alan Dorin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为AGRICAM的自主导引机器人系统，用于在保护性栽培系统中进行大规模授粉监测。该系统在低成本轨道上自主运行，集成双RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS/RFID、运动传感器和4G网络，通过计算机视觉分析量化授粉昆虫的访花活动和时空分布。在商业蓝莓农场的80米工业多隧道中进行了30小时的部署验证，成功绘制了授粉模式图，确认了授粉者分布的均匀性，并揭示了授粉活动与时间和微气候的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 昆虫授粉对全球粮食生产至关重要，但在商业农场尺度上监测授粉者仍具挑战性。现有监测方法需要在细节、空间覆盖和资源投入之间权衡，缺乏能够兼顾大尺度覆盖、自动化运行且不干扰昆虫行为的监测系统。

Method: 设计了AGRICAM自主移动机器人平台：在低成本、易安装的轨道上沿作物行自主移动，集成双RGB相机（采集昆虫位置影像）、微气候传感器、GPS和RFID模块、运动传感器及4G蜂窝网络。数据上传云端后使用计算机视觉模型进行授粉者访问次数和时空活动变化的量化分析。配备Web界面进行远程配置和调度，且系统设计不干扰农场作业和昆虫行为。

Result: 在商业蓝莓农场长达80米的工业多隧道中成功运行30小时，绘制了昆虫授粉的空间分布模式图。空间分析确认了多隧道内授粉者分布的均匀性（符合农场管理团队期望），同时数据揭示了昆虫活动随一天中的时间以及微气候条件变化而波动的规律。

Conclusion: AGRICAM被证明是一种可扩展、自动化的作物授粉监测系统，能够支持基于数据的决策以优化授粉管理，从而提升作物生产力和食品安全。该系统成功解决了自动化大尺度授粉监测的难题，具有商业应用价值。

Abstract: Insect pollination is critical for global food production, yet monitoring pollinators at commercial farm scale remains a challenge. Recent advances in computer vision and deep learning have enabled detailed analysis of pollinator behaviour, but monitoring must trade-off detail against spatial coverage and human or technological resources. This paper presents the Automated Guided Robot for Insect and Crop Activity Monitoring (AGRICAM), a purpose-built robotic system designed to meet the requirements of large-scale pollination monitoring in protected cropping systems. AGRICAM operates autonomously on low-cost, easily installed track for movement along crop rows, without disrupting farm operations or insect behaviour. The platform integrates two RGB cameras, microclimate sensors, GPS and RFID modules, motion sensors, and 4G cellular network connectivity for data transmission. A web interface enables remote device configuration and scheduling. The system autonomously captures video and image data of insects' locations and local environmental conditions. These are transferred to the cloud and analysed using computer vision models to quantify pollinator visitation and spatio-temporal activity variation. We deployed the system on a commercial blueberry farm to demonstrate and test its capability. It successfully mapped insect pollination patterns across 80 m long industrial polytunnels over 30 hours. This data enabled spatial analyses of insect activity we used to confirm a uniform pollinator distribution within polytunnels, as desired by the farm management team. The data also highlighted variation of insect activity associated with time of day and microclimate. AGRICAM therefore has been shown to be a scalable, automated crop pollination monitor that can support data-driven decisions to enhance pollination management, thereby improving crop productivity and food security.

</details>


### [88] [DARD: Zero-Shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-Guided Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29243)
*Wenjie Cai,Yuezhe Yang,Jianyang Xia,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了DARD，一种零样本的退化感知Retinex引导扩散框架，用于低光图像增强。通过测试时退化感知Retinex分解提取物理先验作为结构引导，结合时间步自适应频率融合平衡结构锚定与细节生成，并引入物理一致性和CLIP语义引导的反向细化过程，在多个真实世界基准上优于现有零样本方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散增强方法要么依赖配对监督，要么在零样本设置下缺乏可靠场景约束，导致结构不一致和颜色漂移。传统Retinex模型具有物理可解释先验可作为场景约束，但在真实场景混合退化下效果不佳，需要将两者的优势结合。

Method: 1) 测试时退化感知Retinex分解，从退化输入中提取图像特定物理先验，为零样本复原提供结构引导；2) 时间步自适应频率融合策略，将先验注入逆向扩散过程，平衡结构锚定与细节生成；3) 引导反向细化过程，结合物理一致性和CLIP语义引导，抑制采样中的结构伪影和语义漂移。

Result: DARD在多个真实世界低光基准上取得强失真和感知性能，一致超越现有零样本基线。在下游语义分割任务中，DARD增强图像相比AGLLDiff实现了28.10%的相对mIoU提升。

Conclusion: 通过将Retinex物理先验与扩散模型生成能力结合，DARD在零样本设置下实现了可靠的低光图像增强，兼顾结构一致性、色彩保真和感知质量，并验证了对下游视觉任务的实际效用。

Abstract: Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods provide strong generative capability for low-light image enhancement (LLIE), yet they either rely on paired supervision or lack reliable scene constraints in zero-shot settings, often leading to structural inconsistency and color drift. Motivated by conventional Retinex models, which offer physically interpretable priors that can serve as reliable scene constraints yet struggle with mixed degradations in real-world scenarios, we propose DARD, a zero-shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-guided Diffusion framework for LLIE. DARD first extracts image-specific physical priors from the degraded input through a test-time degradation-aware Retinex decomposition, thereby providing reliable structural guidance for zero-shot restoration. It then injects these priors into reverse diffusion through a timestep-adaptive frequency fusion strategy to balance structural anchoring and detail generation. Finally, a guided reverse refinement process with physical consistency and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based semantic guidance is introduced to suppress structural artifacts and semantic drift during sampling. Extensive experiments show that DARD achieves strong distortion and perceptual performance and consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines across multiple real-world low-light benchmarks. To further validate the practical utility of our method for downstream applications, we evaluated its impact on semantic segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that images enhanced by DARD achieve a 28.10% relative improvement in mIoU over AGLLDiff.

</details>


### [89] [QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29253)
*Yaroslav Prytula,Anton Popov,Dmytro Fishman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出QCell，一种基于查询（query-based）的重叠细胞实例分割模型。它通过实例重组模块在潜空间分解并重组查询表示，结合对比查询对齐目标来分离重叠细胞，并在新引入的Organoid数据集基准及多个基准上超越现有方法（ISBI2014上+2.2 AP和+2.7 AJI）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显微镜下重叠细胞的半透明结构导致弱边界和重叠区域的混合视觉证据，现有方法依赖局部感兴趣区域或形状先验，缺乏跨重叠对象的全局推理能力。

Method: (1) 实例重组模块：在潜空间分解并重组查询表示，使模型能推理重叠下的完整对象结构；(2) 对比查询对齐目标：结合判别性实例特征学习与重叠细胞查询分离；(3) 引入新的Organoid数据集基准。

Result: QCell在多个基准上超越最先进方法，在ISBI2014上获得+2.2 AP和+2.7 AJI的提升。

Conclusion: 基于查询的全局推理方法能有效解决重叠细胞分割中弱边界和证据混合的问题，并展示了在新数据集上的泛化能力（代码已开源）。

Abstract: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells in microscopy remains challenging due to semi-transparent structures that produce weak boundaries and mixed visual evidence in overlap regions. Existing methods address this through local regions of interest or shape priors but lack global reasoning across overlapping objects. We present QCell, a novel query-based model that de-overlaps cell instances in microscopy scenes. Our approach combines (i) an instance recombination module that decomposes and recombines query representations in latent space, enabling the model to reason about complete object structure under overlap, and (ii) a contrastive query alignment objective that combines distinctive instance feature learning and separation of overlapping cell queries. We additionally introduce a new Organoid dataset benchmark for overlapping cell segmentation. We show that QCell outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving +2.2 AP and +2.7 AJI on ISBI2014. Code is available at https://github.com/SlavkoPrytula/QCell

</details>


### [90] [LightFuse: Relightable Interactive Gaussian Scene Reconstruction via Multi-Scan Fusion and 2D Gaussian Ray Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29269)
*Haonan Zhou,Gaoxiang Linghu,Youlin Jia,Hongyu Cui,Kewei Wei,Kaiyue Zhou,Bruce X. B. Yu,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LightFuse是一个基于2D高斯的框架，用于可重光照的交互式场景重建。它通过融合多状态观测、几何精化以及基于可微单次光线追踪的分阶段训练，实现了材质-光照显式解耦，支持物体重排、材质编辑和重光照，在合成场景上超越了最强基线(+9.74dB PSNR, +0.121 SSIM)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在可编辑交互式场景重建中存在两大局限：一是将光照烘焙进外观，无法实现真实重光照；二是在编辑布局后无法保持一致性的阴影和间接光照。这促使作者提出一个能显式解耦材质与光照、并支持物理基渲染的框架。

Method: LightFuse首先融合不同状态下的观测来重建共享背景和可移动物体；接着进行面向光线追踪的几何精化以获得更完整一致的表面；然后在精化几何上采用分阶段训练与可微单次光线追踪，将共享的金属-粗糙度材质与状态特定的环境光照分离。

Result: 在合成场景实验中，LightFuse取得了最先进的重光照质量，平均比最强基线高9.74dB PSNR和0.121 SSIM。

Conclusion: LightFuse证明了通过显式的材质-光照分解与物理基光线追踪，可以在交互式场景重建中同时实现几何一致性、可编辑性和高质量重光照，为可编辑场景重建提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Relightable interactive scene reconstruction aims to build an editable 3D model from scans of different object arrangements and render new layouts under novel illumination. Existing methods either bake lighting into appearance or recover material and illumination only for fixed scenes, leaving edited layouts with inconsistent shadows and indirect lighting. We present LightFuse, a 2D Gaussian framework that extends interactive scene reconstruction with explicit material-illumination decomposition and physically based relighting. LightFuse first fuses observations across states to reconstruct a shared background and movable objects. It then conducts ray-tracing-oriented geometry refinement to produce more complete and consistent surfaces. On the refined geometry, staged training with differentiable one-bounce ray tracing separates shared metallic--roughness material from state-specific environment lighting. The resulting scene supports object rearrangement, material editing, and relighting, while ray tracing recomputes appearance after each interaction. Experiments across synthetic scenes demonstrate state-of-the-art relighting quality, outperforming the strongest baseline by +9.74\,dB PSNR and +0.121 SSIM on average. Project page: https://zhn202.github.io/LightFuse/

</details>


### [91] [RAGDiffusion++: From Macro-Retrieval to Micro-Fidelity Alignment for Garment Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29280)
*Yuhan Li,Xianfeng Tan,Fangao Zeng,Wenxiang Shang,Pipei Huang,Hao Zhou,Zhiyu Jin,Wenjun Zhang,Bingbing Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AR-GRPO框架，通过强化学习重塑流模型的采样分布以生成高保真服装纹理，结合属性感知奖励模型和对抗正则化解决高频率纹理塌陷与伪影攻击问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作RAGDiffusion解决了宏观结构幻觉，但微观纹理真实度仍是瓶颈。监督微调收敛于条件均值导致高频纹理无法采样，而朴素RL又会触发伪影攻击（模型利用奖励模型偏差生成欺骗性棋盘噪声）。

Method: 提出三个核心组件：(i) STGarment-Plus数据集（27,725对高复杂度服装图像）与Dual-Image-Stream FLUX架构升级以建立固有容量；(ii) Garment-RM属性感知奖励模型（基于500K图像细粒度对比学习，84.67%人类偏好准确率）；(iii) AR-GRPO策略，将动态判别器集成到RL采样轨迹中以惩罚伪影并丰富真实高频细节。

Result: Garment-RM奖励模型在人类偏好预测上达到84.67%准确率，AR-GRPO策略有效防止伪影攻击并显著提升高频纹理细节的真实度。

Conclusion: 强化学习能从本质上重塑流模型的采样分布，在准确奖励引导下提升高保真轨迹的概率，而对抗正则化能防止对奖励盲区的利用，从而实现工业级微纹理真实度。

Abstract: Standard clothing asset generation---restoring forward-facing flat-lay garment images from diverse real-world contexts---holds immense commercial value yet demands both macroscopic topological accuracy and microscopic physical fidelity. Although our previous work RAGDiffusion effectively eradicated large-scale structural hallucinations via retrieval-augmented macro-constraints, achieving industrial-grade micro-texture realism remains an unsolved bottleneck. We formally identify this limitation as High-Frequency Trajectory Collapse: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) converges to the conditional mean of the training distribution, which is dominated by smooth, low-frequency textures, causing high-frequency patterns (e.g., fabric weaves, intricate logos) to become nearly un-sampleable. Naively applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training further triggers Artifact Hacking, where models exploit semantic biases in generic reward models by generating deceptive checkerboard noise. Our key insight is that RL can fundamentally reshape the sampling distribution of flow models---elevating the probability of high-fidelity trajectories under accurate reward guidance---while adversarial regularization prevents exploitation of reward blind spots. Realizing this principle requires three prerequisites: (i)inherent capacity, established through a 27,725-pair high-complexity garment dataset (STGarment-Plus) and a Dual-Image-Stream FLUX architecture upgrade; (ii)perceptive reward, provided by a novel attribute-aware reward model (Garment-RM) trained on 500K images via fine-grained contrastive learning, achieving 84.67% human preference accuracy; and (iii)hacking prevention, enforced by our Adversarial-Regularized GRPO (AR-GRPO) strategy that integrates a dynamic discriminator into the RL sampling trajectory to penalize artifacts while enriching authentic high-frequency details.

</details>


### [92] [Elastic Token Compression for Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29281)
*Eduard Zamfir,Christian Reisswig,Zongwei Wu,Yongqin Xian,Radu Timofte*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Region Token Interface (RTI)方法，通过利用自然图像中细节集中在少量区域的特点，对像素空间扩散模型进行令牌剪枝。该方法使用Hilbert排序将二维图像切割转化为一维切割，将平坦区域的冗余令牌聚合成区域令牌，在推理时减少计算量，同时保持图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然图像的细节集中在画面的一小部分区域，但扩散模型在每个patch、每层和每个时间步都使用完整的令牌处理所有位置，造成大量计算浪费。像素空间模型由于没有自编码器来吸收低层冗余，浪费尤为严重。现有方法各有缺陷：相似性合并会分散分组、潜在瓶颈会丢弃位置信息、直接跳过会删除本应汇总的内容。

Method: RTI首先探测预训练的像素文本到图像变压器，发现中间块令牌在图像平坦区域存在冗余。利用Hilbert排序的特性（连续位置始终是图像邻居），将二维分组问题转化为一维切割问题。在模型特征变化最大的位置进行切割，将每个连续片段池化为一个区域令牌。微调期间随机抽取区域数量，使单个检查点适用于所有计算预算。

Result: RTI在匹配的计算预算下优于先前的削减方法，在2.0倍加速时达到与密集质量相匹配的水平，在2.6倍加速时仍保持接近密集质量。

Conclusion: 通过Hilbert排序和区域令牌池化的创新组合，RTI有效利用了图像内容的几何结构来减少扩散模型的计算浪费，实现了显著的推理加速同时几乎不损失生成质量，代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: Natural images concentrate their detail in a small fraction of the frame, yet diffusion models spend a full token on every patch, in every layer and at every timestep. The waste is largest in pixel-space models, with no autoencoder to absorb low-level redundancy first. Probing a pretrained pixel text-to-image transformer, we find its middle-block tokens redundant wherever the image is flat. The redundancy occupies connected, content-shaped regions, and exploiting it requires tokens with the same geometry. Cutting a Hilbert ordering of the patches provides them. Consecutive positions are always image neighbours, so any contiguous run is a connected region whose size and shape follow the content, and grouping in two dimensions becomes a cut in one. Existing reductions each lose part of this. Similarity merging scatters its groups, latent bottlenecks discard position, and skipping deletes what it should summarize. We cut where the model's features change most and pool each run into one region token. Our Region Token Interface (\method{}) adapts a diffusion model to these tokens, with the region count drawn at random during fine-tuning so one checkpoint serves every budget. \method{} leads prior reduction methods at matched budgets, matches dense quality at $2.0\times$ the speed, and stays close at $2.6\times$. The code and models are open-sourced at https://eduardzamfir.github.io/rti

</details>


### [93] [3D-MRL: Nested Multimodal 3D Representations via Matryoshka Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29285)
*Márcus Lobo,Vitor Matias,Jeová Farias,Moacir Ponti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出3D-MRL框架，基于Matryoshka表示学习实现多模态3D预训练，通过单一模型即可在不同嵌入维度下生成嵌套的3D表示，无需针对不同计算预算重新训练多个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态3D预训练方法产生固定维度嵌入，需要为不同的计算预算分别训练不同的模型，这增加了部署成本且缺乏灵活性。

Method: 将Matryoshka表示学习目标仅应用于3D编码器，将点云与冻结的CLIP图像和文本嵌入对齐，并在多个嵌入维度上施加对比学习监督，从而学习嵌套的3D表示。

Result: 在Objaverse-LVIS、ModelNet40和ScanNet数据集上达到竞争性性能；在Objaverse-LVIS上Top-1准确率从46.8%提升至50.9%；检索实验表明不同嵌入维度可提供不同层级的语义和几何特异性。

Conclusion: 3D-MRL验证了Matryoshka表示学习在3D多模态预训练中的有效性，单一模型即可支持多种嵌入维度下的零样本、少样本识别及检索任务。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models align point clouds with image and text embeddings, enabling zero-shot recognition, retrieval, and open-vocabulary understanding of 3D shapes. Existing multimodal 3D pre-training methods produce fixed-dimensional embeddings, requiring separate models for different computational budgets. We propose 3D Matryoshka Representation Learning (3D-MRL), a multimodal 3D pre-training framework based on Matryoshka Representation Learning. 3D-MRL learns nested 3D representations by aligning point clouds with frozen CLIP image and text embeddings while applying contrastive supervision across multiple embedding dimensions. The Matryoshka objective is applied only to the 3D encoder, allowing a single model to produce representations at different dimensionalities without retraining. Experiments on the Objaverse-LVIS, ModelNet40, and ScanNet datasets show that 3D-MRL achieves competitive performance on zero-shot and few-shot 3D recognition tasks. In addition, the learned representations support retrieval across different embedding dimensions within a single model. On Objaverse-LVIS, 3D-MRL improves Top-1 accuracy from 46.8% to 50.9%. Retrieval experiments further show that different embedding dimensions yield varying levels of semantic and geometric specificity.

</details>


### [94] [PERSIST: Persistent-State Discrimination for Shot Boundary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29287)
*Tingyu Lin,Christian Stippel,Armin Dadras,Jakob Zenzmaier,Florian Kleber,Wolfgang Aigner,Robert Sablatnig*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PERSIST框架，将镜头边界检测（SBD）从局部视觉不连续性检测重构为"边界语义判别"问题。核心思想是：只有当局部变化证据伴随视频潜在时间状态的持续更新（而非暂时性偏离后回归趋势）时，才将帧判定为边界。通过FiLM条件正弦表示网络构建连续潜在状态，配合结合局部变化、瞬态脉冲和回归趋势三种语义线索的结构化判别器，在双速率时间骨干上生成可解释的逐帧信号。实验表明该方法大幅减少伪事件（闪光、文字覆盖、档案材料等导致的假阳性），同时达到与最强公开检测器相当的性能，且训练数据更加严格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SBD方法将镜头边界视为局部视觉不连续性的定位，但手持抖动、光照闪烁、运动模糊、遮挡和损坏档案材料等会产生同样剧烈的局部变化却不引入新镜头，导致大量假阳性。作者因此希望重新定义SBD问题，区分"真正的边界"与"暂时性偏离"。

Method: 将SBD重构为边界语义判别：通过FiLM条件正弦表示网络学习连续潜在状态，用"持久性测试"判断局部变化是否伴随潜在状态的持续更新；结构化判别器将三种语义线索（局部变化、瞬态脉冲、回归趋势）组合为单一可解释的逐帧信号，在双速率时间骨干上运行。

Result: 在2,727视频的按子类型诊断中，相比相同训练的线索检测器消除了33-80%的闪光、文字覆盖和档案假阳性；在匹配真实转换召回率下，相比TransNetV2将伪事件假阳性减少约一半（诊断集）和四分之一（ClipShots），同时保持召回率。在在线、广播、短视频和历史档案迁移评估中与最强公开检测器达到同等性能，且仅使用ClipShots真实转换训练（对比基线使用85%合成转换的额外语料库）。

Conclusion: PERSIST证明了将SBD从"检测局部变化"转向"判别边界语义"的有效性：通过持久性标准训练分类器、可读的门控三元组和可测量的边界判别性潜在状态，使每个决策都可检查，同时大幅减少假阳性并在严格训练条件下达到与最强基线相当的性能。

Abstract: Shot boundary detection (SBD) is widely treated as the localisation of local visual discontinuities, yet many false positives such as hand-held shake, illumination flicker, motion blur, occlusion, and damaged archival material produce equally sharp local change without introducing a new shot. We reformulate SBD as boundary semantic discrimination: a frame is favoured as a boundary only when its local change evidence is accompanied by a persistent update of the video's latent temporal state, rather than a transient excursion that returns to the surrounding trend. This persistence test is operationalised with a continuous latent state from a FiLM-conditioned sinusoidal representation network and a structured discriminator that combines three semantic cues, local change, transient impulse, and return-to-trend, into a single interpretable per-frame signal over a dual-rate temporal backbone. The resulting framework, PERSIST, turns every decision into an inspectable one: the persistence criterion is trained into the classifier, its per-frame effect stays readable from the gate triple, and its learned latent state is measurably boundary-discriminative. On a 2,727-video per-subtype diagnostic it removes 33-80% of flash, text-overlay, and archival false positives relative to an identically trained cue detector, and at matched true-transition recall it roughly halves TransNetV2's pseudo-event false positives on that diagnostic and cuts its false positives on ClipShots footage by about a quarter, while preserving recall. It does so while reaching parity with the strongest public detector across online, broadcast, short-form, and historical-archive transfer evaluations, under markedly stricter training: it learns from ClipShots real transitions only, whereas the anchor draws on additional corpora whose transitions are 85% synthetic. Code is available at https://github.com/linty5/PERSIST.

</details>


### [95] [Hyper3-CLIP: Hierarchy-Conditioned Hyperbolic Vision-Language Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29313)
*Matin Mahmood,Antonio Rueda-Toicen,Mohamed ElBassat,Seifeldin Elkerdany,Weixing Wang,Gerard de Melo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Hyper3-CLIP，一种层级条件化的双曲视觉-语言模型（VLM），通过结合全局、局部及全局-局部对比学习与查询条件化视觉池化，弥合了双曲VLM与查询条件化方法之间的鸿沟。该模型利用从文本构建的轻量级查询层级（包含完整标题、句子片段、局部部件描述和提取的短语）来条件化视觉patch池化，并支持图像-文本、整体-部件和父子蕴含损失。测试时无需查询条件化池化，在COCO和Flickr检索、VOC和COCO多标签分类上均有提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP类视觉语言模型通过对比学习学习全局图像-文本表示，但欧几里得嵌入和全局池化无法编码部分-整体和父子等关系结构。双曲VLM通过蕴含目标解决此问题，文本条件化变体通过句子和短语级查询改善细粒度对齐，但这两条研究线相互独立：双曲VLM使用静态图像和区域特征，而查询条件化方法缺乏层级几何结构。作者旨在融合这两类方法。

Method: 作者提出Hyper3-CLIP，一个层级条件化的双曲VLM。核心方法包括：(1) 组合全局、局部和全局-局部对比学习；(2) 查询条件化视觉池化——从文本构造轻量级查询层级（完整标题、句子片段、局部部件描述、提取短语），每个查询对视觉patch池化进行条件化；(3) 生成的表示支持图像-文本、整体-部件和父子蕴含损失；(4) 查询条件化池化仅在训练时激活。

Result: Hyper3-CLIP在COCO和Flickr上的R@5和R@10检索性能提升，在VOC和COCO多标签分类上也有改进，同时在层级指标上保持竞争力。论文还审计了固定提示机制下的零样本提示敏感性和训练时局部GRIT部件预算的影响。

Conclusion: 通过将双曲几何结构融入查询条件化视觉池化，Hyper3-CLIP成功结合了双曲VLM的层级关系建模能力与文本条件化方法的细粒度对齐能力，在不牺牲层级指标的前提下提升了检索和多标签分类性能。代码已开源。

Abstract: CLIP-like vision-language models (VLMs) trained with contrastive objectives learn strong global image-text representations, but their Euclidean embeddings and global pooling fail to encode relational structure such as part-whole and parent-child relations. Hyperbolic VLMs address this gap with entailment-based objectives, and text-conditioned variants improve fine-grained alignment through sentence- and phrase-level queries. However, these two lines of work remain separate: hyperbolic VLMs use static image and region features, while query-conditioned methods lack hierarchical geometric structure. We present Hyper3-CLIP, a hierarchy-conditioned hyperbolic VLM that combines global, local, and global-local contrastive learning with query-conditioned visual pooling. To train the model, we construct lightweight query hierarchies from text, comprising full captions, sentence fragments, localized part descriptions, and extracted phrases. Each query conditions the pooling of visual patches, and the resulting representations support image-text, whole-part, and parent-child entailment losses. Query-conditioned pooling is active only during training. Hyper3-CLIP improves R@5 and R@10 retrieval on COCO and Flickr, as well as multi-label classification on VOC and COCO, while remaining competitive on hierarchy metrics. We also audit zero-shot prompt sensitivity under fixed prompt regimes and study the effect of the localized GRIT part budget used during training. Code is available at https://github.com/Hyper3Labs/hyper3-clip.

</details>


### [96] [Test-Time Scaling for Video Diffusion Models via Diagnosis-Guided Candidate Recycling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29322)
*Hangzhou He,Lunhao Duan,Shanshan Zhao,Kaiwen Li,Qing-Guo Chen,Weihua Luo,Yanye Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GEARS是一个训练免费的视频扩散模型测试时扩展框架，通过"诊断引导的候选回收"机制，将生成失败但部分可用的候选样本转化为可编辑先验，通过生成-评估-编辑循环实现计算效率的提升。在相同NFE预算下，GEARS使1.3B模型达到与14B模型相当的总分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型高质量生成依赖闭源系统或大规模基础设施；测试时扩展虽能提升轻量模型的生成质量，但现有方法局限于"噪声搜索"范式——采样、选择、扰动后丢弃低分候选，这种"生成即丢弃"的过程既浪费计算，也浪费候选样本中已编码的部分运动、布局或外观结构信息。

Method: GEARS包含两个协作组件：(1) Stage-Aware Scheduler决定修复什么、何时修复、哪些候选应保留/回收/丢弃；(2) Candidate Recycler从关键帧和多维奖励反馈中诊断可恢复的失败，生成候选特定的修复提示，并通过流形感知的潜在SDEdit修复候选样本。修复后的候选被回收进搜索池，创建超越标准噪声扰动的精炼路径。

Result: 在匹配NFE预算下，GEARS在VBench基准上持续优于现有视频TTS方法，使1.3B模型达到与14B模型相当的总分。消融实验验证了自适应调度、诊断条件编辑和流形感知再降噪的必要性。

Conclusion: GEARS通过将"生成即丢弃"转变为"生成-评估-编辑"的回收循环，在保留有用结构的同时创建精炼路径，显著提升了轻量视频扩散模型在测试时扩展场景下的效率，缩小了小模型与大模型之间的质量差距。

Abstract: Recent video diffusion models have achieved remarkable generation quality, but high-fidelity results still largely depend on closed-source systems or costly large-scale infrastructure. Test-time scaling (TTS) offers a training-free way to improve lightweight generators by spending additional inference compute, yet existing methods mostly remain within a noise-search paradigm: they sample, select, or perturb denoising trajectories and discard low-scoring candidates after expensive generation. This generate-and-discard process wastes not only computation but also the partial motion, layout, or appearance structure already encoded in recoverable samples. We present \textbf{GEARS} (\textbf{G}uided \textbf{E}diting for \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}ecycling \textbf{S}earch), a training-free framework that introduces {diagnosis-guided candidate recycling} into video TTS by turning such candidates into editable priors through a generation-evaluation-editing loop. GEARS consists of two collaborative components. The \textbf{Stage-Aware Scheduler} determines what to repair, when to repair it, and which candidates should be preserved, recycled, or discarded. The \textbf{Candidate Recycler} diagnoses recoverable failures from keyframes and multi-dimensional reward feedback, derives candidate-specific repair prompts, and repairs the corresponding candidates through manifold-aware latent SDEdit. The repaired candidates are recycled into the search pool, creating refinement paths beyond standard noise perturbation while preserving useful structure. Under matched NFE budgets, GEARS consistently outperforms existing video TTS methods on VBench, bringing a 1.3B model to a total score comparable to a 14B counterpart, and ablations verify the necessity of adaptive scheduling, diagnosis-conditioned editing, and manifold-aware re-denoising. Code is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [97] [Neural video codecs quality assessment dataset and benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29331)
*Nikolay Safonov,Nikita Gornostaev,Alexandra Dubonos,Dmitriy Vatolin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个大规模主观视频质量数据集，包含由神经视频编解码器(NVCs)和传统视频编解码器压缩的视频，通过众包成对比较收集主观评分，为NVC质量评估指标的发展与基准测试提供了宝贵资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经视频编解码器(NVCs)作为新兴的视频压缩方法，引入了新的时间压缩范式，但现有的压缩质量评估方法难以适应其特性。为了推动NVC的发展和改进，需要专门针对NVC的质量评估数据集和基准。

Method: 构建大规模主观质量数据集，视频由神经和传统视频编解码器压缩，采用众包成对比较方式收集主观评分，数据集公开可用。

Result: 成功创建了一个大规模、可公开获取的NVC视频主观质量数据集，可作为质量指标开发和基准测试的资源。

Conclusion: 该数据集填补了NVC质量评估领域的空白，为针对神经视频编解码器的质量评估指标开发与基准测试提供了重要资源，有助于推动NVC技术的进一步发展。

Abstract: Video traffic constitutes a significant share of global web traffic. To reduce its volume, video codecs have been developed and continuously improved. While the industry has achieved substantial progress in traditional video coding, neural video codecs (NVCs) have recently emerged as a new approach that applies deep learning to video compression. This creates new challenges for compression quality assessment, which is essential for the further development and improvement of such codecs. In particular, it is important to evaluate the novel temporal compression paradigms introduced by NVCs. In this work, we present a large-scale subjective dataset of videos compressed with both neural and traditional video codecs. The subjective scores were collected through crowd-sourced pairwise comparisons. The proposed dataset provides a valuable resource for the development and benchmarking of video quality metrics tailored to neural video codecs. The dataset is available at the following link: https://videoprocessing.github.io/nvc-dataset-benchmark

</details>


### [98] [GenFirst: Generation Before Reconstruction for Stable End-to-End Latent Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29335)
*Guangting Zheng,Yiyuan Zhang,Tao Yang,Yunpeng Chen,Rui Zhu,Jiajun Deng,Yanyong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个无需潜在坍缩的直接端到端潜在生成模型训练方法GenFirst，通过"先生成后重建"策略解决重建与生成目标冲突，并在图像生成、文本到图像、共享潜在表征学习及统一文本-图像生成等多种任务上验证了其通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在生成模型通常采用两阶段流水线（先训练VAE再做生成），但重建优化的潜在空间并不一定有利于生成。端到端联合训练虽具吸引力，却面临潜在坍缩及生成-重建冲突两大难题，此前直接端到端训练均未成功。

Method: 通过分析不同目标函数对潜在空间的塑造作用，识别两个关键洞见：(1) KL散度目标中的熵项对防止坍缩至关重要（重建和先验拟合会收缩后验，而熵项保持潜在不确定性）；(2) 重建与生成存在不对称学习动力（重建快且强监督，生成慢且难优化）。基于此提出GenFirst策略：先生成目标在弱重建压力下塑造潜在空间，随后渐进增强重建以恢复视觉细节。

Result: 在ImageNet-256上，SiT在无CFG时gFID为1.45，有CFG时达到0.97；MMDiT在文本到图像生成上GenEval得分达0.90。框架还扩展到共享视觉潜在表征（同时支持生成与表征学习）以及连续统一文本-图像生成。

Conclusion: 通过识别熵项在防坍缩中的关键作用以及生成-重建的不对称学习动力学，实现了首个无潜在坍缩的直接端到端潜在学习，并在不同生成先验（连续自回归与SiT）及多种模态任务上证明了该方法的普适性。

Abstract: Latent generative models typically follow a two-stage pipeline, training a variational autoencoder for reconstruction and then a generative model on the frozen latent space. Since reconstruction-optimized latents are not necessarily generation-friendly, jointly training both models is an appealing alternative. However, direct end-to-end training remains challenging, as it is prone to latent collapse and faces a generation-reconstruction conflict. We revisit this problem by analyzing how different objectives shape the latent space and identify two key insights. First, the entropy term in the Kullback-Leibler divergence objective is essential for preventing collapse: reconstruction and prior fitting tend to shrink the posterior, while entropy preserves non-degenerate latent uncertainty. Second, reconstruction and generation exhibit asymmetric learning dynamics: reconstruction is fast and strongly supervised, whereas generation is slower and harder to optimize. Based on these insights, we achieve the first direct end-to-end training without latent collapse and propose GenFirst, a simple generation-before-reconstruction strategy.
