Instead of considering all preceding historical conversations or using no prior conversation information for stance detection, our TamGraph employs a stepwise, entropy-guided backtracking mechanism to selectively activate memory from historical conversations and dynamically constructs a target-aware graph to model the stance relations among utterances. This allows the exploitation of target-related information from the conversation history for stance detection while preventing the introduction of noise. Experimental results on both English and Chinese benchmarks demonstrate that our TamGraph substantially improves LLM performance on conversational stance detection.

</details>


### [304] [REIGN: Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks for Efficient Context-Length Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29899)
*Devrim Çavuşoğlu,Emre Akbaş*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: REIGN是一种针对长文档密集检索的对比训练双编码器模型，它通过对冻结的Guidance Network产生的上下文块嵌入序列进行操作，而非直接处理原始token，从而将token级处理与文档级推理解耦，大幅降低训练成本（约4个数量级），同时在多个基准上匹配或接近更大模型的检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长文档的密集检索成本高昂：token级编码器在序列长度上呈二次方扩展，且大多数长上下文嵌入模型需要通过架构变通或拉伸十亿参数LLM才能达到32K token。作者希望解耦token级处理与文档级推理，以更低成本实现高效的长文档检索。

Method: REIGN是一个对比训练的bi-encoder，它不直接在原始token上操作，而是对来自冻结的Guidance Network（GN）的序列化上下文块嵌入进行操作。模型针对多块输入（主要用于文档到文档检索），单块输入仍由GN处理。GN嵌入可缓存到磁盘，从而将每文档训练成本相对于分块Transformer微调降低约四个数量级。同时发布了用于对比训练和长上下文评估的合成长文档检索基准。

Result: 在分布内Wikipedia基准、分布外LoCo套件以及真实专利检索案例研究中，REIGN以更小的参数预算匹配了密集长上下文检索器。配对显著性检验显示其在专利任务上与1.6-4.3倍大的模型相当，在LoCo上保持在20倍大小模型nDCG@10的0.65以内。

Conclusion: REIGN通过将token级处理（由冻结GN完成）与文档级推理（由轻量模型完成）解耦，实现了长文档检索的高效性和竞争力，为长上下文检索提供了一种兼顾成本与性能的新范式。

Abstract: Dense retrieval over long documents is expensive. Token-level encoders scale quadratically in sequence length, and most long-context embedding models reach 32K tokens only through architectural workarounds or by stretching billion-parameter LLMs. We propose REIGN (Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks), a contrastively trained bi-encoder that operates on sequences of contextualised chunk embeddings from a frozen Guidance Network (GN) rather than on raw tokens. REIGN targets multi-chunk inputs, primarily for document-to-document retrieval; single-chunk inputs stay with the GN. Decoupling token-level processing from document-level reasoning, and caching the GN embeddings to disk, cuts per-document training cost by roughly four orders of magnitude relative to chunked Transformer fine-tuning. We also release a synthetic long-document retrieval benchmark for contrastive training and evaluation at long context lengths. Across an in-distribution Wikipedia benchmark, the LoCo out-of-distribution suite, and a real-world patent retrieval case study, REIGN matches dense long-context retrievers at smaller parameter budgets in each regime. A paired significance test puts it on par with models 1.6-4.3x larger on the patent task, and it stays within 0.65 nDCG@10 of a 20x-larger model on LoCo.

</details>


### [305] [Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31076)
*Xuehai Wang,Haowei Qin,Tongxin Liu,Junkai Li,Buqiang Xu,Jintian Zhang,Yijun Chen,Zirui Xue,Shumin Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了AutoSciRub，一个评估优先（evaluation-first）的框架，在科学研究的执行前诱导出任务特定的可执行评分标准（rubric），用于指导研究执行、标准级验证和迭代修订，在多个基准上显著提升了自主科研智能体的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式的科研任务往往没有明确指定所需的分析、方法和成功标准，导致智能体可能遗漏重要分析、使用不当方法或得出证据支撑不足的结论。现有方法缺乏对隐式实验和证据需求的显式刻画。

Method: AutoSciRub将模糊指令分解为原子科学目标，将其锚定在相关文献和任务可见数据上，并综合生成具体、可操作、可验证的标准。评分标准在执行前生成，用于指导执行过程；在修订阶段，由评分标准引导的验证识别未满足的标准，实现研究报告及其支持工件的针对性精炼。

Result: 在ResearchClawBench上，固定Codex harness下三个骨干LLM平均提升2.08分，固定DeepSeek-V4-Flash骨干下三个agent harness平均提升2.95分；在AstaBench E2E Discovery的20任务随机子集上，三个agent harness平均提升16.8分，同时保持或增加成功完成任务数。

Conclusion: 评估优先的指导机制为自主科学研究提供了一种有效且可泛化的控制机制。

Abstract: Autonomous scientific research agents are increasingly applied to end-to-end scientific workflows, including literature review, data analysis, experimentation, and report generation. However, open-ended research tasks often do not clearly specify the analyses, methods, and success criteria required to complete the task. As a result, agents may miss important analyses, use inappropriate methods, or draw conclusions that are insufficiently supported by evidence. To address the problem, we present AutoSciRub, an evaluation-first framework that induces a task-specific executable rubric before research execution, and uses it to guide execution, criterion-level verification as well as iterative revision. AutoSciRub decomposes an underspecified instruction into atomic scientific goals, grounds them in relevant literature and task-visible data, and synthesizes specific, actionable, and verifiable criteria. The resulting rubric makes implicit experimental and evidential requirements explicit, providing guidance for experiments and analyses. During revision, rubric-guided verification identifies unmet criteria and enables targeted refinement of the research report and its supporting artifacts. On ResearchClawBench, AutoSciRub consistently improves all tested configurations, with an average gain of 2.08 points across three backbone LLMs under the fixed Codex harness and 2.95 points across three agent harnesses using a fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone. On a randomly sampled 20-task subset of AstaBench E2E Discovery, AutoSciRub further achieves an average improvement of 16.8 points across three agent harnesses, while maintaining or increasing the number of successfully completed tasks. These results demonstrate that evaluation-first guidance provides an effective and generalizable control mechanism for autonomous scientific research (Code: https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoSciRub).

</details>


### [306] [Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs: Why Models Answer Structurally Unanswerable Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29109)
*Yucheng Du,Xiyang Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大型语言模型面对结构性不可回答的问题（如计算cot(-540°)或评估(1).startswith("1")）时往往给出自信答案而非拒绝回答。研究发现模型中存在一个可用的"无合法答案"信号（线性方向），但该信号与安全拒绝路径几乎正交，导致模型虽有识别能力却无法将其路由到拒答行为，这本质上是一种路由失败而非编码失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在遇到结构性不可回答的问题时倾向于编造答案而非拒绝回答，这引发了一个关键疑问：模型是根本没有识别出问题不可回答（识别失败），还是识别出来了但未能将这一认知转化为拒答行为（路由失败）？理解这一机制对提升模型可靠性和安全性至关重要。

Method: 作者在1.7B到70B参数的指令微调模型上，使用线性探针方法在隐藏状态中寻找区分可回答与结构性不可回答问题的方向；将该方向与安全拒绝方向及行为定义的无效感知方向进行比较（余弦相似度）；并通过生成时沿识别方向进行方向引导（steering）来验证因果性，同时对比基座模型与指令微调模型。

Result: （1）单一线性方向在隐藏状态中即可区分可回答与结构性不可回答的数学和代码问题；（2）该识别方向与安全拒绝方向几乎正交；（3）行为定义的无效感知方向与识别方向仅部分对齐；（4）沿识别方向引导可双向、剂量依赖地改变无效感知行为，而随机方向无效；（5）正交几何在预训练结束时已存在。

Conclusion: 模型对结构性不可回答问题的自信错误回答更可能是路由失败而非编码失败：模型内部存在可用的"无合法答案"信号，但安全拒绝路径未与之对齐，无法利用该信号触发拒答行为。这一发现为改进模型拒答机制提供了新的干预方向。

Abstract: Large language models often answer structurally unanswerable questions, such as computing cot(-540°) or evaluating (1).startswith("1"), instead of abstaining. We ask whether this failure reflects missing recognition or failed routing from recognition to abstention. Across instruction-tuned models from 1.7B to 70B parameters, a single linear direction in the hidden state separates answerable from structurally impossible math and code prompts, showing that models represent impossibility before generation. Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. Generation-time steering along the recognition direction changes invalidity-aware behavior bidirectionally and dose-responsively on structural math and code cells, while random directions do not. Base/instruct comparisons further show that the low-cosine geometry is already present at the pretraining endpoint. The confident-on-impossible failure is therefore better explained as a routing failure than as an encoding failure: the model has a usable "no admissible answer" signal, but the safety-refusal pathway is not aligned to use it.

</details>


### [307] [HEAR Who Said What: Unlocking Speaker-Attributed Reasoning via Counterfactual Voice Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29120)
*Dongwook Lee,Sangkwon Park,Eunwoo Song,Che Hyun Lee,Youngho Cho,Junho Kim,June Young Yi,Heeseung Kim,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出HEAR基准（2.4K人工验证样本，来自887个多说话人音频片段），用于诊断语音语言模型（SLM）的说话人归因推理能力。评估20个主流SLM后发现它们在此类基础任务上表现困难，常依赖语义先验而非真实声学线索。为此提出A2R模型（30B参数），通过在Counterfactual Audio with Speaker-level Hard negatives (CASH)数据集上优化，使其优先利用声学语音线索而非语言信号，在HEAR上表现优异并展现出对多种多说话人下游任务的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多说话人环境中SLM的部署日益普遍，但这些模型能否正确地将语音归因到对应的说话人、并基于说话人身份进行推理，仍然是一个未被充分研究的问题。现有模型在此类基础能力上表现不佳，且缺乏系统评估该能力的基准。

Method: 1) 构建HEAR基准，采用概念上分层的方式诊断说话人归因推理的基础能力；2) 提出A2R模型（30B参数），在CASH数据集（包含反事实音频和说话人级别的困难负样本）上优化，引导模型优先关注声学语音线索而非语言信号。

Result: 评估20个领先的SLM在HEAR上表现欠佳，常依赖语义先验而非实际声学线索。A2R在HEAR上取得强性能，并对多种多说话人下游任务展现出零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 学习说话人归因能力能够解锁SLM潜在的语言感知推理能力，说明说话人归因是说话人感知推理的关键基础能力。

Abstract: Speech Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-speaker environments, yet their ability to attribute speech to the correct speaker and reason over speaker identities remains unclear. Hence, we introduce HEAR, a conceptually hierarchical benchmark diagnosing the foundational capabilities of speaker-attributed reasoning, comprising 2.4K human-verified samples from 887 diverse multi-party audio clips. Evaluating 20 leading SLMs on HEAR reveals they struggle with these foundational tasks, often relying on semantic priors rather than actual vocal cues. To address this, we present A2R, a 30B model optimized on Counterfactual Audio with Speaker-level Hard negatives (CASH), a dataset designed to guide the model to prioritize acoustic vocal cues over linguistic signals. A2R achieves strong performance on HEAR and exhibits zero-shot generalization to diverse multi-speaker downstream tasks, demonstrating that learned speaker attribution unlocks the model's latent capacity for speaker-aware reasoning. All resources are available at https://attributetoreason.github.io/AttributeToReason/

</details>


### [308] [AI Historian: Helping historians organize and verify person-centred temporal clues from dispersed historical narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29133)
*Yifeng Lu,Zijie Yang,Jie Li,Qingkai Min,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AIH（AI Historian）是一个AI代理系统，帮助历史学家从分散的传记叙事中组织人物-时间证据。它以源句为证据单元，识别人物和时间线索，验证跨文本关联并推断可比较的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。在六例《史记》案例上，AIH Agent的时间定位MicroIoU达86.2%（人工标注81.3%，直接LLM提示仅17.1%），且仅需约14分钟（人工需1小时32分），并已扩展到二十四史及东亚、近现代史料。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史记录并非以完整连续的形式保存，人物活动、关系和历史背景的信息散落在不同文本、章节和叙事视角中，历史学家需检索、识别和比较这些材料以重建时间序列并核验来源，工作繁琐且成本高昂。

Method: 构建AI代理系统AIH：以源句作为证据单元，识别人物与时间线索，验证候选跨文本关联，推断可比较的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。

Result: 在涉及刘邦、项羽、萧何的六例《史记》案例中，AIH Agent时间定位MicroIoU达86.2%，优于人工标注（81.3%）和直接LLM提示（17.1%）；耗时约14分钟，远少于人工的1小时32分钟；并成功应用于二十四史、其他中国古代史、日本/韩国古代史及近现代史料，结果通过Westlake Historian发布。

Conclusion: AIH能够在规模化场景下降低历史材料组织的成本，将因章节化叙事而掩盖的关联转化为可追溯、可修订的研究问题，供协作验证，展示了AI代理在历史研究中的实际价值。

Abstract: History is not preserved in complete, continuous form. Accounts of a person's activities, relationships and historical contexts are scattered across texts, chapters and narrative perspectives; historians must retrieve, identify and compare these materials to reconstruct temporal sequences and verify them against sources. Here we present AI Historian (AIH), an AI agent system that helps historians organize person-time evidence from dispersed biographical narratives. It takes source sentences as evidence units, identifies people and temporal cues, verifies candidate cross-text associations and infers comparable temporal ranges while preserving traceable source-text evidence. We evaluated AIH on six Shiji cases concerning Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Xiao He. AIH Agent achieved a temporal-localization MicroIoU of 86.2%, compared with 81.3% for human-only annotation and 17.1% for direct large-language-model prompting; it required about 14 min, versus 1 h 32 min for human-only annotation. We further applied AIH to the Twenty-Four Histories and other ancient Chinese histories, ancient Japanese and Korean histories, and modern and contemporary historical materials, and released the results through Westlake Historian. These results indicate that AIH can reduce the cost of organizing historical materials at scale while turning connections obscured by chapter-based narration into traceable, revisable research questions for collaborative testing.

</details>


### [309] [Beyond Polarization: The Generative Constraint of Chain-of-Thought in Pointwise Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30398)
*Xiaoyang Chen,Jie Liu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi,Jin Ma,Ben He,Yingfei Sun,Dezhi Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究确认了点式文档重排序中Chain-of-Thought模型持续不如直接评分模型的差距，并验证了该差距在高达32B参数规模下依然稳定存在。尽管通过强化学习、细粒度监督和架构解耦等干预手段可以修复分类准确性和绝对分数，但相对排序差距依然无法消除，表明这一瓶颈源于将连续相关性语义通过离散文本路由所导致的信息分辨力损失，而非简单的训练偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将CoT重排序模型不及直接评分模型归因于分类能力差、分数极化或校准崩溃等问题，但尚不清楚通过针对性训练是否能够弥合这一差距。作者旨在通过系统性干预实验验证这一差距的本质原因。

Method: 首先在高达32B参数的多个模型规模上确认CoT与直接评分模型之间的性能差距稳定存在；然后设计三种压力测试干预：强化学习、细粒度监督（fine-grained supervision）和架构解耦（architectural decoupling），分别针对分类能力、绝对分数和校准偏差进行显式修复。

Result: 尽管这些干预手段确实改善了模型的分类准确率和绝对分数，但相对排序（ranking）的差距依然存在且无法消除。差距在不同模型规模下保持稳定，且对多种干预手段具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 点式评分范式下，将连续的相关性语义量化为离散文本（CoT）会限制排序信号的分辨率，这是一个在当前标准方法下难以克服的稳定瓶颈，而非可以通过训练轻易修正的偏差。作者建议可能需要跳出点式评分范式来寻找解决方案。

Abstract: In pointwise document reranking, Chain-of-Thought models typically underperform direct scoring models. While existing diagnostics attribute this to inferior classification, score polarization, or calibration breakdown, whether targeted training can bridge this gap remains unclear. Our empirical study first confirms that this gap is stable across scales up to 32B parameters, ruling out model and data capacity confounders. We then apply stress tests utilizing reinforcement learning, fine-grained supervision, and architectural decoupling to explicitly repair these deviations. Although these interventions improve classification accuracy and absolute scores, the relative ranking gap persists. These findings suggest that, within the pointwise scoring paradigm, routing continuous relevance semantics through discrete text constrains ranking signal resolution, revealing a bottleneck that is stable and difficult to overcome under current standard methods, rather than an easily resolvable training bias.

</details>


### [310] [Quantifying Error Tolerance in Synthetic Data: An Atomic-level Operand vs. Operator Perturbation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29144)
*Jiaxiang Liu,Chenhao Yuan,Shuwen Xu,Boxuan Xing,Xiusheng Huang,Yinhao Xu,Hao Liu,Wenhao Teng,Xiangwen Liao,Pengfei Cao,Jun Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ATOM框架，将合成数据分解为功能单元f(x)→y，区分良性操作数(Operand x)扰动与致命操作符(Operator f)扰动，揭示模型对前者鲁棒但对后者崩溃的双重分离现象，并通过优先操作符多样性实现优于激进/宽松过滤策略的数据生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据生成对大型语言模型至关重要，但缺乏对错误容忍度的定量分析，导致现有过滤策略陷入两难：激进过滤可能排除有价值样本，宽松过滤无法有效消除错误样本。

Method: 提出ATOM框架，将数据分解为功能单元f(x)→y，区分操作数(x)扰动与操作符(f)扰动；通过实验揭示模型对操作数扰动鲁棒、对操作符扰动敏感的双重分离，并据此调整数据合成优先级。

Result: 实验显示双重分离现象：模型对操作数扰动鲁棒但对操作符扰动崩溃。ATOM合成数据在性能上超过严格基线，如相比LIMA提升3.1%，表明操作符多样性的重要性高于操作数精度。

Conclusion: 操作符多样性比操作数精度更关键，ATOM框架为合成数据的错误容忍分析提供了量化基础，指导更合理的数据过滤与生成策略。

Abstract: Synthetic data generation has become a cornerstone for advancing large language models. However, the lack of the quantitative analysis for error tolerance became a critical bottleneck. Consequently, current filtering strategies fluctuate between two extremes: they are either overly aggressive, risking the exclusion of potentially valuable samples, or overly permissive, failing to eliminate erroneous samples effectively. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (ATOM), a framework that decomposes data into functional units ($f(x)\rightarrow y$). ATOM distinguishes benign Operand $x$ perturbations from fatal Operator $f$ perturbations. The former are needlessly discarded by aggressive filtering, while the latter slip through permissive filtering. Our experiments reveal a double dissociation: models are robust to operand perturbations but collapse under operator perturbations. By prioritizing operator over aggressive operand precision, our ATOM-synthesized data outperforms rigorous baselines (e.g., +3.1% gain over LIMA), suggesting that operator diversity matters more than operand precision. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lut-hub/ATOM.

</details>


### [311] [Toward a Cross-Lingual Romanization Ecosystem for Sinitic Languages: A Paired Mandarin-Cantonese Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29170)
*Zijie Zhang,Tan Lee,Yong Cao,Benyou Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem，一个跨语言的汉语方言罗马化设计框架，包含数字基础设施和开源工作流。通过四个设计原则（语音对应、历史音韵对应、一音一符、基本拉丁字母）实现系统性的跨语言罗马化对齐，并开发了粤语（CantRomZJ1）和普通话（MandRomZJ1）等方言罗马化方案。实验表明，相比Pinyin+Jyutping基线，该方案在语音转罗马化任务中将粤语WER和CER分别降低7.80%和10.61%，证明跨语言罗马化对齐可提升低资源汉语方言语音技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 汉语各方言（如粤语、客家话、吴语等）之间存在大量同源词，但现有罗马化方案（如拼音、粤拼）互不兼容，缺乏系统性的跨语言对齐。这种不一致限制了低资源汉语方言语音技术中的迁移学习能力，因此需要一套统一的设计框架来对齐各方言的罗马化系统。

Method: 提出四个设计原则：语音对应（相似音用相似符号）、历史音韵对应（同源罗马化字符串对齐）、一音一符、基本拉丁字母使用。基于此框架开发粤语CantRomZJ1和普通话MandRomZJ1等方案；构建开源基础设施支持结构化存储、转换、解析、词典构建和输入法生成；通过Meta MMS微调进行语音转罗马化实验评估。

Result: 相比Pinyin+Jyutping基线，MandRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1组合使粤语WER降低7.80%，CER降低10.61%，验证了跨语言罗马化对齐对低资源汉语方言语音迁移的有效性。

Conclusion: 跨语言罗马化对齐能够有效改善低资源汉语方言语音技术中的迁移效果，该设计框架和开源基础设施为汉语方言语音处理提供了系统化的支撑。

Abstract: This paper proposes the Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem, a cross-lingual Sinitic romanization design framework with supporting digital infrastructure and a community-driven open-source workflow. The design framework addresses the lack of systematic cross-lingual romanization alignment among Sinitic languages through four design principles: phonetic correspondence for representing similar sounds with similar romanized symbols, historical-phonological correspondence for aligning cognate romanization strings, one-phoneme-one-symbol, and basic Latin-letter use, with a balancing consideration recognizing trade-offs among these principles. For the main paired case study, we devel-op CantRomZJ1 and MandRomZJ1, Cantonese and Manda-rin romanization schemes following the design framework, respectively. We also develop schemes for several other Sinitic languages, including Meixian Hakka, Shanghai Wu, and Nanjing Jianghuai Mandarin, following the same de-sign framework. To bring the romanization schemes into practical use, we develop open-source infrastructure for structured romanization storage, conversion, parsing, dic-tionary construction, and input-method generation. Finally, we evaluate the design framework through speech-to-romanization experiments based on Meta's Massively Mul-tilingual Speech (MMS) fine-tuning. Compared with the Pinyin+Jyutping baseline, our Man-dRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1 condition reduces Cantonese WER and CER by 7.80% and 10.61%, respectively. These results suggest that cross-lingual romanization alignment can improve transfer in low-resource Sinitic speech technology.

</details>


### [312] [Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29209)
*Millicent Ochieng,Felermino D. M. A. Ali,Elizabeth A. Ankrah,Najeeb Gambo Abdulhamid,Migisha Boyd,Stephanie Nyairo,Mercy Muchai,Samuel Chege Maina,Aditya Vashistha,Anja Thieme,Jacki O'Neill*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过社区扎根的混合方法评估，研究AI生成的多模态故事与五个非洲社区的文化对齐程度，提出文化对齐的分类体系，并评估多模态LLM评判员能否大规模近似社区判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成多模态内容的评估往往缺乏社区视角，忽视生成内容是否真正符合代表性社区的生活实践、关系、语言、价值观和视觉期望。作者希望通过社区扎根的评估来理解文化对齐的本质，并检验自动化评估的可靠性。

Method: 采用混合方法：对19位来自五个非洲社区的文化代表进行定量标注与定性焦点小组讨论；基于评估结果构建包含五大文化标记类别和八种错位机制的分类体系；进一步评估五个多模态LLM评判员在社区判断上的表现。

Result: 发现文化对齐不仅取决于可识别的文化标记，更取决于这些标记如何融入社会、语言、程序和视觉语境；自动评判员的可靠性和分数校准在不同社区间差异显著，没有任何单一评判员能在所有五个社区中表现一致。

Conclusion: 研究倡导社区校准的评估管线：自动化评判员需先针对社区判断进行验证，以确定其可被信任的领域，同时在需要人工审查的地方保留人类参与。

Abstract: In this paper, we examine how well AI-generated multimodal stories align with the lived practices, relationships, language, values, and visual expectations of the communities they represent. We conduct a community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, combining quantitative annotations with qualitative focus group discussions. We find that cultural alignment depends not simply on recognizable cultural markers, but on how those markers fit social, linguistic, procedural, and visual context. From these evaluations, we develop a taxonomy of cultural alignment comprising five broader cultural marker categories and eight recurring mechanisms of misalignment. We additionally evaluate five multimodal LLM judges to examine whether automated evaluation can approximate community-grounded judgments at scale. Judge reliability and score calibration vary substantially across communities, with no single judge performing consistently across all five settings. These findings motivate community-calibrated evaluation pipelines in which automated judges are validated against community judgments to determine where they can be trusted and where human review remains necessary.

</details>


### [313] [Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30468)
*Jueun Kim,Sungho Park,Wook-Shin Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Hi-Q，一种证据条件化的层次化查询细化框架，用于解决多跳问答中查询粒度与语料库证据粒度不匹配的核心瓶颈。Hi-Q 通过解析算子判断检索证据是否支持当前查询单元，已解决节点终止，未解决节点通过保持依赖的二元算子展开，并由语义覆盖验证器检查，从而依据语料库支持信号（而非固定模板或预建图）动态生长查询树。在三个多跳 QA 基准上的全语料库检索设置中，Hi-Q 平均达到 52.3 EM / 64.0 F1，显著超越 IRCoT 和 PropRAG 等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通过固定图结构、迭代改写查询或执行生成程序来处理查询与证据粒度不匹配问题，但这些策略无法明确判断一个查询单元何时已被证据支持、何时应被细化，缺乏针对可检索粒度发现问题的显式决策机制。

Method: Hi-Q 在每个查询节点上使用解析算子测试检索证据是否支持当前查询单元；已解析节点终止，未解析节点由保持依赖的二元算子展开，并由语义覆盖验证器检查。由此生成由语料库支持信号决定拓扑结构的查询树，而非依赖固定分解模板或预建图。

Result: 在三个多跳 QA 基准的全语料库检索设置下，Hi-Q 平均达到 52.3 EM / 64.0 F1，比迭代检索基线 IRCoT 平均高 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1；在 MuSiQue-full 上比基于图的 RAG 基线 PropRAG 高 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1 且无需全语料库图构建。在受限支持/干扰设置中平均达 57.9 EM / 69.3 F1，分别领先 PropRAG 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1 和 IRCoT 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1。

Conclusion: Hi-Q 通过证据条件化的层次化查询细化，显式地决策查询单元的解析与否，并在多种检索设置下超越现有基线，验证了以语料库支持信号驱动查询树生长的有效性。

Abstract: A central bottleneck in multi-hop Question Answering (QA) is that the granularity at which a question is expressed often differs from the granularity at which corpus evidence is retrievable. Existing methods address this mismatch by imposing fixed graph structures over the corpus, by iteratively reformulating the query, or by executing a generated program over it, but these strategies do not explicitly decide when a query unit is already supported by evidence and when it should be refined. We formulate this bottleneck as retrievable granularity discovery and introduce Hi-Q, an evidence-conditioned framework for hierarchical query refinement. At each query node, a resolution operator tests whether retrieved evidence supports the current query unit; resolved nodes terminate, while unresolved nodes are expanded by a dependency-preserving binary operator and checked by a semantic coverage verifier. Hi-Q therefore grows a query tree whose topology is determined by corpus support signals rather than by a fixed decomposition template or a pre-built graph. We evaluate Hi-Q on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, primarily under full-corpus retrieval, where dependent evidence must be located among open-domain distractors rather than within a small annotated pool. In this setting Hi-Q reaches 52.3 EM and 64.0 F1 averaged over the three benchmarks, ahead of the iterative retrieval baseline IRCoT by 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1 on that same average, and ahead of the graph-based RAG baseline PropRAG by 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1 on MuSiQue-full, without corpus-wide graph construction. In the restricted supporting/distractor setting used by prior work, Hi-Q likewise attains the best accuracy, with 57.9 EM and 69.3 F1 on average, ahead of PropRAG by 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1 and IRCoT by 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1. The project page is available at https://hi-q-project.github.io/.

</details>


### [314] [Attribute-Based Activation Steering of LLMs for Group-Specific Explanation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29215)
*Leandra Fichtel,Janek Prange,Henning Wachsmuth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于激活工程的方法来引导大语言模型生成针对特定目标群体的个性化解释，通过计算群体特定的属性引导向量并添加到模型内部激活中，实现对解释风格和知识水平的细粒度控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠提示词无法有效让LLM生成针对不同背景和能力的个性化解释，缺乏其他计算方法来对解释进行群体定制。

Method: 首先识别目标群体在解释风格和知识水平上的群体特定属性，然后基于激活工程计算属性引导向量，在推理过程中将其添加到LLM的内部激活中，实现细粒度的解释引导。

Result: 与提示词方法和最先进的引导基线相比，该方法在特异性上显著更好地将解释定制到目标群体，同时在很大程度上保持了事实性。实验还通过不同目标群体的专家人工评估验证了效果。

Conclusion: 激活工程比提示词能更有效地对LLM进行结构化引导，可在维持事实性的同时实现面向特定群体的个性化解释生成。

Abstract: To effectively enable people to understand new topics, explanations should be tailored to their backgrounds and abilities. So far, prompting alone has been shown to be insufficient for creating such explanations and other computational methods are missing. Therefore, this paper investigates whether LLMs can be steered to generate explanations that are tailored to a specific group of people. To this end, we propose an approach that first identifies group-specific attributes in terms of explanatory style and knowledge of a specific target group. Building on activation engineering, it then computes attribute-based steering vectors and adds them to the internal activations of an LLM during inference to enable a fine-grained steering. In our experiments, we assess the steering effectiveness of our approach in terms of specificity and factuality of the generated explanations. Additionally, we evaluate the explanations in a study with human experts from different target groups. Compared to prompting and state-of-the-art steering baselines, our approach tailors the explanations significantly better to the target group while largely maintaining factuality.

</details>


### [315] [ECGQuest: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Language Models for Electrocardiography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30893)
*Mohammadsina Hassannia,Matthew A. Reyna,Reza Sameni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了ECGQuest，一个基于文献构建的ECG（心电图）解读知识基准数据集，包含10,904道独特的判断题及其否定形式（共21,808个问答对）。评估了23个语言模型（3个商业模型和20个开源模型），并通过LoRA微调了5个7-14B参数的开源模型。零样本准确率在49.5%-74.4%之间，GPT-5表现最佳；微调后所有开源模型提升6.5-14.1%，最佳模型达到76.3%，五模型投票集成达到78.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型基准主要评估广泛的医学知识或单个ECG信号/图像的解读，而非ECG解读所需的更广泛的上下文知识（如心脏病学、电生理学、临床诊断、信号采集和仪器等）。需要一个专门针对ECG上下文知识的基准来评估和微调ECG特定的语言模型。

Method: 1) 使用GPT-4o流水线从23本ECG参考书籍和2003-2025年的Computing in Cardiology会议论文中生成问题；2) 构建10,904道独特判断题及其否定形式（21,808个问答对）；3) 在零样本设置下评估3个商业模型和20个开源模型；4) 对5个7-14B参数的开源模型使用LoRA进行微调，并以BERT和BiomedBERT作为监督编码器基线；5) 在MedMCQA和MedQA的ECG相关子集上进行泛化评估。

Result: 零样本准确率范围49.5%-74.4%，GPT-5表现最佳。通用模型优于医学专用模型，多个模型表现出强烈的判断偏见，编码器基线接近随机水平。微调提升开源模型6.5-14.1%，微调后的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B达到76.3%准确率，五模型投票集成达到78.5%。在MedMCQA和MedQA上，微调主要惠及较弱或类别有偏见的模型，并未一致改善强基础模型。

Conclusion: ECGQuest提供了一个可复现的ECG上下文知识基准，并表明参数高效微调可以使较小的语言模型与更大的商业模型竞争。这为ECG特定领域语言模型的评估和开发提供了重要资源。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation requires knowledge of cardiology, electrophysiology, clinical diagnosis, ECG waveforms, signal acquisition, and instrumentation. Existing language-model benchmarks, however, primarily assess broad medical knowledge or interpretation of individual ECG signals and images rather than the broader contextual knowledge required for ECG interpretation. We developed ECGQuest, a literature-grounded resource for evaluating and fine-tuning ECG-specific language models. A GPT-4o-based pipeline generated questions from 23 ECG references and Computing in Cardiology proceedings from 2003-2025. The final dataset contains 10,904 unique True/False questions paired with their negated forms (21,808 Q&A pairs). We evaluated three commercial and 20 open-source language models on a held-out test set in a zero-shot setting. Five open-source models with 7-14B parameters were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation, with BERT and BiomedBERT included as supervised encoder baselines. Generalization was assessed on ECG-related subsets of MedMCQA and MedQA converted to binary True/False questions using official answer keys. Zero-shot accuracy on ECGQuest ranged from 49.5% to 74.4%, with GPT-5 performing best. General-purpose models outperformed medically specialized models, several models showed strong True/False bias, and encoder baselines performed near chance. Fine-tuning improved all open-source models by 6.5-14.1%. Fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B reached 76.3% accuracy, while a five-model voting ensemble reached 78.5%. On MedMCQA and MedQA, fine-tuning mainly benefited weaker or class-biased models and did not consistently improve strong base models. ECGQuest provides a reproducible benchmark for contextual ECG knowledge and shows that parameter-efficient fine-tuning can make smaller language models competitive with substantially larger commercial models.

</details>


### [316] [Anchoring Speech with Semantics: A Multimodal Adapter Mechanism for Automatic Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29239)
*Kuan-Tang Huang,Cheng-Yeh Yang,Chien-Chun Wang,Hung-Shin Lee,Hsin-Min Wang,Berlin Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了SAMA-ASR，一种轻量级适配器机制，通过从辅助翻译中提取语义锚点和从语音中提取声学锚点来增强解码器，从而改善低资源语音识别（ASR）性能。在两个30小时的低资源闽南语和客家语数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源ASR面临的主要挑战是稀缺的转录文本只能为解码器端生成提供有限的监督信号，导致模型难以充分利用有限的训练数据。

Method: 提出SAMA-ASR机制：1）设计轻量级适配器，将解码器与来自辅助翻译的语义锚点以及来自语音的声学锚点结合起来；2）通过跨模态适配，使解码器状态同时基于翻译衍生的语义嵌入和语音嵌入进行条件化；3）在推理时，语义锚点可由上游语音到文本翻译器自动生成，无需oracle翻译。

Result: 在两个30小时的低资源汉语方言（台湾闽南语和客家语）数据集上，SAMA-ASR优于声学基线、基于提示的基线以及仅语义翻译引导的基线；在自动语义锚点设置下仍保持有效性；紧凑的ST模型也能生成有用的语义锚点。

Conclusion: SAMA-ASR通过融合语义锚点与声学锚点的跨模态适配机制，为低资源ASR提供了一种有效且可推广到类似编码器-解码器多任务语音模型的轻量级解决方案。

Abstract: Low-resource ASR remains difficult because scarce transcripts provide limited supervised evidence for target-side generation. To address this gap, we propose SAMA-ASR, a lightweight adapter mechanism that augments the decoder with semantic anchors from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech; in principle, the mechanism can be applied to similar encoder--decoder multitask speech models. Through cross-modal adaptation, SAMA-ASR conditions decoder states on translation-derived semantic embeddings and a speech embedding, combining utterance-level meaning with speech-grounded evidence before token prediction. At evaluation time, these semantic anchors can be generated automatically by an upstream speech-to-text translator rather than supplied as oracle translations. Experiments on two 30-hour datasets covering the low-resource Sinitic varieties Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka show that SAMA-ASR improves over acoustic, prior prompt-based, and semantic-only translation-guided baselines and remains effective in practical automatic semantic-anchor settings; translator-capacity analyses show that useful semantic anchors can be produced by a compact ST model.

</details>


### [317] [When Patients Cut In: Extending Clinical Conversational AI Safety to Interruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29241)
*Zachary Ellis,Spencer Hazel,Adam Brandt,Yajie Vera He,Ernest Lim,Jared Joselowitz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对临床语音智能体在真实场景中患者会打断系统说话的问题，提出了一种基于转录本的打断恢复评估方法。作者将对话分析中的重叠类别改编为三种操作性打断类型（识别型、竞争型、过渡子单元型），并测试了四种部署导向的LLM配置在四个场景单元（病史采集和信息提供）中的表现，评估系统是否保留临床必需内容。结果显示：信息提供场景中所有模型都出现失败率上升，竞争型FAQ打断导致四种模型全部30/30失败（占88.6-100.0%），道歉标记("对不起打断")对恢复的改善不稳定且不一致，甚至对某个模型反而降低恢复率。因此，打断鲁棒性不能用一个单一分数衡量，评估必须基于内容、按单元报告，并与部署的打断特征相匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床语音智能体已在真实诊疗中部署，但真实患者会打断医生/系统说话。现有级联架构（语音转文本→LLM→文本转语音）在患者中途打断时可能丢失临床必需内容。然而，临床对话AI基准几乎都假设患者会耐心等待智能体说完，完全忽略了打断导致的内容丢失问题。

Method: 作者提出基于转录本的打断恢复评估方法：(1) 将对话分析的overlap类别改编为三种可操作打断类型——识别型(recognitional)、竞争型(competitive)、过渡子单元型(transitional sub-unit)；(2) 测试四种非推理型LLM配置；(3) 覆盖四个场景单元，横跨病史采集（信息收集）和FAQ（信息提供）两类任务；(4) 评分标准为智能体是否保留临床必需内容。

Result: 信息收集单元中，目标问题失败率因模型而异；信息提供单元中（可进行直接对比），所有模型的失败率均上升。不同场景单元的排名不一致。竞争型FAQ打断导致四种模型全部出现30/30的信息提供覆盖失败（Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%；基线为三种模型0/30，Llama为4/30）。道歉标记"对不起打断"使恢复率改变数十个百分点，但在模型间表现不一致，对某个模型反而降低了恢复率。

Conclusion: 打断鲁棒性不能简化为单一评分。评估必须：(1) 以内容为基础进行判断；(2) 按场景单元分别报告结果；(3) 与部署环境的实际打断特征相匹配。这为临床语音智能体的可靠性评估提供了新的方法论框架。

Abstract: Clinical voice agents are now deployed in routine care, where real patients do not wait their turn: they interrupt. These systems typically use a cascaded architecture (speech-to-text -> LLM -> text-to-speech), so when a patient cuts the agent off mid-utterance, clinically required content can be lost even when the model handles cooperative transcripts well. Yet clinical conversational-AI benchmarks almost universally assume patients wait for the agent to finish, missing interruption-induced loss of required content. We present a transcript-based evaluation of interruption recovery, adapting conversation-analytic overlap categories into three operational types (recognitional, competitive, transitional sub-unit) and testing four deployment-oriented, non-reasoning LLM configurations across four cells spanning history-taking (information gathering) and FAQ (information provision), scored on whether the agent preserves the clinically required content. In the gathering cells, target-question failure varied across models; in the provision cells, where arms are directly comparable, failure rose for every model. Rankings differ across cells, and competitive FAQ interruption produced 30/30 provision-coverage failures for all four models (Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%; baseline 0/30 for three, 4/30 for Llama). A brief apology marker ("sorry to interrupt") shifts recovery by tens of percentage points, inconsistently across models, and for one it reduces recovery. Interruption robustness therefore cannot be a single score: evaluation must be content-grounded, reported per cell, and matched to the deployment's interruption profile.

</details>


### [318] [Configurable Semantic Chunking for Biomedical Information Extraction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31139)
*Riya Ahuja,Tim Kacprowski,Roya Shiasi Sardoabi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可配置的语义分块框架，通过实体保留窗口、触发词中心分块、命题优先提取、分层触发词优先级和层级关系解析等策略，替代BioMedRAG中固定的等长分块。在生物医学关系抽取基准（GM-CIHT、DDI、ChemProt）和不良反应分类（ADE）上评估，其中GM-CIHT上全混合配置取得82.6% F1，比固定分块基线（74.2%）提升8.4个点。跨数据集分析表明语义分块对具有显式关系线索的抽取数据集更有效，而固定分块在密集生化学抽取和二元分类任务中仍具竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BioMedRAG虽引入了带学习分块评分器的检索增强生成用于生物医学信息抽取，但其依赖固定大小的分块方式，可能导致语义证据被割裂，从而影响抽取性能。本文旨在解决这一局限性。

Method: 提出一种可配置的语义分块框架，包含五个核心组件：实体保留窗口、触发词中心分块、命题优先提取、分层触发词优先级和层级关系解析。该框架仅替换BioMedRAG中的分块构建阶段，保留嵌入模型、学习分块评分器、生成器和评估协议不变。

Result: 在GM-CIHT上，全混合配置达到82.6% F1，较固定分块基线（74.2%）提升8.4个百分点。跨数据集分析显示，语义分块在具有显式关系线索的抽取数据集（GM-CIHT和DDI）上效果更优，而在密集生化学抽取和二元分类设置（ChemProt和ADE）下固定分块仍具竞争力或更优。

Conclusion: 通过将分块逻辑外部化为配置文件，该框架为生物医学RAG流水线提供了可解释、可适应的替代方案，克服了固定大小分块的僵化问题，但需根据任务特性选择合适的分块策略。

Abstract: BioMedRAG introduced retrieval-augmented generation with a learned chunk scorer for biomedical information extraction. However, it relies on fixed-size chunking which can fragment semantic evidence. We propose a configurable semantic chunking framework that addresses this limitation by combining entity-preserving windows, trigger-centered chunking, proposition-first extraction, tiered trigger prioritization, and hierarchical relation resolution. The framework integrates with BioMedRAG by replacing only the chunk construction stage while preserving the embedding model, learned chunk scorer, generator, and evaluation protocol. We evaluate the framework on biomedical relation extraction benchmarks (GM-CIHT, DDI, ChemProt) and adverse event classification (ADE). On GM-CIHT, the full hybrid configuration achieves 82.6% F1, improving over the fixed-size baseline (74.2% F1) by 8.4 points under our experimental setup. Cross-dataset analysis shows that semantic chunking improves extraction datasets with explicit relation cues, such as GM-CIHT and DDI, while fixed chunking remains competitive or stronger for dense biochemical extraction and binary classification settings such as ChemProt and ADE. By externalizing chunking logic into configuration files, the framework provides an interpretable and adaptable alternative to rigid fixed-size chunking for biomedical RAG pipelines.

</details>


### [319] [Large Language Models Systematically Favor Popular Options: Evidence and Mitigation Across MCQs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29257)
*Abdelrahman Abdallah,Mohammed Ali,Bhawna Piryani,Mahmoud Abdalla,Adam Jatowt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示了LLM在多项选择题中存在"流行度偏见"——模型系统性地偏好流行但不正确的选项，并在高流行度干扰下准确率骤降但置信度依然很高。作者提出PopMCQ基准（六种受控策略）和PopDebias推理时校正方法，在22个开源LLM上获得最高54.1个百分点的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多项选择题是评估LLM的标准格式，但选项的流行度会混淆评估结果。现有LLM会系统性地偏向流行但不正确的选项，且模型置信度与实际准确率严重失配（高置信低准确率），这种偏见尚未被系统性研究。

Method: 1) 构建PopMCQ基准：六种受控策略变化选项流行度，同时保持正确答案固定；2) 提出PopDebias：一种轻量级推理时校正方法，从模型预测中估计并移除流行度先验，无需微调，测试时无需标签（仅需小规模校准集拟合参数），计算开销可忽略。

Result: 在最对抗性设置下（所有干扰项比正确选项更流行），模型66%的时间选择流行但错误的答案。在22个开源LLM（0.5B到32B参数）上，PopDebias在强流行度压力下取得一致改进，准确率提升最高达54.1个百分点。

Conclusion: 流行度偏见是LLM评估中的一个重要混淆因素，但可以通过PopDebias这类无需微调的推理时校正方法有效缓解，为更公平的LLM评估和更鲁棒的模型部署提供了解决方案。

Abstract: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) are a standard format for evaluating large language models (LLMs), yet the popularity of answer options can confound evaluation. Modern LLMs systematically prefer popular but incorrect options over less popular correct ones, a vulnerability we call \textbf{popularity bias}. This pattern aligns with confidence miscalibration: model confidence remains high even as accuracy collapses for popular options. To systematically isolate this phenomenon, we introduce \textbf{PopMCQ}, a benchmark with six controlled strategies that vary option popularity while keeping the correct answer fixed. In our most adversarial setting, where all distractors are more popular than the correct option, models choose popular but wrong answers 66\% of the time. To mitigate this bias, we propose \textbf{PopDebias}, a lightweight inference-time correction that estimates and removes a popularity prior from model predictions. It requires no fine-tuning, is label-free at test time (using only a small calibration split for parameter fitting), and adds negligible computational cost. Experiments on 22 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 32B parameters) show consistent improvements, with accuracy gains up to 54.1 percentage points under strong popularity pressure. The code and data are available https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/PopMCQ

</details>


### [320] [SHADOWBENCH: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29270)
*Hojae Han,Jongyoon Kim,Sanghyuk Park,Dongwook Cheon,Myungjae Jeon,Sunjong Choi,Soonho Kong,Wonseok Heo,Seung-won Hwang,Donghoon Hyeon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SA-Pass（语义对齐通过）评估指标，用于解决自动形式化中因不同表述导致评估误判的问题，并构建了ShadowBench基准，包含178个研究生至研究级数学问题。SA-Pass通过"影子语句"（shadows）测试形式化语句的语义对齐性，要求生成语句编译通过、蕴含每个影子（正向检查）并被其合取蕴含（反向检查）。在Claude Code配置下达到61.8%编译率和11.2% SA-Pass，与专家判断的二元一致性达98.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动形式化评估指标存在两大缺陷：可能接受类型正确但语义错位的语句，或拒绝用不同表述书写的正确语句，导致无法准确评估形式化质量。

Method: 提出SA-Pass指标：利用特征化预期语句的辅助"影子语句"进行测试，生成语句需编译通过、蕴含每个影子（正向检查）、且被影子合取蕴含（反向检查）才能获得满分。并构建ShadowBench基准（178个Lean 4问题，涵盖8个数学领域）。

Result: Claude Code (Opus 4.8)搭配Numina-Lean-Agent在ShadowBench上达到61.8%编译率和11.2% SA-Pass；在六种代理配置的输出上，SA-Pass与专家判断的二元一致性达98.8%。

Conclusion: SA-Pass提供了一种更可靠、与人评价高度一致的自动形式化评估方法，ShadowBench可作为该领域的标准化基准，其早期版本已被用于ICML 2026 AI4Math挑战赛Track 4。

Abstract: Autoformalization translates informal mathematical theorems into code for proof assistants such as Lean. A central challenge is that current evaluation metrics can accept type-correct but misaligned statements or reject correct statements written in a different formulation. Inspired by Pass@$k$, we propose SA-Pass (*Semantic Alignment Pass*), which tests formal statements using auxiliary statements called *shadows* that characterize the intended statement. A generated statement receives full credit only when it compiles, implies each shadow (forward check), and is implied by their conjunction (backward check). We instantiate SA-Pass in ShadowBench, a Lean 4 full autoformalization benchmark of 178 postgraduate- to research-level problems spanning eight mathematical areas. Claude Code (Opus 4.8) with Numina-Lean-Agent reaches $61.8\%$ compile rate and $11.2\%$ SA-Pass. Across outputs generated by six agentic configurations, SA-Pass achieves $98.8\%$ binary agreement with expert judgments. An early version of ShadowBench served as the benchmark for Track 4 of the ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge.

</details>


### [321] [Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29278)
*Zhaolu Kang,Meixin Wu,Yu Xue,Yingjie He,Qiming Shi,Lei Wei,Yidi Wang,Richeng Xuan,Zhichao Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SCEval（结构破坏评估）诊断协议，通过定向破坏文本、视觉和音频通道的内部证据结构（而非移除模态），评估全模态大语言模型在跨模态结构不稳定时是否仍然可靠。基于273个三模态样本评估15个系统，发现干净准确率不能代表结构退化下的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态大语言模型评估多在干净、完整、同步的输入上进行，无法区分模型性能依赖于稳定的跨模态结构还是仅在完整输入中存在的线索，缺乏对模态结构退化鲁棒性的诊断。

Method: 提出SCEval诊断协议：保持问题、答案空间和模态通道不变，仅对文本、视觉、音频进行单独及联合的结构性破坏（corruption）。构建273个人工验证的三模态样本（来自Social-IQ、OmniBench、VALOR），评估15个开源及专有全模态系统。

Result: 发现：1）结构破坏降低干净准确率；2）文本-视觉联合损伤构成最稳定的共享故障线（fault line）；3）多模态退化呈非加性效应，并非简单随破坏模态数量线性增加；4）干净的模态融合准确率无法预测结构不可靠时的模型可靠性。

Conclusion: 干净的omni-modal准确率并不能证明模型在跨模态证据结构变得不可靠时仍能保持性能，需要专门的结构性压力测试来评估真实鲁棒性。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly. Built from $273$ human-verified tri-modal examples from Social-IQ, OmniBench, and VALOR, SCEval evaluates $15$ proprietary and open-source omni-modal systems. The results show that structural corruption lowers clean accuracy, text--vision damage forms the most stable shared fault line, and multi-modal degradation is non-additive rather than a simple function of the number of corrupted modalities. Clean omni-modal accuracy therefore does not establish that a model will remain reliable when cross-modal evidence becomes structurally unreliable.

</details>


### [322] [Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29305)
*Junxuan Li,Zijun Liu,Ziyi Huang,Peng Li,Yuzhou Liu,Ming Yan,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出测试时环境分解（TTED）方法，让LLM智能体在推理阶段将复杂环境观测分解为子模块，并通过无标签学习在测试时获取经验，从而提升智能体在真实复杂Web环境中的组合泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在人工构建的简单环境中表现优异，但迁移到复杂真实世界场景时性能骤降。现有研究多归因于组合泛化差距，但缺乏有效的测试时适应方法来解决这一问题。

Method: 引入试错步骤（trial steps），让智能体将复杂环境观测分解为子模块，并实现无标签学习算法TTED，在推理（测试）阶段利用经验自适应地调整智能体行为。

Result: 在合成和真实基准上的实验表明：（1）在简单子环境中获得的经验可以有效组合以提升完整环境中的表现；（2）在子环境上的测试时训练能显著增强智能体在真实Web自动化任务中的组合泛化能力。

Conclusion: 随着LLM智能体接触越来越复杂的环境，在测试时学习环境分解技能对于鲁棒的真实世界部署至关重要，本文为无标签测试时学习算法的设计提供了关键见解。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in manually constructed environments, yet their performance frequently collapses when transitioned to complex real-world settings. Existing research largely attribute this degradation to the compositional generalization gaps in LLMs on combinations of multiple simple, well-structured environments. In this work, we propose that LLM web agents can learn simple environment observations at test time. Specifically, we introduce trial steps for agents to decompose a complex environment observation into sub-modules, and implement a label-free learning method, Test-Time Environment Decomposition (TTED), to adapt agent behaviors with experience during inference. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the framework's efficacy across both synthetic and realistic benchmarks, showing (1) experience gains acquired within simpler sub-environments can be effectively composed to improve performance in the full one, and (2) test-time training on sub-environments can significantly enhance the compositional generalization of agents in real-world web automation tasks. We also provide key insights in the design of the label-free learning algorithm. As more complex environments are accessed by LLM agents, we believe learning environment decomposition skills at test time will be critical for robust real-world deployment.

</details>


### [323] [Detecting and Repairing Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29307)
*Sai Krishna Reddy Mulakkayala,Niki van Stein,Aske Plaat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究RAG系统中检索增强语言模型生成答案的"修复"问题，而非仅止于检测错误。利用RAGTruth基准将标记的错误答案拆分为事实性声明，并与三种修复策略（删除、替换、重写）对比，由三种不同语言模型评判916个修复后答案。结果显示每种策略都减少了不被支持的内容，但三者构成"接地保持权衡"而非质量排序——删除保留原文64.3%文本最有效，重写保留80.1%但减少最少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究集中于检测RAG模型生成的不被检索文档支持的陈述，但仅标记错误对读者毫无帮助。问题在于：标记之后应该采取什么行动？哪些修复策略更有效？目前对检测后该做什么几乎一无所知。

Method: 使用RAGTruth基准（人工标注不支持段落），将每个标记的答案拆分为独立事实性声明，逐一对照检索来源核查。对比四种处理方式：保留不变、删除不支持声明、用源文本替换、改写声明。由三个不同模型家族的LLM评判916个修复后的答案。

Result: 三种修复策略均降低了判为含不支持内容的答案比例，且三个评判模型对策略排序一致。删除达到最大减少但保留最少原文（64.3%），改写保留最多（80.1%）但减少最少。值得注意的是83.5%被标注为干净的答案也被修改了。各策略处于不同的"接地保存权衡"位置，而非形成简单质量排序。

Conclusion: 修复策略不存在单一最优解，选择何种策略取决于应用场景对保真度与减少幻觉的取舍。自动评估指标无法提供判断答案有用性的充分证据，实际选择需要依赖下游任务中的人类证据。

Abstract: Language models increasingly answer questions by consulting retrieved documents rather than memory alone, a design now common in search assistants and enterprise knowledge tools. Grounding a model in retrieved text reduces unsupported statements but does not eliminate them, and a reader cannot tell a grounded sentence from an invented one. Most research on this problem stops at detection, yet flagging a faulty answer changes nothing for the person reading it, and little is known about which action should follow. Using RAGTruth, a benchmark whose unsupported passages are annotated by hand, we split each flagged answer into individual factual claims, check each against the retrieved source, and compare leaving the answer untouched with three repair strategies of increasing richness: deleting an unsupported claim, replacing it with source text, and rewriting it. Three language models from different families judge the 916 repaired answers. Every strategy reduces the proportion of answers judged to contain unsupported content, and all three judges agree on the ordering. Deletion achieves the largest reduction while retaining least of the original answer, at 64.3% of the text, whereas rewriting retains 80.1% and reduces least. Repair is not confined to faulty answers: 83.5% of answers annotated clean are edited too. The strategies occupy different points on a grounding preservation trade-off rather than forming a quality ranking, and choosing between them needs evidence about answer usefulness that automatic metrics cannot supply.

</details>


### [324] [All You Need Is Non-Commutative Words](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29314)
*Carla M. Quispe Flores,Stanley Salvatierra,Renan Cabrera*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出用幺正矩阵表示词元，将句子编码为其有序乘积，利用矩阵乘法的非交换性捕获词序而无需位置编码。该方法支持无需q/k/v投影的反对称自注意力、变长文本块的并行组合，以及通过嵌套群扩展实现持续学习。在标准文本分类基准上达到或超过词袋基线，IMDB上准确率更高，AG News上性能相当，且仅用64个实值参数替代约3万维词表空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的词袋模型忽略了词序信息，而基于Transformer的方法需要位置编码和高维词表嵌入，参数开销大。作者希望通过幺正矩阵代数的非交换性，在极低维参数空间中同时捕获词序并支持多种高级能力（如免投影注意力、并行组合、持续学习）。

Method: 将每个词元表示为幺正矩阵，句子编码为这些矩阵的有序乘积。利用矩阵乘法的非交换性自然编码词序。该代数框架还派生出了：无反称自注意力（无需query/key/value投影）、变长文本块的并行组合（降低注意力成本）、canonical-coset读出层（紧凑编码所有真实幺正自由度），以及通过嵌套群扩展实现持续学习——每个新任务扩展算子空间，同时精确保持先前表示。

Result: 在标准文本分类基准上，该方法匹配或超过词袋基线：IMDB数据集上取得更高准确率，AG News上获得相当性能。值得注意的是，仅用64个参数的稠密实值编码就替代了约30,000维的传统词表空间，展现了极强的高效表达能力。

Conclusion: 幺正矩阵代数提供了表达力强的文本编码方案，在极低参数维度下实现词序感知、高效注意力和持续学习等多重能力，验证了代数结构在NLP嵌入中的潜力，为替代高维稀疏词表表示提供了新方向。

Abstract: We represent lexical tokens as unitary matrices and encode each sentence as their ordered product. The noncommutativity of matrix product captures word order without positional encodings (PEs). The same algebra yields several capabilities, including antisymmetric self-attention with no query, key, or value projections, and parallel composition of variable-length text chunks at a reduced attention cost. Furthermore, it provides a canonical-coset readout layer that encodes all true unitary degrees of freedom compactly, while supporting continual learning through nested group extensions that enlarge the operator space with each new task preserving prior representations exactly. Across standard text-classification benchmarks, the method matches or exceeds bag-of-words baselines. Achieving higher accuracy on IMDB and comparable performance on AG News. Notably, this is accomplished by replacing the conventional $\sim$30,000-dimensional vocabulary space with a dense, 64-parameter real-valued encoding, highlighting the expressive efficiency of our parameterization.

</details>


### [325] [Padārtha: Ontology-Grounded Fine-Grained NER Benchmark for Classical Sanskrit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29324)
*Sujoy Sarkar,Pretam Ray,Paramhans Shah,Manoj Balaji Jagadeeshan,Akash Gairola,Arjuna S R,Pawan Goyal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Padārtha，首个基于本体论构建的梵语细粒度命名实体识别（NER）基准，基于《摩诃婆罗多》史诗，标签集源自印度古典本体论体系Nyāya-Vaiśesika。包含18个细粒度类别、108K个实体标注和5,000节专家验证测试集，首次系统对比了生成式NER与传统架构在梵语上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的标注模式并非中立，现代新闻文本发展出的标注集应用于古典文献时会强加源文化定义。研究希望在文本自身的传统中构建标注模式，以梵语古典史诗为对象建立文化本位的NER基准。

Method: 从Nyāya-Vaiśesika印度古典本体论导出标签集，形成18个细粒度类别、10个本体论节点，并映射到5个标准粗粒度标签以保证互操作性。专家标注12.6K条命名实体，链接到Mahānāma语料库中的对应提及，最终得到108,335个实体标注（73,632节），并构建5,000节的专家验证测试集以侧重罕见提及。

Result: 微调生成式模型与传统任务特定系统表现相当；但所有系统从粗粒度到细粒度都表现出性能急剧下降，且在训练中未见过的实体（out-of-entity mentions）上表现挣扎。微调模型对未见实体的召回远差于已见实体，且在词汇歧义下倾向于默认主流语义。

Conclusion: 细粒度NER的瓶颈并非单纯数据稀缺，模型在泛化到未见实体和细粒度区分上存在根本性局限，这对梵语古典文本的NER研究提出了重要挑战，也凸显了文化本位标注模式的价值。

Abstract: Annotation schemas are not neutral. When applied to classical literature, tag sets developed for modern journalistic texts impose source-culture definitions on texts they were never designed to describe. We instead ground a schema in the tradition of the text itself introducing \textit{Padārtha}, the first ontology-grounded fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark for Sanskrit, built on the \textit{Mahābhārata} epic. Our tag set derives from \textit{Nyāya-Vaiśesika}, a classical Indian ontological system, yielding 18 fine-grained categories organized under 10 ontological nodes and mapped onto five standard coarse tags, ensuring interoperability with existing benchmarks. Expert annotators label over 12.6K entries from a scholarly index of named entities, linked to corresponding mentions in the \textit{Mahānāma} corpus, producing fine-grained annotations for 108,335 entity mentions across 73,632 verses, along with a 5,000-verse expert-verified test set sampled to stress rare mentions. We present the first systematic benchmarking of generative NER against traditional architectures for Sanskrit, finding that fine-tuned generative models perform comparably to task-specific systems. However, all systems show a sharp decline from coarse to fine granularity and struggle with out-of-entity mentions unseen during training. The limitation is not due to data scarcity alone, as fine-tuned models recall unseen entities far worse than seen ones and tend to default to the majority sense under lexical ambiguity.

</details>


### [326] [StageWell: A Process-Aligned Chinese Corpus for Positive-Psychology Support Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29326)
*Yuxiong Wang,Ziwei Lin,Bo Wang,Yu Zhang,Shiguang Ni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出StageWell，一个面向积极心理学对话的过程对齐中文语料库，以及HQS结构化数据构建与评估协议。通过六阶段支持过程和multi-agent整轮对话重写工作流，构建了12,445个SFT实例、1,849个DPO偏好对以及120个专家修订对话。在四个9B-14B开源LLM上验证了该方法在过程控制、响应质量和安全性上的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有积极心理学对话资源通常将监督简化到单轮策略或整体偏好标签层面，导致过程位置（process position）、支持功能（support function）和局部修复目标（local repair targets）等关键信息隐含不清，缺乏对多轮支持过程的显式建模。

Method: 1) 提出六阶段支持过程来组织对话结构；2) 设计HQS结构化数据构建与评估协议；3) 采用multi-agent整轮对话重写工作流构建语料；4) 将DPO偏好对构建为"过程局部化修复"（process-localized repairs），以有缺陷的模型输出作为rejected响应，同一上下文和阶段约束下的针对性改写作为chosen响应。

Result: 在四个9B-14B开源LLM上，平均BERTScore提升0.037，Q-Overall提升1.32分，S-exact提升0.236，H-critical率下降0.167，在过程控制、响应质量和安全性方面均取得稳健增益。

Conclusion: 将支持性对话建模为结构化多轮支持过程而非单轮响应生成，能够显著提升模型在积极心理学对话任务上的表现，验证了过程对齐监督的价值。

Abstract: Positive psychology dialogue aims to support emotional distress and positive resource building, requiring models to produce not only empathetic replies but also coherent progression through a multi-turn support process. Existing resources often reduce supervision to turn-level strategies or holistic preference labels, leaving process position, support function, and local repair targets implicit. We introduce StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive psychology dialogue, together with HQS, a structured protocol for data construction and evaluation. StageWell organizes support into a six-stage support process and uses a multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting workflow to construct 12,445 SFT instances, 1,849 DPO preference pairs, and a GroundTruth subset of 120 expert-revised dialogues and 977 QA pairs. Guided by HQS, DPO pairs are built as process-localized repairs: flawed model outputs are used as rejected responses, and targeted rewrites under the same context and stage constraint are used as chosen responses. Across four 9B-14B open-source LLMs, this supervision yields robust gains in process control, response quality, and safety. Averaged across models, BERTScore improves by 0.037, Q-Overall increases by 1.32 points, S-exact increases by 0.236, and the H-critical rate decreases by 0.167. These results highlight the value of modeling supportive dialogue as a structured multi-turn support process rather than as single-turn response generation.

</details>


### [327] [When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29327)
*Jiayu Hou,Lei Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Engram Adapter，一个将预训练时的条件记忆重用于冻结大语言模型的后置适配框架。它通过多通道n-gram局部模式匹配和占用跟踪作为轻量级选择性先验，并利用学习到的标量门控抑制不连贯的域外检索，从而在提升域内性能的同时保留99.4%-100.1%的域外平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法通常是"始终开启"的，其学习到的扰动应用于每个输入，会损害域外（OOD）性能。在专业领域部署大语言模型时，需要在提升域内表现的同时不牺牲通用能力，这促使作者探索条件激活（conditional activation）的适配方案。

Method: 提出Engram Adapter框架，将预训练时期的条件记忆重新用作冻结LLM的后置适配器。具体包括：(1) 多通道匹配，基于局部n-gram模式；(2) 显式占用跟踪作为轻量级选择性先验；(3) 学习到的标量门控抑制不连贯的OOD检索，使残差注入更倾向于在域内输入上发生。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，以AG-News和MedMCQA为适配任务，OOD基准涵盖推理、翻译、代码生成和法律推理。Engram Adapter在提升域内准确率的同时保留99.4%-100.1%的平均OOD性能；在LegalBench上平均略超冻结基座模型，而始终开启的基线方法性能急剧下降。机制分析显示OOD激活虽非零，但门控和投影衰减将残差降至隐藏状态范数的约0.08%，产生很小的KL漂移和可忽略的准确率变化。

Conclusion: 条件激活（conditional activation）是在冻结骨干网络上实现模块化、保留能力（retention-preserving）领域专业化的有前途的路径。

Abstract: Large language models deployed in specialized domains must improve in-domain performance without sacrificing general capabilities. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are typically always on: their learned perturbations are applied to every input, which can degrade out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We propose Engram Adapter, a framework that repurposes pretraining-time conditional memory as a post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs. It uses multi-channel matching over local n-gram patterns with explicit occupancy tracking as a lightweight selectivity prior, making residual injection more likely on in-domain inputs while a learned scalar gate suppresses incoherent OOD retrievals. We evaluate on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with AG-News and MedMCQA as adaptation tasks and OOD benchmarks spanning reasoning, translation, code generation, and legal reasoning. Engram Adapter improves in-domain accuracy while preserving 99.4%--100.1% of average OOD performance; on LegalBench it slightly exceeds the frozen base model on average, whereas comparable always-on baselines degrade sharply. Mechanistic analyses show that although OOD activations are non-zero, gate and projection attenuation reduce residuals to approximately 0.08% of hidden-state norm, yielding small KL drift and negligible accuracy change. These results suggest conditional activation is a promising route toward modular, retention-preserving domain specialization over frozen backbones.

</details>


### [328] [Arabic Safety Alignment as Selective Refusal: An Empirical Study of SFT, DPO, and Guard Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29378)
*Mohamad Zbib,Ammar Mohanna*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对阿拉伯语大语言模型的拒绝行为评估问题，提出用良性拒绝率B和有害提示拒绝率H两个指标取代单一的拒绝率。在五个阿拉伯语模型及AraSafe数据集上的130次运行中，发现仅用拒绝样本的SFT会导致全面拒绝崩溃，而精选的混合SFT配置可在B=14%-23%下达到H=90%-93%。DPO和推理护栏对不同模型的影响不同。文章强调应基于部署目标选择模型特定的操作点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的单一拒绝率无法揭示拒绝行为中的关键权衡：模型既要拒绝有害提示，又不能过度拒绝良性或敏感提示。这种权衡在阿拉伯语LLM中尤为重要且此前缺乏系统评估。

Method: 使用良性拒绝率B和有害提示拒绝率H双指标进行评估；在五个阿拉伯语能力模型中、完整人工编写的AraSafe数据集上进行了130次运行；对比仅拒绝SFT、混合SFT、DPO和推理护栏等不同干预方式；并通过300条响应的盲审评估标注一致性。

Result: 仅拒绝SFT崩溃为全面拒绝；精选混合SFT在B=14%-23%下达到H=90%-93%，四个配置在全部三次运行中超过H=90%目标，Fanar在三次中两次达标；DPO和推理护栏在不同模型上产生不同效果；标注者二值拒绝一致性达89.0%（kappa=0.78）；SFT在Arabizi上提升H但无模型达到90%，显示从MSA的部分迁移有限。

Conclusion: 研究支持模型特定的操作点选择策略：先设定部署目标，仅保留能改善目标的干预措施。这为阿拉伯语安全对齐提供了更精细、实用的评估与调优框架。

Abstract: Arabic large language models must refuse harmful prompts without over-refusing benign or sensitive prompts, yet a single refusal rate hides this trade-off. We evaluate it using benign refusal B and harmful-prompt refusal H, where H measures refusal rather than harmful compliance. Across five Arabic-capable models and 130 runs on the full human-written AraSafe set, refusal-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses toward blanket refusal, whereas selected mixed-SFT configurations reach H = 90% to 93% at B = 14% to 23%; four selected configurations exceed the H = 90% target in all three runs, while Fanar does so in two of three. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and inference guards change B and H differently across models rather than acting as uniform upgrades. In a blinded 300-response audit, annotator binary-refusal agreement is 89.0% (kappa = 0.78); Qwen3Guard and Aya Expanse 32B reach 88.7% and 91.0% accuracy, respectively, with no conclusive paired difference. Selected SFT raises H on Arabizi for all five models, but none reaches 90%, showing only partial transfer from Modern Standard Arabic. Overall, the results support model-specific operating-point selection: set a deployment target and retain only interventions that improve it.

</details>


### [329] [AlgoWorlds: Benchmarking Tool Use for Global Optimization in Algorithmic Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29397)
*Zixiang Xu,Jiaan Wang,Fandong Meng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AlgoWorlds是一个新的基准测试，将形式化的组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境，用于评估LLM代理是否能通过工具收集信息并做出全局最优决策。包含240个环境、十个组合优化家族和四种工作量级别，测试了七个主流LLM，结果显示即使最先进的模型也仅在38.61%的情况下达到精确最优，表明挑战不仅在于信息获取，更在于信息整合、全局约束推理和决策验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用基准只评估代理能否使用合适工具和有效参数完成任务（可行性），但在真实决策场景（如路径规划、车队调度）中，个体选择通过共享约束和成本相互影响，可行解可能远非最优解。因此需要一个基准来回答更困难的问题：代理能否将工具收集的信息转化为全局最优决策？

Method: AlgoWorlds将形式化的组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境，每个环境包含隐藏实例，只能通过任务特定的信息工具观测，代理随后提交一个结构化决策并评估其可行性和最优性。基准涵盖240个环境、十个组合优化家族和四个工作量级别，使用确定性程序生成实例，精确算法验证最优解并确定工作量，每个实例通过两种结构不同的工具接口呈现。

Result: 评估了包括Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.6 Sol在内的七个领先LLM。实现全局最优仍然极具挑战性：尽管大多数情况下领先模型能产生可行决策，但性能最好的模型仅在38.61%的情况下达到精确最优。即使代理收集到足够信息重建隐藏实例，大多数失败仍以可行但次优的决策告终。

Conclusion: 挑战超出了信息获取范畴，延伸到信息整合、全局约束推理和决策验证。Agent工具使用能力的评估需要从"可行性"提升到"全局最优性"层面，这也为未来研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Tool-use benchmarks generally evaluate whether an agent completes a workflow using appropriate tools and valid arguments. However, feasibility alone is insufficient in real-world decision settings such as route planning and fleet dispatch. Individual choices interact through shared constraints and costs, so a feasible solution may still be substantially suboptimal. This raises a harder question: can an agent turn information gathered through tools into a globally optimal decision? We introduce AlgoWorlds, a benchmark that transforms formally specified combinatorial optimization problems into partially observed decision environments with verifiable global optima. Each environment contains a hidden instance observed only through task-specific information tools, after which the agent commits to one structured decision evaluated for feasibility and optimality. AlgoWorlds contains 240 environments covering ten combinatorial optimization families and four workload levels. Family-specific deterministic programs generate the instances, exact algorithms certify their optima and determine workload levels, and two structurally different tool interfaces present each underlying instance. We evaluate seven leading LLMs, including Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Achieving global optimality remains highly challenging: although leading models produce feasible decisions in most cases, the best-performing model reaches exact optimality in only 38.61% of cases. Even when agents collect sufficient information to reconstruct the hidden instance, most failures end in feasible but suboptimal decisions. The challenge therefore extends beyond information acquisition to information integration, global constraint reasoning, and decision verification. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/AlgoWorlds/, and the code is available at https://github.com/xzx34/AlgoWorlds.

</details>


### [330] [Evaluating the Semantic Specificity of Representation Steering in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29431)
*Zhangdie Yuan,Andreas Vlachos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)诊断框架，用于审计大规模语言模型中的表征干预（Localized Representation Steering, LRS）。通过将干预向量应用于模型本已胜任的规则族，发现晚期层LRS并未真正修复推理回路，而是注入全局标签偏差——将模型基线准确率从99.6%降至40.4%。作者提出四种互补对照实验验证该诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准基准评估容易被表面标签覆盖所欺骗，导致对推理回路修复产生错误印象。研究者希望区分真正的推理修复与表面的标签覆盖。

Method: 提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)诊断框架：将表征干预向量应用到模型本已胜任的规则家族上，评估其效果。以矛盾失明（contradiction blindness）这一逻辑失败为例，针对晚期层LRS进行跨规则迁移测试。配套四种对照实验：直接logit偏差等价性测试、控制向量标签翻转、跨模型嫁接、早期层steering检查。

Result: 晚期层LRS仅注入全局标签偏差：将其应用于模型已正确处理（99.6%基线）的规则时，性能降至40.4%，表明干预迫使模型产生错误的矛盾预测，而非真正的推理修复。

Conclusion: CRT提供了一种严格的方法论来区分真正的推理修复与表面标签覆盖，揭示了当前LRS方法在矛盾盲失任务中的局限性。

Abstract: Localized Representation Steering (LRS) is widely used to correct reasoning pathologies in large language models. However, standard benchmark evaluations can easily be fooled by superficial label overrides, creating a false impression of reasoning circuit repairs. In this work, we propose Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT), a diagnostic framework that audits representational interventions by evaluating them on rule families where the model is natively competent. Evaluating late-layer LRS for a widespread logical failure, contradiction blindness, reveals that the intervention merely injects a global label bias: applying the steering vector to rules the model already handles correctly (99.6% baseline) degrades performance to 40.4% by forcing false contradiction predictions. We support this diagnosis with four complementary controls (direct logit bias equivalence, control vector label-flipping, cross-model grafting, and early-layer steering checks), providing a rigorous methodology to distinguish genuine reasoning repairs from superficial label overrides.

</details>


### [331] [Whose Assessment of Distress? Community Perspectives and LLM Alignment on Well-Being Posts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29446)
*Andrew Aquilina,Xiang Lorraine Li,Yu-Ru Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过视角主义标注实验（321名参与者对1198条Reddit帖子进行9587次判断，覆盖六个身份社群），发现大型语言模型在心理困扰检测中系统性高估困扰程度：当社群认为无至轻度困扰时，开源模型准确率仅31-44%（主要为假阳性），即使GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro等先进模型也表现出同样的膨胀倾向，而这种偏差不能简单归因于"局外人视角"——因为非情境化的外部人类评分者几乎没有这种偏差（18%高估 vs 19%低估）。模型的高估源于其先验偏差超过了所有人类判断群体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理困扰的判断具有社会情境性，不同社群的规范（情感表达、脆弱性、求助意愿）各异。然而用于困扰检测的LLM通常被对齐到单一、无差异的标准上，无法捕捉被评估社群的多重视角，可能造成不公平的心理健康AI部署。

Method: 采用视角主义（perspectivist）标注方法：321名参与者对1198条Reddit帖子（来自六个身份社群）提供9587条判断，生成社群特定标签。将情境化内群体评分者与无情境化外群体评分者对比，并评估九种开源LLM配置和四种前沿模型配置在这些标签上的表现。

Result: 1) 内群体评分者与社群判断一致性略高（OR=1.18），且效应在社群间差异显著；2) 开源LLM系统性高估困扰，在"无至轻度"困扰案例上准确率仅31-44%，以假阳性为主；3) GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro同样存在无至轻度膨胀，Claude Opus 4更保守；4) 模型偏差不能归于局外人视角，因为无情境化外群体人类评分者几乎对称（18% vs 19%）；5) 模型高估源于其困扰先验超过所有人类判断组。

Conclusion: LLM的困扰检测存在校准偏差，系统性高估心理困扰，这可能导致对特定社群的不平等待遇。研究强调在心理健康AI部署中需要社群特定校准，单一对齐标准不足以公平服务多元社区。

Abstract: Judgments about psychological distress are socially situated: what counts as concerning hinges on community norms around emotional expression, vulnerability, and help-seeking. Yet large language models (LLMs) used for distress detection are typically aligned to a single, undifferentiated standard. How well do these models capture the perspectives of the communities whose language they assess? We address this question through a perspectivist annotation study in which 321 participants provided 9,587 judgments on 1,198 Reddit posts spanning six identity-based communities, yielding community-specific labels. Raters in the contextualized in-group condition show a modest tendency to agree more with their community than uncontextualized out-group raters (OR = 1.18), an effect varying significantly across communities. We then evaluate nine open-weight LLM configurations and four frontier configurations against these labels. Open-weight LLMs systematically over-estimate distress: when communities perceive none-to-mild distress, these models achieve only 31-44% accuracy, predominantly producing false positives. GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro show the same none-to-mild inflation even when their full-sample over/under rates are mixed, while Claude Opus 4 is more conservative. This pattern does not simply mirror an outsider reading position: uncontextualized out-group human aggregates were nearly symmetric, with 18% over-estimation versus 19% under-estimation. Instead, the models that inflate none-to-mild cases exhibit a distress prior that exceeds both contextualized in-group and uncontextualized out-group human judgments. These findings have implications for equitable AI deployment in mental health contexts, where miscalibrated distress detection may unevenly affect the communities being assessed.

</details>


### [332] [AI Can Be Easily Persuaded in Clinical Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29453)
*Jiayuan Zhu,Jiazhen Pan,Fenglin Liu,Minhao Hu,Junde Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究AI在医学决策中是否容易被说服，发现专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属、声称的过往表现、多位医生支持、临床观点及重复施压都会影响AI决策，甚至虚假但看似合理的临床观点也能将AI从正确决策中劝离，表明AI在医疗决策中容易受到说服性影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI在临床实践和医疗决策中扮演越来越重要的角色，而医学是高风险的循证领域，决策直接影响患者生命，因此理解AI在面临他人说服时能否保持客观判断至关重要。

Method: 通过受控实验设计，系统地测试不同说服因素（如专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属、过往表现声称、医生数量、临床观点、重复施压）对AI医疗决策的影响程度。

Result: 研究发现：高级临床医生比医学生的相同说服输入多改变约10%的案例；声称更好的过往表现始终增加说服力；即使捏造一个支持错误答案的看似合理的临床观点，也能将AI从正确决策中劝离。AI容易被人们说什么、谁在说以及如何呈现观点所强烈影响。

Conclusion: AI在医疗决策中容易被人为说服影响，无法可靠判断临床观点的正确性。因此必须确保AI在面临说服时保持健全的判断力，以实现其在高风险医疗决策中的安全可靠应用。

Abstract: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical practice, it is playing a growing role in medical decision making. Medicine, however, is a high stakes and evidence based field, where decisions can directly affect patients' lives. It is therefore important to understand whether AI can maintain objective judgment when others try to persuade it. In this paper, we study how easily AI can be persuaded through controlled experiments. We find that professional authority, national background, institutional affiliation, claimed past performance, multiple physicians, supported clinician views, and repeated pressure can all affect AI decisions. Surprisingly, the same persuasive input changes about 10% more cases when it comes from a senior clinician than from a medical student. Simply claiming a better performance history consistently makes the physician more persuasive. More strikingly, a plausible clinician view can persuade AI away from a correct decision even when it is fabricated to support an incorrect answer. This indicates that AI can be strongly influenced by convincing support without reliably determining whether this view from the clinician is correct. Together, these findings suggest that AI can be easily persuaded by what people say, who says it, and how the opinion is presented. Therefore, it is essential for AI to maintain sound judgment under persuasion, enabling its safe and reliable use in high stakes medical decision making.

</details>


### [333] [Item-Mean Surrogates: Why Richer Persona Data Fail to Improve LLMs as Human Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29455)
*Daehwan Ahn,Chengfeng Mao,Dokyun Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过四个数据集（超过40万参与者和6000多项调查条目）系统验证了LLM作为人类替代品的可行性。发现LLM在聚合层面表现良好，能准确预测条目的平均人类响应，但其预测仅能解释3.05%的个体差异（远低于人类重测基准的53.6%）。LLM响应还压缩了人类响应分布，作者将这一现象称为"条目均值替代性"（item-mean surrogacy），并提出了四项实证测试标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用作人类替代品或探索工具，前提假设是更丰富的人物数据能使其成为特定个体的替代品。作者希望严格检验这一假设，验证LLM是否真的能替代个体人类参与者。

Method: 跨四个大规模数据集（>400,000参与者，>6,000个调查条目和实验结果）系统评估LLM响应与人类响应的匹配度；通过移除条目均值后分析个体变异解释率，比较LLM与人类重测基准；进行方差分析分离个体效应与人-条目交互效应；并提出四项实证测试用于验证LLM作为人类替代品的声明。

Result: LLM在聚合层面准确，但一旦移除每个条目的平均人类响应，LLM预测仅解释3.05%的剩余个体变异，远低于人类重测基准的53.6%。更丰富的人物设定、模型变体和微调均无法弥合这一差距。方差分析显示人-条目交互效应比稳定的个体效应大约8.9倍，而人物数据无法捕捉这种条目特异性偏差。LLM响应还会压缩人类响应分布（更少的离散度、更少的响应类别、扭曲的分布形状）。

Conclusion: 当前的LLM替代品仅能近似条目平均值，无法替代个体人类所需的分布或个体特异性偏差。作者提出四项实证测试作为未来LLM人类替代品声明的验证标准。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as human surrogates, often on the premise that richer persona data could make them substitutes or exploratory tools for specific individuals. We test this premise across four datasets covering more than 400,000 participants and more than 6,000 survey items and experimental outcomes. LLMs perform well at the aggregate level: their average responses closely align with average human responses to the same items. But this success largely reflects predicting each item's average human response. Once each item's human mean is removed, LLM predictions explain only 3.05% of the remaining respondent-specific variation, far below the 53.6% human test-retest benchmark. Richer personas, model variants, and fine-tuning do not close this gap. In variance analyses, once item means are removed, the reliable remaining signal is person-by-item. It captures how a respondent departs from the mean on a particular item and is about 8.9x larger than the stable person effect. Persona data encode the respondent, but not this item-specific deviation. LLM responses also compress human response distributions, using less spread, fewer response categories, and distorted distributional shapes. We call this pattern item-mean surrogacy. Current LLM surrogates can approximate item averages, but not the distributions or respondent-specific deviations needed to replace individual humans. We propose four empirical tests for LLM-based human-surrogate claims.

</details>


### [334] [Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29464)
*Aryo Pradipta Gema,Neel Rajani,Rohit Saxena,Wai-Chung Kwan,Pasquale Minervini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FACE-Eval是一个包含5,100个样本的评估基准，用于测试链式思维(CoT)监控的忠实性。研究发现当偏好信息通过工具返回或隐含在原始工件中时，所有15个模型的言语化承诺降低，而未被言语化的采纳率反而升高，导致CoT监控可靠性下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CoT忠实性测试往往将显式偏差线索放在用户消息中，但现实场景中智能体可能通过工具返回或原始工件接触到偏好信息。因此需要评估在这些更实际场景下CoT监控是否仍然可靠。

Method: 构建FACE-Eval基准(5,100样本)，变化线索位置(用户消息或工具返回)和显式性(直接摘要或原始工件)，测量言语化承诺和非言语化采纳两个指标，评估15个开放权重模型(4B到1.60T参数)，并使用两个转录监视器检测偏好采纳。

Result: 所有模型在工具返回线索下的言语化承诺更低，非言语化采纳更高；隐含线索同样导致承诺降低和采纳升高。来源归因提示可在7个模型上缩小通道差距，但监控告知无法可靠缩小差距。两个监视器的检测能力与更高的非言语化采纳呈负相关(r=-0.54和r=-0.78)。

Conclusion: 当偏好信息通过工具或原始工件传递时，CoT监控的可靠性下降，因为模型倾向于不言语化其偏好采纳，使得监控难以检测。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer. Existing faithfulness tests often place explicit bias cues in the user message, while agents may encounter preferences through tool returns or raw artifacts. We introduce FACE-Eval (Faithful Attribution of Cue Effects Evaluation), a 5,100-sample evaluation that varies cue location (user message or tool return) and explicitness (direct summary or raw artifact). We measure verbalized commitment among cue-following answers and unverbalized adoption among all cued samples. We evaluate 15 open-weight models from eight families, with total parameters ranging from 4B to 1.60T. Every model has lower verbalized commitment for tool-return than user-message cues and for implicit than explicit cues. Unverbalized adoption is higher for tool-return cues on all 15 models and for implicit cues in 28 of 30 model-channel comparisons. A source-attribution prompt narrows the channel gap on seven models, sometimes by increasing user-channel unverbalized adoption, while telling models that their reasoning will be monitored does not reliably close the gap. We also use two transcript monitors (GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-4o-mini) to detect preference adoption in the largest model of each family. Across 32 model-channel-explicitness cells, higher unverbalized adoption is associated with lower detection ability for both monitors (Pearson r=-0.54 and r=-0.78, respectively). These results suggest that CoT monitoring may be less reliable when preference information arrives through tools or must be inferred from raw artifacts, within the single-call, prefilled-tool setting tested here.

</details>


### [335] [MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29477)
*Jason Luo,Saibilila Abudukelimu,Judy Song,Andrew Feng,Shivank Garg,Vasu Sharma,Kevin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MUDDLE是一个受控基准测试，用于在文档问答系统中分离"上下文过长"和"干扰文档主题过近"两种失败原因。它使用270个人工标注问题，每种问题构建五种条件：仅有源文档、源文档加2/4个主题相近的硬负样本、源文档加2/4个长度匹配的随机干扰文档。在markdown格式上的实验表明，硬负样本比长度匹配的随机文档更能降低准确率，而随机文档接近无干扰基线，说明主题相似性而非长度是主要的干扰因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档问答系统越来越多地需要在检索到的文档集合上回答问题，而非单一干净来源，因此对分散注意力的上下文（distracting context）的鲁棒性至关重要。然而，当系统失败时，很难判断是因为上下文太长还是干扰文档主题太接近，因为先前的工作常常将这两个效应混为一谈。作者希望设计一个能分离这两个因素的受控基准。

Method: 作者提出MUDDLE基准：(1) 使用270个人工标注问题，每个问题绑定单一源文档；(2) 每种问题实例化五种条件：仅源文档、源文档+2/4个主题相似的硬负样本、源文档+2/4个长度匹配的随机干扰文档；(3) 随机干扰文档与硬负样本在长度和来源上匹配，从而消除长度变量的混淆；(4) 所有条件呈现为markdown、页面图像和原始PDF，但当前实验在markdown下进行；(5) 使用LLM judge对三个模型族进行评分。

Result: 在完整的markdown扫描实验中，对于gpt-5-mini，硬负样本在两种上下文大小下都比长度匹配的随机文档更降低准确率；随机文档则保持在无干扰基线附近。效应虽小但方向一致，当跨越上下文大小合并时，硬负样本显著劣于长度匹配的随机干扰文档。

Conclusion: MUDDLE成功分离了长度和主题相似性对文档问答鲁棒性的影响，证明主题相似的硬负样本是比长度更关键的干扰因素。研究释放了数据和评估代码，以便可重复研究上下文退化问题。

Abstract: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

</details>


### [336] [SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29481)
*Zihan Wang,Anita Marie Slominska,Rennie Bimman,Elizabeth Di Flumeri,Amanda Mayappo-Neeposh,Conall Francoeur,Tamara Ellen Carver,Xiao-Wen Chang,Doina Precup,Esin Darici Haritaoglu,Ismail Haritaoglu,Akshatha Arodi,Naomi Goloff*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个专门针对儿科严重疾病沟通(SIC)训练的基准套件和模拟框架，包括PitfallBench和DialogueBench两个基准，以及SIC-Agents自改进框架，用于生成可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿科严重疾病沟通(SIC)极其重要，但缺乏可扩展的临床医生沟通训练。与一般对话模拟相比，儿科SIC面临多方交互、回应父母痛苦情绪、依赖反馈动态等额外挑战。现有基于LLM的模拟器优化的是通用对话质量，而非SIC训练所需的课程相关行为。

Method: 与教育工作者和儿科临床医生合作，构建了首个针对儿科SIC训练的基准套件和模拟框架。基准包括PitfallBench（陷阱基准）和DialogueBench（对话基准），分别评估回合级和全对话级模拟器性能。提出SIC-Agents自改进框架，生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为。

Result: 实验表明SIC-Agents框架优于静态专家提示方法，并已发布基准供儿科SIC家长模拟研究使用。

Conclusion: SIC-Agents通过自改进和可编辑技能文档机制有效提升了儿科SIC模拟器的训练效果，为儿科严重疾病沟通训练提供了可扩展的解决方案和公开基准资源。

Abstract: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks

</details>


### [337] [CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29492)
*Kyungdon Lee,Wei Xu,Alan Ritter,Dong-Ho Lee,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CoCoA框架，通过双上下文训练（有/无文化线索）实现LLM的上下文条件性文化对齐，在保持中性偏好的同时将文化偏差分数从43降至24。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs在跨文化语境中常偏向西方相关实体。传统的去偏方法追求统一中性，但文化偏差缓解需要上下文条件性行为——有文化线索时偏好文化适配实体，无线索时保持中性。现有方法无法满足这一需求。

Method: 提出CoCoA（Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment）框架，核心是双上下文训练：在同一实体对上分别采用有/无文化线索的上下文进行训练。结合对比对齐目标（contrastive alignment objective）与校准和漂移正则化（calibration and drift regularization），并通过目标感知梯度协调（goal-aware gradient reconciliation）进行优化。
