We release VibeJam, a browser-based user study platform for users to collaborate with AI agents to develop websites. VibeJam enables agent customization and uses the open-source Aider agent by default, and to mirror downstream use, we add diff review, chat and plan modes, and live website previews. In a pilot study with 55 released, game-based website creation tasks, five experienced AI programmers rate our system as fun, simple, and resembling commercial tools, while 13 junior students use VibeJam to make websites of higher quality than agents in the same task. We open-source VibeJam to spur extensions and support studies on how coding agents can help users.

</details>


### [373] [En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29890)
*Nhu Vo,Phuong Nguyen,Nu Uyen Phuong Le,Inigo Jauregi Unanue,Dung D. Le,Massimo Piccardi,Wray Buntine*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了En-ViMedNER，这是第一个英越平行生物医学命名实体识别（NER）语料库，包含4,392篇PubMed摘要对、44,892个句对和202,949个实体提及对，覆盖21种UMLS语义类型。通过自动翻译、专家后期编辑、LLM辅助标签投影和人工验证构建。在越南语NER和跨语言NER两个任务上进行了基准测试，最佳F1分数分别为52.70和45.44。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英语生物医学NER已有丰富的UMLS标注资源（如MedMentions），但越南语缺乏同等资源。医疗AI应用的跨语言发展需要越南语的并行NER语料，以支持越南语临床决策支持和医学信息提取。

Method: 采用UMLS语义类型作为语言中性的跨语言标签空间；通过自动翻译、专家后期编辑、LLM辅助标签投影和人工验证仲裁四步流水线构建语料库；将MedMentions ST21pv的21种语义类型适配到越南语；构建了人类审计且共识校正的小测试集；在越南语NER和跨语言NER两种设置下评估多种模型。

Result: 越南语NER任务中最佳模型F1为52.70（测试集）和53.78（小测试集）；跨语言NER任务中最佳模型F1为45.44（小测试集）。越南语监督编码器模型表现优于英语监督多语言编码器模型和基于提示的LLM。

Conclusion: En-ViMedNER填补了越南语生物医学NER资源的空白，其语言中性的UMLS标签体系支持与现有英语资源的直接对比。语料库、构建流水线和基线模型将公开释放以促进未来越南语生物医学NLP研究。当前F1分数表明该任务仍有较大提升空间。

Abstract: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) is fundamental to healthcare AI applications, including clinical decision support and medical information extraction. While corpora with Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) annotations, such as MedMentions, have driven progress in English biomedical NER, no comparable resource exists for Vietnamese. This paper presents En-ViMedNER, the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, which are language-neutral codes providing a shared cross-lingual label space and ensuring direct comparability with existing UMLS-based resources. The corpus contains 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 English-Vietnamese sentence pairs, and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types adapted from the MedMentions ST21pv dataset. To balance quality and scalability, we have constructed the corpus through automatic translation, expert post-editing, LLM-assisted label projection, and human verification and adjudication. We characterize En-ViMedNER as a large-scale silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset. We evaluate En-ViMedNER in two settings: (i) Vietnamese-input/Vietnamese-output biomedical NER and (ii) English-input/Vietnamese-output cross-lingual NER. For Vietnamese NER, we benchmark Vietnamese-supervised encoder models, English-supervised multilingual encoder models, and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 52.70 on the test set and 53.78 on the mini-test set. For cross-lingual NER, we benchmark encoder-decoder models and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 45.44 on the mini-test set. We publicly release our corpus, corpus construction pipeline, and baseline models to facilitate future Vietnamese biomedical NLP research.

</details>


### [374] [When History Is Multimodal: Rethinking Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29897)
*Jiaqi Su,Cong Pang,Jiawei Hong,Tiankuo Yao,Zixuan Chen,Xin Lou,Lewei Lu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出视觉渲染（Visual Rendering, VR）作为长时程智能体的表征型上下文管理器，并在此基础上提出VERA（Visual Evidence-Retaining strategy），一种无需训练的上下文管理策略：在文本基准上将文本历史渲染为视觉记忆，在多模态基准上直接保留原生视觉观察而非转译为文本。实验表明VERA在几乎所有基准上将累计非缓存token削减31.5%-63.1%，在文本任务上与现有管理器持平，在多模态任务上取得最高准确率，支持"模态保持"的上下文管理观。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体需要上下文管理器将不断增长的交互历史压缩为有界的工作上下文，但现有光学记忆工作主要将像素视为文本化历史的稠密编解码器，往往预设视觉渲染相比文本存在显著性能下降，因而依赖SFT、自蒸馏或强化学习来弥补差距。这留下两个未解决问题：（i）在公平、受控对比下视觉渲染作为上下文管理器的真实表现；（ii）当历史本身天然是多模态时，视觉载体是否具备原生优势。

Method: 本文将上下文管理形式化为"受预算约束的历史变换"问题，提出视觉渲染（VR）作为表征型上下文管理器。在共享的框架、策略模型、触发机制和任务域下，在四个文本中心基准和三个多模态基准上与四个基线（无压缩、全丢弃、滑动窗口、摘要）进行公平对比。基于视觉记忆是原生视觉证据自然载体的发现，进一步提出VERA策略：对文本中心任务沿用VR的文本历史渲染方式，对多模态任务直接保留原生视觉观察而非转译为文本。VERA基于确定性渲染构建，无需训练且不暴露内存操作。

Result: 公平对比显示视觉记忆是原生视觉证据的自然载体。VERA在几乎所有基准上相比无压缩策略将累计非缓存token削减31.5%-63.1%；在文本中心任务上与现有上下文管理器性能持平；在多模态任务上取得所有基线中最高的准确率。

Conclusion: 研究支持一种"模态保持"的长时程上下文管理观：视觉渲染不仅是一种可行的上下文压缩载体，而且在历史本身包含视觉信息时具有原生优势。VERA证明无需训练和显式内存操作即可实现高性能的上下文管理，为未来长时程智能体的记忆设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents need a context manager to compress growing interaction histories into a bounded working context, via passive strategies or active strategies that decide how memory is accessed and reorganized. Meanwhile, prior optical-memory work mainly treats pixels as a dense codec for textualized histories, often presupposing that rendering context into optical memory incurs a significant performance drop relative to text, thus coupling this representation with SFT, self-distillation, or reinforcement learning to close this gap, leaving unresolved (i) how visual rendering performs as a context manager under a fair, controlled comparison, and (ii) whether this carrier offers a native advantage when history is inherently multimodal. In this paper, we formulate context management as a budget-constrained history transformation and introduce Visual Rendering (VR) as a representational context manager. Under a shared harness, policy model, trigger, and task domain, we evaluate VR on four text-centric and three multimodal benchmarks against four baselines (No Compression, Discard-All, Sliding Window, Summarization), finding visual memory is a natural carrier of native visual evidence. Building on this finding, we propose VERA (Visual Evidence-Retaining strategy for long-horizon Agents), a training-free context manager built on deterministic rendering with no exposed memory operations: on text-centric benchmarks it renders textual history as VR does, while on multimodal benchmarks it retains native visual observations instead of translating them into text. Across nearly all benchmarks, VERA cuts cumulative non-cache tokens by 31.5%-63.1% versus No Compression, matches existing managers on text-centric tasks, and achieves the highest accuracy among all baselines on multimodal tasks, supporting a modality-preserving view of long-horizon context management.

</details>


### [375] [When Less is More: Understanding When Token Filtering Helps and Fails in AI-generated Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29903)
*Xiaoyang Han,Lvxiaowei Xu,Ming Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文挑战了零样本AI文本检测中"更多token证据=更可靠检测"的传统共识。通过引入top-k累积概率过滤作为诊断探针，作者发现仅保留40%的token有时能达到最优检测性能，但这种收益并不普遍——对弱源语言模型有帮助，对强源语言模型则无效。系统性分析揭示某些token不仅是无信息的，而且由于熵校准错误（entropy miscalibration）而系统性地有害，呈现出token级检测的两面性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本AI文本检测器普遍假设token级证据越多检测越可靠，但这一假设从未被严格验证。作者通过实证研究发现这一共识存在反例（更少token反而效果更好），因此希望系统性地解释为什么以及何时token过滤有益或有害，从而为检测器设计提供理论指导。

Method: 1) 使用熵间隙分数（EGS，Entropy Gap Score）作为检测指标；2) 引入top-k累积概率过滤作为诊断探针，跨三个代表性设置进行实验；3) 利用典型集理论（typical set theory）分析EGS行为；4) 通过熵校准（entropy calibration）和分布分析量化其动态变化。

Result: 过滤行为在不同设置下表现出显著差异：对于弱源语言模型，低熵token是有害的，过滤能提升检测性能；对于强源语言模型，低熵token并非明显有害，过滤无法带来收益。仅保留约40%的token即可实现最优性能，但该收益不具普适性。

Conclusion: 这是首个系统性证明某些token不仅无信息、而且因熵校准错误而系统性有害的工作。研究揭示token级检测存在两面性权衡，提示检测器的设计不应盲目追求更多token证据，而应意识到token质量（熵校准程度）对检测可靠性的关键影响。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has made AI-generated text detection increasingly critical. Existing zero-shot detectors assume that more token-level evidence leads to more reliable detection. However, our empirical study challenges this consensus: fewer tokens sometimes work better, retaining only 40% can yield optimal performance, yet this benefit is not universal. Using the Entropy Gap Score (EGS), we introduce top-$k$ cumulative probability filtering as a diagnostic probe. Across three representative settings, filtering exhibits strikingly different behaviors. We analyze EGS via typical set theory and quantify its dynamics through entropy calibration and distribution analysis. We find that filtering helps for weak source LMs, where low-entropy tokens are harmful, but fails for strong source LMs, where they are not notably harmful. Our work provides the first systematic analysis showing that some tokens are not merely uninformative but systematically harmful due to entropy miscalibration, revealing a two-sided trade-off in token-level detection.

</details>


### [376] [IndicDetect: Evaluating Cross-Lingual LLM-Generated Text Detection for Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29919)
*Bhaskar Ganesh Devalla,Junchao Wu,Nilesh Dokuparthi,Greeshma Yaluru,Tatiana Muniz Rodriguez,Lidia S. Chao,Derek F. Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出IndicDetect，一个针对印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语的AI生成文本检测基准，专门评估检测器在真实分布偏移（领域偏移、生成器偏移、对抗扰动）下的鲁棒性。研究发现监督神经检测器在分布内表现良好，但训练无关方法在未见生成器和对抗攻击下显著退化，且退化程度因语言而异，印地语退化最严重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成文本检测基准很少关注印度语言（Indic languages），且大多数检测器在理想化设定下测试，无法反映真实世界的分布偏移情况。作者希望填补这一空白，构建一个更贴近实际应用场景的多语言基准。

Method: 构建包含人工编写文本与LLM生成文本配对的数据集，覆盖多个领域和多个生成器；采用统一的、可重复的评估方案，系统性地测试领域偏移、生成器偏移和对抗扰动三种分布偏移场景；评估多种统计和神经检测器。

Result: 监督神经检测器在分布内表现良好，但训练无关方法（training-free）在未见生成器和对抗攻击下性能大幅退化；不同语言间退化程度不同，印地语在对抗扰动下退化最严重。表明现有检测器在Indic设置下的主要弱点是鲁棒性而非峰值准确率。

Conclusion: IndicDetect提供标准数据划分、评估协议和基线，为Indic脚本中的AI生成文本检测建立了一个鲁棒的、语言感知的基础，并强调检测鲁棒性是当前研究的核心挑战。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of LLMs has further heightened the need to develop dependable AI-generated text detection, especially beyond English. Nevertheless, current benchmarks pay little attention to Indic languages and test detectors in idealized settings that do not represent the real world. We present a generalized benchmark for AI-generated text detection in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil, which we call IndicDetect, designed to assess the robustness of detectors under realistic distribution shifts. IndicDetect comprises highly curated human-written texts matched with LLM-generated counterparts across various domains and generators, and systematically evaluates detectors in the presence of domain shift, generator shift, and adversarial perturbation. Using a single and repeatable evaluation scheme, we evaluate a wide range of statistical and neural detectors. We find substantial robustness failures: supervised neural detectors perform well in-distribution, while training-free methods degrade considerably under unseen generators and adversarial attacks. The severity of these failures varies across languages, with Hindi exhibiting the largest overall degradation under adversarial perturbations. These results highlight that the primary weakness of existing detectors in Indic settings lies in their robustness, not in their peak accuracy. IndicDetect provides standard data splits, an evaluation protocol, and baselines to establish a robust, language-aware foundation for AI-generated text detection in Indic scripts.

</details>


### [377] [Sleight of Word Benchmark: Can Language Models Notice If Their Own Output Was Tampered With?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29921)
*Alberto Cetoli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"Sleight of Word"的基准测试方法，通过在语言模型生成过程中持续替换某个单词来干扰其输出，并评估模型对这种外部扰动的感知能力。该基准在19个不同的开源权重语言模型上测试了两个维度：模型惊讶度相关指标和文本反应评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型的输出可能在生成过程中被篡改，但现有研究很少关注模型对自身生成过程受到外部干扰的感知能力。作者希望构建一个简单有效的基准来测试模型对生成过程中单词替换扰动是否敏感。

Method: 在语言模型生成过程中，持续将一个单词替换为另一个单词（称为"Sleight of Word"方法）。测量两个轴：一是与模型惊讶度（surprise）相关的指标，二是对19个不同开源权重语言模型的文本反应进行定性/定量评估。

Result: 在19个开源权重语言模型上进行了系统性评测，测量了模型对单词替换扰动的惊讶度指标和文本层面的反应。

Conclusion: 通过构建这种简单的单词替换测试，可以评估语言模型在生成过程中对外部扰动的感知能力，为理解模型对自身输出的监测和感知机制提供了一种简单而有效的手段。

Abstract: The output of a Language Model can be tampered with \emph{while} the model is writing it. A simple test can thus be constructed by evaluating the model's perception of this external perturbation. In this spirit, a simple benchmark is built in which a single word is consistently substituted with another in the generation process. We call this method \emph{Sleight of Word}. Two distinct axes are measured: metrics that relate to the model's surprise, as well as an evaluation of the textual reaction for 19 different open-weight language models.

</details>


### [378] [Token Counts Are Not Model Lineage: A Frozen-Threshold Holdout Study of Black-Box LLM API Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29930)
*Bo Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究对通过OpenAI兼容端点返回的提示词token计数作为黑盒模型归因信号的有效性进行了冻结阈值验证。在24个标注端点对上（12个开发集+12个盲测集），开发集上shift-invariant精确匹配分数完美分离（阈值0.725），但盲测集中仅6对符合预定义规则，平衡准确率仅0.75，且两个同家族模型对（Qwen 3.8和DeepSeek V4变体）低于阈值。结论：token计数一致性可作为共享tokenization栈的指纹，但不能作为模型家族血缘关系的独立必要条件测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当LLM通过中继和转售API服务时，黑盒模型归因日益重要。token计数是一种低成本信号，但该信号对更广泛的"模型家族"归因的有效性缺乏直接的留出测试验证。

Method: 对24个标注端点对进行冻结阈值研究，分为开发集和未触碰的留出集，含三个时间重复和每对30个受控文本。引入有效性门控的结果契约，区分观察到的差异与因缺失使用数据、速率限制或端点策略造成的无信息测量。采用shift-invariant精确匹配分数。

Result: 开发集12对完美分离（冻结阈值0.725）。留出集中仅6/12对符合预定义三重复规则，平衡准确率0.75，敏感度0.50（Wilson区间0.15-0.85），特异度1.00。两个同家族对（Qwen 3.8和DeepSeek V4变体）低于阈值。共4,320次形式化API调用中，所有日志可重放，留出集含189个非200响应和157个成功但无token计数的响应。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了token计数一致性可作为共享tokenization栈的指纹，但拒绝了将其作为模型家族血缘关系独立必要测试的用途。

Abstract: Black-box model attribution is increasingly relevant when large language models (LLMs) are served through relay and reseller APIs. A tempting low-cost signal is the prompt-token count returned by an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: two models that share a tokenizer and chat template may produce the same count sequence up to a fixed offset. Yet the validity of this signal for broader \emph{model-family} attribution has received little direct holdout testing. We conduct a frozen-threshold study over 24 labeled endpoint pairs, split evenly into a development set and an untouched holdout set, with three temporal repeats and 30 controlled texts per pair. We introduce a validity-gated result contract that distinguishes an observed dissimilarity from an uninformative measurement caused by missing usage data, rate limits, or endpoint policy. The resulting shift-invariant exact-match score perfectly separates the 12 development pairs, yielding a frozen threshold of 0.725. On holdout, however, only 6 of 12 pairs are eligible under the pre-specified three-repeat rule. Among eligible pairs, balanced accuracy is 0.75, sensitivity is 0.50 (95\% Wilson interval 0.15--0.85), and specificity is 1.00 (0.342--1.00). Two same-family pairs---Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4 variants---fall below the frozen threshold. Across 4,320 formal API calls, every log is replayable, while holdout contains 189 non-200 responses and 157 successful responses without prompt-token usage. The study therefore validates token-count consistency as a fingerprint of a shared \emph{tokenization stack}, but rejects its use as a standalone necessary test for model-family lineage.

</details>


### [379] [Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29934)
*Mohammadali Khodabandehlou,Bhaskar Krishnamachari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次将压缩感知的弃权（abstention）建模为学习问题：模型在支持证据经KV缓存压缩后幸存时作答，证据被移除时弃权。通过压缩器存活掩码和答案相关跨度的监督，10.1M参数LoRA适配器在MuSiQue 2跳问答上将幻觉减少97%，并取得6-22倍相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存压缩通过驱逐上下文token降低推理内存，但当被驱逐的token包含答案证据时，模型会产生幻觉而非识别上下文不足。现有方法缺乏让模型感知压缩造成的证据缺失并主动弃权的机制。

Method: 将压缩感知的弃权形式化为学习问题：利用压缩器存活掩码与紧致答案相关跨度构建监督信号，将样本标注为Confident（证据幸存）或Abstain（证据被移除）；训练10.1M参数的LoRA适配器学习条件化的作答/弃权策略，并在多种压缩策略下训练。

Result: 在约2.6K个MuSiQue 2跳问答样本上，LoRA适配器在提示式截断下将基础模型幻觉减少97%，同时保持证据保留样本的正确作答；在实际压缩缓存解码下，多压缩器训练带来6-22倍相对提升；受控删除实验证明所学行为由证据内容驱动而非输入长度。

Conclusion: 训练适配器学习条件化弃权策略，优于仅提示式弃权基线（后者在高保留率可作答样本上过度弃权），证明压缩感知的训练是缓解KV缓存压缩下幻觉的有效途径。

Abstract: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not. We construct supervision from compressor survival masks and tight answer-bearing spans, labeling examples as Confident when evidence survives and Abstain when it is removed. A 10.1M-parameter LoRA adapter trained on ~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA examples reduces base-model hallucinations by 97% under prompt-style truncation while preserving correct answering on evidence-retaining examples. Unlike prompt-only abstention baselines, which over-abstain on many answerable high-retention examples, the trained adapter learns a conditional policy. We also evaluate the method under actual compressed-cache decoding, where multi-compressor training yields a 6-22x relative lift over the unaided base on evidence-retaining examples. Controlled-deletion experiments show that the learned behavior is driven by evidence content rather than input length alone.

</details>


### [380] [When Safety Speaks a Language: A Mechanistic Analysis of Safety-Language Identity Entanglement in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29936)
*Apoorva Upadhyaya,Sandipan Sikdar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征对多语言LLM的安全对齐机制进行了系统性机械分析，涉及3个指令微调模型、8种语言及所有层，发现安全相关特征与语言身份在几何上纠缠，且跨语言共享模式因模型架构和深度而异；消融安全特征不仅影响有害响应率，还会改变目标语言，这种干预效果可由安全与语言特征的关系预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的安全对齐在不同语言间表现不一致（跨语言退化），但驱动这种不对称性的内部机制尚不清楚，亟需从机制层面理解多语言安全对齐的内在原理。

Method: 采用稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取残差流中的稀疏可解释方向，对3个指令微调LLM、8种语言及所有模型层的安全相关和无关特征进行系统性机械分析，并通过特征消融实验考察其对有害响应率和目标语言的影响。

Result: 安全相关特征的定位和层分布依赖模型架构；安全特征与语言身份在几何上纠缠，并呈现跨语言共享模式（即不同深度和架构下语言共享安全特征的程度不同）；消融安全特征会同时影响有害响应率和目标语言，且干预程度可由安全-语言特征关系预测。

Conclusion: 安全对齐的语言普适性是架构依赖的，本研究为多语言安全干预提供了机制层面的解释框架。

Abstract: Safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) degrades across languages, yet the internal mechanism driving this asymmetry remains poorly understood. Our work, therefore, presents a systematic mechanistic analysis of multilingual safety using sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, sparse interpretable directions in the residual stream associated with harmful and harmless model behavior across three instruction-tuned LLMs, eight languages, and all model layers. We observe that safety-relevant features are architecture-dependent in terms of where they are located and how they are distributed across layers. Additionally, they are geometrically entangled with language identity and exhibit cross-lingual sharing patterns, i.e., languages share safety features to varying degrees across model depths and architectures. This safety-language entanglement has direct consequences such that ablating safety features impacts not only harmful response rates but also target language, with the degree of intervention predicted by the relationship between safety and language features. Our findings qualify the language-universality of safety alignment as architecture-dependent and offer a mechanistic account of multilingual safety interventions.

</details>


### [381] [XQDT: eXplainable and Quantitative Data-Text Alignment Metric with Feedback Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29948)
*Kun Efimov-Zhang,Yifei Song,Claire Gardent*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端可解释的评估指标，通过微调语言模型来识别数据-文本对中的遗漏、多余、错误和正确数据单元，并将局部判断聚合为精确率、召回率和F1分数，既提供细粒度的诊断反馈，又保持与人类判断的高度相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据-文本对齐评估存在两大痛点：传统指标缺乏可解释性，难以说明分数背后的原因；而基于提示词的LLM-as-Judge方法成本高且不可靠。

Method: 微调语言模型以端到端方式识别数据-文本对中的四类数据单元（遗漏、多余、错误、正确），将局部判断聚合成精确率、召回率和F1分数，同时提供细粒度诊断与可解释的整体质量度量。

Result: 微调模型在错误预测上优于LLM-as-Judge方法，在精确率、召回率和F1分数上达到有竞争力的水平，且与人类判断保持强相关性；验证器的输出还可用于下游修正与改进任务。

Conclusion: 该可解释评估指标不仅提供准确且可解释的对齐质量评估，还能作为验证器为数据到文本和文本到数据的对齐优化提供反馈信号，具有评估与改进双重价值。

Abstract: Evaluating data-text alignment remains challenging: existing metrics often provide limited explanations for the scores, while prompt-based LLM-as-Judge methods can be expensive and unreliable. We present an end-to-end explainable evaluation metric that fine-tunes a language model to identify omitted, extra, incorrect, and correct data units in a data-text pair. These local judgements are aggregated into precision, recall, and F1 scores, providing both fine-grained diagnostic feedback and an interpretable measure of alignment quality. Across benchmarks, our fine-tuned models outperform LLM-as-Judge methods in error prediction and achieve competitive precision, recall, and F1 scores, while maintaining strong correlation with human judgements. Beyond evaluation, our verifier outputs also provide useful feedback signals for downstream correction and refinement, supporting alignment-oriented improvement of data-to-text and text-to-data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/guihuzhang/xqdt.

</details>


### [382] [How Prolific Sellers Self-Present: Dissecting the Communication Patterns of 1.6 Million Reverb Listings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29952)
*David M. Markowitz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文基于自我呈现理论和担保理论，分析在线市场中卖家地位（高产卖家vs普通卖家）如何反映在其语言模式上。通过对Reverb.com上160万条乐器列表的分析，发现高产卖家更注重产品的客观功能属性（如规格参数），较少涉及主观特征（如音色），同时采用更具叙事性的风格（更多使用人称代词）和更长的描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在线市场中卖家地位如何通过语言模式体现，以及高产卖家与普通卖家的产品描述在内容、风格和结构上的差异。

Method: 基于自我呈现理论和担保理论，对Reverb.com上160万条乐器列表进行大规模文本分析，从内容（客观vs主观）、风格（叙事性vs非叙事性）和结构（描述长度）三个维度比较高产卖家与普通卖家的产品描述。

Result: 高产卖家更注重产品的客观功能方面（如特征和规格），较少涉及主观特性（如音色）；他们使用更多人称代词，以更具叙事性的风格进行沟通，并使用比普通卖家更长的描述。

Conclusion: 高产卖家关注的技术性强，但传达方式却像讲故事。研究结果对自我呈现理论和担保理论具有启示意义。

Abstract: The current paper draws on self-presentation theory and warranting theory to evaluate how the language patterns in an online marketplace reflect seller status (i.e., a prolific seller versus an everyday seller). Using 1.6 million musical instrument listings from Reverb.com in search of content, style, and structural differences in seller product descriptions, the evidence suggested prolific sellers tend to focus more on objective and functional aspects of a product (e.g., its features and specifications) and less on subjective characteristics like tone, relative to everyday sellers. Prolific sellers also communicated in a more narrative-like style, which was driven by an elevated use of personal pronouns, and they used longer descriptions than everyday sellers. Therefore, what prolific sellers focus on tends to be quite technical, but how they communicate this information is typical of a story that is told to potential buyers. Implications for self-presentation theory and warranting theory are discussed.

</details>


### [383] [Detecting Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Large Language Models with Linguistic, Behavioral, and Mechanistic Indicators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29956)
*Armaan Singh,Ryan Trinh Le,Jasmine Kaur,Abdullah Sultan,Edward Lue Chee Lip,Kiran Nijjer,Adnan Ahmed,Vasu Sharma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出隐藏思维链检测分数(HCDS)，通过对比中性提示行为与显式CoT/无CoT行为的一致性，来探测大语言模型是否进行潜在推理。实验表明推理调优模型(Qwen3-4B Thinking)比指令模型表现出更强的类CoT行为，但该方法不直接证明隐藏推理链的存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在回答复杂推理问题时通常不展示中间步骤，现有方法依赖模型自我报告的思维链，但这些报告可能不准确。需要一种不依赖自我报告的、更客观的行为与机制层面的信号来研究模型是否进行潜在推理。

Method: 提出HCDS（Hidden CoT Detection Score），该方法通过比较模型在中性提示下的行为与显式CoT提示和显式无CoT提示下的行为之间的对齐程度，生成一个行为学与机制学相结合的检测分数。使用长度调整的校准对照单元来排除长度偏差干扰。

Result: 在GSM8K上，Qwen3-4B的Thinking变体HCDS为+1.87（p=1.2×10⁻⁷），Instruct变体为+1.41（p=1.9×10⁻⁴）；不同推理栈和量化下复现结果偏差在0.08以内。八个长度校准对照单元中有七个不显著。未调整分数在单步算术和数值事实查询上产生较大正分数。

Conclusion: 推理调优模型显示出更强、更少受提示条件影响的类CoT行为，这与潜在推理假说一致，但并非直接证据。HCDS提供了一种不依赖模型自我报告的研究潜在推理的新途径。

Abstract: Large language models often answer complex reasoning questions without revealing intermediate steps, raising whether they reason latently or complete patterns. We propose the Hidden CoT Detection Score (HCDS), a comparative behavioral and mechanistic signal measuring whether neutral-prompt behavior aligns more closely with explicit CoT or explicit no- CoT. Here, hidden CoT operationally denotes this neutral-prompt CoT-like alignment; HCDS does not directly observe or prove an unexposed reasoning trace. On GSM8K, HCDS is significantly positive for both Qwen3-4B variants (Thinking $+1.87$, $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$; Instruct $+1.41$, $p = 1.9 \times 10^{-4}$), replicates across a different inference stack and quantization within $0.08$ ($+1.80$ and $+1.45$), and is not significantly positive in seven of eight length-adjusted calibration-control cells. The unadjusted score produces large positive scores on single-step arithmetic and numeric factual lookup. The variants also respond differently to no-CoT instructions: Instruct complies from the prompt alone, whereas Thinking continues reasoning and requires intervention. These findings show stronger, less prompt-conditional CoT-like behavior in the reasoning-tuned model, consistent with but not proof of latent reasoning. HCDS thus investigates latent reasoning without relying on models' self-reported traces.

</details>


### [384] [Generative vs. Encoder Models for Multilingual NER: A Comprehensive Empirical Study on Naamapadam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29959)
*Jakkala Mahesh,Jatavath Shravan Kumar,Komalla Shivani,Sujoy Sarkar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对Naamapadam基准中的11种印度语言进行NER比较研究，评估了五种经典编码器架构、四种微调LLM和九种生成模型。结果显示编码器模型（mBERT和XLM-R）在10/11种语言中显著优于所有生成架构，与最强生成模型（Gemma-2-2B，平均F1=0.427）相比差距达7.5-40个百分点，最佳少样本结果仅为编码器基线的28%。研究识别出三种语言集群并提供部署指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印度有22种宪法认可语言，超过十亿使用者的数字语言层结构不完整。NER作为将原始文本转化为机器可理解知识的基础步骤，在英语中已被充分研究，但在大多数印度语言中仍未解决。作者希望通过严格的对比研究，厘清生成模型与编码器模型在印度语言NER任务上的真实能力差异。

Method: 在Naamapadam基准的全部11种印度语言上，系统评估三类模型：1) 五种经典模型家族（seq2seq transformers和multilingual encoders）；2) 四种仅解码器LLM（使用LoRA和4-bit NF4量化微调）；3) 九种生成模型（零样本到5-shot推理）。所有评估采用严格的CoNLL跨度级评估标准。

Result: 编码器模型（mBERT和XLM-R，印地语F1=0.675）在11种语言中的10种显著优于所有生成架构；与最强生成竞争者Gemma-2-2B（平均F1=0.427）相比差距为7.5-40个百分点；最佳少样本结果仅达编码器基线28%的性能。

Conclusion: 对于印度语言NER任务，编码器架构仍是可靠的首选方案。研究识别出三种语言集群（编码器主导、部分覆盖和失败区），并基于迁移学习和低资源NLP原则提供了可操作的部署指南，指导实际应用中的模型选择。

Abstract: Language is humanity's most consequential technology, yet for over a billion speakers across India's twenty-two constitutionally recognised languages, its digital layer remains structurally incomplete. Named Entity Recognition (NER), the foundational step in transforming raw text into machine-interpretable knowledge, has been studied exhaustively for English but remains largely unsolved across most Indic languages. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of generative and encoder-based neural architectures for NER on all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark. We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference. Under strict CoNLL span-level evaluation, encoder-based models (mBERT and XLM-R, both F1=0.675 on Hindi) substantially outperform every generative architecture in ten of eleven languages, with gaps of 7.5-40 percentage points against the strongest competitor (Gemma-2-2B: avg F1=0.427). The best few-shot result reaches only 28% of the encoder baseline. We identify three language clusters--encoder-dominant, partial-coverage, and failure-zone; and provide actionable deployment guidelines grounded in transfer learning and low-resource NLP principles.

</details>


### [385] [DataFoundry: Evolving Data Preparators via Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29966)
*Cehao Yang,Xiaojun Wu,Xueyuan Lin,Chengjin Xu,Xuhui Jiang,Hui Xiong,Jian Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DataFoundry框架，通过递归自我改进的方式在数据大规模生产之前演化数据准备器，采用Skills-as-Modules架构（中央控制器编排模块化技能），解决现有数据准备流程仅在生成后进行事后过滤的质量控制错配问题。在DataPrep-Bench的数学、金融、法律和医学领域上，递归演化的数据准备器比基线产生更高下游效用的训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型领域自适应的数据准备流程存在根本性错配：数据质量问题往往源于构建过程本身，但质量控制仅在生成之后通过事后过滤来应用，缺乏在源头（构建过程中）进行质量控制的机制。

Method: 提出DataFoundry框架：(1) 将数据准备器表示为可演化的运行时规范；(2) 采用Skills-as-Modules架构，由中央Controller编排模块化技能来编译可执行运行时；(3) 在小规模试点集上使用领域合适的标准诊断缺陷；(4) 将诊断反馈转化为适配器（adapters），修订各个准备组件同时保持稳定接口，实现递归自我改进。

Result: 在DataPrep-Bench的数学、金融、法律和医学四个领域上评估，递归演化的数据准备器生成的训练数据相比基线具有更高的下游效用；跨不同骨干模型（backbones）的实验表明改进不依赖特定模型；分析和案例研究揭示了框架的优化动态和演化过程在实践中的展开方式。

Conclusion: DataFoundry证明了在数据大规模生产之前通过递归自我改进来演化数据准备器是有效的，能够从根本上解决数据质量控制错配问题，并且该框架的改进具有跨模型泛化能力。

Abstract: Domain adaptation of large language models increasingly depends on constructing high-quality training data, yet existing data-preparation pipelines typically address quality only after generation through post-hoc filtering. This creates a fundamental mismatch: data-quality issues often originate from the construction process itself, while quality control is applied only to its outputs. We introduce \textsc{DataFoundry}, a framework for \textbf{evolving data preparators through recursive self-improvement} before large-scale data production. \textsc{DataFoundry} represents a data preparator as an evolvable runtime specification and instantiates its evolution with a \textsc{Skills-as-Modules} architecture, in which a central \textsc{Controller} orchestrates modular skills to compile executable runtimes, diagnose deficiencies on small pilot sets using domain-appropriate criteria, and translate diagnostic feedback into adapters that revise individual preparation components while preserving stable interfaces. We evaluate \textsc{DataFoundry} on DataPrep-Bench across mathematics, finance, law, and medicine, and find that recursively evolved preparators produce training data with higher downstream utility than baselines. Experiments across different backbones further demonstrate that these improvements are not tied to a particular model, while analyses and case studies further reveal the framework's optimization dynamics and illustrate how its evolution unfolds in practice.

</details>


### [386] [Beyond Fluency: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Saudi Dialect and Cultural Competence in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29990)
*Ghassan Al-Sumaidaee,Sajjad Abdoli,Ahmed Rashad,Maxim Legg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对沙特阿拉伯方言的基于评分标准的基准测试，包含31个由专家编写、涵盖惯用语、语用、词汇和文化嵌入现象的问题，每个问题都配有专家建立的标准答案。通过模型无关和模型特定两个阶段的评估方法，对四个SOTA系统进行评分，发现宏观平均分仅落在42.7%-53.1%的狭窄区间内，没有模型超过55%，证实沙特方言能力仍普遍未解决。错误分类中最主要的失败模式是"模糊框架"（37.3%），而纯粹的幻觉仅占11.2%，表明模型失败更多在于扭曲语域和平坦化语用细微差别，而非陈述虚假信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在阿拉伯语市场部署日益增多，但现有基准测试过度奖励现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）流利度，未衡量方言和文化能力。由于日常阿拉伯语主要是方言形式，且方言承载着MSA中心化评估无法捕捉的社会意义，这一差距具有重要影响，亟需填补。

Method: 提出了针对沙特方言的基于评分标准的基准测试方法。测试包含31个专家编写的问题，涵盖惯用语、语用、词汇和文化嵌入现象，每个问题有专家建立的标准答案。评估分为两个阶段：（1）模型无关阶段，仅基于标准答案推导出原子的、MECE的正面标准；（2）模型特定阶段，对四个SOTA系统（Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.7、GPT-5.6、Kimi K3）按标准进行评分，并对主动引入的错误进行惩罚。使用九类错误分类法对466个错误实例进行编目。

Result: 在124个模型-提示评估中，编目了466个错误实例。四个系统的宏观平均分在42.7%-53.1%的狭窄范围内，没有模型超过55%，每个模型至少有一个负分提示。模糊框架是最主要的失败模式（占错误37.3%），而纯粹的幻觉仅占11.2%。还观察到一致性-上限权衡和模型特有的错误特征。发布了完整的提示集、标准答案和评分标准以供复现。

Conclusion: 沙特方言能力在当前的顶尖LLM中仍普遍未解决。模型失败的主因并非陈述虚假信息，而是扭曲语域和扁平化语用细微差别，这表明方言能力评估需要超越事实正确性的框架。发布测试集和标准以支持可复现的方言评估，推动该领域的进一步发展。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in Arabic-speaking markets, yet standard benchmarks overwhelmingly reward Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) fluency while leaving dialectal and culturally grounded competence unmeasured. This gap is consequential: everyday Arabic is largely dialectal, and dialect encodes social meaning that MSA-centric evaluation cannot capture. We present a rubric-based benchmark for the Saudi dialect, comprising 31 expert-authored prompts spanning idiomatic, pragmatic, lexical, and culturally-embedded phenomena, each paired with an expert-established ground truth. Our methodology separates evaluation into a model-agnostic phase, in which atomic, MECE positive criteria are derived solely from the ground truth, and a model-specific phase, in which four state-of-the-art systems -- Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.7, GPT-5.6, and Kimi K3 -- are scored against those criteria and penalised for errors they actively introduce. Across 124 model-prompt evaluations we catalogue 466 error instances under a nine-category taxonomy. The four systems cluster within a narrow macro-average band (42.7%-53.1%), with no model exceeding 55% and every model recording at least one negative-scoring prompt, confirming that Saudi dialectal competence remains broadly unsolved. Notably, Ambiguous Framing is the dominant failure mode (37.3% of errors) while outright Hallucination accounts for only 11.2%, indicating that models fail less by stating falsehoods than by distorting register and flattening pragmatic nuance. We further observe a consistency-versus-ceiling trade-off and model-distinctive error signatures. We release the full prompt set, ground truths, and scored rubrics to support reproducible dialectal evaluation.

</details>


### [387] [Generating Clinical Vignettes that Preserve Cognitive Formulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29995)
*Amit Oren,Nimrod Hertz-Palmor,Dean Ariel,Guy Laban*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FORMA是一个理论驱动的框架，将疾病的认知模型编译为有向加权图，通过采样生成个体化的临床病例小短文，并验证生成的短文是否保留指定组件和因果链接。在PTSD场景下生成16,500个短文，结果表明完整条件下认知图可恢复（MCC=+0.41），专家评分显著更高，临床医生85%认为其为人类撰写，同时减少了1.5-7倍的感知质量人口差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型能生成流畅的临床病例短文，但流畅性并不能保证对可具体说明的临床结构的忠实度。需要一种理论支撑的框架来确保生成的短文保留指定的临床组件和因果联系。

Method: FORMA框架包括三个步骤：1) 将疾病的认知模型编译为有向加权图；2) 采样该图的个体特定配置；3) 验证生成的短文是否保留指定组件和因果链接。在PTSD上使用Ehlers和Clark认知模型实例化，通过500个人设、11个生成模型和三种消融条件生成16,500个短文。

Result: 全条件短文的认知图可恢复性显著（MCC=+0.41, AUC=0.70），而零样本生成几乎不可恢复（MCC=+0.01, AUC=0.50）。专家对完整条件短文评分显著更高；临床医生85%认为完整短文是人类撰写的（零样本仅22%）。FORMA将人口统计差异的感知质量差距减少了1.5-7倍。

Conclusion: 认知公式化可以作为可审计的规格说明，用于大规模合成临床文本生成，兼顾保真度、质量和公平性。

Abstract: Large language models can generate fluent clinical case vignettes, but fluency alone does not ensure fidelity to a specifiable clinical structure. We introduce FORMA, a theory-grounded framework that compiles a cognitive model of a disorder into a directed weighted graph, samples a person-specific configuration of that graph, and validates whether the generated vignette preserves the specified components and causal links. We instantiate FORMA on Posttraumatic Stress Disorder using the Ehlers and Clark cognitive model, generating 16,500 vignettes across 500 personas, 11 generation models, and three ablation conditions. Evaluation combines an external edge-recovery probe, two clinical experts, a scaled LLM judge, and a clinician user study with 100 licensed practitioners. The cognitive graph is recoverable from full-condition vignettes (MCC = +0.41, AUC = 0.70) but not from zero-shot generation (MCC = +0.01, AUC = 0.50). Experts rate full vignettes substantially higher than zero-shot alternatives, and clinicians perceive them to be human-written 85% of the time, compared with 22% for zero-shot. FORMA also reduces demographic disparity in perceived quality by 1.5-7x. These results show that cognitive formulation can serve as an auditable specification for scalable synthetic clinical text generation. A repository with the data and code is available online: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA.

</details>


### [388] [Small Language Models as Judges for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30005)
*Fengyu Xie,Yilun Zhao,Bingsen Chen,Arman Cohan,Chen Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究小型语言模型能否作为基于评价标准的强化学习中的高效可靠评判器。作者构建了两个点式评价标准数据集，比较了生成式、对数概率边际和探针三种方法，发现Qwen3-1.7B探针评判器在标准级一致性上最优，作为GRPO奖励模型在性能上超越8B生成式基线且速度快10.7倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评价标准的强化学习（Rubric-based RL）在无精确答案任务中通过按实例特定标准评分来扩展RL的应用，但奖励计算成本高昂，因为训练需要反复进行评价标准评判，且通常依赖专有API或7B参数以上的生成式LLM评判器。作者希望探究更小的语言模型能否作为高效且可靠的评判替代方案。

Method: 作者构建了两个点式评价标准数据集PointRubric和RaR-Science-Static，包含实例特定标准和逐项满意度标签。比较三种从小型模型中提取标准级判断的方法：生成式裁决（Generative verdicts）、是/否对数概率边际（Yes/No Logprob margins）和探针评判器（Probe judges）。

Result: 在两个数据集上，Qwen3-1.7B探针评判器在标准级一致性上表现最强，优于生成式和对数概率方法。作为GRPO奖励模型，它将策略从0.232训练到0.643（RaR-Science评价标准分数），而8B生成式评判基线达到0.594，且基线需要10.7倍的奖励评判时间。任务和领域迁移实验表明探针评判器能跨设置保持标准级奖励结构。

Conclusion: 小型模型的探针评判器可以作为基于评价标准的强化学习中高效且可靠的奖励模型，在性能和效率上均优于大规模生成式评判器，并具有良好的迁移能力。

Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends RL beyond tasks with exact answers or rule-based verifiers by scoring responses against instance-specific criteria. However, this makes reward computation expensive: training requires repeated rubric judging, often with proprietary APIs or local generative LLM judges with 7B parameters or more. We study whether smaller language models can serve as efficient and reliable rubric-based judges. To make this question measurable, we construct PointRubric and RaR-Science-Static, two pointwise rubric-based evaluation datasets with instance-specific criteria and itemwise satisfaction labels. We compare three ways of extracting criterion-level judgments from small models: Generative verdicts, Yes/No Logprob margins, and Probe judges. Across both datasets, the Qwen3-1.7B Probe judge achieves the strongest criterion-level agreement among these methods, outperforming Generative and Logprob judges. Used as a GRPO reward model, it trains a policy from 0.232 to 0.643 on RaR-Science rubric score, compared with 0.594 for an 8B Generative judge baseline, while the baseline requires 10.7$\times$ more reward-judge time. Task and domain transfer experiments further suggest that Probe judges preserve criterion-level reward structure across settings.

</details>


### [389] ["Act Like a 5th Grader" is Not Enough: Bounding Knowledge in LLM-Based User Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30033)
*Krisztian Balog,Arild Michel Bakken*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出认知受限用户模拟器（CBUS），通过模拟小学生（4-6年级）有限的工作记忆来改善LLM在人类行为模拟中的"超人偏差"。基于71,000多条真实阅读理解数据，实验表明显式建模认知约束比单纯提升模型规模能更有效地缩小模拟差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM常被用于模拟人类行为，但存在"超人偏差"——表现得过于完美和确定，无法捕捉真实读者（尤其是认知能力还在发展中的小学生）的自然变异性。标准的人格提示方法无法生成具有真实认知局限的响应。

Method: 提出CBUS框架，通过"情节瓶颈"（episodic bottleneck）显式建模年轻读者的受限工作记忆。在框架内形式化了两种不同的应试策略，用于模拟不同的阅读行为。

Result: 在多个LLM骨干网络上，显式建模认知边界显著缩小了模拟差距。结果表明，施加架构约束比单纯扩展原始模型能力更能实现高保真模拟。

Conclusion: 要生成逼真的人类行为模拟，关键不在于提升模型规模，而在于在架构层面显式地建模认知限制。这为更可信的LLM用户模拟器设计提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior but frequently fail to exhibit realistic cognitive constraints, suffering from a "superhuman bias." Using a dataset of over 71,000 reading comprehension responses from 2,359 primary-school students (grades 4--6), we demonstrate that standard persona prompting yields near-perfect, deterministic performance, failing to capture the natural variance of developing readers. To address this, we introduce the Cognitively Bounded User Simulator (CBUS), an architectural framework that explicitly models the restricted working memory of young readers through an episodic bottleneck. Within this framework, we formalize two distinct test-taking strategies to emulate different reading behaviors. Our evaluation shows that explicitly modeling cognitive bounds significantly narrows the simulation gap across multiple LLM backbones, demonstrating that enforcing architectural constraints is more effective for high-fidelity simulation than simply scaling raw model capabilities.

</details>


### [390] [Pak3H: Evaluating the Cost of Cultural Mismatch in LLM Alignment with a Human-Contextualized Urdu Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30065)
*Abdullah Hashmat,Usman Naseem,Agha Ali Raza*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Pak3H1，首个经过人工验证、文化情境化的乌尔都语3H对齐基准套件，包含Helpfulness、Harmlessness和Honesty三个子集。通过多阶段流水线整合人工文化改编和词典引导的后编辑，零样本评估显示跨语言对齐存在系统性缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM的3H对齐在英语中心设置下表现良好，但在低资源语言中因文化不匹配而迁移效果差。已有的多语言3H基准多依赖自动翻译或LLM合成，传播了源语言偏见且缺乏本地相关性，需要人工验证的文化情境化基准。

Method: 构建Pak3H1基准套件，包含PakAlpaca（helpfulness）、PakBeaverTails（harmlessness）和PakTruthfulQA（honesty）三个组件。采用多阶段流水线：人工文化改编 + 词典引导的后编辑，优先考虑母语者的判断，确保语义保真度与情境真实性。

Result: 零样本评估多种开源和专有LLM架构，发现系统性跨语言对齐缺口：帮助性胜率在本地化情境下下降，安全性护栏在区域安全风险下失效，综合诚实度指标因本地化事实约束而大幅下降。

Conclusion: 当前对齐方法存在结构性局限，强调了人类引导的本地化对于公平的多语言评估的必要性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty (3H) alignment in English-centric settings, but these gains transfer poorly to low-resource languages due to cultural mismatches. Existing multilingual 3H benchmarks rely predominantly on automated translation or LLM based synthesis, propagating source-language biases while sacrificing local relevance. To address this gap, we introduce Pak3H1, the first human-validated, culturally contextualized Urdu benchmark suite for 3H alignment, comprising PakAlpaca (helpfulness), PakBeaverTails (harmlessness), and PakTruthfulQA (honesty). Our multi-stage pipeline integrates manual cultural adaptation and dictionary-guided post editing to prioritize native speaker judgment, ensuring both semantic fidelity and contextual authenticity. Zero-shot evaluations across multiple open and proprietary LLM architectures reveal systematic cross-lingual alignment gaps: helpfulness win rates decline under localized contexts, harmlessness guardrails break down against regional safety risks, and composite honesty metrics degrade substantially due to localized factual constraints. These findings expose structural limitations in current alignment approaches, underscoring the necessity of human-guided localization for equitable multilingual evaluation.

</details>


### [391] [Budget-Aware Compression Pipeline for Single-GPU LLM Inference: Methods, Trade-offs, and Coupling Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30076)
*Hongyu Yu,Yifei Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究在单张NVIDIA GPU上部署70B参数量大语言模型的推理问题，将单GPU推理建模为预算感知的设计问题，系统研究剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩三者之间的相互作用，并提出了一套实用的压缩流水线，成功将70B模型压缩至约33GB，在单张A40上实现约57 tokens/s的推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单GPU部署70B大语言模型面临三大核心约束：设备内存有限、长上下文吞吐量低、工程集成成本高。现有研究多孤立地看待剪枝、量化、KV缓存压缩等技术，缺乏对它们在真实执行条件下相互作用的理解，亟需系统性研究。

Method: 将单GPU推理视为一个三轴（内存、长上下文吞吐、工程集成成本）上的预算感知设计问题。通过受控消融实验研究剪枝、量化、KV缓存压缩的相互作用：发现逐层剪枝能提升权重量化的鲁棒性，KV缓存稀疏化可补充INT8 KV量化从而在不影响解码速度的前提下减少内存，而静态向量量化器常与动态缓存冲突。基于耦合结果和显式预算跟踪，组装了实用压缩流水线。

Result: 将70B模型压缩到约33GB，在单张A40上以10k token提示词实现约57 tokens/s的推理速度，在常见基准和推理基准上保持绝对准确率在5%以内。

Conclusion: 贡献了设计规则和可复现的评估协议，能够联合报告质量、内存和端到端速度三个指标，为在现实单GPU约束下实现自动化流水线搜索提供了基础。

Abstract: Single-GPU deployment of 70B-parameter language models on an NVIDIA GPU is constrained by device memory, long-context throughput, and engineering integration cost. We cast single-GPU inference as a budget-aware design problem over these three axes and study how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Controlled ablations show that layer-wise pruning makes weight quantization more robust. KV-cache sparsification complements INT8 KV quantization by reducing memory without hurting decoding speed, while static vector quantizers often conflict with dynamic caching. Guided by these coupling results and explicit budget tracking, we assembled a practical pipeline and compressed a 70B model to about 33 GB, sustained about 57 tokens/s on 10k token prompts on a single A40, and kept absolute accuracy within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks. We contribute design rules and a reproducible evaluation protocol that jointly report quality, memory, and end-to-end speed, and we provide a foundation for automated pipeline search under realistic single-GPU constraints.

</details>


### [392] [When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30086)
*Rishi Datta,Lavanya Prahallad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究了如何将传统拟合分类器与大型语言模型（LLM）结合用于信用违约预测。实验发现，将分类器预测概率加入提示词可将LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提升至0.78（与随机森林持平），同时保持更高的召回率；而仅让LLM模仿分类器或反向组合均无效。作者推荐使用分类器引导的简单提示词。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信用违约预测是金融决策中的重要任务。传统方法依赖逻辑回归、随机森林等拟合分类器处理表格特征，而LLM可通过提示词方式应用于该任务。作者希望探究如何将两者的优势结合——传统分类器具备排序能力，而LLM提示可能缺乏这种能力，同时探究不同组合方式的优劣。

Method: 在Default of Credit Card Clients数据集上进行实验。区分两种组合方式：(1)让LLM模仿分类器的输出；(2)利用分类器构建提示词（包括特征剪枝到8个最重要特征、以及将分类器的预测概率加入提示词）。评估指标包括召回率、F1、AUC-ROC和AUC-PR，并使用bootstrap置信区间。还测试了反向组合（LLM引导分类器）及多种分类器的使用。

Result: 少样本LLM单独使用时召回率(0.47)和F1(0.50)最高，但AUC-ROC(0.72)低于随机森林(0.79)。让LLM模仿分类器无显著变化。将提示词剪枝至分类器的8个最重要特征使召回率提升0.071、F1提升0.032。将分类器预测概率加入提示词使LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提升至0.78（与随机森林持平），同时保持比其高0.118的召回率。反向组合及使用多个分类器均无帮助。

Conclusion: 推荐使用分类器引导的简单提示词用于LLM信用违约预测：将拟合分类器的预测概率注入LLM提示，可同时获得分类器的排序能力和LLM的高召回率优势，实现性能互补的最优组合。

Abstract: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.

</details>


### [393] [Arkios: An Open Bilingual English-Nepali Language Model Trained From Scratch, with a Devanagari-Aware Tokenizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30092)
*Sajal Regmi,Siddhartha Pudasaini,Chetan Phakami Pun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Arkios，一个10.4亿参数的稠密Transformer模型，从头训练于1500亿token的英尼双语文本。该模型在ARC基准上超越了三个同规模的开放模型（尽管训练token少了一个数量级），并揭示了低资源语言小模型评估中的重要发现：标准的多选字母提示格式会使模型在尼泊尔语和英语上均表现为随机水平，而直接对答案文本评分则能揭示真实的语言理解能力。同时描述了指令微调中引入的manifest条件工具调用约束，并发布了模型权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在解决低资源语言（尼泊尔语）大语言模型领域的空白，同时揭示标准评估协议在低资源语言小模型上的系统性缺陷。他们发现常见的字母选项提示格式会导致模型在尼泊尔语和英语阅读理解上均表现出随机水平，这会导致天真的基准测试得出模型没有尼泊尔语能力的错误结论——但事实并非如此。此外，他们还探索了指令微调中工具调用的安全性约束问题。

Method: 使用自定义单文件C/CUDA训练栈，从零训练了一个1.04B参数的稠密Transformer，基于150B token的英尼双语文本。构建了针对天城体梵文的字节级BPE分词器。在ARC-Easy/ARC-Challenge上与其他三个同等规模开放模型对比评估，并采用标准协议进行全量评估。同时引入了一种manifest条件工具调用契约：仅当上下文中声明了工具清单时才允许工具调用，否则抑制该行为。

Result: 在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上，Arkios超越了Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B和OLMo-1B三个同规模开放模型，尽管训练token少了约一个数量级。在标准字母选项格式下，尼泊尔语得分为0.240、英语为0.236（随机基线0.250），均接近随机；但直接对答案文本评分时，尼泊尔语为0.306、英语为0.387，显示出真实的（偏向英语的）理解能力。同时报告了manifest条件工具调用契约的成立与失效情况。

Conclusion: Arkios在ARC上的出色表现主要归因于预训练数据（教育网页文本）与ARC数据集格式（小学科学）之间的匹配，而非通用能力的优势。标准评估框架的字母选项格式对低资源语言小模型具有系统性误导性，应采用答案文本直接评分的方式。模型权重以Apache-2.0许可发布，训练代码和部分私有尼泊尔语数据未公开。

Abstract: We present Arkios, a 1.04B-parameter dense transformer pretrained from scratch on 150B tokens of bilingual English-Nepali text, using a custom single-file C/CUDA training stack and a Devanagari-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer built for this project. On ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge, Arkios exceeds three comparably sized open models (Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B, OLMo-1B) despite an order of magnitude fewer training tokens, likely aided by a match between our educational-web-text pretraining data and ARC's grade-school-science format rather than a general capability advantage. We report full evaluation results under standard protocols, including a correction to an earlier partial-sample estimate, and findings specific to evaluating small models in a low-resource language: the standard multiple-choice-letter prompt format used by common evaluation harnesses places this model at chance on Nepali reading comprehension, and simultaneously at chance on English in the same format, which would lead a naive benchmark run to conclude the model has no Nepali ability when in fact it does. Concretely, both languages score at chance in the letter-choice format (0.240 Nepali, 0.236 English, against a chance baseline of 0.250), while scoring the answer text directly reveals genuine, English-favoring comprehension (0.306 Nepali, 0.387 English). We describe a manifest-conditioned tool-use contract introduced during instruction tuning, where tool calls are permitted only when a tool manifest is declared in context and suppressed otherwise, and report where that contract holds and where it does not. We release both the base and instruction-tuned model weights under Apache-2.0. The training code and a small privately-sourced portion of the Nepali pretraining corpus are not released; everything needed to reproduce the reported numbers from the released weights is included here.

</details>


### [394] [AtlasNLP: A Country-Aware Atlas of Dataset Representation in NLP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30107)
*Joan Nwatu,Tsedeniya Solomon Amare,Longju Bai,Bontu Fufa Balcha,Zayd Bashir,Angana Borah,Zara Burzo,Yubin Choi,Naihao Deng,Samika Gupta,Michel Faloughi,Claude Kwizera,Ziqiao Ma,Cynthia Yacel Fuertes Panizo,Ellie Seehorn,Hui Shen,Jiayi Tang,Zesen Zhao,Boyuan Zheng,Rada Mihalcea*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了AtlasNLP，一个覆盖13,000余条NLP数据集记录的国家级图谱，追踪数据集所代表的人口以及数据集生产地点。研究发现数据集覆盖在国家与任务间高度不均、生产与代表存在地理不对称、语言覆盖不等于地理代表，揭示当前数据集文档实践中的盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解NLP数据集中哪些国家被代表对于识别差距、定位数据收集、衡量进展和指导AI政策至关重要，但地理元数据极为稀缺，国家层面的代表性往往被宽泛的语言级别声明所掩盖。

Method: 构建AtlasNLP，包含AtlasNLP-Gold（人工策展的参考集）和AtlasNLP-Core（基于ACL的大规模数据集集合），覆盖13,000余条NLP数据集记录，并进行跨任务类别的归一化分析。

Result: 发现：(1) 数据集覆盖在国家与任务间高度不均；(2) 数据集生产与代表性存在地理不对称；(3) 语言覆盖并不蕴含地理代表性。

Conclusion: 研究结果揭示了当前数据集文档实践中的盲区，并促使呼吁在数据集文档中增加更明确的地理元数据，以实现国家感知的NLP评估。

Abstract: Understanding which countries are represented in NLP datasets is essential for identifying gaps, targeting data collection, measuring progress, and informing AI policy. However, geographic metadata is very rarely available, and country-level representation is often hidden behind broad language-level claims. We introduce AtlasNLP, a country-aware atlas of over 13,000 NLP dataset records across normalized NLP task categories, tracking both the populations represented and where datasets are produced. AtlasNLP includes AtlasNLP-Gold, a human-curated reference set, and AtlasNLP-Core, an ACL-derived large-scale collection. Using this resource, we show that (1) dataset coverage is highly uneven across countries and tasks; (2) dataset production and representation are geographically asymmetric; and (3) language coverage does not imply geographic representation. These findings reveal blind spots in current dataset documentation practices and motivate more explicit geographic metadata for country-aware NLP evaluation.

</details>


### [395] [COGTRL: Training LLMs for Scientific Discovery Assistance using Cognitive Traces via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30109)
*Shrinidhi Kumbhar Santosh Mashetty Divij Handa Kevin Coutinho,Siddharth Sambhaji Ghule,Chitta Baral*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出COGTRL，一个轨迹级强化学习框架，训练LLM生成认知轨迹（cognitive traces），使其作为科学发现助手时表现优于仅基于科学文献训练的模型。在AI和材料科学两个领域、两个3B参数模型上，方法质量平均提升7.85分，性能可与70B模型竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数研究论文省略了科学家在实现目标过程中对约束的检查、失败替代方案和迭代决策等细粒度认知过程，而这些认知过程对于在约束下工作的真实科学家至关重要。仅基于科学文献训练的LLM缺乏这些关键认知能力。

Method: 提出COGTRL，一种轨迹级（trajectory-level）强化学习框架，通过交替联合优化认知轨迹（cognitive traces）和科学步骤（scientific steps），训练LLM模拟具有认知基础的推理过程。

Result: 在AI和材料科学两个领域、两个3B参数模型上，COGTRL相比同类3B基线平均提升7.85分的方法质量，且达到与70B参数模型相当的竞争性能。领域专家的分析表明偏好COGTRL生成的方法。

Conclusion: 训练LLM生成认知轨迹能显著提升其作为科学发现助手的性能，即使模型参数规模较小（3B），也能取得与大模型相当的竞争力，说明认知过程的建模比单纯扩大模型规模更关键。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on extensive scientific research are increasingly integrated as assistants for scientific discovery. However, most research papers omit the fine-grained cognitive process of examining constraints, failed alternatives, and iterative decisions required to achieve the desired goal. Such cognitive processes are vital for real-world scientists working toward specific goals under constraints. In this paper, we show that LLMs, when trained to produce such cognitive traces, perform better as scientific discovery assistants than when trained solely on scientific literature. We propose COGTRL, a trajectory-level reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to emulate cognitively grounded reasoning by jointly optimizing cognitive traces and the scientific steps produced in an interleaved manner. Across two 3B-parameter models and two scientific domains (AI and Materials Science), COGTRL improves method quality by an average of 7.85 points over comparable 3B model baselines and achieves competitive performance relative to 70B parameter models. Moreover, analysis by domain experts shows a preference for methods generated by COGTRL over the baselines.

</details>


### [396] [Can LLMs Take the Pulse of the Economy? A Real-Time Evaluation of LLM Nowcasts on Macroeconomic Indicators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30110)
*Xinyue Zhao,Ruiyi Zhang,Liqin Ye,Rui Cao,Pengtao Xie,Sudheer Chava*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 LiveMacroEval，一个抗数据污染的实时基准测试，用于评估 LLM 智能体对 16 个美国宏观经济指标的"即时预测"（nowcasting）能力。通过每小时的实时预测和多种评分机制，研究发现 LLM 智能体的整体预测精度与传统机构预测相当，但不同指标间差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宏观经济指标的即时预测对货币政策与金融市场至关重要，LLM 智能体具备广阔世界知识、实时网络搜索和高频查询能力，是理想的候选方案。然而，GDP 和 CPI 等核心指标在预训练中可能已被记忆，传统历史数据评估存在数据污染风险，亟需一种抗污染的评估方法。

Method: 构建 LiveMacroEval 实时基准：LLM 智能体在每次官方发布前的窗口期内对 16 个美国宏观指标进行逐小时即时预测。采用 LiveMacro Score（基于公告窗口的股票收益）和 LiveBetting Score（模拟 Polymarket 交易）评估预测质量，并与美联储地区银行预测、Bloomberg ECOS 专业共识及 auto-ARIMA 基线进行比较。

Result: 经过六个月、四个先进 LLM 智能体（配备网络搜索）的测试，LLM 智能体的整体即时预测精度与机构及专业基准大致相当，但在不同具体指标上的表现差异较大。

Conclusion: LLM 智能体展现出作为宏观经济状况实时估计器的潜力，但需针对不同指标进行精细化优化，且抗污染的实时评估框架（如 LiveMacroEval）对可信评估至关重要。

Abstract: Nowcasting headline macroeconomic indicators, i.e., estimating an indicator's value for the current reference period before its official release, is critical for monetary policy and financial markets, and central banks devote dedicated teams of expert economists to producing such estimates. Large language model (LLM) agents are a promising candidate for this task, combining broad world knowledge with real-time web search and supporting queries at higher frequency than institutional nowcasts. Evaluating their nowcasting capability is, however, challenging: headline indicators such as GDP and CPI are widely reported and likely memorized during pretraining, so any evaluation on historical releases is vulnerable to data contamination. To address this, we introduce LiveMacroEval, a live, contamination-resistant benchmark in which LLM agents produce hourly nowcasts for sixteen major U.S. macroeconomic indicators over a pre-release window closing at each official release. Nowcast quality is assessed through a LiveMacro Score against announcement-window equity returns and a LiveBetting Score from simulated Polymarket-style trading, with Federal Reserve regional-bank nowcasts, the Bloomberg ECOS professional consensus, and an auto-ARIMA baseline as comparators. Over six months with four state-of-the-art LLM agents configured with web search, aggregate nowcast accuracy is broadly comparable to the institutional and professional benchmarks, with performance varying widely across individual indicators. This highlights LLM agents' potential as real-time estimators of macroeconomic conditions.

</details>


### [397] [Manacá-1B: An Open, Reproducible Brazilian-Portuguese Language Model and a Tokenizer-Aware, Paired Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30114)
*Bruno Leonardo Santos Menezes,Carlos Leonardo Souza Cardoso,Fabio Andre Machado Porto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布了Manacá-1B，一个17.2亿参数的巴西葡萄牙语开源解码器模型，采用完全容器化、可复现的训练流程，提供完整训练日志与动力学数据。模型在四个葡萄牙语基准上对九个开源基线进行评估，所有比较均报告标准误差和配对显著性检验。Manacá-1B在LAMBADA-PT最后一词预测任务上是7B规模以下最强的模型。论文还揭示了SentencePiece分词器转换到HuggingFace格式时静默丢失normalizer的评估陷阱，并提供了可复现全部数据的修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语领域缺乏高质量的开源语言模型，现有模型难以复现且评估常缺乏不确定性度量，导致该语言的模型发展受限且评估结果不可靠。

Method: 从零训练一个1.72B参数的解码器模型Manacá-1B，采用完全容器化的可复现流水线；使用统一的评估框架（同一harness）在四个葡萄牙语基准上对比九个开源基线，每个对比报告标准误差和配对显著性检验；同时调查并修复了SentencePiece分词器与HuggingFace fast格式之间的兼容性问题。

Result: Manacá-1B在LAMBADA-PT上超过Tucano-1b1和Tucano-2b4，是7B规模以下最强模型；在常识补全任务上具有竞争力，在多选推理上接近随机水平（与其他小型基础模型一致）；预训练过程稳定，零跳过或NaN步骤，损失尖峰可自恢复；分词器缺陷使LAMBADA-PT准确率从45.3降至25.0，修复后完全复现训练时的分词器。

Conclusion: Manacá-1B为巴西葡萄牙语提供了一个可复现、评估严谨的开源模型，同时揭示了评估管线中分词器转换的隐蔽陷阱，强调了评估基础设施验证和完整数据发布的重要性。

Abstract: Brazilian Portuguese remains under-served by open language models, and the few that exist are difficult to reproduce and are often compared without measures of uncertainty. We release Manacá-1B, an open decoder-only model of 1.72 billion parameters trained from scratch for Brazilian Portuguese with a fully containerized, reproducible pipeline. The pretraining is stable, with zero skipped or NaN steps and self-recovering loss spikes, and we release its full log and dynamics. We evaluate the model against nine open baselines on four Portuguese benchmarks under a single harness. Every comparison reports a standard error and a paired significance test, and the harness is validated against previously published numbers. On last-word prediction Manacá-1B is the strongest model below the 7B scale, exceeding both Tucano-1b1 and Tucano-2b4 on LAMBADA-PT with large paired margins; it is competitive on commonsense completion and near chance on multiple-choice reasoning, as are all small base models. Along the way we document a concrete evaluation pitfall: converting a SentencePiece tokenizer with case-folding normalization to the HuggingFace fast format silently drops the normalizer, routing every capitalized token to byte-fallback and depressing scores in a way that is invisible in aggregate metrics. The uncorrected tokenizer lowered LAMBADA-PT accuracy from 45.3 to 25.0; we quantify the effect and provide a one-line fix that reproduces the training tokenizer exactly. Code, raw training and evaluation logs, per-example prediction vectors, the model weights, and the corrected tokenizer are released so that every number in this paper can be recomputed.

</details>


### [398] [Verification-Aware Training for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30135)
*Geonmo Gu,Byeongho Heo,HeeJae Jun,Yoohoon Kang,Sangmin Lee,Sangdoo Yun,Dongyoon Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出验证感知训练（VAT）框架，通过模拟推理时的顺序验证过程，将接受/拒绝模式转化为监督信号，用于训练投机解码中的草稿模型，从而提升推理加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的投机解码草稿模型训练仅依赖token级别的模仿学习，采用固定的逐位置权重，这既未反映验证的序贯性（从首个拒绝位置起全部丢弃），也未反映实际接受/拒绝模式，导致训练目标与推理目标不一致。

Method: VAT包含两个核心组件：(1) 验证头——一个轻量级联合训练的二分类器，监督草稿模型在每个位置能否通过序贯验证；(2) 验证自适应权重——将固定权重调度替换为：在样本首个拒绝点前保持全权重，拒绝点之后再锚定衰减起点。VAT仅修改训练目标，不改变草稿架构、目标模型或推理流程。

Result: 在EAGLE-3和DFlash上应用于Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B，平均接受长度提升最高达11.4%，墙钟加速比提升最高达8.7%，在数学、代码和对话基准上均表现一致提升。

Conclusion: VAT是一种即插即用的训练框架，可叠加在现有投机解码方法之上，通过使训练目标与验证机制对齐，显著提升草稿模型的接受长度和推理加速效果。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a draft model to generate candidate tokens, which are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Verification proceeds sequentially and discards every position from the first rejection onward, yet existing draft training relies on token-level imitation of the target with a fixed per-position weighting that reflects neither property. We introduce Verification-Aware Training (VAT), a plug-in framework that simulates verification at every training step and turns the resulting accept and reject patterns into supervision. VAT consists of two components: (i) a verification head, a lightweight jointly trained binary classifier that supervises the draft model on whether each position survives sequential verification; (ii) verification-adaptive weighting, which replaces the fixed weighting schedule by keeping full weight up to each sample's first rejection point and re-anchoring the decay to start there. VAT modifies only the training objective, so it can be layered on top of existing methods without changing the draft architecture, the target model, or the inference procedure. Applied to EAGLE-3 and DFlash on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B, VAT improves average acceptance length by up to 11.4% and wall-clock speedup by up to 8.7%, with consistent gains across math, code, and chat benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/vat

</details>


### [399] [CAST: Critique-Aware Supervision for Training Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Calling Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30147)
*Amir Saeidi,Zehua Zhang,Rishitosh Singh,Naman Ahuja,Vivek Gupta,Ali Payani,Gaowen Liu,Jayanth Srinivasa,Chitta Baral*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAST是一个批评感知训练框架，通过将稀疏的任务结果转化为动作级监督，用于批评学习和策略优化，从而提升LLM代理在长时程、交互式环境中的可靠性。在动态工具调用基准上，CAST在Retail任务上比GPT-OSS-120B提升超过10%的pass^4，在域外Telehealth任务上额外提升9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理在长时程、交互式、有状态的环境中，单个错误动作（如错误退款）可能导致不可逆的任务失败，且必须在执行前拦截。这类失败可能不会在单次运行中出现，而是在重复试验中显现。现有提示型批评代理方法缺乏系统性，而优化型方法没有系统化方式生成丰富的验证推理理由用于训练。

Method: CAST框架包含两部分：(1) 分析代理轨迹，综合结构化推理理由，在部分可观测性下解释动作有效性；(2) 利用生成的批评模型构建批评感知训练数据，用于优化策略模型。将稀疏任务结果转化为动作级监督，用于批评学习和策略优化。

Result: 在动态工具调用基准上，对Qwen3系列模型进行微调后，CAST在Retail任务上比GPT-OSS-120B提升超过10%的pass^4，在域外Telehealth任务上额外提升9%。

Conclusion: 批评感知训练能够提升LLM代理在现实动态环境中的鲁棒性，证明将批评推理纳入策略训练是提高代理可靠性的有效途径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, interactive, and stateful environments. In these settings, a single wrong action, such as refunding the wrong purchase, can cause irreversible task failure and must be intercepted before execution. Such failures may not appear in every single run, but can emerge across repeated trials, making reliability across steps and trials critical. However, ensuring agentic reliability is challenging: even frontier LLMs struggle to explain why an action may be wrong, especially in long, intertwined trajectories governed by domain-specific policies. Much recent work relies on prompt-based critique agents, while optimization-based methods lack a systematic way to produce rich verification rationales for training. We address this gap with CAST, a critique-aware training framework that converts sparse task outcomes into action-level supervision for critique learning and policy optimization. CAST analyzes agent trajectories to synthesize structured rationales explaining action validity under partial observability. The resulting critique model is used to construct critique-aware training data for optimizing the policy model. Fine-tuning Qwen3-family models on dynamic tool-calling benchmarks, CAST improves reliability across domains, outperforming GPT-OSS-120B by over 10% pass^4 on Retail tasks and yielding an additional 9% improvement on Telehealth in an out-of-domain setting. These results demonstrate that critique-aware training improves the robustness of LLM agents in realistic dynamic environments.

</details>


### [400] [Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30156)
*Xiaoqiang Kang,Shengen Wu,Maizhen Ning,Xiaobo Jin,Kaizhu Huang,Yutao Yue,Xiaowei Huang,Qiufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS)和Perception-Augmented (PA)训练以及Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE)方法，解决平面几何问题（PGP）求解中符号编程范式下测试时扩展（TTS）失效的问题，通过将符号程序转化为异构推理轨迹、在符号演绎前进行显式视觉感知增强，并在推理时采用共识引导的多轨迹集成，在三个几何基准上取得显著提升，相比高预算自洽性可降低8倍采样成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面几何问题求解是多模态推理的关键基准，但测试时扩展在符号编程范式下无法有效扩展。作者识别出两个关键障碍：刚性符号程序导致的推理多样性受限，以及符号演绎前缺乏足够的显式视觉锚定。

Method: 1) Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS)：将每个符号程序转换为异构推理轨迹，包括可执行的Python脚本和CoT增强变体；2) Perception-Augmented (PA)训练：在演绎前将图表解析为结构化语义子句；3) Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE)：高效的自我自适应推理集成方法。

Result: 在三个几何基准上的实验表明，该方法在多个模型规模上一致性地提升了PGP求解性能，超越通用多模态大语言模型和专门的几何求解器。在测试时扩展下，CG-MTE达到与高预算自洽性相当的准确率，同时采样成本降低最多8倍。

Conclusion: 通过增强推理多样性（MTS）和显式视觉感知（PA训练），配合高效的共识引导集成（CG-MTE），有效解决了符号编程范式下测试时扩展失效的问题，为平面几何推理提供了可扩展且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Plane geometry problem (PGP) solving has become a critical benchmark for multimodal reasoning because it requires accurate visual perception and precise multi-step symbolic deduction. Although test-time scaling (TTS) has demonstrated remarkable success in general mathematical reasoning, it fails to scale effectively under the symbolic-program paradigm for plane geometry. We identify two key obstacles: limited reasoning diversity induced by rigid symbolic programs and insufficient explicit visual grounding before symbolic deduction. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS), which converts each symbolic program into heterogeneous reasoning traces, including executable Python scripts and CoT-augmented variants. We further propose Perception-Augmented (PA) training, which parses diagrams into structured semantic clauses before deduction, and Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE) for efficient self-adaptive inference. Experiments on three geometry benchmarks show that our method consistently improves PGP-solving across model scales and achieves strong performance against both general-purpose MLLMs and specialized geometry solvers. Under test-time scaling, CG-MTE achieves comparable accuracy to high-budget self-consistency while reducing sampling cost by up to 8x. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Jason8Kang/ReTTS-PGPS.

</details>


### [401] [CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30158)
*Kwangmin Ki,Yunhun Nam,Jongheon Jeong,Jaehyung Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CPR（Critical-Point Routing）提出了一种令牌级路由框架，在基础模型和其SFT专家模型之间进行切换，仅在需要领域知识的关键令牌处调用专家模型，从而在不牺牲领域性能的前提下几乎完全消除灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SFT在适配目标领域时会降低模型的通用能力（灾难性遗忘），现有方法通过修改SFT损失来缓解遗忘，但不可避免地在领域性能和通用能力之间存在权衡。作者希望跳出这一权衡，在模型层面将两种能力解耦。

Method: 提出CPR（Critical-Point Routing）框架：1）基于"关键令牌"（基础模型失败但专家成功的令牌）训练一个轻量级分层路由器，估计每个令牌的专家调用概率；2）设计配套的推理流程，结合动量平滑和阈值门控来决定是否调用专家模型。

Result: 在多种模型-领域配置下，CPR在所有设置中达到最先进水平：领域性能比SFT专家提升1.4-5.5%，同时将通用能力下降从3.4-14.5%恢复至最多仅0.5%，且仅需在约三分之一的令牌上调用专家，开销极小。

Conclusion: 通过在令牌级别智能路由基础模型与专家模型，CPR成功打破了领域性能与通用能力之间的权衡，实现了两者兼得，为SFT的灾难性遗忘问题提供了一种新的解决思路。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.

</details>


### [402] [GPAgentBench-2K: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Complex Clinical Action Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30188)
*Boqi Chen,Xudong Liu,Yunke Ao,Heejin Do,Jianing Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了GPAgentBench-2K，这是首个基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）的LLM智能体基准，用于初级医疗临床决策，包含六大基础临床动作、拓扑工作流先验和安全性知情弃权机制。评测16个LLM后发现：动作空间扩大导致性能显著下降，且即使最先进模型也存在临床质量-安全性差距（高风险案例中安全约束违反率超50%）。C-GRPO虽优于无约束RL方法，但距临床可接受安全水平仍相去甚远。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM临床基准将临床工作流简化为静态预测或动作集粗糙的无约束马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），无法真实反映临床决策的约束性和复杂性，缺乏更贴近真实全科医生（GP）诊疗场景的评估环境。

Method: 构建基于专家验证的真实GP就诊记录的GPAgentBench-2K基准，采用CMDP框架建模六大基础临床动作，施加拓扑工作流先验，将安全性知情弃权作为一等结果。利用C-GRPO（约束组相对策略优化）建立参考基线。

Result: 评测16个SOTA LLM发现：动作空间扩张导致性能显著退化；前沿模型即便诊断准确率最高，在高风险案例中仍有超过一半违反安全约束；C-GRPO显式建模约束优于无约束RL，但仍远未达到临床可接受的安全标准。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在临床决策中的安全性远未达标，反映了临床质量与安全之间存在显著鸿沟。显式约束建模（如C-GRPO）虽有帮助但不足，未来需要更有效的安全对齐方法才能使LLM达到临床可接受水平。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential as clinical agents, yet existing benchmarks reduce clinical workflows to static predictions or unconstrained Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with coarse action sets. To address this, we introduce GPAgentBench-2K, the first Constrained MDP (CMDP) LLM-agent benchmark for primary-care clinical decision-making, constructed from expert-validated records of real-world GP encounters. Our environment models a full spectrum of six foundational clinical actions, imposes a topological workflow prior over the action space, and operationalizes safety-informed abstention as a first-class outcome. Evaluating 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a significant performance degradation as the action space scales. Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases. Finally, we establish a reference point using Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), and show that while explicitly modeling constraints improves performance over unconstrained RL methods, it remains far from clinically acceptable safety.

</details>


### [403] [When Errors Become Memories: Causal Pathway Tracing in Multi-Turn Memory-Augmented LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30198)
*Shuyao Xiao,Shengling Wang,Xuan Chen,Ke Chao,Ming Cui,Feifei Qian,Fanlin Meng,Chaoyang Mei,Chaoyong Jiang,Qi Ouyang,Junxi Yi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于结构因果模型（SCM）的框架，用于分析记忆增强大语言模型中的跨轮次错误传播问题。通过识别内部记忆更新和外部问题反馈两条路径，构建四种反事实轨迹，在四个层面量化错误影响，并验证路径引导的错误修复策略的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要评估记忆系统能否正确存储和检索信息，但缺乏对错误如何在响应、记忆状态和未来交互中传播的系统性理解。长期记忆虽有益于信息重用，但也可能把局部错误转化为持续风险，亟需因果层面的分析框架。

Method: 1) 构建SCM框架，将用户问题、模型响应和记忆状态建模为动态因果过程；2) 识别内部记忆更新与外部问题反馈两条错误入口路径；3) 通过路径干预构建四条反事实轨迹，量化下游效应与交互作用；4) 从记忆保持、自然响应、诊断探针和概率级错误偏好四个层面评估错误影响；5) 设计路径引导的修复策略（问题修复、记忆修复、联合修复）。

Result: 错误影响通常随交互距离增大而衰减；记忆更新路径比问题反馈产生更持久的影响；潜在错误可能在自然响应中消失后仍残留在记忆中；传播模式随记忆类别和记忆机制变化。修复策略验证：问题修复降低27.5%残差错误，记忆修复降低70.2%，联合修复降低98.3%，几乎完全消除残余传播。

Conclusion: SCM框架有效分解了记忆增强LLM中错误的跨轮次传播机制，证实记忆更新路径是错误持久性的主要来源，且联合修复策略能近乎完全消除错误的长期传播，为记忆系统设计与错误缓解提供了因果层面的理论指导。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables large language models (LLMs) to preserve and reuse information across interactions, but it can also turn localized errors into persistent risks. Existing work mainly evaluates whether memory systems store and retrieve information correctly, leaving limited understanding of how errors propagate across responses, memory states, and future interactions. We propose a structural causal model (SCM)-based framework for cross-turn error propagation in memory-augmented LLMs. We model user questions, model responses, and memory states as a dynamic causal process, and identify two entry pathways: internal memory updating and external question feedback. By intervening on these pathways, we construct four counterfactual trajectories and quantify their downstream effects and interaction. Error influence is evaluated at four levels: memory retention, natural responses, targeted diagnostic probing, and probability-level error preference. Experiments show that error influence generally decays with interaction distance, while the memory-update pathway contributes more persistent effects than question feedback; latent errors may remain even after disappearing from natural responses. Propagation patterns also vary across memory categories and memory mechanisms. Pathway-guided restoration further validates this decomposition: Question Repair reduces residual error by 27.5%, Memory Repair by 70.2%, and Joint Repair by 98.3%, nearly eliminating residual propagation.

</details>


### [404] [When Models Hear What They Expect: Diagnosing Prosodic Heuristics in Multimodal Sarcasm Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30204)
*Yongjian Chen,Pengfei Wei,Yiqun Sun,Zhu Li,Lawrence B. Hsieh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统考察了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在讽刺检测中是否真正利用韵律线索进行语用推理，还是依赖表面的声学模式。通过五种模态条件解构词汇内容、声音语义和韵律结构的贡献，发现添加音频会系统性地增加误报率而非提升真报率。误差诊断表明模型错误聚类在一种共同的"表现型韵律"刻板印象上（高音高和不规则停顿），这偏离了实际的讽刺标记线索。针对性地操纵这两个维度可在因果层面证实该启发式，诱导高达60%的误报率，且该操纵模板在Gemini 3 Flash Preview上同样有效，表明该刻板印象超越单一模型架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在跨模态（语音+文本）处理上的研究缺乏对韵律线索是否真正被用于语用推断的系统性考察，特别是讽刺检测这一需要深层语用理解的场景。作者希望辨明模型是真正理解韵律语义，还是仅仅依赖表面的声学模式进行"捷径"式判断。

Method: 使用Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni在中文和英文上评估讽刺检测，设计五种模态条件来分解词汇内容、声音语义和韵律结构的独立贡献；通过声学误差诊断识别模型错误聚类模式；对识别出的关键声学维度（音高和停顿）进行针对性操纵，进行因果验证；并将相同的操纵模板迁移到Gemini 3 Flash Preview以检验泛化性。

Result: 添加音频系统性提升误报率但未改善真报率；模型错误聚类在"高音高+不规则停顿"这一表现型韵律刻板印象上，与实际讽刺韵律标记不符；针对这两个维度的操纵可诱导高达60%的误报率；该操纵模板可无修改地复现于Gemini 3 Flash Preview，验证了跨架构的普遍性。

Conclusion: 当前MLLMs并未真正利用韵律进行语用推理，而是依赖一种跨语言、跨模型架构共享的"表现型韵律"刻板印象启发式。这一发现揭示了多模态模型在处理语音时的深层局限，暗示其在自然语音语用理解上的能力需要重新审视。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) process speech and text jointly, yet whether they exploit prosodic cues for pragmatic inference or rely on surface acoustic patterns has received little systematic investigation. We address this through sarcasm detection, evaluating Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni on Mandarin Chinese and English under five modality conditions that decompose the contributions of lexical content, vocal semantics, and prosodic structure. Adding audio systematically inflates false positives without improving true positive detection. Acoustic error diagnosis reveals that model errors cluster on a shared stereotype of expressive prosody, namely elevated pitch and irregular pausing, that diverges from the actual cues marking sarcasm in both languages. Targeted manipulation of only these two dimensions causally confirms the heuristic, inducing false positive rates of up to 60%. Applying the same manipulation template to Gemini~3 Flash Preview without modification replicates the effect, suggesting that the stereotype extends beyond the Qwen Omni family rather than arising from a single model architecture.

</details>


### [405] [Label Semantic Expansion via Label Guided Neural Topic Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30216)
*Haojia Zheng,Yuyin Lu,Juntian Huang,Fan Ou,Yanghui Rao,Haoran Xie,Fu Lee Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出标签语义扩展（LSE）框架，采用"话题服务于标签"的反向视角，通过标签引导的神经主题模型（LGNTM）学习与标签对齐的主题，从而丰富稀疏标签表示，并在标签-主题对齐、标签扩展、主题质量和下游分类等多个维度上取得优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有标签感知主题模型采用"标签引导主题"的视角，学习的主题无法直接用于以标签为中心的分析任务（如内容标注和标签语义描述），缺乏从主题到标签的反向利用路径。

Method: 提出LSE框架，将标签语义与语料库中的描述性主题词融合以丰富标签表示；并提出LGNTM模型，学习与标签对齐的专用主题，在词汇和文档语义空间中接地，并保持主题结构与标签结构之间的一致性。

Result: 在标签-主题对齐、标签扩展、主题质量和下游分类实验上均展现强劲的综合性能，覆盖互补的评估维度。

Conclusion: "主题服务于标签"的反向视角为标签中心分析提供了一条可行且有效的路径，LGNTM在多个互补评估维度上验证了该框架的泛化能力与实用性。

Abstract: Topic models are widely used for content analysis, where users often analyze corpora around predefined labels rather than unordered latent topics. Existing label-aware topic models mainly follow a labels-for-topics perspective, using labels to guide topic learning, while the learned topics are not directly usable for label-centered analysis. We explore the reverse topics-for-labels perspective and instantiate it as Label Semantic Expansion (LSE), which enriches sparse label representations with corpus-grounded descriptive topic words. To exploit topics in LSE effectively, we propose a Label-Guided Neural Topic Model (LGNTM), which learns dedicated label-aligned topics, grounds them in lexical and document semantic spaces, and preserves consistency between topic structures and label structures. Experiments on label-topic alignment, label expansion, topic quality, and downstream classification demonstrate strong overall performance across complementary evaluation dimensions.

</details>


### [406] [The Differential Reasoning Router: Operationalizing Cost-Aware LLM Annotation in E-commerce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30224)
*Cheng Lyu,Jingyue Zhang,Vinny DeGenova,Mengwei Li,Yuanli Pei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了差分推理路由器（DRR），一种面向冷启动LLM标注场景的成本感知框架，通过联合优化模型选择与人工升级策略，在达到与最强基线相当准确率的同时节省超过60%的推理token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在电商结构化产品数据标注中的早期部署面临冷启动问题：预发布标签有限、昂贵推理的价值未知、需要在规模化前进行人工审核。特别是在基于规则的标注工作流中，模型错误和规则边界模糊共同影响最终决策，需要一个能够智能分配直接模型、推理模型和人工审核资源的框架。

Method: DRR分别在样本级和业务规则级估计直接模型与推理模型的独立成功概率，实现自适应路由：简单样本由直接模型处理，仅在推理预期能改善决策时才使用推理模型，对可能双重失败或规则分歧的样本升级给人工标注者。通过路由产生的标签为提示工程、监督微调、校准和规则优化提供针对性真实数据。

Result: 在生产级电商工作流中，DRR与最强的基于置信度的路由方法达到准确率持平，同时实现了超过60%的推理token成本节省。

Conclusion: DRR展示了在冷启动阶段通过精细的样本级和规则级路由策略，可以在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降低推理成本，并支持从人工密集型标注向高置信度自动化路由的渐进过渡。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate structured product data in e-commerce, but early deployment often begins as a cold-start problem: only limited pre-launch labels are available, the value of expensive reasoning is unknown, and human review is needed before the system can be trusted at scale. This challenge is especially common in rule-based annotation workflows, where each item must satisfy multiple business rules and both model errors and ambiguous rule boundaries affect final decisions. We introduce the Differential Reasoning Router (DRR), a cost-aware framework for cold-start LLM annotation that jointly optimizes model selection and human escalation. Rather than treating a reasoning model as a default fallback, DRR estimates separate success probabilities for a direct model and a reasoning model at both the sample and business-rule levels, enabling adaptive routing: easy cases are handled directly, reasoning is reserved for cases where it is expected to improve the decision, and likely double-failure or rule-disagreement cases are escalated to human annotators. The resulting labels provide targeted ground truth for prompt engineering, supervised fine-tuning, calibration, and rule refinement, enabling a gradual shift from human-heavy cold-start annotation toward high-confidence automated routing. In a production e-commerce workflow, DRR reaches accuracy parity with the strongest confidence-based router while achieving more than 60\% reasoning-token cost savings.

</details>


### [407] [Quantifying and Mitigating Korean Jamo-Level Typographical Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30229)
*Seojin Lee,Hwanhee Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现韩语中因谚文字节块内jamo（子字符单元）层级的键盘错误会产生额外的排版扰动，现有字符级编辑模型和语法纠错流程无法可靠修复。作者在KMMLU基准上施加五种jamo级扰动，发现模型准确率随扰动强度单调下降且参数规模不提供鲁棒性；进一步揭示typo扰动引起内部表征的独特偏移，线性探针可高AUROC检测未知扰动类型；据此提出Typo-Aware Chain-of-Thought (TACoT)方法，仅在探针检测到疑似错字时才路由到CoT推理，以较低推理成本恢复大部分CoT准确率增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩语的音节块由jamo子字符单元组成，键盘级错误可发生在音节内部，产生语义改变的有效字符或暴露原始jamo，破坏子词分词且现有纠错流程不可靠，使LLM直接暴露于损坏输入，需量化其脆弱性并寻求缓解。

Method: 1) 在KMMLU基准上施加五种jamo级扰动类型并评估四个语言模型。2) 分析typo扰动引起模型内部表征的独特偏移，训练线性探针检测未知扰动类型。3) 提出TACoT方法：仅当探针检测到疑似错字时才路由输入到链式思维推理，兼顾准确率与推理成本。
