Motivation: 现有RAG系统可预计算并存储检索文档的KV缓存以避免每次查询重复编码。量化这些缓存可减少存储开销，但没有任何先前工作探讨压缩是否会损害忠实性（响应是否仍基于所给证据）。准确性和忠实性并不等价，模型可能产生正确但不再被上下文支持的答案，因此需要专门评估。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型上，对RGB和HotpotQA两个数据集，分别评估INT8和INT4量化下的KV缓存。同时测量准确率（accuracy）和忠实性（faithfulness），忠实性通过幻觉检测器、NLI蕴含判断和LLM评判者三种方式评估。

Result: INT8量化在准确率和忠实性两个指标上近乎无损；INT4量化降低准确率，更严重的是，即使在仍然事实正确的答案中，超过90%的忠实性变化为负向退化，即准确率指标对这些回归完全不可见。忠实性损失在噪声检索和更多检索块场景下进一步加剧。

Conclusion: 在部署压缩缓存之前必须审计忠实性。仅评估准确率不足以衡量量化对RAG系统的影响，忠实性应作为压缩缓存部署的关键考核指标。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can precompute and store key-value caches of retrieved documents to avoid re-encoding context at every query. Quantizing these caches further reduces storage, but no prior work asks whether compression damages faithfulness, whether responses remain grounded in the retrieved evidence. Faithfulness and accuracy are not equivalent: a model can produce a correct answer that is no longer supported by the context it was given. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct under INT8 and INT4 quantization on RGB and HotpotQA, measuring both accuracy and faithfulness with a hallucination detector, NLI entailment, and an LLM judge. INT8 is near-lossless across both metrics. INT4 reduces accuracy and, more critically, even among answers that remain factually correct, over 90% of faithfulness changes are negative, i.e., accuracy metrics are blind to this regression. The harm grows under noisy retrieval and with more retrieved chunks. Faithfulness must be audited before compressed caches are deployed.

</details>


### [480] [Evidence-Bounded Mental Health Reasoning from Heterogeneous Speech Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31014)
*Chengyuan Gao,Jiang Wu,Tao Lu,Jiayan Guo,Mingkun Xu,Tianyi Zang,Shangyang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将多模态心理健康筛查重构为证据受限推理问题，引入Evidence Package Benchmark和EviBound框架，通过协议感知的证据控制实现更安全的临床NLP，在抑郁症检测上AUROC达0.8658且零声明违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态心理健康筛查模型假设所有临床语音协议具有同等证据效力，但实际不同协议（从自由访谈到固定阅读任务）支持根本不同的证据。强制统一推理会导致模型从无关文本中幻觉出症状或过度声称支持，即使是先进的长链思维LLM也无法解决，因为自由形式推理会加剧边界违规。

Method: 1) 将多模态筛查重构为证据受限推理问题；2) 提出Evidence Package Benchmark，整合1,870个来自六个异构来源的数据包，含显式模态掩码和证据权限；3) 提出EviBound协议感知证据控制框架：使用画像感知规划器限制推理范围，通过五路声学一致性编排证据工具，并利用边界批评器抑制无证据支持的声明。

Result: EviBound在留出测试集上抑郁症AUROC达0.8658，超过最强直接全模态基线+0.0811 AUROC，同时保持零声明违规。

Conclusion: 该工作超越了无约束准确率，迈向证据一致、协议感知的 safer 临床NLP系统，为心理健康筛查提供了更可靠的范式。

Abstract: Computational mental health screening using multimodal speech and text has shown great promise. However, existing models often assume all clinical speech protocols carry equivalent evidentiary validity. In reality, heterogeneous protocols, from free interviews to fixed reading tasks, support fundamentally different evidence. Forcing uniform reasoning flattens these boundaries, causing models to hallucinate symptoms from irrelevant text or overclaim support. Even advanced long chain-of-thought LLMs fail to resolve this issue, as free-form reasoning can exacerbate boundary violations. To address this, we reformulate multimodal screening as an evidence-bounded reasoning problem. We introduce the Evidence Package Benchmark, integrating 1,870 packages across six heterogeneous sources with explicit modality masks and evidence permissions. We further propose EviBound, a protocol-aware evidence control framework. Unlike direct LLM prompting, EviBound uses a profile-aware planner to restrict reasoning scope, orchestrates evidence tools via five-way acoustic consensus, and enforces a boundary critic to suppress unsupported claims. Empirical results show EviBound achieves a held-out test Depression AUROC of 0.8658, exceeding the strongest direct omni-modal baseline by +0.0811 AUROC while maintaining zero claim violations. Our work moves beyond unconstrained accuracy toward evidence-consistent, protocol-aware systems for safer clinical NLP research.

</details>


### [481] [LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31016)
*Sebastian Fox,Luke Markham,Ryan Lail,Michael Karotsieris*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究构建了包含500个单错误笔记对的基准（298个遗漏、202个添加或更改），发现8种LLM法官设计检测"添加/更改"内容表现良好（0.79-0.94），但检测"遗漏"几乎等同于抛硬币（0.50-0.63）。通过重构任务（先列出事实清单再逐项核对）可恢复检测能力，两种方法（逐事实流水线和GEPA进化单次调用）各有优劣，且均被"事实在其他位置重复提及"的情况击败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境AI抄写员生成临床笔记的主导错误是"遗漏"（记录未包含诊疗过程中已确立的信息），而标准检查方法是LLM法官（第二个模型对照转录稿检查笔记）。核心问题在于：法官是否真的能检测出遗漏？现有公开语料因参考笔记与转录稿存在实质性差异而无法提供答案标准，因此需要专门的基准来回答这个问题。

Method: 构建500个单错误笔记对的基准，其中298个为明确缺失的命名事实，202个为添加或更改的对照组。评估8种法官设计在成对判别和单笔记检测上的表现。随后重构任务：先列出转录稿确立的事实清单，再逐一检查笔记是否包含。比较两种实现：逐事实流水线（每条事实单独检查）和GEPA演化出的单次调用提示（一次调用完成同样任务）。并由两名临床医生（含一位非作者）进行验证。

Result: 成对判别中，8种设计对添加/更改内容得分为0.79-0.94，对遗漏仅为0.50-0.63。单笔记检测中无设计能可靠标记遗漏。流水线在2.7%误报率下能指明缺失事实及严重程度；单次调用检测更多（36.9%对24.6%，p=0.002）但误报率6.2%，成本仅为十分之一。医生作者验证70项，10个分歧中10次倾向流水线（p=0.002）；第二位非作者临床医生盲评严重程度等级与之一致。在真实厂商笔记上，重新校准的单次调用优于8种设计中的最佳者，误报率为其一半。两种方法均无法处理"事实在其他位置被重述"的遗漏。

Conclusion: 直接让LLM法官"找问题"无法可靠检测临床笔记中的遗漏错误，这是当前AI抄写员审计的核心缺陷。将任务重构为"先枚举事实再逐项核对"能显著恢复检测能力，但仍有局限性（重述事实的遗漏仍无法捕获）。研究发布了基准、提示和判断结果以供后续研究使用。这揭示了当前LLM审计范式在遗漏检测上的结构性盲区，并提供了可行的改进路径。

Abstract: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes, and published audits find their dominant error is omission: information the encounter established that the note fails to record. The standard check is an LLM judge: a second model reads the note against the transcript and flags problems. We ask whether judges detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key: their clinician reference notes and transcripts are materially discrepant. Our benchmark has 500 single-error note pairs from audited fact sheets, 298 with a named fact certainly absent and 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination (the flawed note below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip) reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content and 0.50-0.63 on omissions. On single notes, no design flags omissions reliably more often than perfect notes. Wording changes, voting and GEPA prompt optimisation move the operating point without creating usable detection. Restructuring the task recovers it: list the facts the transcript establishes, then check the note for each. Two methods reach it independently and trade off: a per-fact pipeline, and a GEPA-evolved prompt doing the same in one call. The pipeline's flags name the missing fact and its severity at 2.7% false alarms. The single call detects more (36.9% against 24.6%, p=0.002) at 6.2% false alarms and a tenth of the cost per note. A physician author validated 70 items and, where the two routes disagree, sided with the pipeline on 10 of 10 (p=0.002). A second clinician, not an author, graded the severity rubric blind and agrees to within a grade. On real vendor notes from a companion census no benchmark threshold transfers, but the re-calibrated single call detects more than the best of the eight at half its false-alarm rate. Omissions whose fact is restated elsewhere defeat both routes. We release the benchmark, prompts and judgements.

</details>


### [482] [One note in three: a verified census of three deployed AI scribes, and the instrument that counted it](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31017)
*Sebastian Fox,Luke Markham,Ryan Lail,Michael Karotsieris*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文审计了三款商业AI医疗记录员在142次会诊中的表现，发现31.3%的记录存在已验证的错误，主要集中在过敏/药物信息、虚构患者身份以及电话会诊中把病史写成体检内容等问题。研究还揭示了审计结果严重依赖审查方法和工具设置，错误率在28%-97%之间波动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI医疗记录员（AI scribes）宣称由临床医生签署每份记录，但其生成的临床笔记可能包含严重错误。已有审计研究之间存在显著分歧，作者希望揭示这些分歧的来源，并系统评估商业AI记录员的实际错误率。

Method: 对同一142次会诊（英国初级保健和美国门诊记录及作者场景）使用三款商业AI记录员生成565份笔记。通过12次发现过程提出13,678个候选错误，经重要性过滤后由两个不同模型家族的对抗性小组审查，最终618个错误通过验证。两名临床医生对不重叠样本进行盲法裁决。

Result: 31.3%的记录存在已验证错误，集中在过敏/药物信息、虚构患者身份等。排除患者记录本可预填的错误后，错误率为24.8%。审查指导语从9.3%到79.0%改变错误验证比例，不同审计标准下错误率在28%-97%之间。已发表的审计间分歧可完全由仪器差异解释（缺失错误占比54-86%对本文的23.1%）。

Conclusion: AI记录员的错误率高度依赖于审计方法和工具设置而非仅取决于记录员本身。研究公开了全部618个发现、证据、提示词和可复现流程，呼吁建立标准化审计方法以公正评估AI临床记录系统的安全性。

Abstract: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes under the reassurance that a clinician signs every note. We audited three commercial AI scribes on the same 142 consultations: 565 notes from recorded UK primary-care and US ambulatory encounters plus authored scenarios. Twelve discovery passes proposed 13,678 candidate errors; the 5,898 clearing an importance filter went to an adversarial panel of two models from different families, each told to refute what it could, and 618 survived. One note in three (31.3% [27.0, 35.6]) carries a verified failure, concentrated in allergy and medication information, invented patient identity, and history written up as examination on telephone consultations that can contain none. No product was given a patient record; setting aside the two classes a record would have prefilled, invented identity and dates, the rate is 24.8% [20.8, 29.0]. One failure mode did not fit our scheme, drawn from published scribe-error taxonomies: a treatment the clinician retracts, recorded as delivered care. Two clinicians adjudicated blind, disjoint samples: a physician author upheld 20 of 21 findings (95.2% [77.3, 99.2]) and an independent clinician, not an author, 12 of 12 ([75.8, 100]); both judged every sampled refusal genuine. A failure rate depends on the instrument as much as the scribes. With model, evidence and settings fixed, the review instruction alone moves the share of candidates verified from 9.3% to 79.0%, and the reviewing family moves it too: alone at that instruction the gentler flags 54.8% of notes against 27.8%. Between 28% and 97% of sampled notes carry a failure depending on the standard. Published audits disagree among themselves by a margin instrument differences alone can produce: omission is 54-86% of their errors against our 23.1%. We release all 618 findings with transcript-side evidence, every prompt and model version, and the re-runnable pipeline.

</details>


### [483] [When Does Predictor-Based RL Align with Human Perception? A Study of Subjective Rewards in Codec-Based Speech Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31035)
*Joonyong Park,Jerry Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于码本的文本到语音（TTS）模型中，学习到的感知预测器能否作为强化学习奖励而不丧失与人类听众的一致性。通过GRPO和Best-of-N重排序对比，发现每个奖励只主要改善其自身目标指标，主观预测器不可互换；Best-of-8表现不逊于GRPO，表明GRPO应被视为将奖励选择的行为摊销到策略中，而非普遍优于重排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 码本式TTS模型使语言模型后训练适用于语音生成，但学术界尚不清楚学习到的感知预测器能否作为强化学习奖励，且不会与人类听众失去对齐。需要系统性研究这一问题，为多奖励语音后训练提供奖励选择依据。

Method: 使用GRPO结合学习到的奖励（动漫风格、自然度、喜爱度、唤醒度），引入字符错误率（CER）区域约束防止感知奖励通过转录漂移被优化，并与相同奖励门控下的Best-of-N重排序进行对比。通过多评估者A/B测试和奖励间隙分析评估人类迁移效果。

Result: 每个奖励主要改善其自身目标指标，主观预测器不可互换；多评估者A/B测试显示人类迁移不均匀；奖励间隙分析显示签名奖励间隙能显著预测听众选择，而残余CER间隙不能，但各轴校准仍存在异质性。Best-of-8是强人类级基线，与GRPO在感知上没有明显差距。

Conclusion: 主观语音奖励应作为"预测器-轴-基础"三元组来分析，GRPO是对奖励选择行为的摊销而非普遍优于重排序。研究为多奖励语音后训练前选择奖励提供了实用诊断工具。

Abstract: Codec-based text-to-speech (TTS) models make language-model post-training applicable to speech generation, but it remains unclear when learned perceptual predictors can serve as reinforcement learning rewards without losing alignment with human listeners. We study this question with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using learned rewards for anime-like speaking style, naturalness, likability, and arousal. To prevent perceptual rewards from being optimized through transcript drift, we introduce a character error rate (CER) zone constraint and compare policy optimization with Best-of-$N$ reranking under the same reward gate. Across single-reward runs, each reward primarily improves its own target metric, showing that subjective predictors are not interchangeable quality surrogates. Multi-rater A/B tests further show uneven human transfer, while a reward-gap analysis separates average transfer from within-axis calibration: signed reward gaps significantly predict listener choices in the pooled analysis, whereas residual CER gaps do not, but per-axis calibration remains heterogeneous. Best-of-8 is a strong human-level baseline and is not clearly worse than GRPO perceptually, suggesting that GRPO should be viewed as amortizing reward-selected behavior into the policy rather than uniformly outperforming reranking. These results support analyzing subjective speech rewards as predictor-axis-base tuples and provide practical diagnostics for selecting rewards before multi-reward speech post-training.

</details>


### [484] [Language-Statistical Analysis of Neural Audio Codec Tokens Across Architectures, Corpora, and Noise Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31037)
*Joonyong Park,Shinnosuke Takamichi,David M. Chan,Shunsuke Kando,Yuki Saito,Hiroshi Saruwatari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析了13种神经音频编解码器（NAC）在三种语料库和三种噪声条件下的token统计特性，发现声学条件和量化器元类别主导统计指标变化，而非语料库身份，并揭示了不同编解码架构在噪声下的不同退化特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明神经音频编解码器产生的离散token序列遵循类似语言的统计规律，但缺乏对多种编解码器架构和声学条件下这些规律的系统性分析，需要建立架构条件化的语言统计分析方法。

Method: 对13种NAC（涵盖多码本RVQ、单码本VQ和非VQ设计）在三种语料库、三种噪声条件（纯净、白噪声、DEMAND噪声）下估计Zipf和Heaps参数、单字熵、码本占用率和Jensen-Shannon散度，并采用显式拟合有效性检查和族条件n-gram阶数。

Result: 语料库身份对指标方差解释很少，声学条件和量化器元类别起主导作用；单字熵与元类别关联最强；RVQ在白色和DEMAND噪声下分别出现坍缩和爆炸退化特征，非VQ也有爆炸现象，单码本VQ仅发生占用率和分布形状变化。

Conclusion: 这些结果为对NAC token应用语言统计分析提供了架构条件化的约定和参考基准。

Abstract: Neural audio codecs (NACs) convert speech into discrete token sequences, and prior work has reported that these sequences follow language-like statistical laws. This paper analyzes the token statistics of 13 NACs spanning multi-codebook residual vector quantization (RVQ), single-codebook VQ, and non-VQ designs, evaluated on three corpora under clean, white-noise, and real-world DEMAND-noise conditions. Zipf and Heaps parameters, unigram entropy, codebook occupancy, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) are estimated from matched token samples with explicit fit-validity safeguards and family-conditional $n$-gram orders. Corpus identity explains little variance in any metric, whereas acoustic condition and quantizer meta-category dominate in a metric-dependent way, and unigram entropy is the metric most strongly associated with meta-category. Clean-to-noise JSD computed at a common unigram order is associated with mel-cepstral distortion most clearly under DEMAND noise. The collapse and explosion degradation signatures previously reported for RVQ codecs concentrate in RVQ cells under white and DEMAND noise, respectively; explosion also occurs in non-VQ codecs, and single-codebook VQ codecs shift in occupancy and distribution shape without either signature. These results provide architecture-conditioned conventions for applying language-statistical analysis to NAC tokens.

</details>


### [485] [Type-Balanced Contextual Learning for Incremental Named Entity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31038)
*Duzhen Zhang,Yahan Yu,Xiuyi Chen,Chenxing Li,Dong Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Type-Balanced Contextual Learning (TBCL)方法来解决增量命名实体识别（INER）中伪标签方法所面临的偏置上下文问题，通过句子对学习和上下文一致性损失来平衡新旧实体类型的上下文关联，在三个数据集上的十个INER设置中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: INER面临灾难性遗忘和non-entity类型语义偏移两大挑战。虽然伪标签方法有效，但存在一个被忽视的偏置上下文问题：在新句子中，旧实体类型token的上下文关联明显偏向新实体类型，这加剧了旧知识的退化并促进了新知识的过拟合。

Method: 提出TBCL方法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 句子对（sentence-duplet）学习方案，用于平衡新旧类型上下文的训练；(2) 上下文一致性损失（contextual consistency loss），用于对齐和稳定上下文表示。

Result: 在三个公认数据集上的十个INER设置中进行了广泛实验，验证了TBCL方法的有效性，展示了其在解决伪标签INER方法中偏置上下文问题上的能力。

Conclusion: TBCL通过上下文分析为INER提供了新视角，有效解决了偏置上下文问题，增强了INER系统在不断涌现新实体类型场景下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Incremental Named Entity Recognition (INER) stands as a pivotal task in information extraction, emphasizing the successive identification of new entity types within unstructured text. Faced with the continuous influx of entity types, INER grapples with two significant challenges: the widespread issue of catastrophic forgetting and the unique shift issue of the non-entity type semantics. While pseudo-labeling-based INER methods have proven effective in addressing these challenges, a previously overlooked issue arises: the biased context problem. Our analysis shows that, in new sentences, the contextual associations of tokens representing old entity types exhibit a significantly stronger bias towards new entity types compared to their contexts in old sentences. This tendency intensifies the degradation of old knowledge while promoting the overfitting of new knowledge. To solve this biased context, we propose a Type-Balanced Contextual Learning (TBCL) method, featuring a sentence-duplet learning scheme and a contextual consistency loss. This approach offers a fresh perspective for INER through context analysis. Extensive experiments across ten INER settings on three highly recognized datasets showcase the efficacy of our TBCL method, highlighting its proficiency in resolving the biased context issue inherent in pseudo-labeling based INER approaches.

</details>


### [486] [Improving Information Extraction with Learned Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31058)
*Omar Sharif,Soroush Vosoughi,Nikhil Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现信息抽取失败时，改进提问设计比改进抽取模型本身更有效。在四个临床基准和五个LLM上，仅优化问题设计就提升18.6 F1分，超过使用更大模型的收益。作者提出LoQ（生成文档特定问题集）和FeedQ（基于反馈迭代优化问题的框架），优化后的问题可训练轻量级生成器，4B参数模型即可匹敌专家基线并大幅超越更大的未调优模型。论文开源12,820个优化问题数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统信息抽取研究认为失败源于模型能力不足，因此倾向于扩大模型或改进推理。作者质疑这一假设，指出查询（问题）设计同样是抽取管线的关键环节，且尚未被系统性研究。

Method: 提出两个核心方法：(1) LoQ (List of Questions)，生成文档特定的问题集；(2) FeedQ，一种反馈驱动的优化方法，根据抽取结果迭代精炼问题。优化后的问题可用于微调轻量级生成器。

Result: 改进问题设计在四个临床基准和五个LLM上平均提升18.6 F1分数，优于使用更大抽取模型的效果。微调后的4B参数模型匹配或超越专家推导的基线，并显著超过更大的未调优模型。释放了12,820个优化问题数据集。

Conclusion: 问题设计应被视为信息抽取中的一等公民（first-class problem），而非仅依赖模型缩放。可学习、可优化的问题设计方法对资源受限场景尤其有价值。

Abstract: When information extraction fails, a natural instinct is to improve the model doing it: for example, by scaling it up or refining its reasoning. In this paper, we show that another part of the pipeline matters at least as much: the queries used to elicit this information. Across four clinical benchmarks and five LLMs, improving the question design alone raises performance by 18.6 F1-score points, i.e. more than using larger extraction models. To make such question design learnable, we introduce List of Questions (LoQ), which generates document-specific question sets, and FeedQ, a feedback-driven optimization method that iteratively refines questions against extraction outcomes. The resulting optimized questions can be used to train lightweight generators: with fine-tuning, 4B-parameter models match or outperform expert-derived baselines and substantially exceed the performance of much larger untuned models. We release a dataset of 12,820 optimized questions to support a broader shift in information extraction research toward treating question design as a first-class problem.

</details>


### [487] [Every Token Leaves a Ripple in the Stream of Thought: Eliciting Model-Internal Token Saliency for Chain-of-Thought Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31066)
*Tianyi Zhao,Yinhan He,Wendy Zheng,Chen Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MIST方法，从模型内部视角（残差流中token的"思维流"涟漪）定义token重要性，通过必要性和充分性两个互补维度计算统一重要性分数，用于token级CoT压缩，在四个推理基准和四个模型上持续优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长链式推理（CoT）虽然提升多步问题求解能力，但推理痕迹过长导致推理成本高昂。现有token级CoT压缩方法依赖外部评分器或启发式信号，这些信号与模型内部答案计算过程仅有间接关联，token选择缺乏精准性。

Method: MIST采用模型内部视角：每个推理token在残差流（模型的"思维流"）中留下涟漪，涟漪幅度反映该token对答案计算的贡献。token重要性沿两个互补轴定义：(1) 必要性——移除token内部贡献后答案似然度的下降；(2) 充分性——单独提供该贡献时答案似然度的提升。两者结合形成统一重要性分数用于剪枝。

Result: 在四个推理基准和四个模型的实验中，MIST持续优于现有基线方法，验证了模型内部显著性可作为推理token重要性的有效代理。

Conclusion: 模型内部的显著性信号能够为推理token重要性提供有效代理，基于必要性和充分性的双维度评分框架为token级CoT压缩提供了更精准、成本更低的解决方案。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step problem solving, but long reasoning traces inflate inference cost. Token-level CoT compression reduces this cost by pruning full reasoning chains into shorter traces for model adaptation, making token selection the central challenge. Existing methods often rely on external scorers or heuristic signals only indirectly tied to the model's internal answer computation. We instead adopt a model-internal perspective: as the model forms an answer, each reasoning token leaves a ripple in the residual stream, the model's \emph{stream of thought}, and the magnitude of this ripple reflects the token's contribution to the answer computation. Building on this view, we propose \textsc{MIST} (Model-Internal Saliency for Token-level CoT compression), which defines token importance along two complementary axes: \emph{necessity}, the drop in answer likelihood when a token's internal contribution is removed, and \emph{sufficiency}, the gain in answer likelihood when that contribution alone is provided. Combining the two yields a unified importance score for pruning. Across four reasoning benchmarks and four models, \textsc{MIST} consistently outperforms baseline methods, suggesting that model-internal saliency provides an effective proxy for reasoning-token importance.

</details>


### [488] [The First Token Is a Clue: Verbalizing Multi-Token Concepts from the J-lens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31084)
*Xijie Gong,Tonghan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需微调即可从冻结的LLM中直接恢复多token概念向量的方法。该方法利用Jacobian Lens提出首token线索，让冻结模型自动补全候选概念，再从后续隐藏状态中恢复完整概念向量，在推理和因果干预任务上显著优于Template Lens。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始的Jacobian Lens虽然能解释LLM的隐藏状态，但仅将其读取为单个token的排名列表，无法表达多token概念。之前的Template Lens需要预计算固定短语词汇的向量，Oracle Lens需要微调组件，都无法直接从冻结模型中恢复多token概念的向量表示。

Method: 首先利用Jacobian Lens（J-lens）提议多token概念的首个token；然后让冻结的模型基于正确的首token和源提示自动补全候选概念；最后从后续隐藏状态中一次前向传播恢复每个候选概念的完整向量，并与完整词汇表一起进行评分。

Result: 在Gemma-3-12B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-14B上的496个多跳完形填空测试中，该方法平均Rank@10达43.1%（Template Lens为27.6%）；去掉J-lens线索后性能降至21.6%；因果概念交换的succ@10达61.4%（Template Lens仅26.2%）。

Conclusion: 首token线索能够有效引导多token概念的恢复，同时后续隐藏状态可以提供概念向量用于读取和因果干预，证明了无需微调即可从冻结模型直接恢复多token概念向量。

Abstract: The Jacobian Lens (J-lens) is a recent tool for interpreting LLMs. It reads a hidden state as a ranked list of vocabulary tokens, leaving multi-token concepts without a representation of their own. The original J-lens work addresses this limitation with Template Lens, which precomputes vectors for a fixed phrase vocabulary, and Oracle Lens, which fine-tunes components to propose phrases and reconstruct phrase vectors. We ask whether multi-token concepts and their vectors can instead be recovered directly from J-lens and the frozen model. We find that the first token of a multi-token concept is about as readable as a single-token concept. Given the correct first token and source prompt, the frozen model recovers the second token in 88.3% of two-token cases. We show that a vector for the complete concept can be recovered from subsequent hidden states in a single forward pass. We therefore use J-lens to propose first tokens and let the frozen model complete candidate concepts. We then recover a vector for each candidate and score it alongside the complete vocabulary. Across 496 multi-hop clozes on Gemma-3-12B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen3-14B, our method achieves an average $\mathrm{Rank@}10$ of 43.1%, compared with 27.6% for Template Lens. Without the J-lens clue, performance drops to 21.6%, showing that the first-token clue substantially improves readout. Causal concept swaps using the recovered vectors achieve an average $\mathrm{succ}@10$ of 61.4%, compared with 26.2% for Template Lens under the same intervention. These results show that first-token clues can guide multi-token concept recovery, while subsequent hidden states provide vectors for readout and intervention.

</details>


### [489] [S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31100)
*Jiajun Shi,Siyuan Tao,Yuhao Wu,Zexuan Wang,Jingyuan Zhang,Jiaheng Liu,Xinping Lei,Xinrong Zhang,Siyuan Fang,Zhewen Tan,Tianle Cai,Junhao Fang,Jiameng Huang,Yueyang Wang,Jinkai Liu,Yuxuan Zhang,Jian Yang,Zhoujun Li,Shen Yan,Wenhao Huang,Ge Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出S³Gym，一个用于评估LLM智能体自我改进能力的交互式基准，涵盖自我测试、自我判断和自我改进三个耦合能力。实验发现自我改进既非自动也非统一，不同经验整合路径（历史ICL、摘要记忆、参数训练）的效果高度依赖任务结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准将LLM视为固定策略进行评估，忽略了它们在与外部环境交互过程中积累行为经验并持续改进的能力。因此，智能体能否主动测试自身行为、判断经验质量并利用经验改进未来决策，这一问题尚未得到系统评估。

Method: 提出S³Gym基准，将宽松探索与严格保留评估分离，在7个具有可执行环境验证器的文本游戏中实现该协议。评估三种经验整合路径：直接历史ICL、基于分数的摘要记忆、参数训练。

Result: 上下文级经验能提升部分模型-游戏组合的性能，但最有效的路径强烈依赖任务结构：摘要适合可压缩为可复用策略规则的经验，但在依赖精确状态信息时往往不如原始历史；参数训练在某些任务上带来显著提升，但在其他任务上表现出不稳定改进和严重负迁移。

Conclusion: 识别成功行为不足以实现自我改进，智能体还必须将反馈转化为可执行且可迁移的策略。S³Gym为诊断这一过程及识别智能体无法将交互经验转化为可靠自我改进的瓶颈提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with external environments and accumulate substantial behavioral experience, yet existing agent benchmarks largely evaluate them as fixed policies. It therefore remains unclear whether an agent can actively test its behavior, judge the resulting experience, and use that experience to improve future decisions. We introduce \textbf{S\textsuperscript{3}Gym}, an interactive benchmark for evaluating LLM self-improvement through three coupled capabilities: \textbf{Self-Testing}, \textbf{Self-Judging}, and \textbf{Self-Improvement}. S$^3$Gym separates permissive exploration from strict held-out evaluation and instantiates this protocol in seven text-based games with executable environment verifiers. We evaluate three pathways for incorporating interaction experience: direct History ICL, score-conditioned Summary Memory, and parameter Training.
  Our experiments reveal that self-improvement is neither automatic nor uniform. Context-level experience improves performance for several model--game pairs, but the most effective pathway depends strongly on the task structure: summaries are beneficial when experience can be compressed into reusable strategic rules, yet often underperform raw history when success depends on precise, state-contingent information. Parameter training produces substantial gains on some tasks, but also exhibits unstable improvement and severe negative transfer on others. These findings show that recognizing successful actions is insufficient; agents must also transform feedback into executable and transferable policies. S$^3$Gym provides a unified framework for diagnosing this process and identifying the bottlenecks that prevent agents from translating interaction experience into reliable self-improvement.

</details>


### [490] [Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31111)
*Yuhao Wu,Jingyuan Zhang,Jiajun Shi,Yuxuan Zhang,Xinping Lei,Junting Zhou,Zexuan Wang,Yuchen Wu,Huan Zhou,Duo Wang,Yinzhu Piao,Yongchang Peng,Yunfeng Shi,Jin Chen,Zuo Wang,Jinkai Liu,Jiaheng Liu,Wenxuan Zhang,Shen Yan,Wenhao Huang,Ge Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ASPIRE基准，用于评估LLM在模糊目标驱动下的自我进化能力。与现有工作由人类指定任务和指标不同，ASPIRE仅提供自然语言能力目标，下游评估任务隐藏。实验发现当前智能体虽能完成训练和工具编辑流程，但权重级改进稀疏不稳，且最强的进化工具链仍低于工程化的Qwen-Agent参考基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类学习常始于模糊目标（如"成为更好的物理学家"），需要学习者自行诠释目标、识别能力差距、决定学什么和怎么学。然而现有LLM自我进化研究由人类预先指定任务与评估指标，将自我进化简化为优化显式目标，忽略了"决定学什么和怎么学"这一关键环节。

Method: ASPIRE基准提供仅含自然语言能力目标的设定，隐藏下游评估任务。智能体需自行操作化目标：选择数据和更新方法、构建训练与验证信号、决定评估时机。基准支持模型权重进化和智能体工具链进化两种模式，在统一交互环境中进行，最终在专家撰写的520个隐藏项目（覆盖六个目标）上评估。

Result: 实验显示模糊目标将搜索努力引导至目标诠释方向。当前智能体虽能完成训练和工具编辑循环，但权重级收益稀疏且不稳定；最强进化出的工具链仍低于工程化的Qwen-Agent参考。智能体常在不匹配的数据上训练并过度信任狭隘的自我评估，导致局部收益无法迁移到隐藏评估，且持续的搜索和训练可能抹除早期改进。

Conclusion: 当前LLM自我进化方法在处理模糊目标时存在根本性不足：目标诠释能力弱、数据选择不匹配、自我评估不可靠、改进不稳定。ASPIRE基准揭示了这些缺陷，为该方向提供了更贴近人类学习本质的评测框架。

Abstract: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. We introduce ASPIRE, a benchmark for vague-goal-driven self-evolution. ASPIRE provides only a natural-language capability goal while downstream evaluation tasks remain hidden. The agent must operationalize the goal by choosing data and update methods, constructing training and validation signals, and deciding when to evaluate. ASPIRE supports both model-weight and agent-harness evolution in a unified interactive environment and evaluates the resulting systems on a hidden, expert-authored set of 520 items spanning six goals. Our experiments show that vague goals redirect search effort toward goal interpretation. Current agents routinely complete training and harness-editing loops, but weight-level gains remain sparse and unstable, and the strongest evolved harness remains below the engineered Qwen-Agent reference. Agents often train on mismatched data and trust narrow self-evaluations, so local gains fail to transfer to hidden evaluation and continued search and training can erase earlier improvements.

</details>


### [491] [PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31119)
*Yuhan Wang,Zhengxi Lu,Yuchen Yan,Kaitao Song,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PaperGym，一个将科研论文转化为完整训练环境的统一框架。通过利用论文结构分离问题与评分准则（问题来自研究目标和背景，准则来自方法与实验），将准则泄漏率降至3.7%。训练采用两阶段：先用准则作为OPSD自教师的特权上下文，再用其作为GRPO的奖励，在多个模型上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究规划是AI科学家的决定性能力，但研究计划没有可验证的答案，使得强化学习缺乏所需的环境（任务+评论者）。现有pipeline从相同内容中提取问题和准则，导致奖励可通过改写（paraphrase）获得，且准则被压缩为每个rollout的单一标量，无法提供充分监督。

Method: PaperGym利用论文的结构：问题从研究目标和背景合成，准则从方法和实验中推导，涵盖方法创新性和实验设计两个方面。训练使用准则两次：首先作为OPSD自教师的特权上下文，然后作为GRPO的奖励信号，形成两阶段训练调度。

Result: 准则泄漏率降至3.7%（现有数据集为11.90%-34.10%）。在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B上，该调度优于监督微调、任一单独阶段以及反向顺序，五个基准平均提升+5.6、+5.0、+4.8分。固定配方下，PaperGym-20k训练的模型在三方比较中胜率58.1%（RubricHub Science仅28.2%）。Qwen3-8B在ResearchQA上达73.48，超过更大的Kimi K2.6。

Conclusion: PaperGym证明通过结构化分离问题与准则可以有效构建科研规划的训练环境，防止奖励被改写策略利用。该框架发布包含pipeline、PaperGym-20k语料库以及PaperGym-Innov和PaperGym-Design两个基准，为AI科学家的研究规划能力训练提供了可复现的基础设施。

Abstract: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic. Rubrics extracted from scientific papers can supply the critic. Existing pipelines, however, draw the question and the criteria from the same content, so the reward can be earned by paraphrase. The rubric is further compressed into a single scalar per rollout. We introduce PaperGym, a unified framework that turns each research paper into a complete training environment. PaperGym exploits the structure of a paper: the question is synthesized from the research goal and background, while the criteria are derived from the method and experiments. The criteria span methodological innovation and experimental design, and criterion leakage falls to 3.7%, versus 11.90% to 34.10% in existing datasets. Training uses the rubric twice: first as privileged context for OPSD's self-teacher, then as the reward for GRPO. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, this schedule outperforms supervised fine-tuning, either stage alone, and the reverse ordering, improving five-benchmark averages by +5.6, +5.0, and +4.8 points. With the recipe held fixed, models trained on PaperGym-20k win 58.1% of three-way comparisons, against 28.2% for RubricHub Science. The trained Qwen3-8B reaches 73.48 on ResearchQA, above the far larger Kimi K2.6. We release the pipeline, the 20,000-instance corpus PaperGym-20k, and the benchmarks PaperGym-Innov and PaperGym-Design.

</details>


### [492] [DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31128)
*Yung Wei Shueh,Zhi-Jie Chen,Chia-Hsuan Hsu,Hsin-Ling Hsu,Donghua Zhang,Chenwei Wu,Jun-En Ding,Tongze Zhang,Shihao Yang,Pengfei Hu,Fang-Ming Hung,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了DIASENTINEL，一个完全本地部署的多智能体系统，用于2型糖尿病（T2DM）一年期风险筛查和基于指南的报告生成。该系统整合了校准风险预测、确定性临床信号提取、基于美国糖尿病协会（ADA）指南的Reciprocal Rank Fusion，以及结合规则检查与LLM蕴含的混合验证层，实现了可靠、可审计且保护隐私的临床决策支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在临床决策支持方面具有潜力，但仍存在幻觉事实、无依据建议和引用错误等严重问题，直接部署可能带来医疗安全风险。

Method: 构建了完全本地部署（on-premise）的多智能体系统，包含四个核心组件：(1) 校准的风险预测模型；(2) 确定性临床信号提取；(3) 基于ADA指南的Reciprocal Rank Fusion（倒数排名融合）检索；(4) 结合规则检查与LLM蕴含判断的混合验证层。

Result: 系统提供了实时批量筛查仪表板和交互式患者报告界面，支持引用推荐、验证结果和原始EHR数据对比功能，展示了一个实用的可靠、可审计且保护隐私的LLM临床决策支持框架。

Conclusion: DIASENTINEL证明了一个实用的框架，能够通过多智能体架构、确定性验证和指南融合技术，有效解决LLM在临床场景中的幻觉与可信度问题，实现可靠且可审计的临床决策支持。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines, and a hybrid verification layer combining rule-based checks with LLM entailment. The demonstration provides a real-time batch-screening dashboard and an interactive patient report interface with cited recommendations, verification results, and raw EHR comparison. DIASENTINEL demonstrates a practical framework for reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based clinical decision support.

</details>


### [493] [Context-Aware Interleaved Batching for WhisperX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31170)
*Carlos Bain,Max Bain*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出上下文感知的交错批处理（Context-Aware Interleaved Batching）方法，通过VAD分段边界稳定Whisper的文本条件化，在不牺牲推理速度的前提下，同时获得批处理的高效性和顺序处理的上下文连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WhisperX通过音频内批处理加速转录，但隔离了音频片段，丢失了保持标点连贯性和术语转录所需的历史上下文；而标准Whisper虽保留顺序上下文但推理缓慢且易出现幻觉循环。

Method: 利用VAD（语音活动检测）导出的片段边界来稳定Whisper的文本条件化，使得跨批处理音频片段可以安全地维持连续的历史上下文，实现上下文感知的交错批处理。

Result: 在长音频基准测试上，该方法降低了词错误率（WER），改善了专有名词的转录准确性，同时保持了高吞吐量的推理速度。

Conclusion: 该方法证明可以在不牺牲推理效率的前提下，同时获得批处理的速度优势和顺序处理（上下文保留）的质量优势，是长音频转录中速度与质量的较优平衡方案。

Abstract: While WhisperX accelerates speech transcription via intra-audio batching, it isolates audio segments, losing the historical context needed for coherent punctuation and terminology transcription. Conversely, standard Whisper retains context sequentially but suffers from slow inference and hallucination loops. To achieve the best of both worlds, we propose Context-Aware Interleaved Batching. By using VAD-derived segment boundaries, our algorithm stabilizes Whisper's text conditioning, allowing us to safely maintain continuous historical context across batched audio segments. As demonstrated on long-form audio benchmarks, this approach reduces Word Error Rate (WER) and improves proper noun transcription, all while maintaining high-throughput inference speeds.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [494] [ERR+: Sequential Entropy Resolution for Efficient and Decisive LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28771)
*Xin Jiang,Minhao Wang,Wen Wu,Zhentao Xie,Shangheng Du,Jinxin Shi,Jiabao Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ERR+，一个两阶段的强化学习框架（RLVR），基于观察"正确推理轨迹在思考阶段展现出更频繁且更大的token级熵降"。第一阶段使用熵释放奖励（ERR）奖励不确定性消解，第二阶段使用鲁棒相对效率奖励促进答案简洁性。实验在五个数据集上一致提升准确率和响应简洁性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法仅使用正确性奖励信号，对推理过程质量缺乏指导，导致内部推理结构未得到优化。作者通过实证发现正确推理轨迹在思考阶段有更频繁、更大的token级熵降，希望利用这一信号指导推理过程优化。

Method: 提出两阶段RLVR框架ERR+：(1)第一阶段训练使用熵释放奖励（ERR），奖励与思考阶段累计token级熵降成正比，并用响应长度进行对数归一化，允许高熵探索状态不受约束；(2)第二阶段引入鲁棒相对效率奖励，通过tanh变换的组内z-score对同生成响应进行长度评分。实验证明两目标联合优化在早期训练会引发梯度冲突，因此采用顺序设计。

Result: 在五个数据集上与多个模型骨干的实验中，ERR+一致提升了准确率和响应简洁性。

Conclusion: 通过两阶段设计避免梯度冲突，ERR+同时优化推理过程质量（熵降）和输出效率（简洁性），实现了更好的推理性能。

Abstract: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on complex tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought (CoT) traces via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). While current RLVR methods have achieved strong results with correctness-based reward signals, they provide limited guidance on the quality of the reasoning process itself, leaving the internal reasoning structure largely unoptimized. Through empirical analysis across multiple model families, we identify a consistent pattern: correct reasoning trac es exhibit more frequent and larger token-level entropy drops within the thinking phase than incorrect ones. We propose ERR+, a two-phase RLVR framework grounded in this observation. The first phase trains with the Entropy Relief Reward (ERR), a bonus proportional to cumulative token-level entropy drops in the thinking phase, log-normalized by response length. Unlike prior methods that suppress entropy, ERR rewards the resolution of uncertainty while leaving exploratory high-entropy states unconstrained. The second phase introduces the Robust Relative Efficiency Reward, which scores each response's length against co-generated peers via a $\tanh$-transformed within-group $z$-score. We provide a formal analysis showing that joint optimization of the two objectives induces gradient conflict in early training, motivating the sequential design . Experiments on five datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in both accuracy and response conciseness across model backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/XrkArul/err_response

</details>


### [495] [Unsupervised Latent Space Alignment with Hyperspherical Geodesic Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28840)
*Cameron Ryan,Vivek Sivaraman Narayanaswamy,Kowshik Thopalli,Shusen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HGA（超球面高斯对齐）方法，通过直接优化两个潜空间之间的变换来最大化几何拟合度，实现无监督或弱监督条件下不同神经网络潜空间的对齐，在模型拼接和多语言词嵌入对应恢复任务上达到与监督方法相当的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立训练的神经网络对相同数据会编码出相似的潜空间几何结构，但这些结构不直接兼容，需要通过变换对齐。现有的对齐方法大多依赖共享样本对应（锚点），作者质疑仅凭潜空间的几何特征是否足以恢复对齐关系，从而探索无监督对齐的可能性。

Method: 提出HGA方法，通过最大化两个潜空间之间几何拟合度量来直接优化它们之间的变换。该方法由潜空间几何驱动而非配对数据驱动，因此可在无监督和弱监督两种模式下运行。基于超球面高斯分布建模潜空间的几何签名。

Result: 在模型拼接和多语言词嵌入对应恢复等任务上，HGA在极少或无监督的情况下能达到与监督方法相当的性能。

Conclusion: 潜空间的几何特征本身足以作为对齐的基础，无需依赖配对数据或监督信号，证明了纯几何驱动的潜空间对齐方法是可行且有效的。

Abstract: Independently trained neural networks tend to encode the same data with similar latent geometries. These latent geometries are not directly compatible, yet they can be nearly the same up to some class of transformations. While there exists many methods for alignment between different latent spaces, it is typically done using a set of shared sample correspondences, known as anchors. This leaves a fundamental question: are the geometric signatures of different latent spaces representing similar data sufficient to recover an alignment between them? To that end, we introduce HGA (Hyperspherical Gaussian Alignment), a method that directly optimizes a transformation between two latent spaces by maximizing a geometric measure of "fit" between them. Since it is driven by the geometry of the latent spaces rather than paired data, HGA can operate in both an unsupervised and weakly supervised regime. On tasks such as model stitching or multilingual word embedding correspondence recovery, HGA manages to match supervised results with minimal or no supervision.

</details>


### [496] [PruneShift: A Framework for Evaluating Decision Reliability in Structured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29765)
*Hao Ye,Gaopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PruneShift评估框架，将结构化剪枝的代理评估分为三部分：广泛的预测保真度、选择器输出附近的保真度、以及所选剪枝决策的质量。通过理论证明和四个实验研究，展示了为什么预测拟合、决策可靠性和剪枝方法质量需要分开评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化剪枝因直接评估所有可行掩码代价过高，通常使用代理目标。但现有评估只报告平均代理误差或秩相关性，这些摘要不能直接检验代理所选掩码的质量。作者证明Spearman和Kendall一致性与归一化选择遗憾可以同时趋近最优，说明现有指标不足以评估实际剪枝决策质量。

Method: 提出PruneShift框架，分离三种评估维度：广泛预测保真度、选择器输出附近保真度、所选剪枝决策质量。理论上推导了基于均匀误差、选择器次优性、决策边际、密度比和比较质量的充分条件，并给出有限池证书和显式超额成本界。在四个数据集（TextbookQA、Natural Questions、QQP、OSSCAR）上进行实验验证。

Result: 理论证明Spearman/Kendall一致性与最大选择遗憾可以同时达到，现有指标具有局限性。实验显示：TextbookQA中7/20区间支持代理选择掩码，6/20支持固定比较器，7/20跨零；Natural Questions中仅1/4设置严格改进；QQP中16/16预设端点支持覆盖率机制；OSSCAR中68/75主端点显示局部保真优于广泛保真，但独立固定掩码确认在24/25端点不显著。

Conclusion: 现有广泛采样的代理评估指标（如秩相关或平均误差）无法可靠预测剪枝决策的实际质量。预测拟合、决策可靠性和剪枝方法质量是需要独立证据的三个不同维度，PruneShift框架为这三者提供了分离的评估路径。

Abstract: Structured pruning uses surrogate objectives because direct task evaluation over every feasible mask is too expensive. Most evaluations report average surrogate error or rank correlation on broadly sampled masks. These summaries do not directly test the mask chosen by the surrogate. We introduce PruneShift, an evaluation framework that separates broad predictive fidelity, fidelity near selector outputs, and the quality of the selected pruning decision. We first prove that Spearman and Kendall agreement can approach one while normalized selection regret remains maximal. We then derive sufficient conditions based on uniform error, selector suboptimality, decision margin, density ratio, and comparison mass. The analysis also yields a finite pool certificate with an explicit excess cost bound. Four studies test different links in this argument. External TextbookQA confirmation is heterogeneous: 7 of 20 simultaneous intervals favor the surrogate-selected mask, 6 favor its fixed comparator, and 7 cross zero. On a fixed Natural Questions pool, strict improvement holds in one of four settings. A controlled QQP experiment supports the proposed coverage mechanism in all 16 prespecified endpoints, although the sufficient bounds are conservative. Finally, a restricted OSSCAR reconstruction study on OPT-125M shows better local than broad fidelity in 68 of 75 primary endpoints. Independent fixed-mask confirmation is inconclusive in 24 of 25 endpoints and favors the comparator in one. These results show why predictive fit, decision reliability, and pruning method quality require separate evidence.

</details>


### [497] [Curvature Cryptanalysis of Smooth Transformer Feed-Forward Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28843)
*Munawar Hasan,Apostol Vassilev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现光滑两层前馈网络（FFN）在选择输入-原始输出预言机下存在一种额外的结构模型提取通道。通过利用第二个Hessian泄露通道，仅需16个投影Hessian（8193次黑盒查询）即可恢复CIFAR-10视觉Transformer中隐藏的FFN方向，平均绝对余弦对齐超过0.94，并能实现超过93%的功能替代准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的模型提取工作主要关注行为级提取（输入-输出映射），但忽略了结构级提取的可能性。论文旨在证明即使在没有参数、梯度或内部激活访问权限的条件下，黑盒模型的光滑FFN曲率也会暴露隐藏的内部参数几何结构，这种行为保真度无法揭示的信息漏洞。

Method: 1) 形式化Hessian集合为部分对称分解问题，建立局部可识别性和稳定性条件；2) 利用向量输出模板重用将结构性查询成本降低16倍；3) 通过固定恢复方向、仅拟合剩余FFN参数实现功能提取；4) 针对输出舍入和高斯噪声，自适应调整有限差分步长以恢复提取性能。

Result: 在独立训练的CIFAR-10视觉Transformer上，仅16个投影Hessian（8193次黑盒查询）恢复隐藏FFN方向，平均绝对余弦对齐>0.94，其中GELU方向95.1%和SiLU方向91.9%超过0.90对齐。功能替代模型达到>93% top-1一致率，测试准确率保持在与目标0.90%和0.62%以内。自适应噪声处理恢复对齐至0.9603和0.9398。

Conclusion: 在指定的预言机模型下，光滑FFN的曲率暴露了仅凭行为保真度无法揭示的内部参数几何。这提供了一个从黑盒二阶观测到隐藏FFN结构恢复和功能替换的端到端路径，表明结构级模型提取是一个实际的安全威胁。

Abstract: We show that smooth two-layer feed-forward networks (FFNs) expose an additional structural model extraction channel under a chosen-input raw-output oracle at the FFN branch; consider transformer FFN branches with GELU or SiLU activations under chosen-input raw-output access, without access to parameters, gradients, or internal activations; exploit a second-order leakage channel in which projected input Hessians form different mixtures of the same hidden symmetric rank-one factors induced by the FFN input weights. We formalize resulting Hessian collection as a partially symmetric decomposition to establish conditions for local identifiability and stability to exploit vector-output stencil reuse to reduce the structural query cost by a factor of 16. On independently trained CIFAR-10 vision transformers, only 16 projected Hessians, corresponding to 8193 black-box queries, recover the hidden FFN directions with average absolute cosine alignment above 0.94, with 95.1 % of GELU and 91.9 % of SiLU directions exceeding 0.90 alignment. Recovery remains high across independently trained models, repeated extraction runs, and all transformer blocks. The recovered structure supports functional extraction too. Keeping the recovered directions fixed and fitting only the remaining FFN parameters yields high-fidelity substitutes with more than 93 % top-1 agreement, while test accuracy remains within 0.90% and 0.62% of the GELU and SiLU targets. Output rounding and Gaussian noise substantially reduce recovery under a fixed attack configuration, but adapting the finite-difference step restores average alignment to 0.9603 and 0.9398. This is an end-to-end path from black-box second-order observations to hidden FFN-structure recovery and functional replacement. Under the stated oracle model, smooth FFN curvature exposes internal parameter geometry that behavioral fidelity alone cannot reveal.

</details>


### [498] [Equivariant Sheaf Neural Networks: Learning Geometric Transport on Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28853)
*Alessio Borgi,Mario Severino,Fabrizio Silvestri,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ESNN（等变剪切神经网络），通过学习有向矩阵值边传输（edge transport）来丰富等变图神经网络中向量信息的传递方式，在不提高表示阶数（保持一阶标量和向量特征）的前提下实现精确的欧几里得等变性。理论分析表明，当相对位移是唯一协变几何输入时，所有线性O(n)等变映射可分解为独立的径向和切向分量；同时引入受控的对称性松弛机制以处理具有偏好环境方向的系统。在粒子动力学、网格模拟、点云分类和分子性质预测等任务上均取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的等变图神经网络虽然为几何系统建模提供了原则性方法，但高效的一阶架构在向量信息跨图传递时的变换方式上存在局限——即如何在边上传送向量特征而不牺牲等变性或增加表示阶数，是一个未被充分解决的挑战。

Method: ESNN的核心方法包括：(1) 学习有向矩阵值传输（edge transport）来连接相邻节点的向量特征，保持一阶表示；(2) 理论上证明线性O(n)等变映射可分解为径向和切向分量；(3) 通过学习协变特征实现更丰富的特征条件化变换；(4) 引入受控对称性松弛机制，可预先给定或从数据推断偏好方向，在方向通路不活跃时恢复完全的E(n)等变性。

Result: 在粒子动力学、网格仿真、点云分类和分子性质预测等多项任务中，ESNN改进了动力学预测精度，能在对称性破缺时恢复重力轴方向，在特定网格任务和长时程推演上取得显著提升，并且对未见旋转保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 学习几何信息在边上的传输方式为表达性等变消息传递提供了一条互补途径，无需高阶表示即可取得性能提升，这为等变图神经网络的设计开辟了新的方向。

Abstract: Equivariant graph neural networks provide a principled way to model geometric systems, but efficient first-order architectures remain limited in how vector information can be transformed as it moves across a graph. We introduce \textsc{ESNN}, an Equivariant Sheaf Neural Network that enriches this interaction by learning directed, matrix-valued transport between neighboring vector features while preserving exact Euclidean equivariance. Rather than increasing the order of the representation, ESNN keeps scalar and vector features first-order and places the additional geometric flexibility in the edge transport itself. We characterize this transport theoretically, showing that when relative displacement is the only covariant geometric input, every linear $O(n)$-equivariant map decomposes into independent radial and tangential components, while learned covariant features enable richer feature-conditioned transformations. We also introduce controlled symmetry relaxation for systems with a preferred ambient direction, which may be prescribed or inferred from data while recovering full $E(n)$-equivariance when the directional pathway is inactive. Across particle dynamics, mesh-based simulation, point-cloud classification, and molecular property prediction, ESNN improves dynamics prediction, recovers the gravity axis when symmetry is broken, yields substantial gains on selected mesh tasks and long-horizon rollouts, and remains robust to unseen rotations. These results show that learning how geometric information is transported across edges offers a complementary route to expressive equivariant message passing without requiring higher-order representations.

</details>


### [499] [Multiclass Linear Perceptrons with Multiplicative Margins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30028)
*Dmitri Rachkovskij,Evgeny Osipov,Olexander Volkov,Daswin De Silva,Denis Kleyko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一族具有乘法边际机制的多类线性感知机分类器（MMPerc），其要求真实类别得分超过其他竞争类别得分达到自身的一定比例而非固定加性阈值，从而避免因数据与权重向量范数差异导致的得分量级依赖问题。实验表明MMPerc在多数情况下优于标准感知机及SVM、Ridge等经典基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准感知机和加性边际感知机存在局限：加性边际对分数量级敏感，而分数量级受数据范数和类别权重向量范数影响，导致分类置信度度量不可靠。作者希望设计一种不受分数量级影响的边际机制。

Method: 提出乘法边际机制的多类线性感知机（MMPerc），要求真实类得分超过竞争类得分达到自身的一定比例。设计了多种架构与算法变体，推导了可分离与不可分离数据下的损失函数和错误界，并分析了偏置、边际阈值选择、训练模式等关键设计考量。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MMPerc通常优于标准感知机以及SVM和Ridge等经典基线，且具有简单、极简设计和计算高效的优点。

Conclusion: MMPerc凭借其简单性、极简设计和计算效率，有望应用于常规机器学习任务、深度神经网络的线性评估、与超维计算/向量符号架构的集成，以及资源受限场景的部署。

Abstract: This paper introduces a family of multiclass linear Perceptron classifiers with a multiplicative margin mechanism (MMPerc), as an alternative to standard margin-free and additive margin Perceptrons. The multiplicative formulation enforces classification confidence by requiring the true class score to exceed that of competing classes by a specified fraction of itself, rather than by a fixed additive threshold. This avoids dependence on score magnitudes arising from varied norms of data and class weight vectors. We propose several architectural and algorithmic variants of MMPerc, derive associated loss functions and mistake bounds for both linearly separable and non-separable data, and analyze key design considerations, including bias, margin threshold selection, and training modes. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that MMPerc classifiers typically outperform the standard Perceptron, as well as classic baselines such as Support Vector Machines and Ridge classifiers. Owing to their simplicity, minimalistic design, and computational efficiency, MMPerc classifiers are promising candidates for conventional machine learning tasks, linear evaluation of Deep Neural Networks, integration with Hyperdimensional Computing / Vector Symbolic Architecture representations, and deployment in resource-constrained applications.

</details>


### [500] [The Halt Vector: Internalizing a Causal Steering Intervention for Efficient Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28859)
*Dylan Jayabahu,Tinuade Adeleke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现推理模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B）的思维链长度约为答案概率稳定所需时间的两倍，且可移除的多余思考因问题而异。作者通过因果可解释性发现"停止向量"（halt vector）——第18层的一个均值差方向，其干预强度控制思考长度——并将其内化到权重中。关键创新在于正确的内化方法：不是最大化标量投影（会破坏下游读者依赖的离轴维度且适得其反），而是重构整个受控激活并固定离轴维度。仅用24个问题的拟合且无强化学习，该方法在五个未见基准上以保持准确率移除约四分之一的思考，削减量与各问题自身的可移除余量相关性达0.70，并修复了随难度增长的非终止病理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型即使在已知答案后仍会继续思考，且多余的思考量因问题而异，全局长度惩罚无法有效移除，需要针对每个问题可移除余量的个性化剪枝方法。

Method: 通过因果可解释性在第18层找到"停止向量"（均值差方向），其干预强度控制思考时长。关键技巧是内化到权重时需重构整个受控激活并固定离轴维度为自然值，而非简单地最大化标量投影。从24个问题拟合，无需强化学习。

Result: 在五个未见基准上以保持准确率为代价移除约四分之一的思考；削减量与问题自身可移除余量相关性达到0.70；修复了随难度增长的非终止病理（该病理会被解码时的置信度钩子加剧）。

Conclusion: 作者不声称胜过一个调优良好的长度惩罚或解码时早期退出的原始权衡，贡献在于"停止"是如何获得的——通过将因果可解释性发现内化到权重中，实现针对每个问题个性化裁剪多余思考。

Abstract: Reasoning models do not stop when they know the answer. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B the chain of thought runs about twice as long as the model's own answer probability takes to settle, and how much of that excess is removable varies from problem to problem, so a global length penalty cannot take it out. We take it out by internalizing a causal interpretability finding into the weights. The mechanism is a halt vector: a difference-of-means direction at layer 18 of this model whose steering strength controls how long it thinks, while a replicated value axis does nothing. Installing that intervention in the weights is harder than it looks. Maximizing the scalar projection onto the direction corrupts the off-axis dimensions a frozen downstream reader depends on, and generation gets longer instead of shorter; what works is reconstructing the whole steered activation with those dimensions pinned to their natural values. Fit from 24 problems and no reinforcement learning, the halt removes about a quarter of the thinking at held accuracy across five unseen benchmarks, and the cut tracks each problem's own removable slack at 0.70. It also closes a non-termination pathology that grows with difficulty and that a decoding-time confidence hook makes worse. We do not claim to beat a well-tuned length penalty or decoding-time early exit on the raw trade-off; the contribution is how the halt is obtained.

</details>


### [501] [Conservative Hybrid Graph Networks for Process Systems with Learned Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28896)
*Paolo Guida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出保守混合图网络（CHGN），该模型将学习到的路由、状态分配和移除率作为数据驱动替代模型，插入固定输运方程中，使质量平衡在构造上成立。CHGN在10-20节点网络上训练后可零样本迁移至25-40节点的未见图，RMSE达2.1e-3，显著优于GNN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业过程网络在运行中并不保持单一有效拓扑（流股被节流或旁路，单元在空闲/过渡/活跃状态间切换），而现有模型通常在测量状态轨迹上训练，但生成这些轨迹的运行机制是潜在的。无约束的图网络能拟合轨迹却无法赋予恢复的路由以稳定的物理意义。

Method: CHGN学习路由、状态分配（regime）和移除率，并将其嵌入固定的输运方程中，使得无论预测何种路由，质量平衡都天然成立。模型结合了数据驱动的代理学习与物理约束的守恒框架。

Result: 在10-20节点网络训练后，零样本迁移至25-40节点未见图，RMSE为2.1e-3（GNN基线为6e-2到9e-2）；门控MAE为7.9e-3，状态准确率94.3%（固定训练拓扑上分别为1.2e-2和96.4%）。在流体混合中试装置上，CHGN优于持续基线预测物理故障，但无法预测手动干预。

Conclusion: CHGN无需重训练即可跨过程拓扑迁移，并能揭示支配工厂行为的潜在机制供检查。该模型的物理一致性约束使其在拓扑泛化和机制可解释性上明显优于纯GNN方法。

Abstract: Industrial process networks do not maintain a single effective topology while operating: streams are throttled or bypassed, and units move between idle, transition, and active regimes. Models of such systems are typically trained on measured state trajectories while the operating mechanisms that generated them remain latent, and an unconstrained graph network can fit such a trajectory without assigning stable physical meaning to the recovered routing. We address both problems with the Conservative Hybrid Graph Network (CHGN), which learns routing, regime assignment, and removal rates as data-driven surrogates and inserts them into a fixed transport equation, so that the mass balance holds by construction for any predicted routing. CHGN trained on networks of 10-20 nodes transfers zero-shot to unseen graphs of 25-40 nodes without retraining, reaching an RMSE of 2.1e-3 against 6e-2 to 9e-2 for GNN baselines under the same protocol, with a gate MAE of 7.9e-3 and regime accuracy of 94.3% (1.2e-2 and 96.4% respectively on the fixed training topology). On a fluid-mixing pilot plant, CHGN improves on a persistence baseline for held-out physical faults but does not predict manual interventions, for which the governing valve actions are unobserved. The model therefore transfers across process topologies without retraining and exposes the latent mechanisms governing plant behaviour to inspection.

</details>


### [502] [Off-Policy Evaluation for Semantic ID Recommenders: Does the Model's Own Code Hierarchy Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28905)
*Artem Betlei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文探讨在生成式推荐系统中，能否利用模型自身的语义ID（SID）树作为离线策略评估（OPE）的动作抽象。研究发现：在近argmax的真实推荐日志上，细粒度（单条目）OPE不可行，但将条目聚合到代码前缀簇可恢复有效样本量并降低误差；该增益源于粗粒化本身而非层级结构，但SID树使粗粒化在生成式系统中变得可行；分辨率深度是关键的调节旋钮，条件偏差界将粗粒化偏差与量化器最坏重建残差及目标日志散度联系起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐器使用SID作为条目编码，但团队在花费稀缺的A/B测试资源前，需要通过离线策略评估（OPE）来决定哪些解码器或重排序变体值得测试。核心问题是：模型自身的SID树能否作为OPE的动作抽象。

Method: 三个部分的方法：(i) 分析近argmax日志下的OPE问题，揭示条目级有效样本量过小的困境，并提出将条目边缘化到代码前缀簇；(ii) 证明增益来自粗粒化而非层级本身，但SID树使粗粒化可计算——每簇质量可精确廉价地从解码器获得；(iii) 将分辨率深度作为调节旋钮，推导条件偏差界，连接粗粒化偏差与量化器最坏重建残差和目标日志散度。

Result: 条目级OPE在生产日志上不可行；SID树粗粒化可恢复可估计的支持域并降低误差；SID树是实现粗粒化可行的关键；分辨率深度是控制偏差-方差权衡的旋钮；条件偏差界提供了理论保证。

Conclusion: SID树可以有效地充当OPE动作抽象，但关键在于利用其层级结构进行粗粒化聚合，并以分辨率深度作为调节工具，在数据支持不足时选择更粗的粒度。

Abstract: Generative recommenders increasingly emit semantic IDs (SIDs): each item is a short sequence of hierarchical discrete codes from a residual quantizer, decoded autoregressively. Before spending scarce A/B-test, a team may decide offline which decoder or reranking variants are worth testing - a job for off-policy evaluation (OPE). We ask a simple question: can the model's own SID tree serve as the action abstraction for that OPE? Our answer has three parts. (i) Under the near-argmax logging real recommenders use, per-item OPE is hopeless - as item-level effective sample size is usually small on production logs - but marginalizing items to code-prefix clusters restores estimable support and cuts error. (ii) This gain is thanks to coarsening, not to the hierarchy specifically; but the SID tree is what makes coarsening feasible in a generative system - each cluster's mass is exactly and cheaply returned by the decoder, whereas flat clustering requires enumerating item/leaf masses that a code-only decoder does not directly expose. (iii) Resolution depth is the operative knob - coarser under scarce support - and a conditional bias bound links the coarsening bias to the quantizer's worst-case reconstruction residual and the target-logging divergence.

</details>


### [503] [Learning-Theoretic Foundation for General Coded Computing: The Straggler Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28910)
*Parsa Moradi,Behrooz Tahmasebi,Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出通用编码计算（GCC）框架，从学习理论视角重新审视编码计算，通过端到端均方误差损失和RKHS约束，为深度神经网络等缺乏代数结构的现代机器学习负载提供容错编码方案，并在最坏情况和概率性两种拖后腿（straggler）场景下建立了理论收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码计算方法主要针对多项式求值和矩阵乘法等具有严格代数结构的计算设计，依赖于精确恢复和严格恢复阈值。而现代机器学习工作负载（特别是深度神经网络）的运算缺乏刚性代数结构，且许多应用只需近似结果而非精确恢复，这严重限制了现有编码计算方案的适用性。

Method: GCC将编码计算形式化为端到端均方误差损失函数，直接度量期望计算与其恢复估计之间的差距。通过推导合适的上界并将编码器和解码器限制在具有温和光滑性约束的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中，证明编码器和解码器均可表示为RKHS核函数的线性组合，从而可高效计算对应系数。

Result: 在最坏情况下（N个工作节点，至多S个拖后腿节点），端到端损失以O(S^3N^{-3})速率衰减；在概率性设置中（每个工作节点独立以概率p拖后腿），期望损失以O(log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})速率收敛。

Conclusion: GCC框架突破了传统编码计算对严格代数结构和精确恢复的依赖，为现代机器学习负载提供了理论上可保证的近似恢复方案，在两种互补的拖后腿场景下均展现出良好的性能衰减速率。

Abstract: Coded computing has emerged as a powerful paradigm for mitigating the impact of straggling workers in distributed computing systems. However, existing coded-computing schemes are predominantly designed for the exact recovery of highly structured computations, such as polynomial evaluation and matrix multiplication, and typically rely on strict recovery thresholds. These assumptions significantly limit their applicability to modern machine-learning workloads, particularly deep neural networks (DNNs), whose computations generally lack rigid algebraic structure and, in many applications, require only accurate approximations rather than exact recovery.
  To address this gap, we revisit coded computing from a learning-theoretic perspective and introduce General Coded Computing (GCC). Rather than adopting existing algebraic tools, GCC formulates coded computing through a natural end-to-end mean-squared error loss that directly measures the discrepancy between the desired computations and their recovered estimates. By deriving suitable upper bounds and restricting the encoder and decoder to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with mild smoothness constraints, we show that both the encoder and decoder admit specific representations as linear combinations of RKHS kernel functions. This representation allows the corresponding coefficients to be computed efficiently. Moreover, this framework enables us to establish theoretical performance guarantees for GCC under two complementary straggler regimes. In the worst-case setting with $N$ worker nodes, and at most $S$ stragglers, we show that the end-to-end loss decays at least at rate $O(S^3N^{-3})$ for standard configurations. We then study a probabilistic setting in which each worker independently straggles with probability $p$. We prove that the expected loss can still converge at rate $O(\log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})$.

</details>


### [504] [SemKV: Semantic Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization Guided by the Quality Cliff for Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28911)
*Daeha Lee,Do-Hyung Kim,Jae-Hong Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现KV cache在分数比特网格上的均匀量化存在"质量悬崖"现象：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在2.322 bits/值以下仍与FP16统计上无差异，但在2.0 bits处崩溃。基于此，作者提出SemKV方法，通过模型内部得分对token排序并分配两个高于悬崖的相邻精度，实现6.0x存储压缩且无统计可检测的质量损失；使用失真优化的量化器可将无损操作点提升至7.9x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV cache是长上下文LLM推理的主要内存瓶颈，随上下文长度线性增长。现有均匀KV量化未深入探索分数比特网格上的退化行为，也缺乏对"质量悬崖"现象的系统性刻画，导致重要性感知混合精度方法的设计缺乏理论指导。

Method: 1) 通过多种子统计协议系统刻画均匀量化在分数比特网格上的质量退化曲线，发现(2.0, 2.322]区间存在质量悬崖；2) 分析八种模型内部重要性指标在此区间上的统计可互换性；3) 提出SemKV：保留所有token，按模型内部得分排序，分配两个相邻的"高于悬崖"精度以实现网格插值；4) 用失真优化的TurboQuant-MSE量化器替换仿射基座以降低悬崖位置。

Result: SemKV实现6.0x存储压缩，与完整KV相比无统计可检测质量差异（n=900，三个种子），并优于享有1.5x更大内存预算的FP16 token剪枝方法。采用TurboQuant-MSE后，无检测损失操作点提升至7.9x。质量悬崖现象在生成时量化和多轮对话中重现，并可迁移至Mistral-7B。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了KV量化中存在的质量悬崖现象，将重要性感知混合精度重新定义为"悬崖之上的网格插值"问题。核心配方是：先为目标部署场景测量悬崖位置，再在悬崖之上进行精度插值，从而在保持统计不可区分性的前提下实现显著存储压缩。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck of long-context large language model (LLM) inference, growing linearly with context length. We show that uniform KV quantization on a fractional-bit grid does not degrade gracefully: under a prespecified multi-seed statistical protocol, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with an affine quantizer is statistically indistinguishable from FP16 KV down to 2.322 code bits/value and collapses at 2.0 bits - a quality cliff in (2.0, 2.322] that reappears in generation-time quantization and multi-turn dialogue and transfers to Mistral-7B. The cliff reframes importance-aware mixed precision: above it, eight model-internal importance indicators are statistically interchangeable, so the benefit of mixing is grid interpolation, reaching average precisions uniform quantization cannot realize. SemKV preserves every token, ranks tokens by a model-internal score, and assigns two adjacent above-cliff precisions, achieving a measured 6.0x storage reduction with no statistically detectable quality difference from full KV (n=900, three seeds), and outperforming FP16 token pruning granted a 1.5x larger memory budget. Replacing the affine base with a distortion-optimized quantizer (TurboQuant-MSE) lowers the cliff in every protocol tested, raising the no-detectable-loss operating point to 7.9x. The recipe: measure the cliff for the target deployment setting, then interpolate above it.

</details>


### [505] [RankShift: In-Database Detection and Explanation of Categorical Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28922)
*Omair Shafi Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RankShift是一种无需训练模型、直接在分析数据库内部检测类别分布偏移（category shift）的方法。它通过Pearson得分比较每个时间窗口的类别占比与良性参考，返回得分、校准警报及最大的增长贡献类别。在HDFS、BGL、Thunderbird三个日志语料库上，其性能与count-vector自编码器相当或更优，且能检测到事件计数监控无法察觉的稀有类别偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异常检测系统（如事件计数监控、自编码器）主要关注事件数量或消息速率的变化，但无法检测"类别活跃度改变而事件总数不变"的分布偏移。例如登录服务总失败次数不变但某个来源占比从2%升至30%，或稀有日志模板变得常见但消息速率稳定。这类变化会改变哪些类别活跃，却不改变事件发生总数，对安全监控和系统运维至关重要。

Method: RankShift直接在存储数据的分析数据库内运行。它比较每个时间窗口的类别份额（category shares）与良性参考（benign reference），使用Pearson得分，其各项能识别导致变化的具体类别。单个查询同时返回得分、校准后的警报以及最大的增长贡献类别。该方法无需模型训练或独立推理服务，完全在数据库内完成。

Result: 在HDFS上，RankShift与count-vector自编码器的AUROC差距仅0.001（0.999对1.000）；在Thunderbird上以0.983对0.949领先。在固定体积（fixed-volume）受控实验中，RankShift能检测到事件计数监控不可见的稀有类别偏移，AUROC达0.787，优于自编码器的0.771。在三个语料库上，观测到的误报率与请求的操作水平一致。且RankShift的部署状态比自编码器小137倍。

Conclusion: RankShift证明了类型分布偏移（category-shift）检测可以高效地在分析数据库内部实现，无需训练或额外推理服务，在检测稀有类别变化方面优于或匹敌自编码器，同时大幅降低部署开销。

Abstract: A login service can receive its usual number of failed sign-ins while one source grows from 2% to 30% of them. The same pattern appears in system logs when a rare event template becomes common while the message rate stays stable. These events change which categories are active without changing how many events occur. RankShift detects such changes inside the analytical database that stores the data. It compares each window's category shares with a benign reference using a Pearson score whose terms identify the categories responsible for the change. The same query returns the score, calibrated alert, and largest increasing contributions. We evaluate RankShift on HDFS, BGL, and Thunderbird. It matches the count-vector autoencoder within 0.001 AUROC on HDFS (0.999 versus 1.000) and leads on Thunderbird (0.983 versus 0.949). In a controlled fixed-volume experiment, RankShift detects rare-category shifts that are invisible to event-count monitoring, reaching 0.787 AUROC compared with 0.771 for the autoencoder. Across all three corpora, observed false-alarm rates track the requested operating levels. RankShift requires no model training or inference service, and the autoencoders deployed state is 137x larger.

</details>


### [506] [Revisiting the Provable-Auditable Privacy Gap of DP-SGD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28934)
*Saloni Modi,Srivi Balaji,Yusong Zhu,Gautam Kamath,Kevin Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将经验隐私下界作为具体优化指标，并设计了一个轻量级防御框架，可在不损害理论隐私保证的前提下，显著提升DP-SGD等优化方法在标准基准上的经验隐私表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统差分隐私提供算法的理论隐私上界，但近年来的隐私审计工作通过构造经验区分事件来下界化真实隐私，发现DP-SGD的理论隐私界几乎紧密，导致悲观的视角。作者希望打破这一困境，提出一个可直接优化的经验隐私下界指标，并设计相应的防御方法。

Method: 提出将经验隐私下界作为优化目标的具体度量；设计一个轻量级防御框架，可通用地增强ML流水线中的优化方法；该框架在增强DP-SGD时不会增加理论隐私成本（区别于以往的成员推理攻击防御方法）；在多种审计构造、模型和数据集上进行评估。

Result: 该防御框架在标准基准上显著提升了经验隐私（即提高了隐私审计下的经验下界），同时不损害DP-SGD的理论隐私保证，并在广泛的审计设置（多种威胁模型、模型架构和数据集）中展示了灵活性和有效性。

Conclusion: 经验隐私下界可以作为一个实用的优化目标，与理论隐私上界互补。本文的防御框架在提升实证隐私的同时保持理论隐私无损，为私有机器学习中的隐私-效用权衡提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Differential privacy (DP) has traditionally been used to provide theoretical upper bounds on an algorithm's stability to changing its training data. In modern private machine learning applications, achieving strong tradeoffs between utility and theoretical privacy is challenging, and thus one may optimistically hope that existing theoretical privacy analyses are loose. Recent work on privacy auditing has adopted a dual viewpoint, instead lower bounding the true privacy of an algorithm by constructing empirical distinguishing events. The auditing literature has thus far yielded a pessimistic outlook on the looseness of theoretical privacy bounds for DP-SGD, the de facto private training method in modern ML, as nearly-matching empirical lower bounds have been achieved under various threat models [NHSBTJCT23, AC24, CBP25].
  In this work, we propose the empirical privacy lower bound of an algorithm as a concrete metric to optimize for, complementary to the theoretical upper bound. We give a lightweight defense framework that generically augments optimization methods in the ML pipeline to have significantly-improved empirical privacy on standard benchmarks. Moreover, we show that our framework comes at no theoretical privacy cost when augmenting DP-SGD, unlike previously-proposed defenses against membership inference attacks. We evaluate our defense against a broad range of audit constructions, models, and datasets to demonstrate its flexibility.

</details>


### [507] [From the Loss Landscape to Diverse Feature Learning in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28948)
*David Aram Yunis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文围绕神经网络损失景观中的"模式连通性"（mode connectivity）这一现象展开研究，旨在理解、解释并利用神经网络的优化过程。作者指出，虽然神经网络已大规模部署于自动驾驶、建筑、法律、招聘和医疗等领域，但人们对其如何达成解决方案的理解仍然有限。由于所有神经网络都必须经过训练这一优化过程，理解网络的核心在于理解其优化机制和数据暴露方式。本文通过研究模式连通性这一尚无法解释的奇特现象，揭示了损失景观的特殊结构，并对其进行了系统性的阐述和利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络已从学术兴趣发展为影响国家经济的关键技术，但其决策机制缺乏深入理解，导致了自动驾驶、法律、招聘、医疗等领域的意外后果。理解大型生产系统的失败很难直接研究，但这些失败迹象在各类规模的神经网络中都存在，因此可以通过更易于处理的设定来研究。核心问题在于：理解神经网络本质上就是理解其优化过程——通过什么过程和哪些数据达成结果。然而领域对这一知识的理解十分模糊，特别是模式连通性这一现象完全无法用现有理论解释。

Method: 本文采取"阐明（elucidate）、解释（explain）和利用（exploit）"三步策略来研究损失景观中的特殊结构——模式连通性。通过研究可在较小规模上复现的失败迹象，并在优化过程的框架下系统性地剖析神经网络的训练机制，从而揭示损失表面上连接不同神经网络的路径背后的原理。

Result: 论文对模式连通性这一损失景观中的特殊结构进行了系统性的阐述和解释，并展示了如何利用这一结构来理解和改进神经网络的训练过程。

Conclusion: 本文通过深入研究模式连通性，为理解神经网络如何在损失景观中达到特定解提供了新的视角，填补了该领域对优化过程理解的空白，并展示了这一认识对实际应用的重要价值。

Abstract: Over the course of the last decade, neural networks have grown from an academic curiosity to moving the markets of nations. Despite this explosion in both research and deployment, relatively little is understood about how they achieve the solutions they do. This is both scientifically relevant, and pressing for society. When neural networks make decisions across self-driving, construction, law, hiring and health, there have been and will continue to be unintended consequences.
  However, attempting to generalize the failures of the largest and most important production systems makes for a very difficult task. Yet signs of these failures exist at all scales of neural networks, so we should be able to study a much more tractable setting. All neural networks must undergo an optimization process, called training, to be useful. To a great degree, understanding neural networks is understanding their optimization: through what process and exposure to which data did they arrive at their results. Yet our knowledge on this topic as a field is quite imprecise. In particular, a curious phenomenon called mode connectivity, the ability to connect neural networks in the loss surface, defies explanation entirely.
  This dissertation elucidates, explains and exploits this special structure in the loss landscape...

</details>


### [508] [Continuity-Free Near-Minimax Leading-Order Regret for CVaR-UCBVI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28960)
*Yuanlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI算法在无需连续性假设的情况下，对任意归一化收益分布（包括原子、混合和连续分布）都能达到锐化的遗憾界 Õ(√(SAK/τ) + (SAHK^{1/4}+S²AH)/τ)，其中 τ^{-1/2} 主导项匹配期望遗憾的极小极大下界（对数因子内），使该算法在完整收益分布类上达到极小极大最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作中的CVaR强化学习在任意收益分布下仅有 Õ(τ^{-1}√(SAK)) 的次优遗憾界，只有在密度下界假设下才能获得更优的 Õ(√(SAK/τ)) 速率。本文旨在证明无需连续性假设即可达到锐化速率，扩大算法的适用范围。

Method: 核心创新是"选定预算自界"（selected-budget self-bound）：证明episode短缺的条件方差至多为 τ 加上值估计宽度。将该界代入原始的Bernstein分解，通过高概率论证，对任意归一化收益分布推导出 Õ(√(SAK/τ)+(SAHK^{1/4}+S²AH)/τ) 遗憾界。

Result: 证明了同一Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI算法在无连续性假设下即可达到 Õ(√(SAK/τ)) 主导遗憾速率，τ^{-1/2} 主导项匹配极小极大下界，高阶项保留 τ^{-1} 依赖。适用于原子、混合及连续收益分布。

Conclusion: Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI在主导阶意义下于完整收益分布类上是极小极大最优的，消除了先前对密度或连续性假设的需求，显著拓展了理论保证的适用范围。

Abstract: For finite-horizon tabular CVaR reinforcement learning, prior work proves a $\widetilde{O}(τ^{-1}\sqrt{SAK})$ leading regret bound for arbitrary normalized return laws and the sharper $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/τ})$ rate under a density lower bound. We show that the same Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI algorithm attains the sharper rate without continuity assumptions. The key is a selected-budget self-bound: the conditional variance of the episode shortfall is at most $τ$ plus the value-estimation width. Substitution into the original Bernstein decomposition yields, with high probability, $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/τ}+(SAHK^{1/4}+S^2AH)/τ)$ regret for arbitrary normalized return laws, including atomic, mixed, and continuous laws. The $τ^{-1/2}$ leading term matches the expected-regret minimax lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Thus Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI is minimax-optimal over the full return-law class in the leading-order regime; the lower-order terms retain their $τ^{-1}$ dependence.

</details>


### [509] [V2TATC: A Joint Voice-Trajectory Embedding Framework and Dataset for Air Traffic Controller Situational Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28981)
*Louis Brusset,Mathurin Petit,Jordan Kam,Alexandre Bayen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了V2TATC (Voice-to-Trajectory for Air Traffic Control)，一个联合语音通信与飞行轨迹数据的嵌入框架。该框架将空中交通管制员的语音指令与对应飞机的轨迹映射到同一潜在空间，支持双向查询，可用于繁忙空域中的态势感知辅助。作者在旧金山湾区进行了验证，并发布了新的配对语音-轨迹数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 国家空域系统（尤其是低空空域）的航空交通量持续增长，需要可扩展的决策支持工具辅助空中交通管制员，但现有的工具缺乏将语音指令与轨迹数据两种模态联合建模的能力。

Method: V2TATC采用自监督轨迹编码器、冻结的大规模语音编码器、对比联合嵌入以及基于归一化流的双射提升（bijective lifting）机制，将语音指令和对应飞机的轨迹映射到同一潜在空间中的邻近点，支持跨模态双向查询。

Result: 在旧金山湾区（涵盖多个主要机场及商业与通用航空低空混合交通）进行了实验，验证了跨模态检索的有效性，并进行了消融实验和潜在空间分析。同时发布了一个新的配对语音-轨迹数据集。

Conclusion: 语音与轨迹数据模态并非独立，它们代表同一物理指涉（正在空域中飞行的飞机）。V2TATC能够有效利用这一关联性，为ATC在实时推理ADS-B轨迹或飞行员自然语言意图时提供态势感知支持。

Abstract: As air traffic volumes in the National Airspace System continue to expand, in particular in the low altitude airspaces, the need for scalable decision support tools used by air traffic controllers will also require more development. This article introduces Voice-to-Trajectory for Air Traffic Control, a joint voice communication-flight trajectory data embedding framework, that can be a component of situational awareness in congested airspaces, and assist the development of tools for ATC as they reason in real-time over Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast trajectories, or the intent expressed by pilots in natural language. We show that these data modalities are not independent and represent a common physical referent: an aircraft flying through the airspace. V2TATC maps a voice instruction and the trajectory of the addressed aircraft to nearby points in a single latent space that can be queried in both directions. It combines a self-supervised trajectory encoder, a frozen large-scale speech encoder, a contrastive joint embedding, and a bijective lifting via normalizing flows. We demonstrate V2TATC's effectiveness on the San Francisco Bay Area, for its concentration of major airports, and its mix of commercial and general aviation low altitude traffic. Lastly, we release a novel paired voice-trajectory dataset, and report experiments on cross-modal retrieval, ablations, and latent-space analysis.

</details>


### [510] [Effective Graph and Rank-based Contextual Embeddings for Textual and Multimedia Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29001)
*Thiago César Castilho Almeida,Gustavo Rosseto Letício,Lucas Pascotti Valem,André Freitas,Daniel Carlos Guimarães Pedronette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GRaCE框架，一种完全无监督的图嵌入方法，基于排名信息生成可解释的嵌入表示。它改进了RaDE算法，通过基于排名的代表性子集选择策略，在检索、分类和聚类任务中优于RaDE和原始特征，适用于文本和图像等多种数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图嵌入方法虽然能有效压缩图信息，但传统方法缺乏可解释的维度，且计算成本高。RaDE虽然引入基于排名的可解释嵌入方法，但其原始提案未充分探索代表性子集选择在不同类别中的有效性，也未在分类和聚类任务中评估嵌入性能。

Method: 提出GRaCE（Graph and Rank-based Contextual Embeddings）框架，这是一个完全无监督的方法，通过利用稳健的基于排名的度量来进行代表性子集选择和节点嵌入，生成可解释的嵌入表示。该方法参考了RaDE的思路，但改进了代表性子集的选择策略。

Result: GRaCE在多个数据集（包括文本和图像集合）上超越了RaDE和原始特征方法，在检索、分类和聚类任务中表现优异。实验中使用先进的Transformer模型作为特征描述符，并使用图卷积网络（GCN）模型进行分类任务。

Conclusion: GRaCE通过基于排名的可解释嵌入方法，成功解决了传统图嵌入缺乏可解释性的问题，并在多种下游任务中展现出优越性能，验证了基于排名的代表性子集选择在无监督图嵌入中的有效性。

Abstract: In a data-driven world, efficiently organizing and mapping relationships between objects is crucial. Graphs are powerful tools for modeling these connections, being widely used in social networks, telecommunications, and biology. However, graph-based methods often face high computational costs, particularly in memory and space usage. To address this, graph embedding techniques, also referred to as Network Representation Learning, encode graph information into lower-dimensional representations while preserving structural aspects. Traditional methods, however, lack interpretable dimensions. RaDE (Rank Diffusion Embedding) introduces a new approach using rank-based information, with a key step being the selection of a representative subset of nodes to provide interpretability for its dimensions and improve retrieval tasks. Despite its potential, RaDE's original proposal did not fully explore the effectiveness of representative subset selection across different classes or evaluate embeddings in tasks like classification and clustering. Inspired by RaDE, this work introduces GRaCE (Graph and Rank-based Contextual Embeddings), a fully unsupervised framework that generates interpretable embeddings by leveraging robust rank-based measures for representative subset selection and node embedding. GRaCE surpasses RaDE and Original Features across diverse datasets, including textual and image collections, excelling in retrieval, classification, and clustering tasks, considering state-of-the-art Transformer models as feature descriptors and Graph Convolutional Networks models in classification tasks.

</details>


### [511] [Context-Aware Interpretable Representations for Retrieval and Graph Convolutional Network Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29004)
*Thiago César Castilho Almeida,Gustavo Rosseto Letício,Vinicius Atsushi Sato Kawai,Daniel Carlos Guimarães Pedronette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督的上下文感知表示学习框架，通过结合流形学习与基于排序的可解释图嵌入，同时弥合几何差距（传统成对度量无法捕捉数据流形固有几何）和可解释性差距（表示与人类认知不对齐），生成稀疏且自可解释的嵌入。实验表明该方法在保持低维度的同时，在图像检索和基于GCN的半监督分类任务中维持或提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管视觉信息建模取得了显著进展（CNN、Transformer、基础模型），但相似性评估的本质和模型透明性仍存在关键挑战：一是几何差距，传统成对度量无法捕捉数据集流形的内在几何结构；二是可解释性差距，学习到的表示缺乏与人类认知的对齐。如何在保持低维度和下游任务高效性的同时提供表示的可解释性，仍然是一个开放性问题。

Method: 提出一个新颖的无监督框架，将流形学习策略与基于排序的可解释图嵌入相集成。方法分为两个阶段：首先通过流形分析刻画数据集的上下文信息，然后生成稀疏、自可解释的嵌入。该框架采用灵活的设计，支持不同的流形学习和表示学习策略。

Result: 在多样化数据集和特征上的广泛实验表明，所提出的上下文感知表示不仅提供了内在可解释性和降维能力，还在下游任务（特别是图像检索和基于图卷积网络GCN的半监督分类）中维持或提升了有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架成功弥合了几何差距和可解释性差距，提供了一种兼顾可解释性、低维度和下游任务性能的表示学习方法，是通往更具透明性和认知对齐的视觉表示的重要一步。

Abstract: The advances in visual information modeling and representation during the last decades are remarkable, mainly supported by Convolutional Neural Networks, Transformer-based, and Foundation Models. Despite this progress, critical challenges regarding the nature of similarity assessment and model transparency have been neglected. A primary concern is the Geometric Gap, where traditional pairwise measures fail to capture the intrinsic geometry of the dataset manifold. Furthermore, the Interpretability Gap persists, as representations often lack alignment with human cognition. Therefore, how to provide interpretability to representations while maintaining low dimensionality and high effectiveness in downstream tasks remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose a novel unsupervised framework that integrates Manifold Learning strategies with Rank-based Interpretable Graph Embeddings. Our approach effectively bridges these gaps by first characterizing the contextual information of the dataset through manifold analysis and subsequently generating sparse, self-explainable embeddings. The proposed approach employs a flexible formulation, allowing different Manifold Learning and Representation Learning strategies. Extensive experimental evaluation across diverse datasets and features demonstrates that our Context-Aware representations not only provide intrinsic interpretability and dimensionality reduction but also maintain or enhance effectiveness in downstream tasks, specifically in image retrieval and semi-supervised classification using Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs).

</details>


### [512] [Hybrid Semantic Context-Enhanced Ensemble Learning for Wind Power Ramp-Event Forecasting and Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29024)
*Momina Liaqat Ali,Muhammad Abid,Muhammad Abdullah,Aneela Zameer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合预测方法，将涡轮机运行数据转换为简化文本并嵌入为稠密向量，为风电爬坡事件预测补充语义上下文特征，在SDWPF数据集多个时间尺度上实验，并通过统计检验和外部数据集验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风电爬坡事件（短时间内输出功率的剧烈波动）难以预测，标准模型常常漏报这些事件，需要更有效的预测方法。

Method: 构建pipeline将涡轮机运行数据转换为简化文本，再转换为稠密嵌入向量，作为集成模型的额外输入特征；在10/30/60分钟三个预测时域上测试，使用Diebold-Mariano检验和bootstrap置信区间评估，并变化爬坡阈值、PCA降维压缩嵌入，在Kaggle SCADA和NREL数据上外部验证。

Result: 语义上下文特征相对基线产生微小但统计显著的增益，在30/60分钟时域上最明显且跨阈值稳健；PCA压缩在长时域部分情况有帮助；最佳上下文增强集成排名靠前，但GRU在30/60分钟爬坡事件RMSE仍最低；外部数据集验证误差降低可泛化，但增益大小依赖模型和数据集；预测区间在正常情况覆盖良好但爬坡事件期间变弱。

Conclusion: 语义上下文特征为爬坡事件预测提供了一致但有限的改进，尤其在中长时域上有效；爬坡事件期间预测区间性能下降表明数据分布存在局部偏移，需要进一步处理。

Abstract: Wind power ramp events which are sudden, large swings in turbine output over short windows are difficult to estimate, and standard models often miss them. Hybrid forecasting approach is built which augments semantic context to ramp-event forecast. Rather than applying an extensive language model directly to predict turbine operating data, we have implemented a pipeline where turbine operating data is converted to simplified text, which is then converted to dense embeddings to be used as inputs for ensemble models incorporated with other features. Testing runs are performed at multiple intervals within the SDWPF dataset, including 10-minute, 30-minute, and 60- minute horizons, with ramp events constituting the highest change in future power output. We check robustness against autoregressive, LSTM, and GRU baselines plus several ensemble configurations, using Diebold-Mariano tests and bootstrap confidence intervals, and we vary the ramp threshold, compress the embeddings with PCA, and validate externally on Kaggle SCADA and NREL data with uncertainty-aware scoring.
