Result: 创作者消融实验显示生产探索使每创作者发帖量提升8.55%、至少发帖一次的创作者提升7.10%。观众侧消融实验发现视频观看次数增加1.74%但观看时间减少2.13%。三周协同分流实验证实：在语料库路径明显弯曲前，数据无法区分适度的快速效应与任意大的慢速效应，有效置信区间可能缺少有限上端点。

Conclusion: 探索对创作者供给有明确正面作用，但观众侧语料库效应存在根本性的测量限制。若语料库在每个发布周期以速率w周转，t周期实验最多表达wt比例的最终语料库效应。要识别总价值，需要更长的实验持续时间或独立语料库设计。实验确立了创作者正面响应，测得了三周内可见的总语料库流动，并明确了识别总价值所需的设计与时长。

Abstract: Industrial recommenders give new content initial views through budgeted exploration, then use early performance to decide further delivery. On many short-video platforms, exploration is the primary way new videos reach viewers. Viewer-side tests measure consumption; the published budget objectives we review omit creator response. We analyze four experiments on a major short-video platform. An eight-month creator ablation finds production exploration raises videos posted per creator by 8.55% and creators posting at least once by 7.10% relative to a minimal floor. A budget-matched reallocation raises creator participation with no detectable short-run viewer-side change. A year-long viewer ablation finds 1.74% more video views but 2.13% less view time. A delivered view creates immediate feed value, can trigger organic take-up, and can induce creator supply. Take-up and supply replenish a shared corpus, creating two measurement limits. Viewer-side A/B tests cancel the corpus effect when both arms consume the same corpus. Giving each arm its own corpus avoids cancellation, but turnover still controls the horizon. If the corpus turns over at rate w per posting cycle, a t-cycle experiment expresses at most wt of the eventual corpus effect. More users reduce noise but do not speed turnover. Before the corpus path visibly bends, data cannot distinguish a modest fast effect from an arbitrarily large slow one, so a valid confidence interval may lack a finite upper endpoint. As predicted, the three-week co-diverted experiment cannot determine the sign of the eventual corpus effect. Within the window, it identifies the direct feed effect, and an exploratory cohort analysis detects organic lift after exploration ends. The experiments establish a positive creator response, measure the gross corpus flow visible within three weeks, and show the design and duration needed to identify total value.

</details>


### [686] [The Edge Spectrum of Choice-Derived Item Graphs: Strong and Weak Edges Encode Different Relations in Collaborative Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29578)
*Keigo Sakurai,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文诊断了图协同过滤中来自选择模型的边权重图谱问题：强边和弱边编码了性质不同的关系（称为边频谱），强边集中在被点击项的同位竞争者上，与排序梯度方向相反（符号不匹配）。作者通过形式化分析解释了为何drop-in选择派生算子不如co-click、标量修复失效、只有边幅度感知算子才能恢复预期排序，并提出可复用的诊断协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图协同过滤常依赖item-item图进行正平滑，隐含假设是更强的边编码与弱边相同的关系。但作者发现，当边权重来自选择模型（choice model）时，该假设不成立：强边和弱边编码的是性质不同的关系（边频谱），导致平滑算子与排序梯度之间存在符号不匹配，从而引发一系列现有方法失败的问题。

Method: 作者形式化了平滑算子与排序梯度之间的符号不匹配，证明co-click图因构造特性不会产生这种错位。通过在MIND和EB-NeRD上诊断三类经验现象：drop-in选择派生算子、均匀标量修复（符号翻转、in-slate margin loss）、以及边幅度感知算子，并用诊断结果定位边界而非调参。

Result: 在MIND和EB-NeRD上验证了三个经验观察：(i) drop-in选择派生算子无法胜过co-click；(ii) 均匀标量修复可预测地失败，因为错位存在于图中而非损失函数中；(iii) 只有边幅度感知算子能恢复预期排序，其边界由诊断定位而非调参获得。邻居截断k被证明是语义开关而非稀疏化超参数。

Conclusion: 核心主张是哪些干预会失败/成功及其原因，而非绝对的性能增益（诊断预测增益在衰减传播通道下很小）。作者将诊断转化为可复用协议，供从业者在部署任何选择派生item侧算子前使用。

Abstract: Graph collaborative filtering relies on item--item graphs whose edges are used for positive smoothing, under the implicit assumption that stronger edges encode more of the same relation as weaker ones. We show that this assumption fails for a practically important class of graphs: those whose edge weights come from a choice model. On such graphs, strong and weak edges encode qualitatively different relations, which we call an edge spectrum. Specifically, strong edges concentrate on the in-slate competitors of clicked items, exactly the pairs that the within-slate ranking gradient pushes apart, while weak edges do not. We formalize this as a sign mismatch between the smoothing operator and the ranking gradient, and prove that co-click graphs cannot exhibit the same misalignment by construction. This diagnosis explains three empirical observations on MIND and EB-NeRD: (i) drop-in choice-derived operators do not beat co-click, despite indexing structurally distinct neighborhoods; (ii) uniform scalar fixes (sign flip, in-slate margin loss) fail predictably, because the misalignment lives in the graph, not in the loss; (iii) only edge-magnitude-aware operators, with the regime boundary located by the diagnosis rather than by tuning, recover the predicted ordering. The neighbor cutoff $k$ is therefore a semantic switch, not a sparsification hyperparameter. Our claim concerns which interventions fail or succeed and why, not absolute headline gains, which the diagnosis itself predicts to be small under the attenuated propagation channel we observe. We turn the diagnosis into a reusable protocol practitioners can run before deploying any choice-derived item-side operator. Code: https://github.com/kyomusso/Edge-Spectrum-in-CF.

</details>


### [687] [RePair: Turning Retrieval Failures into Counterfactual Hard Pairs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29604)
*Siyi Liu,Xiaorong Zhu,Enjun Du,Xinyu Zuo,Lisheng Duan,Haijin Liang,Jin Ma,Junfu Pu,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出RePair方法，通过挖掘模型失败样本（top-ranked false positives）作为反事实脚手架，利用LLM引导的最小化编辑将错误余量修正为硬正样本，使其与未编辑版本构成跨越决策边界的硬负/正样本对，从而提供互补的拉-推监督信号，以更少的数据量（107K合成样本，比现有方法少26%-75%）在Flickr30K和COCO30K上超越对比增强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP风格的双编码器在视觉-语言检索中很强，但实际准确性常受限于局部语义区分——排名靠前的"几乎正确"样本与真实匹配仅差一个关键细节。现有硬样本挖掘只能选择混淆候选却无法构造修正版本，而合成增强虽能生成新样本，但未基于实际模型失败条件化，针对的是无关的困难维度。

Method: RePair遵循三个原则：有效性（Validity）、最小性（Minimality）和局部性（Locality）。具体通过双向挖掘误报（false positives），利用LLM引导的反事实编辑，并结合局部硬样本对对比目标进行训练。其核心洞察是：排名靠前的误报是反事实脚手架，只修正其中导致失败的局部残差即可得到同模态的硬正样本，修正与未修正版本构成跨越决策边界的硬负/正对。

Result: 在Flickr30K和COCO30K上，RePair以仅107K合成样本超越受控增强基线，比可比方法少26%-75%的数据量，证明失败条件化的修复比错误无关的增强更具数据效率。

Conclusion: 基于模型实际失败条件化的反事实修复比盲目增强更高效，利用最小化的局部修正可在决策边界处构建互补的训练信号，以更少的数据实现更好的视觉-语言检索性能。

Abstract: Vision-language retrieval with CLIP-style dual encoders achieves strong cross-modal performance, yet practical accuracy often hinges on localized semantic distinctions where top-ranked near misses differ from the true match by a single critical detail. Hard-sample mining can select confusable candidates but cannot construct corrected counterparts; synthetic augmentation can generate novel samples but, without conditioning on actual model failures, targets irrelevant dimensions of hardness. We observe that a top-ranked false positive is a counterfactual scaffold---sharing most of the query's semantics while differing in a localized failure-causing residual. Minimally correcting this residual yields a hard positive of the ground truth in the same modality; the corrected and unedited versions form a hard negative pair that straddles the decision boundary, producing complementary pull--push supervision. We introduce RePair, guided by three principles---Validity, Minimality, and Locality---which mines false positives bidirectionally, applies LLM-guided counterfactual editing, and trains with a local hard-pair contrastive objective. On Flickr30K and COCO30K, RePair outperforms controlled augmentation baselines with only 107K synthetic samples---26\%--75\% fewer than comparable methods---confirming failure-conditioned repair is more data-efficient than error-agnostic augmentation.

</details>


### [688] [ICEGR: An Intent-Coherent End-to-End Generative Retrieval Framework for E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29652)
*Jiayi Tuo,Hehan Li,Dongjun Fu,Xin Lu,Ling Zhuang,Fuwei Zhang,Meifang Li,Peizhi Xu,Hanmeng Liu,Shuanglong Li,Liwei Qian,Yanbiao Ma,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出ICEGR，一个意图一致的端到端生成式检索框架，解决电商搜索中生成式检索在训练流程中查询意图不一致的问题。通过三个组件（意图感知的语义ID构建、合成查询增强的统一SFT、相关性校准的偏好优化），在离线Recall@20提升21.7%、NDCG@20提升26.6%，在线A/B测试中CTR提升3.52%、订单量提升15.96%、GMV提升7.53%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式检索方法在电商搜索中存在三个关键问题：(1) 基于静态商品信息构建的语义ID无法编码商品-意图关联；(2) 依赖在线日志的监督微调对低曝光商品缺乏真实查询意图监督；(3) 面向业务的偏好优化可能偏爱热门或高价值商品而削弱查询-商品相关性。

Method: ICEGR包含三个核心组件：(1) 意图感知语义ID构建：将查询意图信号融入语义ID构建，使其超越静态商品信息捕捉搜索意图；(2) 合成查询增强的统一SFT：将多个SFT任务统一到查询到ID目标下，用合成查询补充低曝光商品的稀疏监督；(3) 相关性校准的偏好优化：将查询-商品相关性与业务信号整合到边际自适应偏好目标中，平衡查询意图与业务偏好学习。

Result: 离线实验：Recall@20提升21.7%，NDCG@20提升26.6%（相比基线）。在线A/B测试（部署于百度电商搜索）：CTR相对提升3.52%，订单量提升15.96%，GMV提升7.53%。

Conclusion: ICEGR通过在生成式检索训练全流程中贯穿查询意图一致性，有效解决了SID构建、SFT监督和偏好优化三个环节的意图不一致问题，显著提升了电商搜索的检索性能和商业指标，证明了端到端生成式检索在电商场景中的实际价值。

Abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) is promising for e-commerce search, yet existing methods struggle to maintain query-intent consistency throughout the training pipeline. First, semantic ID (SID) construction based on static product information limits the ability of SIDs to encode product-intent associations. Second, although supervised fine-tuning (SFT) learns product-SID mappings across the catalog, low-exposure products still lack real query-intent supervision because query-to-SID training relies solely on online logs, resulting in poor retrieval performance for these products. Third, business-oriented preference optimization may favor popular or high-value products over those that best match the query intent, weakening query-product relevance. To address these issues, we propose ICEGR, an Intent-Coherent End-to-End Generative Retrieval Framework for E-commerce Search that integrates query intent consistently throughout the GR training pipeline. ICEGR comprises three components: (1) Intent-Aware SID Construction incorporates query-intent signals into SID construction, enabling SIDs to capture search intent beyond static product information; (2) Synthetic Query-Enhanced Unified SFT unifies multiple SFT tasks under the query-to-SID objective and augments sparse supervision from online logs with synthetic queries, providing complementary query-intent supervision for low-exposure products; and (3) Relevance-Calibrated Preference Optimization integrates query-product relevance and business signals into a margin-adaptive preference objective, preserving query intent while enabling business preference learning. Offline results show that ICEGR improves Recall@20 by 21.7% and NDCG@20 by 26.6% over the baseline. Deployed as an end-to-end generative retrieval pathway in Baidu E-commerce Search, ICEGR achieves relative improvements of 3.52% in CTR, 15.96% in order volume, and 7.53% in GMV in an A/B test.

</details>


### [689] [Demand-Side Measurement for Generative Engine Optimization: Constructing and Validating a Million-Persona, Intent-Annotated Buyer Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30023)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin,Daniil Dzemesjuk*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文介绍了PersonaGen-1M，一个包含1,031,732个合成买家画像的大规模语料库，覆盖511个行业标签和4个市场情境，包含19,416,821个结构化行为属性（其中5,160,046个为搜索查询）。每个画像都带有主意图标签（78.3%信息型、17.4%商业型、4.3%交易型）和来源偏好字段，旨在支持品牌进入生成式引擎推荐短名单的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成式引擎（如ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity）会直接给买家推荐品牌短名单，但研究品牌如何进入或错过这些名单需要需求侧数据（买家提问内容、所需信息、信任的资料来源）。现有的大型画像语料库是为训练数据多样性构建的，既没有分阶段搜索意图标签，也没有来源偏好字段，无法与供给侧推荐测量数据关联。

Method: 从四个公开数据集中提取约4000万条原始画像描述，通过GPU加速的MinHash LSH加上语义去重进行清洗，然后按固定schema进行丰富化处理。每个画像包含主意图标签（覆盖其查询集）和偏好来源字段；意图标签用于筛选驱动推荐的商业评估画像，偏好来源字段与引文溯源数据进行配对关联。

Result: 生成了包含1,031,732个合成买家画像的语料库，覆盖511个行业标签和4个市场情境，包含19,416,821个结构化行为属性和5,160,046个搜索查询。意图分布为78.3%信息型、17.4%商业型、4.3%交易型。与2026年8月调查的百万级画像语料库相比，仅有一个其他语料库带有来源偏好属性（且为六值媒体渠道枚举），PersonaGen-1M的每画像来源列表配对了分阶段商业搜索意图标签和查询集。

Conclusion: 该语料库的主要预期用途是将商业评估画像的查询与引文溯源数据关联，但受控实证估计留作未来工作。完整语料库可应请求共享用于非商业研究，分层子集公开发布以便审查和复用协议、schema和验证流程。

Abstract: Generative engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity answer buyer questions directly and name a shortlist of brands inside the answer. Studying how brands enter or fail to enter that shortlist requires demand-side data: what buyers in a category ask, what information they need, and which sources they trust. Existing large persona corpora are built for training-data diversity and carry neither a staged search-intent label nor a preferred-sources field, so they cannot be joined to supply-side recommendation measurements. We built and validated PersonaGen-1M, a corpus of 1,031,732 synthetic buyer personas spanning 511 industry labels and 4 market contexts, carrying 19,416,821 structured behavioral attributes, 5,160,046 of them search queries. Each persona carries a single primary_intent label covering its query set (78.3% informational, 17.4% commercial, 4.3% transactional) and a preferred_sources field naming the source types that buyer would trust. The corpus was built from roughly 40 million raw persona descriptions drawn from four public datasets through GPU-accelerated MinHash LSH plus semantic deduplication, then enriched to a fixed schema. The intent field selects the commercial-evaluation personas whose queries drive recommendation, and the preferred_sources field pairs against citation-provenance data; that join is the primary intended use, and its controlled empirical estimate is future work. Among million-scale persona corpora surveyed in August 2026, one other carries a source-preference attribute, as a six-value media-channel enum; PersonaGen-1M pairs named per-persona source lists with a staged commercial search-intent label and an attached query set. The full corpus is shared on request for non-commercial research; a stratified subset is published openly so the protocol, the schema and the validation can be inspected and reused without asking us.

</details>


### [690] [The Language of the Question Selects the Market: Query Language and Exit IP as Separable Factors in Commercial Recommendations from a Generative Search Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30052)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文通过234次对照实验（跨4个出口国、6种查询语言）测查生成式搜索界面在商业查询中的市场推荐行为，发现推荐极不稳定、查询语言（而非地理位置）决定本地供应商是否出现，且语言与位置的作用可分离。负对照实验表明，真正决定因素是行业是否受国家管制，而非是否存在国内供应商。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式搜索界面回答商业问题时，其推荐的市场由模型推理之前就已决定。作者希望揭示这一"预先决定"的机制——究竟是语言、位置还是其他因素（如行业管制）决定了答案提名哪个市场的产品。

Method: 控制探针实验：对ChatGPT网页界面和OpenAI API进行234次运行，收集于2026年8月29-30日，覆盖4个出口国家、6种查询语言，每单元6次相同运行。对比浏览器界面与API（网页搜索启用/禁用），固定查询语言仅移动出口IP，以及负对照（第二类别行业）实验设计。

Result: 三个核心发现：(1) 头部推荐不稳定——6次相同运行中4/6的提示改变推荐，浏览器与API一致；(2) 查询语言（非位置）决定本地供应商是否出现——语言与国家匹配时全球品牌仅赢1/24，英语查询时爱沙尼亚和土耳其本地品牌0/6；(3) 语言和位置可分离——土耳其语从柏林、俄语从塔林查询时，答案提名所在国供应商但保持查询语言。少数语言处于中间层（俄语从爱沙尼亚4/6次提名爱沙尼亚供应商）。负对照显示该类别无语言效应，说明决定因素是行业管制而非国内供应。

Conclusion: 生成式搜索的市场推荐不是由地理位置决定，而是由查询语言主导，且语言与位置作用于不同的机制层面。更进一步，行业的"国家管制"属性（而非"国家供应"属性）才是解释该现象的关键，这为理解生成式界面中的市场偏差提供了可检验的解释框架。

Abstract: When a generative search interface answers a commercial question, which market's products it names is decided before the model reasons about the products. We report a controlled probe of 234 runs against the logged-out ChatGPT web interface and the OpenAI API, collected on 29 and 30 August 2026 across four exit countries and six query languages, with six identical runs per cell. Three results. First, the top recommendation is unstable: it changed across six identical runs on four of six prompts, and that rate was identical in the browser interface and in the API with web search both enabled and disabled, so instability is a property of the system and not of the surface. Second, query language, and not location, decides whether local suppliers appear at all. Where the query language matched the country, a global brand won 1 of 24 runs; asked in English on the same connections, local brands took 0 of 6 runs in Estonia and Turkiye. Third, language and location are separable and act on different things: holding the query language fixed and moving only the exit IP moves the market whose brands are named while the answer stays in the query language. We show this on two unrelated pairs, Turkish asked from Berlin and Russian asked from Tallinn, and in both the answer names the resident country's suppliers. A minority language occupies a middle tier: Russian asked from Estonia names an Estonian supplier in 4 of 6 runs and a global one in all six, where Estonian names a local supplier in every run and English names none. A negative control in a second category, coded with the same instrument, shows no language effect at all, and disconfirms our own expectation: that category does have domestic suppliers and none was named in any language, which points the explanation at whether a category is nationally regulated rather than at whether it is nationally supplied.

</details>


### [691] [E-SENS: Exclusion-Sensitive Penalization for Negative-Constraint Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30130)
*Yerang Kim,Jiyoon Myung,Joohyung Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出E-SENS，一种无需训练的重新排序方法，用于解决检索增强语言模型在否定约束下的检索失败问题。该方法通过提取"陷阱查询"并减去其相似度分数，有效减少被排除概念的检索命中率，同时保持召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强语言模型在面对用户明确排除的概念时，由于被排除的概念仍出现在查询文本中，稠密检索器会赋予其较高的相似度，导致检索结果违反用户的否定约束。现有的方法未能有效解决这一"否定敏感检索"问题。

Method: E-SENS是一种无训练的重新排序方法。它首先从原始查询中提取针对被排除概念的紧凑"陷阱查询"（trap query），然后从原始查询的检索分数中减去陷阱查询的相似度分数，从而降低包含被排除概念文档的排名。

Result: 在ExcluIR基准上，E-SENS在四种嵌入模型上展现了清晰的召回-违反权衡，并在保持召回率的设置下有效减少了陷阱检索（即检索到被排除概念的文档）。

Conclusion: E-SENS提供了一种简单有效的无训练方案来增强检索的否定敏感性，在不牺牲召回率的前提下显著减少了违反否定约束的检索结果。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models can fail to respect negative constraints when the retriever supplies evidence about concepts the user explicitly excluded. Beyond explicit negation, queries may ask for answers that include one concept while excluding another, or for entities that belong to a category but differ from a closely related instance. Because the excluded concept still appears in the query text, dense retrievers may assign high similarity to documents about that concept even when the user asks to avoid it. We introduce E-SENS, a training-free reranking method for negation-sensitive retrieval. E-SENS extracts a compact trap query for the excluded side and subtracts trap-query similarity from the original-query retrieval score. On ExcluIR, E-SENS shows a clear recall-violation trade-off across four embedding models and reduces trap retrieval at recall-preserving settings.

</details>


### [692] [Understanding before verifying: Claim normalization for automated citation verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30145)
*Yifan He,Mengjia Wu,Siming Deng,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出引用规范化的概念，将原始引用声明进行三种重写策略处理后再进行检索与分类，构建了CNCV（Claim-Normalized Citation Verification）三阶段框架，在18个分类器上平均提升macro F1达12%（编码器）和10%（生成式LLM）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的两阶段检索-分类框架直接处理原始引用声明，忽视了其复杂性，导致范围不匹配（scope mismatch）、视角不匹配（perspective mismatch）和命题纠缠（proposition entanglement）三个问题，这些问题增加了检索和分类的难度，限制了模型性能。

Method: 提出claim normalization（引用声明规范化），在检索和分类之前对原始引用声明应用三种重写策略，使每个下游模型执行单一且定义明确的任务；在此基础上构建CNCV三阶段框架：声明规范化、带基础依据的证据检索、引用分类；通过因子实验在18个分类器上评估。

Result: 与之前的二阶段框架相比，CNCV在编码器上平均提升macro F1 12%，在生成式LLM上提升10%；提升主要由证据质量驱动（实验中识别出的主导因素）；从自动规范化声明中检索到的证据产生的下游分类性能与人工标注证据在统计上等效。

Conclusion: 引用规范化是提升内容级引用验证的有效策略，它能解决原始引用声明复杂性带来的问题，且自动规范化方法可以达到与人工标注相当的效果，为引用验证系统的性能提升提供了可行的路径。

Abstract: Citation accuracy has been studied for decades because of its importance to research reliability. Content-level citation verification assesses the reliability of scholarly claims. Recent work adopts a two-stage retrieval-classification framework inherited from fact-checking. However, this design overlooks the complexity of the raw citing claim and introduces three issues into the verification system, namely scope mismatch, perspective mismatch, and proposition entanglement. These issues increase the difficulty of retrieval and classification, thereby limiting model performance. Motivated by this gap, we propose claim normalization, which applies three rewriting strategies to the raw citing claim before retrieval and classification, allowing each downstream model to perform a single, well-defined task. Building on this method, we develop Claim-Normalized Citation Verification (CNCV), a new three-stage framework consisting of claim normalization, evidence retrieval with grounding, and citation classification. We evaluate CNCV across 18 classifiers using a factorial experiment on human-annotated citation instances. Compared with the prior two-stage framework, CNCV improves macro F1 by an average of 12% for encoders and 10% for generative LLMs, driven by improved evidence quality, the dominant factor identified in our experiments. Evidence retrieved from automatically normalized claims yields downstream classification performance statistically equivalent to that obtained with manually annotated evidence.

</details>


### [693] [Doc-REFRAG: Rethinking Multimodal Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30163)
*Ruofan Hu,Shengyang Xu,Minjie Hong,Xiaoda Yang,Sashuai Zhou,Ke Lei,Tao Jin,Zhou Zhao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出DocLongRAG数据集（343K QA对，每对平均关联37.4张检索图像）和Doc-REFRAG框架，通过问题引导的视觉token压缩与选择性扩展机制，在多图像RAG场景中实现SOTA准确率并大幅降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态RAG模型主要针对单图像或封闭文档场景，在多图像真实场景中准确率有限；同时处理大量检索图像会产生大量无关视觉token，带来巨大的计算开销。

Method: Doc-REFRAG采用问题引导的两阶段策略：首先将视觉token压缩为粗粒度块（coarse chunks），然后通过轻量级基于强化学习的（RL-based）选择器，选择性扩展与问题相关的块，从而在保留关键信息的同时减少计算负担。

Result: 在六个基准测试上，Doc-REFRAG优于11个强基线模型，达到SOTA准确率，同时显著降低推理延迟。数据集DocLongRAG包含343K QA对，平均每个问题关联37.4张检索图像，反映真实的RAG工作流。

Conclusion: DocLongRAG数据集填补了多图像RAG场景的数据空白，Doc-REFRAG框架有效平衡了准确率与计算效率，为现实世界多图像检索增强生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Real-world knowledge resides in multimodal documents, necessitating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for accurate question answering. However, existing multimodal RAG models are primarily designed for single-image or closed-document settings and exhibit limited accuracy in realistic multi-image scenarios. Moreover, processing numerous retrieved images incurs substantial computational overhead from irrelevant visual tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce DocLongRAG, a large-scale dataset of 343K question--answer pairs, each associated with an average of 37.4 retrieved images to reflect authentic RAG workflows. Building on this dataset, we propose Doc-REFRAG, a question-guided framework that compresses visual tokens into coarse chunks and selectively expands question-relevant ones via a lightweight RL-based selector. Experiments on six benchmarks show that Doc-REFRAG outperforms eleven strong baselines, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly lower inference latency. Our resources are available at https://github.com/Collab-Gen/Doc-REFRAG.

</details>


### [694] [SetMIR: Multi-Interest Retrieval as Set Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30251)
*Xiaodong Liu,Congfei Zhang,Hsiang-wei Chao,Siman Wang,Xiao Bai,Tong Zhao,Jingxiao Ma,Wen Zhang,Zhe Liu,Shantanu Aggarwal,Di Huang,William Leach,Yunzhi Zhou,Yajun Wang,Jinchao Li,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SetMIR将多兴趣召回建模为集合预测问题，通过K个可学习查询解码用户兴趣集合，利用匈牙利匹配实现一对一的兴趣区分学习，并在服务阶段通过存在度分数和查询级NMS动态决定实际发出的ANN查询数量，在Snap DPA数据上以更少的查询量超越现有多兴趣召回方法，并显著提升生产环境的CTR和CVR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多兴趣召回方法存在两个核心问题：(1) 兴趣坍缩(interest collapse)，即不同的嵌入向量学到了相同的兴趣，导致多样性丧失；(2) 静态调度(static dispatch)，即服务时总是使用固定的召回预算，即使某些嵌入并不必要，造成计算浪费。

Method: SetMIR将多兴趣召回视为集合预测问题。具体而言：使用Transformer编码用户行为历史，通过K个可学习的查询(query)解码出一组用户兴趣，每个兴趣产生一个召回嵌入和一个存在度分数(presence score)。训练时采用匈牙利匹配(Hungarian matching)将目标与查询进行一对一的分配，使匹配到的查询学习到不同的兴趣，同时存在度head学习哪些查询是活跃的。服务时，利用存在度分数和查询级非极大值抑制(NMS)只发出活跃且不冗余的ANN查询。

Result: 在Snap的Dynamic Product Ads (DPA)数据上，SetMIR在所有指标上优于四种学习型多兴趣召回方法，同时每个请求发出的ANN查询量减少了33%。部署到DPA生产栈后，整体CVR提升3.1%；与使用相同物品嵌入、ANN索引和召回配额的商品到商品召回源相比，CTR提升44%，CVR提升51%。

Conclusion: SetMIR通过将多兴趣召回形式化为集合预测问题，有效解决了兴趣坍缩与静态调度两大缺陷，不仅在离线实验中全面优于现有方法，还在真实生产环境中带来了显著的业务指标提升，验证了该方法在工业推荐系统中的实用价值。

Abstract: Embedding-based retrieval is at the core of industrial recommender systems, but a single user embedding is often too limited to capture a user's diverse interests. Multi-interest retrieval addresses this by using multiple user embeddings, yet existing methods still suffer from two issues: interest collapse, where different embeddings learn the same interest, and static dispatch, where serving uses a fixed retrieval budget even when some embeddings are unnecessary. We propose SetMIR, which treats multi-interest retrieval as a set prediction problem. SetMIR encodes a user's behavior history with a transformer and uses K learnable queries to decode a set of user interests, each producing a retrieval embedding and a presence score. During training, Hungarian matching assigns targets to queries one-to-one, so matched queries learn distinct interests and the presence head learns which queries are active. At serving time, SetMIR uses presence scores and query-level Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) to issue only active, non-redundant ANN queries. On Snap's Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) data, SetMIR outperforms four learned multi-interest retrievers on every metric while issuing 33% fewer ANN queries per request. Deployed as a new retrieval source in the DPA production stack, SetMIR lifts overall CVR by 3.1%, while lifting CTR by 44% and CVR by 51% over the item-to-item retrieval source with the same item embeddings, ANN index, and retrieval quota.

</details>


### [695] [CAMIE: Co-Engagement-Aware Multimodal Item Embeddings for Snap Dynamic Product Ads Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30255)
*Xiaodong Liu,Siman Wang,Congfei Zhang,Hsiang-wei Chao,Xiao Bai,Wen Zhang,Jingxiao Ma,Zhe Liu,Yunzhi Zhou,Yajun Wang,Jinchao Li,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: CAMIE是一个面向Snap动态产品广告（DPA）的协同参与感知多模态物品嵌入框架，基于LLM/MLLM骨干网络，通过协同参与物品对微调（in-batch InfoNCE目标）统一了视觉、文本和多模态检索，在生产环境中部署后显著提升了CTR和CVR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: I2I检索面临两大挑战：分离的视觉、文本和多模态编码器导致检索栈碎片化；仅基于内容训练无法使嵌入与驱动下游转化的协同参与行为对齐。

Method: CAMIE基于LLM/MLLM骨干网络，利用其原生多模态接口将物品图像和元数据映射到共享嵌入空间；随后使用从用户旅程中挖掘的协同参与物品对，通过对称的in-batch InfoNCE目标对骨干网络进行微调。

Result: 离线实验中，CAMIE在Recall@10上优于最强商业多模态嵌入模型，文本检索质量损失极小。在线实验中，相比多模态对照组CTR提升+0.390%、CVR提升+10.832%；相比文本对照组CTR提升+18.958%、CVR提升+13.12%；整体DPA流量CTR提升+0.211%、CVR提升+1.911%。

Conclusion: CAMIE作为生产环境中的即插即用替代方案，成功部署于两个内容型I2I编码器，验证了多模态统一检索与协同参与对齐的有效性，已在生产环境上线。

Abstract: Item-to-item (I2I) retrieval is a core primitive in large-scale recommendation and advertising systems. In production Snap Dynamic Product Ads (DPA), I2I retrieval faces two challenges: separate visual, textual, and multimodal encoders fragment the retrieval stack, and content-only training does not align embeddings with the co-engagement behavior that drives downstream conversions. We present CAMIE, a co-engagement-aware multimodal item embedding framework for Snap DPA retrieval. CAMIE builds on LLM/MLLM backbones, using their native multimodal interfaces to represent item images and metadata in a shared embedding space. It then fine-tunes the backbone on co-engaged item pairs mined from user journeys with a symmetric in-batch InfoNCE objective. Offline, CAMIE outperforms the strongest commercial multimodal embedding model on Recall@10 and serves text-only retrieval from the same checkpoint with minimal quality loss. Online, CAMIE serves as a drop-in replacement for two deployed content-based I2I encoders, delivering +0.390% CTR / +10.832% CVR over the multimodal control, +18.958% CTR / +13.12% CVR over the text control, and +0.211% CTR / +1.911% CVR on overall DPA traffic. CAMIE is deployed in production.

</details>


### [696] [PEARL: Front-Loading Relational Chains for Multi-Hop Table Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30291)
*Subeen Ho,Hyeongu Kang,SeongKu Kang,Susik Yoon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PEARL是一个无需训练的表检索框架，通过纵向分区（垂直分区）的子表编码来捕捉跨表连接语义。它在离线阶段生成多跳查询并重组相关列，在3跳查询上相比现有方法最高提升30.05%的R@2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的表检索方法依赖整表表示，忽略了真实世界中由连接关系（join relationships）产生的跨表语义，导致在多表关联场景下检索效果不佳。

Method: PEARL采用训练无关（training-free）框架，基于预识别的连接路径离线生成多跳查询，并将相关列重组为垂直分区的语料单元（vertical partitioned corpus units），实现无需查询时LLM推理的多表检索。

Result: PEARL在实验中一致优于现有方法，在3跳查询中R@2指标上取得最高+30.05%的提升。

Conclusion: PEARL通过垂直分区子表编码有效解决了多表检索中的跨表语义问题，且无需训练和查询时的LLM推理，具有高效性和实用性。

Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in tabular reasoning, retrieving relevant tables remains challenging due to the fragmented and relational structure of real-world data. Existing work typically relies on whole table representations that overlook cross-table semantics induced by join relationships. We propose PEARL, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm toward vertical partitioning-based sub-table encoding. PEARL augments the retrieval corpus offline by generating multi-hop queries over pre-identified join paths and reorganizing relevant columns into vertically partitioned corpus units, enabling effective multi-table retrieval without query-time LLM inference. Experiments show that PEARL consistently outperforms existing methods, with up to +30.05% gains in R@2 on 3-hop queries. The source code is available at https://github.com/SOOB2NHO/PEARL.

</details>


### [697] [Beyond Ranking Accuracy: Evaluating LLM-Cited Feature Rationales for Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30333)
*Yanan Cao,Anay Dombe,Murali Mohana Krishna Dandu,Shreeranjani Srirangamsridharan,Sinduja Subramaniam,Yogananth Mahalingam,Evren Korpeoglu,Kannan Achan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在"下次购物篮"回购推荐中的双重角色：作为评分器（ranker）和作为解释器（explainer）。研究发现，现成的LLM作为独立评分器在排名准确性上无法与监督学习模型竞争，但作为解释组件时，在某些数据集和提示设置下可以提供有结果的归因信号，尽管效果因数据集而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际生产环境中，回购推荐的评估不仅限于排名准确性，用户同样需要简洁的人类可读证据来解释"为什么现在推荐这个商品"。LLM有望通过基于可解释行为特征的自然语言推理来提供这种证据，但其在这种场景下的实用价值尚未被系统评估。

Method: 构建了涵盖购买节奏、频率、最近购买时间、用户行为和商品流行度等多维度的回购特征。在两个公开杂货数据集和一个专有零售数据集上，评估LLM作为next-basket评分器相对于启发式方法和监督排序模型的性能。同时，通过跨模型特征掩蔽协议，比较LLM引用的特征与模型特定的归因方法在排名退化方面的影响。

Result: LLM评分在排名性能上无法与监督排序模型竞争，因此不适合作为独立的回购推荐器。但在某些设置下，改变提示和证据表示方式可以改善基于结果的特征掩蔽结果，即使排名性能没有提升；这种效果因数据集而异，且并非始终与归因基线一致。

Conclusion: LLM的实用角色应定位为经过验证的解释组件而非主要排序器。理由质量（rationale quality）应与排名准确性分开评估，从而为LLM在推荐系统中的定位提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Next-basket repurchase recommendation is commonly formulated as a ranking task: given a customer's purchase history, the system ranks previously purchased items that may be needed again. In production settings, however, ranking accuracy is only one component of recommendation quality. Customers may also benefit from concise evidence about why an item is recommended now. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential way to surface such evidence through feature-based, human-readable rationales grounded in interpretable behavioral signals. We construct repurchase features spanning cadence, frequency, recency, user behavior, and item popularity, and evaluate LLMs on two public grocery datasets and one proprietary retail dataset. We investigate (1) whether off-the-shelf LLMs can use these features as next-basket scorers relative to heuristic and supervised rankers, and (2) whether LLM-cited features carry outcome-grounded ranking signal. For the latter, we compare LLM-cited features with model-specific attribution methods under a cross-model feature-masking protocol that measures ranking degradation after masking selected features. Our results show that LLM scores are not competitive with supervised rankers, suggesting that off-the-shelf LLMs should not be used as standalone repurchase recommenders. However, changes in prompt and evidence representation can improve outcome-grounded feature-masking results in some settings even when ranking performance does not improve; the effect is dataset-dependent and does not consistently match attribution baselines. These findings suggest a practical role for LLMs as validated explanation components rather than primary rankers, with rationale quality evaluated separately from ranking accuracy.

</details>


### [698] [HF-SID: High-Fidelity Semantic IDs for Generative Retrieval in Location-Based Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30479)
*Haowen Lin,Jing Li,Zhibin Hao,Fangye Wang,Lihui Su,Song Yang,Xiaojiang Zhou,Pengjie Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出HF-SID，在生成式检索的表示阶段恢复地理、数值和结构保真度，解决现有Semantic ID（SID）模糊化细粒度差异的问题，使用3-token SID而无需额外解码成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于位置的生成式检索中，SID是POI信息到达生成模型的唯一通道，但现有SID存在三个缺陷：(1) LLM对连续坐标的嵌入不连续，数值差异无法反映真实地理距离；(2) 动态数值属性尺度差异大，相同差距对不同属性意义不同；(3) 短文本无法传达层级归属，文本相似的POI可能属于不同层级。这些问题导致现有SID模糊了LBS检索敏感的细粒度差异，且一旦信息未被保留则在解码时不可恢复。

Method: HF-SID在表示阶段（信息被提交到离散码之前）恢复三种保真度：(1) 将坐标转换为连续3D笛卡尔形式；(2) 将每个数值编码为单个单元，通过Geo-CPT和Num-CPT在LLM内结合类型感知嵌入进行整合；(3) 仅应用于最后一层残差的基于结构的对比学习目标，用于分离共享粗粒度标签但细粒度不同的共定位POI。这些机制丰富表示而非延长标识符，使用3-token SID且无额外解码成本。

Result: 该论文在大规模工业数据集上进行了实验（摘要被截断，未展示具体数字），但表明HF-SID在保持3-token SID且无额外解码成本的前提下，有效恢复了地理、数值和结构保真度。

Conclusion: HF-SID通过在表示阶段而非标识符层面增强信息保真度，在不增加解码成本的情况下提升了生成式检索中POI的细粒度区分能力，为LBS生成式检索提供了一种更高效的信息表示方案。

Abstract: Generative retrieval has attracted increasing attention in Location-Based Services (LBS), where each Point-of-Interest (POI) is represented as a Semantic ID (SID). As the SID is the only channel through which POI information reaches the generative model, whatever it fails to preserve is irrecoverable at decoding time, and LBS retrieval is especially sensitive to the fine-grained differences that existing SIDs blur. Specifically, (1) LLMs embed continuous coordinates discontinuously, so their numeric differences do not reflect true geographic distance; (2) dynamic numerical attributes differ vastly in scale, so an identical gap may be decisive for one attribute yet negligible for another; and (3) short text cannot convey hierarchical affiliation, as text-similar POIs may belong to different hierarchies. We therefore propose HF-SID, which restores geographic, numerical, and structural fidelity at the representation stage, before any information is committed to a discrete code. It transforms coordinates into a continuous 3D Cartesian form and encodes each numerical value as a single unit, consolidated inside the LLM by Geo-CPT and Num-CPT with type-aware embeddings; a Structure-based Contrastive Learning objective, applied only to the last-layer residual, then separates co-located POIs that share a coarse tag but differ at the fine level. Because these mechanisms enrich the representation rather than lengthen the identifier, HF-SID uses a 3-token SID at no extra decoding cost. On a large-scale industrial

</details>


### [699] [Local-to-Global Sentence-Level Graph Reranking for Scientific Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30525)
*Zheng Dou,Zhao Zhang,Hao Geng,Ningjing Wang,Deqing Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出LoG-Reranker，一个局部到全局的句子级图重排序框架，用于科学文献综合合成任务，通过角色感知的局部评分和句子图上的全局关系建模，改善重排序结果并提升生成的综合质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重排序器大多在段落层面操作，导致关键的方法论、实证和比较信息被埋在冗长扁平的内容中，削弱了生成内容的依据性；同时现有重排序器主要依赖独立的查询-候选评分，忽略了科学候选文档之间的互补、上下文和对比关系，限制了信息覆盖率和综合结果的全面性。

Method: LoG-Reranker采用两阶段框架：(1) 角色感知的局部评分，识别细粒度的、与查询相关的句子；(2) 在跨候选集的句子图上建模句子间关系，进行全局句子排名精炼。最后将排名靠前的句子及其连接邻居组织为结构化输入上下文，供生成器使用。

Result: 在科学综合合成和重排序基准上的大量实验表明，LoG-Reranker持续优于竞争性的重排序器，产生更可靠的排名并提升生成综合的质量。

Conclusion: LoG-Reranker通过句子级粒度建模和利用候选文档之间的关系，有效解决了现有重排序器在科学合成任务中的粒度不足和关系建模缺失问题，为检索增强的科学综合合成提供了更可靠的支撑。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented scientific synthesis aims to answer complex research questions by integrating information from multiple papers into comprehensive and well-grounded responses. Since the generator can only synthesize the information selected and organized by the reranker, the quality of the generated synthesis depends critically on the reranked results. However, most rerankers operate at the passage level, which leaves key methodological, empirical, and comparative information buried in long and flat contexts, weakening the grounding of generated claims. Moreover, existing rerankers mainly rely on independent query-candidate scoring which overlooks complementary, contextual, and contrasting relations across scientific candidates, limiting information coverage and the comprehensiveness of the resulting synthesis. To address these limitations, we propose LoG-Reranker, a local-to-global sentence-level graph reranking framework for scientific synthesis. LoG-Reranker performs role-aware local scoring to identify fine-grained, query-relevant sentences and then models their relations on a sentence graph across the candidate set to globally refine sentence rankings. Top-ranked sentences and their connected neighbors are organized into a structured input context for generator to produce more grounded and comprehensive synthesis.Extensive experiments on scientific synthesis and reranking benchmarks show that LoG-Reranker consistently outperforms competitive rerankers, yielding more reliable rankings and improving the quality of generated synthesis.

</details>


### [700] [Preference Shapes Relevance: Cross-component Hierarchical Semantic Alignment for Personalized Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30553)
*Gaoming Zhang,Angqing Jiang,Jianchun Song,Kena Qi,Dayao Chen,Wei Lin,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CHAP框架，通过跨组件层次语义对齐解决生成式检索中静态语义ID与动态查询意图不匹配、缺乏用户行为建模以及推理延迟高的问题，在多个数据集和线上测试中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式检索(GR)存在三个核心问题：1) 仅基于物品内容推导的语义ID(SIDs)存在语义鸿沟，无法将动态查询意图与静态物品表示对齐；2) 当前生成范式很少建模用户行为序列；3) 束搜索自回归解码导致高推理延迟成为性能瓶颈。

Method: 1) 设计层次语义对齐模块，将查询的潜在空间与物品的量化路径对齐，并同步多粒度语义；2) 构建个性化GR框架，协同离散SIDs提供结构引导与连续表示进行细粒度语义精炼来建模用户行为；3) 引入残差级联生成机制，将多步Transformer解码器限制为单次推理，提升吞吐量同时减少信息损失。

Result: 在三个公开数据集、一个专有工业数据集以及线上A/B测试中均证明了CHAP的优越性，验证了方法的有效性和实际应用价值。

Conclusion: CHAP从层次化视角全面解决了生成式检索的语义对齐、个性化建模和推理效率三大挑战，实验证明其在实际工业场景中具有实用价值。

Abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm by mapping queries directly to Semantic IDs (SIDs) with powerful representation capabilities for candidate items. However, existing SIDs derived solely from item content create a semantic gap, failing to align dynamic query intents with static item representations. Furthermore, current generative paradigms rarely model user behavior sequences and are always bottlenecked by the high inference latency of beam-search autoregressive decoding. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{C}$ross-component $\textbf{H}$ierarchical semantic $\textbf{A}$lignment for $\textbf{P}$ersonalized generative retrieval ($\textbf{CHAP}$), a novel personalized GR framework from a hierarchical perspective. First, we design a Hierarchical Semantic Alignment module to align query's latent space with item's quantization path and synchronize multi-granular semantics. Second, we construct a personalized GR framework that models user behavior by synergizing discrete SIDs for structural guidance and continuous representations for fine-grained semantic refinement. Notably, we introduce a Residual Cascading Generation mechanism to restrict the costly multi-step Transformer Decoder to a single-pass inference, boosting inference throughput while mitigating information loss. Extensive experiments on three public datasets, one proprietary industrial dataset, and online A/B tests demonstrate CHAP's superiority, validating the effectiveness and practical value of our approach. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zzzgm/CHAP.

</details>


### [701] [Generative Retrieval for E-commerce: Jointly Learning Embedding and Codebook with Same Product Cluster](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30606)
*Songtao Fang,Zihao Xu,Shaowei Wei,Jin Zhang,Zhuojun Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种联合训练嵌入模型和码本的生成式检索方法，通过引入产品聚类信息作为额外监督信号，解决了电商场景中两阶段训练策略导致的错误累积和码本学习缺乏交互建模两大问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电商生成式检索方法采用两阶段训练策略（先训练产品嵌入模型，再学习映射到产品ID的码本），存在两个主要问题：(1) 错误累积——第一阶段嵌入模型产生有偏表示时，第二阶段码本无法纠正这些错误；(2) 码本学习仅依赖产品嵌入，缺乏对查询-产品和产品-产品交互的建模，导致同一聚类的产品可能被分配不一致的ID，损害检索精度。

Method: 提出一种联合训练方法，同时训练嵌入模型和码本，并将相同产品聚类信息作为额外的监督信号引入训练过程，以增强查询-产品及产品-产品之间的交互建模。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了电商检索性能，同时改善了嵌入学习和码本学习的效果。

Conclusion: 联合训练策略配合聚类监督信号能有效缓解级联训练带来的错误传播问题，并提升生成式检索在电商场景中的整体表现。

Abstract: With the development of large language models (LLMs), generative retrieval is becoming increasingly important in e-commerce scenarios. Current mainstream approaches typically use a two-stage training strategy: first train a product embedding model, and then learn a codebook that maps embeddings to product IDs. This cascaded approach suffers from two major issues: (1) error accumulation-if the embedding model in the first stage produces biased representations, the codebook in the second stage cannot correct these errors, degrading final retrieval performance; and (2) codebook learning relies solely on product embeddings and lacks modeling of query-to-product and product-to-product interactions. As a result, products belonging to the same cluster may be assigned inconsistent IDs by the codebook, further hurting retrieval accuracy. To address these problems, we propose a novel method that jointly trains the embedding model and the codebook, and incorporates same product cluster information as an additional supervision signal. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves e-commerce retrieval performance while simultaneously enhancing both embedding and codebook learning.

</details>


### [702] [Learning from What You Retrieve: Online RL Fine-Tuning for Semantic Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30753)
*Shaowei Wei,Chong Huang,Songtao Fang,Jin Zhang,Zhuojun Wang,Chengfu Huo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出PAO（Positive-Advantage-Only）选择性强化学习优化方法，解决大规模电商检索中双编码器检索器与下游重排序器目标不匹配的问题。PAO仅在正优势项上施加梯度更新，避免在冻结的高维空间中无差别惩罚负样本导致的嵌入几何退化，在工业数据集和公开基准上均显著优于标准RL和蒸馏基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双编码器检索器优化对比相似度，而下游重排序器捕捉细粒度相关性偏好，两者目标不匹配限制了端到端检索质量。虽然强化学习可通过奖励模型反馈来调整检索器，但标准策略梯度更新会破坏嵌入几何结构，尤其在工业场景下文档索引必须冻结时问题更为突出。

Method: 提出PAO方法：通过分析发现，在冻结的高维空间中对负样本进行无差别惩罚（推远）会破坏预训练语义流形。PAO选择性地仅对具有正优势的检索项施加梯度更新，将查询嵌入拉向高奖励区域，同时保持全局拓扑稳定性。

Result: 在大型工业数据集和公开基准上的实验均表明，PAO显著优于标准强化学习和蒸馏基线。

Conclusion: 选择性正优势更新的强化学习策略能够有效缓解检索器与重排序器之间的目标不匹配，同时避免冻结索引下的嵌入空间退化问题。

Abstract: In large-scale e-commerce retrieval, dual-encoder retrievers are op- timized for contrastive similarity, whereas downstream rerankers capture finer-grained relevance preferences; this objective mis- match limits end-to-end retrieval quality. Reinforcement Learning offers a way to use reward-model feedback for retriever adaptation, but we observe that standard policy-gradient updates can degrade embedding geometry, especially when the document index must remain frozen due to industrial constraints. To address this, we propose PAO (Positive-Advantage-Only), a selective RL optimization method. Our analysis reveals that in- discriminate penalization of negative samples (pushing away) in a frozen high-dimensional space disrupts pre-trained semantic man- ifolds. PAO selectively applies gradient updates only to retrieved items with positive advantages, effectively pulling query embed- dings toward high-reward regions while preserving global topo- logical stability. Experiments on both a massive industrial dataset and public benchmarks demonstrate that PAO significantly outper- forms standard RL and distillation baselines.

</details>


### [703] [MULTI3IR: A Benchmark for Multi-perspective Multi-domain Multi-modal Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30949)
*Seokwon Song,Sohyeon Kim,Gunhee Kim*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出Multi³IR基准，用于评估检索器对开放式查询多视角覆盖的能力，涵盖多样领域和模态；同时提出SPIN方法，通过参数和标签高效的方式学习噪声向量来引导嵌入向量向多样且有意义的语义方向偏移，实验表明现有多模态检索器存在单视角偏差，而SPIN显著提升视角覆盖率并泛化良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信息检索基准主要聚焦于封闭式查询，即便是开放式查询基准，其支持文档也大多局限于单一主题领域和单一模态，无法评测检索器对开放式查询多面视角的覆盖能力。

Method: 构建Multi³IR基准，包含104.9K条Stack Exchange查询，并为每条查询标注视角描述以捕捉其隐含的观点；提出SPIN方法，通过学习噪声向量以参数和标签高效的方式将嵌入向量引导至多样且语义有意义的多个方向。

Result: 实验显示现有多模态检索器存在单视角偏置问题，SPIN在Multi³IR上显著提升视角覆盖率，并能良好泛化到未见的开放式IR基准。

Conclusion: SPIN有效缓解了检索器的单视角偏置问题，Multi³IR为开放式多视角、跨领域跨模态的检索评估提供了新基准。

Abstract: Information retrieval (IR) increasingly targets open-ended queries that admit diverse perspectives. Existing IR benchmarks, however, focus primarily on closed-ended queries, while even open-ended benchmarks largely consist of queries whose supporting documents span a single subject domain and modality. We introduce Multi$^3$IR, a benchmark that evaluates how well retrievers cover the multifaceted perspectives of open-ended queries across diverse domains and modalities. It comprises 104.9K Stack Exchange queries, each annotated with perspective descriptions that capture the query's implicit viewpoints. We further propose SPIN, a parameter- and label-efficient method that learns noise vectors to steer embeddings toward diverse yet meaningful semantic directions. Experiments show that existing multimodal retrievers suffer from single-perspective bias, while SPIN substantially improves perspective coverage on Multi$^3$IR and generalizes well to unseen open-ended IR benchmarks. The dataset and experimental code are available at https://github.com/seokwon99/Multi3IR.

</details>

### [704] [Event-Driven Language Models with Sparse Neural Activity for Neuromorphic Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30439)
*Simon Richter,Ruhai Lin,Jason Yik,Taylor Kergan,Rui-Jie Zhu,Farshad Moradi,Jason Eshraghian*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在重度量化线性注意力模型中引入稀疏神经活动的方法，通过可训练阈值（±Δ）将低于阈值的激活归零，同时保留关键异常值，在保持与密集模型相当性能的同时减少高达4倍的算术运算。在事件驱动的多核多芯片神经形态平台上，相比边缘GPU上的Transformer推理，可实现高达37倍吞吐量提升和16倍功耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer架构的KV缓存和二次方注意力代价限制了LLM推理性能；虽然SSM通过线性注意力和固定大小的循环状态缓解了这一问题，但其密集线性投影即使经过量化后计算成本仍然很高，需要进一步降低计算开销。

Method: 提出一种在重度量化的线性注意力模型中诱导稀疏神经活动的方法：设置每个投影层独立的可训练阈值（±Δ），将低于阈值的激活置零，同时保留关键的离群值激活，从而在不显著损失性能的前提下将无效算术操作消除。

Result: 该方法在性能与密集模型相当的情况下，将有效算术操作减少至1/4。在事件驱动的多核多芯片神经形态平台上，相比边缘GPU上的同类Transformer推理，吞吐量提升高达37倍，功耗降低16倍；相比未稀疏化的基线提升达5.4倍。

Conclusion: 稀疏量化线性注意力模型是事件驱动多核平台上部署LLM的自然选择，因为神经形态架构能将非结构化稀疏性转化为计算和通信层面的吞吐量优势，而这是GPU架构所不具备的能力。

Abstract: Inference with transformer-based large language models (LLMs) is often limited by the memory-bound KV cache and quadratic attention cost. State-space models (SSMs) mitigate this through linear attention and fixed-size recurrent states, but their large dense linear projections remain computationally expensive even after quantization. We introduce a method that induces sparse neural activity in heavily quantized linear-attention models with minimal performance loss. Activations below a per-projection trainable threshold ($\pm Δ$) are nullified while preserving crucial outliers, achieving comparable performance to dense models with up to 4$\times$ fewer effective arithmetic operations. Targeting a multi-core, multi-chip neuromorphic platform, where event-driven execution converts unstructured sparsity into throughput at both the compute and communication levels, a capability GPU architectures fundamentally lack, we project up to 37$\times$ higher throughput and 16$\times$ lower power versus edge GPU inference of a comparable transformer-based model, and up to 5.4$\times$ improvements over the non-sparsified baseline. These results position sparse, quantized linear-attention models as a natural fit for deploying LLMs on event-driven multi-core platforms.

</details>


### [705] [Conjoint Audio-to-Spikes Encoding and Processing for Efficient Neuromorphic Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30792)
*Valentin M. Meunier,Amélie Gruel,Pierre Lewden,Adrien F. Vincent,Sylvain Saïghi*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于FPGA的可编程、非学习型神经形态音频编码器，并对其进行了端到端评估。通过联合优化编码器和脉冲神经网络分类器，该方法在Heidelberg Digits数据集上达到99.77%的分类准确率，超越了当前神经形态基准的先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经形态传感器与脉冲神经网络结合可降低AI能耗，但原生神经形态数据集稀缺，现有高度仿生的模拟器难以在数字硬件上实现。需要一个高效、可硬件实现的音频到脉冲编码方案。

Method: 提出一种非学习型、高层可编程的音频神经形态编码器，目标在FPGA上实现；使用基于脉冲活动数量的硬件无关指标评估流水线效率；联合优化编码器与分类器，以在较低能耗下获得更好的学习与推理性能。

Result: 首次对TIMIT数据集进行端到端神经形态脉冲编码与评估；简单前馈网络在脉冲编码的Heidelberg Digits数据集上达到99.77%的分类准确率，超越神经形态先进水平。

Conclusion: 通过编码器与分类器的协同优化，可以在降低能耗的同时提升神经形态音频分类性能，验证了可编程硬件友好型编码器的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Obtaining data from neuromorphic sensors and processing it with Spiking Neural Networks is a promising solution to lower the energy cost of artificial intelligence. The current rarity of natively neuromorphic datasets promotes the development of software tools to translate input sensory data into spikes. However, highly bio-mimetic simulators can be challenging to implement on digital hardware. In this work, we evaluate the neuromorphic encoding and subsequent classification of audio into spikes using a non-learnable, high-level, programmable encoder targeting hardware implementation on FPGA. We quantify the pipeline's efficiency with hardware-agnostic metrics based on the quantitative spiking activity. Our study focuses on the simultaneous optimisation of encoder and classifier: the first provides efficient and informative data so that the latter achieves a better performance with an overall lower energy cost at learning and inference. This work introduces the first end-to-end neuromorphic spike-encoding and evaluation of the TIMIT dataset. Our simple feedforward network reaches a classification accuracy of 99.77% on a spike-encoded Heidelberg Digits, overcoming the neuromorphic state of the art on this benchmark dataset.

</details>

### [706] [Networked Multi-Resource Defense Capabilities in a General Lotto Game](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28732)
*Faezeh Shojaeighadikolaei,Keith Paarporn*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多资源分配问题的General Lotto博弈模型，其中防御者拥有多种类型的防御资源，其有效性通过网络权重矩阵表征。作者推导了防御者性能的上下界，并通过数值实验证明其紧致性；在两种攻击类型的情形下解析证明了界重合，建立了精确均衡刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统的安全防护需要将多种防御资源战略性地分配以应对不同类型的攻击。现有研究多假设防御资源独立应对特定攻击类型，但现实中防御资产往往具有异构能力，能够以不同效率应对多种攻击。因此需要一种能够刻画资源与攻击类型之间复杂关联的多资源分配模型。

Method: 将多资源分配问题建模为General Lotto博弈，引入网络权重矩阵描述不同防御资源对各种攻击类型的有效程度。通过博弈论分析推导防御者性能的上下界，并在两种攻击类型的特殊情形下证明上下界重合以获得精确均衡解。

Result: 推导出防御者性能的上下界，数值证据表明界是紧的；在两种攻击类型情况下解析证明了界重合，给出精确均衡刻画；与现有独立防御基准相比，所提出的网络化多资源架构在数值上表现出更优性能。

Conclusion: 多攻击类型防御问题存在基础且可处理的结构，网络化多资源分配架构能够更有效地利用防御资源的异构能力，为实际安全资源配置提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Ensuring the security of complex systems involves the strategic allocation of defensive resources to prevent various types of attacks from succeeding. A defender often has multiple types of defensive assets at its disposal, where it must decide how to optimally deploy their heterogeneous capabilities across different attack types. In this paper, we formulate a multi-resource allocation problem in the form of a General Lotto game where a defender possesses various types of resources. A feature that we introduce is that their individual effectiveness against different types of attacks is characterized by a network weight matrix. In our analysis, we derive upper and lower bounds on the performance of the defender, and provide numerical evidence suggesting that they are tight. For the case of two attack types, we analytically prove that the bounds coincide, establishing an exact equilibrium characterization. We then numerically compare our proposed networked multi-resource architecture to an independent-defense benchmark from the existing literature. These results highlight fundamental and tractable structures underlying multi-attack-type defense problems.

</details>


### [707] [Peer Oversight in Collective Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28754)
*Sarah Mohsen,Pavel Naumov*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出了"同伴k监督"（peer k-oversight）这一顺序集体决策机制的性质，要求每个有害结果至少有k个代理负责。研究表明，如果可以通过重新分配机制中的决策控制权来实现k监督，那么仅需k个代理即可实现。文章还提出了一个多项式时间算法，用于判断此类重新分配是否存在，并在存在时构造之。这些结果确立了同伴监督作为多代理决策系统的一个可处理的设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多代理决策系统中，确保有害结果的责任归属是一个关键问题。作者希望建立一种可验证、可计算的设计原则，即"同伴k监督"，以保证每个有害结果都有足够多的代理（至少k个）共同承担责任，从而防止单个代理能够对不利结果负全责或逃避责任。

Method: 作者形式化定义了peer k-oversight性质，并研究了在顺序集体决策机制中通过重新分配控制权来实现该性质的可能性。核心贡献是理论证明（若可实现k监督，则只需k个代理即可实现）以及一个多项式时间算法来判定重新分配是否存在并构造之。

Result: 证明了一个关键性质：当k-oversight可以通过重新分配控制权实现时，使用恰好k个代理就足够了。同时给出了多项式时间算法来判定是否存在这样的重新分配，并在存在时构造出具体方案。

Conclusion: 这些结果证明了同伴监督（peer oversight）是一个可计算、可处理的多代理决策系统设计原则，为在复杂决策环境中实现责任分散和有害结果防范提供了理论基础和实用工具。

Abstract: This article introduces peer $k$-oversight, a property of sequential collective decision mechanisms requiring at least $k$ agents to be responsible for every harmful outcome. It is shown that whenever $k$-oversight can be achieved by redistributing control over the decisions in a mechanism, it can be achieved using just $k$ agents. A polynomial-time algorithm is also presented that determines whether such a redistribution exists and, when it does, constructs one. These results establish peer oversight as a tractable design principle for multiagent decision-making systems.

</details>


### [708] [The Art of Calling the Winner by Asking Just Enough Questions: Competitive Preference Elicitation with Next-Best Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29087)
*Nisarg Shah,Ziqi Yu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究主动式偏好查询（active elicitation）在集体决策中的应用，针对投票规则下如何高效揭示胜者的问题。作者提出"下一最优查询"（next-best query）模型，并分析竞争比（competitive ratio）。研究表明许多位置评分规则可实现次线性竞争比，而所有Condorcet一致性规则的最坏竞争比为线性。针对Borda计数，提出了层次剪枝（level-wise pruning）和多尺度分数阈值（multi-scale score thresholding）两种技术，后者提供O(√m)的最坏情况保证，并在真实数据上展示了优良经验性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在集体决策中，获取代理（agent）对所有备选方案完整偏好的代价高昂。主动查询（active elicitation）旨在通过有选择性地提问来减少信息收集成本。然而，已有工作缺乏对"最少查询次数"与算法实际查询次数之间差距的系统性理论刻画，尤其是针对不同投票规则的最坏情况分析尚属空白。

Method: 本文提出next-best查询模型，代理每次只需揭示其下一个最喜欢的备选方案。作者定义了竞争比（最小查询次数与算法查询次数的比值），并针对两类投票规则展开分析：位置评分规则（如Borda计数）和Condorcet一致性规则。对Borda计数，设计了两种互补技术：层次剪枝（level-wise pruning），适用于一般凹评分规则的分析；多尺度分数阈值（multi-scale score thresholding），提供O(√m)的最坏情况保证。

Result: 理论结果表明：许多位置评分规则可以实现次线性竞争比，而所有Condorcet一致性规则的竞争比在m（备选方案数量）上呈线性。Borda计数通过多尺度分数阈值技术达到O(√m)的最坏情况保证。层次剪枝方法在真实数据上展示了强经验性能。

Conclusion: 主动偏好查询的可行性高度依赖于投票规则的选择：位置评分规则（特别是Borda计数）在查询效率上具有显著优势，而Condorcet一致性规则本质上需要大量查询。这为实际集体决策系统的设计提供了重要指导——若追求查询效率，应优先选择具有次线性竞争比的位置评分类规则。

Abstract: We study active elicitation of agent preferences for collectively choosing among $m$ alternatives using prominent voting rules. We focus on the next-best query model, in which an agent responds to a query by revealing their next favorite alternative, and measure the competitive ratio, which is the worst-case ratio between the number of queries made by the active elicitation algorithm and the minimum number of queries needed to reveal the winning alternative(s) in hindsight. We show that sublinear competitive ratios are achievable for many positional scoring rules, whereas every Condorcet-consistent rule has competitive ratio linear in $m$. For Borda count, we develop two complementary techniques: level-wise pruning, whose analysis extends to general concave scoring rules, and multi-scale score thresholding, which gives an $O(\sqrt m)$ worst-case guarantee for Borda. We also demonstrate strong empirical performance of level-wise pruning on real data.

</details>


### [709] [Optimally Selecting Representative Agents from a Metric Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29097)
*Benjamin Cookson,Eva Deltl,Yeeseok Oh*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了比例公平聚类问题，目标是选择k个中心在度量空间中公平地代表一组智能体。具体地，关注满足Droop核心公平性质的聚类。在可行中心位置包含所有智能体位置的实际特殊情形下，之前的已知最好结果保证了(1+√2)-近似Droop核心，而已知最佳下界为2。本文证明该下界是紧的，并证明2-Droop核心聚类总是存在，且只需从智能体所在位置选择中心即可实现。该证明基于Scarf定理（平衡非转移效用博弈中非空核心的存在性）。该结果有几个重要推论，最值得注意的是解决了Aronov等人提出的β-plurality问题（针对一般度量空间）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在比例公平聚类中，Droop核心是衡量公平性的重要性质。此前关于该性质的近似保证（上界(1+√2)与下界2之间存在差距），本文希望通过填补这一间隙来获得更精确的理解，并解决相关的开放问题（如β-plurality问题）。

Method: 作者利用Scarf定理（保证平衡非转移效用博弈存在非空核心）来证明2-Droop核心聚类总是存在。关键思想是只从智能体所在位置选取中心，并通过博弈论的核心概念来构造满足公平性质的聚类。

Result: 证明了2是Droop核心近似比的最优值（下界是紧的），即2-Droop核心聚类总是存在，且中心只需选自智能体位置。该结果解决了Aronov等人的β-plurality问题。值得注意的是，本文主要结果由ChatGPT-5.6-Sol通过作者多轮交互生成，作者验证并重写了证明。

Conclusion: 本文通过博弈论工具（Scarf定理）解决了比例公平聚类中Droop核心的近似紧界问题，不仅填补了理论间隙，还解决了一个相关的开放性难题（β-plurality问题）。此外，该论文也展示了AI辅助数学研究的一种新模式——AI生成证明，人工验证与澄清。

Abstract: This paper studies the problem of proportionally fair clustering, where the goal is to select $k$ ``centers'' from a metric space that fairly represent a set of agents who also lie in the metric space. Specifically, we focus on finding a clustering satisfying a fairness property known as the Droop core. In the practical special case in which the set of feasible center locations contains every agent location, the previous best-known result guaranteed a $(1 + \sqrt{2})$-approximation of the Droop core, while the best-known lower bound was $2$. In this paper, we show that this lower bound is tight and that a clustering in the $2$-Droop core always exists. Further, we show that such a clustering can be achieved by only selecting centers from locations in the metric space where an agent resides. We establish this using Scarf's theorem guaranteeing a nonempty core for balanced non-transferable utility games. This result has several interesting corollaries. Most notably, it resolves the $β$-plurality problem of Aronov et al. [2021] for general metric spaces. The main result of this paper was generated by $\mathtt{ChatGPT}$-$\mathtt{5.6}$-$\mathtt{Sol}$ through a series of interactions with the authors. The authors of this paper verified the generated proof and rewrote it for clarity.

</details>


### [710] [Improving Randomized Metric Distortion to 2.3282](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29308)
*Nisarg Shah*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的随机大小稳定彩票（RSL）机制，将随机化投票规则的失真上界从2.5降低到2.3282，打破了此前Charikar等人的2.753和后续改进的2.5界限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在度量社会选择中，随机化投票规则的失真问题此前最优上界为2.5，但没有任何混合方式能进一步改进。作者希望在引入新的机制后突破这一瓶颈，进一步缩小随机化规则与确定性规则（失真为3）之间的差距。

Method: 引入随机大小稳定彩票（RSL_D），其中D是正整数的随机变量。RSL保证随机选民偏好某固定候选人c超过从RSL中D次独立抽样得到的最爱候选人的概率至多为E[1/(D+1)]。该定义推广了固定k的稳定k彩票，且最小最大论证可自然推广。主要贡献是展示如何利用随机D的稳定性来限定失真：将适当选择的RSL与Integrated Veto混合，使用无限维锥线性规划对偶、启发式非线性优化和Bernstein基上的精确有理验证相结合的方法证明失真上界为11641/5000=2.3282。

Result: 通过混合适当选择的随机大小稳定彩票与Integrated Veto，得到失真上界11641/5000=2.3282，显著优于此前的最佳结果2.5。

Conclusion: 随机大小的稳定彩票是一个有力的新工具，能够突破固定大小彩票的局限，为度量社会选择中的随机化投票规则提供了更紧的失真界。

Abstract: In metric social choice, each voter ranks a set of $m$ candidates by her distance to them in an unknown metric space. The cost of a candidate is its average distance to the voters. A randomized voting rule must use only the rankings to choose a lottery over candidates. Its distortion is the worst-case ratio between the expected cost under the lottery it returns and the cost of the best candidate. Charikar, Ramakrishnan, Wang, and Wu [JACM 2024] prove an upper bound of $2.753$, establishing a constant separation from deterministic rules, for which the best achievable distortion is $3$. Independently, Frank [arXiv:2608.17863] and Ye [arXiv:2608.21202] improve the bound to $2.5$, using an equal mixture of maximal lottery and Integrated Veto. The existing arguments do not yield a better bound with any mixture of these rules.
  We break this barrier with a new ingredient, a random-size stable lottery. Let $D$ be a random variable over the domain of positive integers. A random-size stable lottery $\mathrm{RSL}_D$ guarantees that the probability of a random voter preferring any fixed candidate $c$ to her favorite of $D$ i.i.d. draws from $\mathrm{RSL}_D$ is at most $\mathbb{E}[1/(D+1)]$, where the probability also averages over $D$. When $D=k$ deterministically, this reduces to the stable $k$-lottery of Charikar, Ramakrishnan, Tan, and Wang [EC 2025]; the case $k=1$ is precisely a maximal lottery. Their minimax argument for a fixed $k$ easily generalizes to a random $D$. Our main contribution is to show how stability with respect to a random $D$ can be used to bound distortion. By mixing a suitably chosen random-size stable lottery with Integrated Veto, we get distortion at most $11641/5000=2.3282$. The proof combines infinite-dimensional conic linear-programming duality, heuristic nonlinear optimization, and exact rational verification via the Bernstein basis.

</details>


### [711] [Fair Division Under Boolean Valuations: Beyond Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29497)
*Nisarg Shah,Paritosh Verma*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了代理具有任意两级偏好（布尔值偏好，非单调非可加、且不要求归一化）时不可分割物品的公平分配问题。由于偏好非单调，EF1和EFX各有多个变体，本文探讨这些变体在不同条件下（经济效率、激励相容、可行性约束、随机化）的存在性，发现结果取决于归一化代理的数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平分配研究通常假设偏好是单调、可加或归一化的，但现实中代理的偏好可能更一般化（两级布尔偏好且非单调）。此外，非单调偏好导致EF1和EFX的变体增多，需要系统研究这些变体的存在性及其与其他性质的相容性。

Method: 本文通过理论分析系统研究两级布尔偏好下EF1和EFX各变体的存在性，考察其与帕累托效率、激励相容性、可行性约束（如基数约束）及基于彩票的随机化机制的结合，并依据归一化代理（对空集赋予低布尔值的代理）的数量刻画存在性边界。

Result: 研究显示公平分配的存在性景观关键取决于归一化代理的数量。不同EF1/EFX变体在不同条件下（结合效率、激励相容、可行性约束、随机化）呈现出截然不同的存在性结果。

Conclusion: 两级布尔偏好且非单调、非归一化的公平分配问题具有丰富的存在性结构，归一化代理的数量是决定各变体EF1/EFX是否存在的关键参数。论文还声明使用了AI辅助推导并人工验证了正确性。

Abstract: We study fair division of indivisible items when agents have arbitrary two-level preferences: the value of each agent for any set of items is Boolean, which need not be monotone or additive. Notably, we do not impose the standard assumption of normalization, i.e., different agents may value the empty set at different Boolean levels. Since the preferences are nonmonotone, envy-freeness up to one item (EF1) and envy-freeness up to any item (EFX) each admit several variants, depending on which items are tested for removal and whether they are removed from the envious agent's bundle or the envied agent's bundle. This paper investigates the existence of these variants of EF1 and EFX, on their own and together with economic efficiency, incentive compatibility, feasibility constraints, and lottery-based randomization. Our results highlight that the existence landscape depends crucially on the number of normalized agents, who value the empty bundle at the lower Boolean level.
  The authors used significant assistance from GPT-5.6-Sol for deriving theoretical results, verified any AI-generated proofs for correctness, and expanded on the exposition and simplified arguments, with the aid of GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude Opus 5.

</details>


### [712] [Fair Division of Graphs: Beyond Traceability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29902)
*Nicolas Bousquet,Frank Connor,Agnès Totschnig,Sébastien Zeitoun*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究图结构资源上的公平分配问题（EF1_outer），证明了非哈密顿路径图的EF1_outer分配存在性，推进了树的EF1_outer谱猜想，并证明判定EF1_outer分配存在性是NP完全的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典公平分配问题在资源具有图结构且代理必须获得连通束时变得显著更困难。EF1_outer公平性（去除一个不断开束的顶点即可消除嫉妒）对土地划分、网络分配等应用至关重要，但其在图上的存在性和复杂性仍有许多开放问题。

Method: 通过图论与算法复杂性分析相结合的方法：1）为无限族非可迹图建立EF1_outer分配存在性定理，推广Bilò等人的可迹图结果；2）对Chen和Zwicker关于树的EF1_outer谱猜想取得进展；3）通过从已知NP完全问题归约，证明二元加性估值下判定EF1_outer分配存在性是NP完全的。

Result: 1）证明无限族非可迹图存在EF1_outer分配，回答中心开放问题；2）推进树的EF1_outer谱猜想；3）证明判定EF1_outer分配存在性为NP完全，解决开放复杂性难题。

Conclusion: 研究深化了图论与公平分配之间的连接，为结构化资源环境中的公平性研究提供了新工具，同时揭示了EF1_outer问题在计算复杂性上的内在困难。

Abstract: In this paper, we study fair division problems in which resources are structured as graphs and agents must receive connected bundles. This connectivity requirement fundamentally alters the problem, making it significantly more challenging than its classical counterpart. We focus on the fairness notion of $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$, where envy can be eliminated by removing at most one vertex whose deletion does not disconnect the bundle -- a critical constraint for applications such as land division and network allocation.
  Our first result extends prior work by establishing the existence of $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ allocations for an infinite family of non-traceable graphs (that is, graphs that do not admit a Hamiltonian path), answering a central open question and generalizing Bilò et al.'s result for traceable graphs. We then make progress on a conjecture concerning the $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ spectrum of trees due to Chen and Zwicker. Finally, we complement our structural results with algorithmic insights, showing that deciding the existence of an $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ allocation is NP-complete even for binary additive valuations, thereby resolving an open complexity question. Taken together, our results deepen the connection between graph theory and fair division, and offer new tools for studying fairness in structured resource environments.

</details>


### [713] [Learning Proportional Committees from Violation Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30111)
*Frank Connor*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了比例代表制审批委员会中的违规反馈学习问题。学习者在每轮提出一个大小为k的委员会，oracle要么接受提议，要么针对固定的隐藏审批档案选择性地揭示一个代表性违规。文章比较了完整见证反馈（揭示违规程度、遗漏候选人和受影响的选民群体）与仅候选者反馈（仅揭示候选者）两种模式，目标概念为PJR+和EJR+。在所有研究场景中，被拒绝提议的数量仅取决于k，与选民和候选人数量无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解在委员会选举中如何通过违规反馈高效地学习满足比例代表制属性的委员会，并探索不同反馈信息量（完整见证vs仅候选者）对学习复杂度的影响。

Method: 对PJR+和EJR+两种目标概念，分别在完整见证反馈和仅候选者反馈两种模型下，推导确定性及随机化算法的最优拒绝复杂度界限，并证明相应的上下界。

Result: 对于PJR+，两种反馈模型下确定性及随机化的最优拒绝复杂度均为k。对于EJR+，完整见证反馈下证明Ω(k^{3/2})确定性下界并给出O(k²log k)的多项式时间算法；仅候选者反馈下，随机化通过均匀随机删除达到O(k²log k)期望拒绝次数，确定性穷举分支给出2^{O(k²(log k)²)}界限；即使有完整见证反馈，随机化学习者可能仍需k次拒绝。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了不同比例代表制概念（PJR+与EJR+）和不同反馈模型下学习复杂度的显著差异：PJR+相对简单且反馈类型影响不大，而EJR+更为复杂，且反馈信息量对确定性算法有本质影响。

Abstract: We study violation-feedback learning of proportionally representative approval-based committees. In each round, a learner proposes a committee of size $k$. An oracle either accepts the proposal or adversarially selects a representation violation with respect to a single fixed hidden approval profile. We compare \emph{full-witness feedback}, which reveals the violation level, an omitted candidate, and the affected voter group, with \emph{candidate-only feedback}, which reveals only that candidate. The target notions are proportional justified representation plus (PJR+) and extended justified representation plus (EJR+).
  In every setting we study, the number of rejected proposals can be bounded solely in terms of $k$, with no dependence on the numbers of voters and candidates. For PJR+, the optimal deterministic and randomized rejection complexities equal $k$ under both feedback models. For EJR+, the picture is more nuanced. Under full-witness feedback, we prove an $Ω(k^{3/2})$ deterministic lower bound and give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm using $O(k^2\log k)$ rejections. Under candidate-only feedback, randomization achieves $O(k^2\log k)$ expected rejections via uniform random deletion, while deterministic exhaustive branching gives a $2^{O(k^2(\log k)^2)}$ rejection bound. Even with full-witness feedback, randomized learners may require $k$ rejections.

</details>


### [714] [Rival-Injective Allocations: Support-List Structure and Maximum-Anchor EFX$_0$ Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30203)
*Junshuo Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究非负可加估值下的完整分配，通过商品的正支撑集聚焦于"对任意商品无嫉妒"（EFX₀）的全商品形式。作者定义了ri-injective（RI）端点所有权，证明其等价于对商品支撑重叠图的正常列表着色，并提出基于对支撑商品和任意例外商品的容量准则与约束满足问题（CSP）。他们通过反向贪心着色在O(nm²)时间内构造RI分配，证明了最大单例锚定+残差支撑列表退化条件足以保证全商品EFX₀，并给出两个显式反例族表明该条件并非必要。文章还比较了纯多重图和高围长/受控重数假设，并讨论了最大锚定证书类的识别复杂度（未完全解决）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EFX₀作为一种公平分配概念在非负可加估值下尚缺乏完整刻画。作者希望通过将分配问题转化为图着色问题（RI所有权等价于列表着色），建立结构化条件以构造全商品EFX₀分配，并识别现有充分条件的局限性。

Method: 将EFX₀分配问题转化为商品间支撑重叠图的正常列表着色问题（RI所有权）；对任意例外商品固定所有者后得到对支撑商品的成对容量准则和有限域CSP；提出"最大单例锚定+残差支撑列表退化"的构造算法（反向贪心着色，O(nm²)时间）；通过显式反例族验证条件的必要性；并与纯多重图、高围径/受控重数等已有假设进行比较。

Result: RI所有权与列表着色精确等价；对支撑商品所有权准则即对容量充分必要条件；满足锚定+退化条件时可构造全商品EFX₀分配。给出了两个反例族（固定4×10支撑面的22维开锥，及对任意n≥4含两个全支撑商品、m=(n-1)(n-2)+2的族），表明未锚定的列表退化并非必要，且现有假设不能蕴含该结果。最大锚定证书类的识别复杂度未解决。

Conclusion: 本文为全商品EFX₀提供了一种基于图着色和CSP的结构化刻画，给出了高效的构造性充分条件，同时以显式反例证明了条件的非必要性。作者明确指出结果限于RI所有权，并未解决一般情形下四智能体十商品的EFX₀存在性问题。

Abstract: We study complete allocations under nonnegative additive valuations through the positive supports of goods, focusing on the all-good form of envy-freeness up to any good (EFX$_0$). We define rival-injective (RI) endpoint ownership: every good with nonempty positive support is assigned to an agent who values it positively, and every ordered observer--owner pair is used by at most one good. RI ownership is exactly proper list coloring of the graph joining goods whose positive supports overlap in at least two agents. For pair-supported goods with arbitrary exceptional goods, fixing the exceptional owners yields a necessary-and-sufficient pair-capacity criterion and an exact finite-domain owner constraint satisfaction problem (CSP). Every RI allocation in which each agent's own bundle is worth at least her maximum-valued singleton is all-good EFX$_0$. A specified injective choice of maximum-singleton anchors, together with residual support-list degeneracy, constructs such an allocation by reverse greedy coloring in $O(nm^2)$ time. We give two explicit witness families: a nonempty relatively open, 22-dimensional cone on a fixed $4\times10$ support face, and a family for every $n\ge4$ with two universal-support goods and $m=(n-1)(n-2)+2$ goods. Both fail unanchored list degeneracy and are not implied by the explicit pure-multigraph or published high-girth/controlled-multiplicity hypotheses compared here. We also study recognition of the maximum-anchor certificate class, leaving its general complexity unresolved. The exact list-coloring and pair-capacity results concern RI ownership, not general EFX$_0$ existence; unrestricted four-agent, ten-good all-good EFX$_0$ remains unresolved.

</details>


### [715] [Residual Maximin Share: Exact Finite-Agent Frontier, Sparse Extremizers, and Threshold Cuts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30257)
*Qinghua Qin*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了残差最大最小份额（RMMS）与经典最大最小份额（MMS）在最坏情况下的比值精确为 2d_n/(3d_n-1)（d_n 为不超过 n 的最大奇数），形成了奇偶交替的阶梯状精确边界并单调收敛到 2/3。文章进一步构造了仅需线性支撑（约 5n/2 个物品）的三值极值实例，通过二部运输图证明了最小支撑为 3q，并给出了 RMMS 的 min-max 表示及整数加性估值下残差自可行的充要条件（packing-covering 条件）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在动态分配过程中，公平分配份额（如 RMMS）的保证程度是核心问题。此前密度平衡分析只给出了有限智能体的下界，本文旨在证明这些下界是精确的，并深入理解极值实例的组合结构以及 RMMS 的一般结构特征。

Method: 1) 证明有限智能体下界精确性，得到精确比值 2d_n/(3d_n-1)；2) 构造三值线性支撑的极值实例族（奇偶不同支撑规模）；3) 将双重划分建模为二部运输图，证明最小支撑 q+d-1=3q；4) 建立 RMMS 的一般 min-max 表示，并对整数加性估值给出残差自可行的 packing-covering 充要条件。

Result: 精确最坏情况下界 inf(RMMS/MMS)=2d_n/(3d_n-1)，收敛到 2/3；极值实例可用线性数量物品（奇数 n 时 (5n-3)/2，偶数 n 时 (5n-4)/2）实现；最小支撑证明为 3q，且最小支撑下 filler 唯一刚性；RMMS 满足一般 min-max 表示及整数估值下的 packing-covering 刻画。

Conclusion: 这些精确常数确立了基于份额的独裁者（share-based lone-divider）算法所能达到的公平保证的严格极限，为动态分配中的公平性边界提供了完整刻画。

Abstract: Residual maximin share (RMMS) is the largest share threshold that remains guaranteeable throughout dynamic allocation processes, even after previously allocated, lower-valued bundles are removed from the item pool. For additive valuations, recent density-balance analyses established finite-agent lower bounds comparing RMMS with the classical maximin share (MMS). In this paper, we prove that these finite-agent lower bounds are exact. Specifically, if $d_n$ denotes the largest odd integer at most $n$, the worst-case ratio satisfies $\inf_{M,v:\operatorname{MMS}>0}\frac{\operatorname{RMMS}(M,v,n)}{\operatorname{MMS}(M,v,n)}=\frac{2d_n}{3d_n-1}$. Consequently, the exact additive frontier forms consecutive odd-even plateaus and converges monotonically to $2/3$. We then investigate the combinatorial structure of extremal instances. While naive witnesses require $Θ(n^2)$ items, we construct an explicit three-valued family achieving the exact boundary with only linear support: $(5n-3)/2$ items for odd $n$ and $(5n-4)/2$ items for even $n$. Its low-valued block supports two exact partitions that simultaneously certify the MMS benchmark and the residual obstruction. By modeling these dual partitions as a bipartite transportation graph, we prove that this block attains the absolute minimum support $q+d-1=3q$. At minimum support, any two-valued filler is uniquely rigid up to relabeling. Finally, we establish structural characterizations of RMMS. A general min--max representation applies to all finite monotone valuations. For integer additive valuations, we prove that a threshold $T$ is residual self-feasible if and only if every subset cut satisfies a packing-covering condition. Because RMMS is pointwise maximal among residual self-feasible shares, these exact constants establish a tight limitation on the fairness guarantees achievable by share-based lone-divider algorithms.

</details>


### [716] [The Exact MMS Guarantees of EFX and PMMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30267)
*Qinghua Qin*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文精确确定了不可分割商品公平分配中，局部公平标准EFX和PMMS与全局MMS保障之间的最优普适因子为10/17。通过组合充电论证证明下界，并构造达到紧致的分配族，同时建立了与调度均衡之间的精确对应关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EFX和PMMS是局部公平标准，而MMS是全局基准，此前二者的定量关系尚未被精确确定。理解局部公平概念能提供多大的全局保障，是公平分配理论中的核心开放问题。

Method: 1) 通过初始归约证明EFX和PMMS都蕴含相同的局部条件（删除外部束中最少价值商品后其价值不超过焦点束）；2) 使用三段凹权重函数将该局部条件转化为全局10/17保障；3) 构造显式的完整分配族同时满足PMMS和EFX₀，其MMS比率收敛至10/17证明紧致性；4) 建立与调度均衡的对应关系：EFX-to-MMS比率等于自私同构机器覆盖的纯无政府代价倒数，PMMS-to-MMS比率等于基于精确成对机器重分的局部间隙倒数。

Result: 证明了ρ^{EFX→MMS}=ρ^{PMMS→MMS}=10/17，这是两个局部公平概念的最优普适因子；推广得到α-EFX ⇒ (10α/17)-MMS；建立了与调度均衡的精确对应关系，揭示了10/17常数在两类问题中共同出现的深层原因。

Conclusion: 本文精确刻画了局部公平保证（EFX/PMMS）与全局公平基准（MMS）之间的定量关系，常数10/17是最优且紧致的。与调度理论的对应关系不仅解释了常数的来源，也为跨领域研究提供了新视角。

Abstract: Envy-freeness up to any good (EFX) and pairwise maximin share (PMMS) are standard local fairness criteria for indivisible goods, whereas maximin share (MMS) is a global benchmark. We determine the exact quantitative relationship between these local fairness notions and the global MMS guarantee under nonnegative additive valuations. We show that the optimal universal factor for both notions is $ρ^{\mathrm{EFX}\to\mathrm{MMS}}=ρ^{\mathrm{PMMS}\to\mathrm{MMS}}=\frac{10}{17}$. We prove the lower bound by a combinatorial charging argument. After an initial reduction, both EFX and PMMS imply the same local condition on every foreign bundle from the perspective of a focal agent: deleting its least valuable good leaves value at most the focal bundle. A three-piece concave weight function translates this local condition into the global $10/17$ guarantee. We then construct an explicit family of complete allocations that are simultaneously PMMS and EFX$_0$, whose MMS ratios converge to $10/17$, showing that both constants are tight even in the presence of zero-valued goods. The argument also gives $α$-EFX $\Rightarrow (10α/17)$-MMS. Finally, we establish an exact correspondence between these fair-division guarantees and scheduling equilibria. For every fixed number of agents $n$, the EFX-to-MMS extremal ratio equals the reciprocal of the pure price of anarchy for selfish identical-machine covering. Similarly, the PMMS-to-MMS ratio equals the reciprocal of a locality gap based on exact pairwise machine repartition. These correspondences explain why the constant $10/17$ governs both problems.

</details>


### [717] [Mechanism Design for Facility Location Games Under a Prelocated Facility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30292)
*Genjie Qin,Qizhi Fang,Wenjing Liu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究在预设设施（prelocated facility）下定位一个新同质设施（homogeneous facility）的机制设计问题。代理位于实线或圆上，位置为私人信息，成本为到最近设施的距离。目标是设计策略证明（strategy-proof）的近似机制来最小化最大成本或社会成本，覆盖一般设置（代理可在预设设施两侧）和特殊设置（所有代理在预设设施同侧）。在线上：一般设置下最大成本目标给出2近似的确定性机制（下界1.5-ε），社会成本目标给出n上界及1.5/1.0425的下界；特殊设置下最大成本给出5/3随机机制，社会成本给出(n-1)确定性机制。在圆上，最大成本目标给出2近似确定性机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机源于现实场景中已有设施存在时需新设同质设施的问题（如已有学校/医院旁新建类似设施）。由于代理位置为私人信息，需设计策略证明机制保证真实报告；同时需同时优化最大成本或社会成本目标，并适应代理位于预设设施两侧或同侧的不同设置，以及实线和圆两种几何结构。

Method: 针对实线和圆上的代理，分别在一般设置（代理可在预设设施两侧）和特殊设置（代理都在同侧）下，结合最大成本和社会成本两种目标，设计并分析确定性及随机化的策略证明机制，同时给出相应的近似比上界与下界。

Result: 实线一般设置：最大成本下确定性机制2-近似（最优），随机机制下界1.5-ε；社会成本下确定性上界n，确定性下界1.5，随机下界1.0425。实线特殊设置：最大成本下随机机制5/3-近似，社会成本下确定性机制(n-1)-近似。圆上：最大成本下确定性2-近似机制。

Conclusion: 作者系统地刻画了带预设设施的同质设施定位问题在策略证明约束下的近似能力，给出了实线和圆上多种设置与目标组合的机制设计结果及紧或接近紧的上下界，为该类问题提供了理论基准。

Abstract: We study the problem of locating a new homogeneous facility under a prelocated facility. Here, a set of $n$ agents is located on a real line or a circle, each of whom has her location as private information, and her cost is the (expected) distance from her location to the nearest facility. Our goal is to design mechanisms which can approximately minimize the maximum cost or the social cost while eliciting agents' private information truthfully (i.e., strategy-proof).
  Based on real-life scenarios, we consider the problem in two settings: the general setting where each agent can be located at both sides of the prelocated facility, and the special setting where all the agents are located at the same side of the prelocated facility. For agents on a line, in the general setting, we design the best possible deterministic strategy-proof mechanism with $2$-approximation and provide a lower bound of $1.5-ε\textbf{ }(ε>0)$ for any randomized strategy-proof mechanism under the maximum cost objective. For the social cost, we obtain an upper bound of $n$ for deterministic strategy-proof mechanisms and lower bounds of $1.5$ and $1.0425$ for any deterministic strategy-proof mechanism and any randomized strategy-proof mechanism, respectively. In the special setting, we further provide a randomized strategy-proof $5/3$-approximation mechanism for the maximum cost and a deterministic strategy-proof $(n-1)$-approximation mechanism for the social cost. For agents on a circle, we provide a deterministic strategy-proof 2-approximation mechanism under the maximum cost objective.

</details>


### [718] [LangBP: Language-Guided Reasoning and Acting for Joint Bidding and Pricing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30343)
*Jiaqi Ding,Chuan Yang,Linghui Meng,Shengsheng Niu,Jie He,Zhangang Lin,Ching Law,Xiaolin Fang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: LangBP是一个用于语言引导的联合出价与定价的分层框架，通过语义决策变换器（S-DT）从指令和轨迹历史预测目标状态再恢复联合动作，并采用执行分组策略优化（EGPO）配合上下文-效果验证器（CEV）平衡策略更新。实验在AuctionNet上超越强基线，并在大型电商平台上线A/B测试中展现业务收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动出价方法主要依赖数值轨迹建模，难以解释广告活动上下文和表达高层策略。虽然LLM可补充推理能力，但已有的语言引导方法存在两个局限：(1) 仅在语言策略条件下生成动作，未建模对应状态变化，难以区分策略理解错误与动作生成错误；(2) 不同指令可能产生相似执行效果，导致策略更新跨效果不平衡。

Method: 提出分层框架LangBP，包含两个核心组件：(1) 语义决策变换器（S-DT），先从指令和轨迹历史预测目标状态，再通过逆动力学恢复联合动作；(2) 执行分组策略优化（EGPO），使用上下文-效果验证器（CEV）对候选效果打分，并在效果组间平衡策略更新。

Result: 在AuctionNet数据集上，LangBP优于强基线方法；在线A/B测试进一步证明在大型电商平台真实部署中带来了业务收益。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模状态转移将语言策略与动作生成解耦，并引入效果分组的策略优化机制，LangBP有效解决了语言引导方法在联合出价定价问题中的局限，在离线与在线场景均验证了有效性。

Abstract: Auto-bidding is a long-horizon sequential decision problem for maximizing conversion value under budget and key performance indicator (KPI) constraints. Recent work extends this task from bidding alone to joint bidding and pricing, where a policy controls bidding decisions and pricing corrections. Existing methods mainly rely on numerical trajectory modeling, which offers limited support for interpreting campaign context and expressing high-level strategies. Large language models (LLMs) can complement this paradigm with their reasoning capabilities. However, existing language-guided methods have two limitations. First, they condition actions on language strategies without modeling the corresponding state changes, making it difficult to distinguish errors in strategy understanding from errors in action generation. Second, different instructions can produce similar execution effects, leading to imbalanced policy updates across effects. We propose LangBP, a hierarchical framework for language-guided joint bidding and pricing. LangBP's Semantic Decision Transformer (S-DT) predicts target states from the instruction and the trajectory history, then recovers the joint action via inverse dynamics. We further propose Execution-Grouped Policy Optimization (EGPO), which scores candidate effects with a Context--Effect Verifier (CEV) and balances policy updates across effect groups. Experiments on AuctionNet show that LangBP outperforms strong baselines, and online A/B tests further demonstrate business gains in real-world deployment on a large-scale e-commerce platform.

</details>


### [719] [Test-time Reinforcement Learning in Imperfect Information Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30635)
*Ondrej Kubicek,Viliam Lisy,Tuomas Sandholm*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了两玩家零和完美信息不完全博弈中的测试时推理问题，将gadget game这一表格方法扩展到强化学习/策略梯度设置中，通过隐式表示而非显式构建来消除子博弈规模限制，并证明了正则化策略梯度算法即使没有gadget game也能限制策略退化，实验表明测试时训练能显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时推理已在游戏和语言模型等域表现优异，但在两玩家零和完美信息不完全博弈中，具有正式性能保证的测试时策略修改仍具挑战性。现有解决方案仅局限于表格方法或单步梯度更新，缺乏可扩展的通用方法。
